A&N UT Health Mission Cold Chain Assistant (Immunization) Recruitment 2025 Overview

Company Name Andaman & Nicobar Union Territory Health Mission & Office of the State Health Society (A&N Islands) (A&N UT Health Mission)
Post Name Cold Chain Assistant (Immunization)
No of Posts 01
Salary Consolidated Salary (In Rs.): Rs. 25,000/- per month.
Qualification Bachelor’s Degree in Science, knowledge of logistic and supply management or public health or ITI in R/AC TRAT and PGDCA with 2–3 years of experience in cold chain management, logistics or a related field, strong technical knowledge of cold chain management, and excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Age Limit Age: Not more than 60 years.
Start Date for Apply  Not Mentioned
Last Date for Apply  09.01.2026 (The last date of receipt of application is 09.01.2026).
Official Website Not Mentioned

A&N UT Health Mission Cold Chain Assistant (Immunization) Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Name of the Post No. of Post Consolidated Salary (In Rs.)
Cold Chain Assistant (Immunization) 01 Rs. 25,000/-

Eligibility Criteria

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Science, knowledge of logistic and supply management or public health or ITI in R/AC TRAT and PGDCA.
  • Experience: At least 2–3 years of experience in cold chain management, logistics, or a related field.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong technical knowledge of cold chain management, including equipment maintenance and temperature monitoring.
  • Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with stakeholders at all levels.

Salary/Stipend

  • Consolidated Salary (In Rs.): Rs. 25,000/- per month is payable for the post of Cold Chain Assistant (Immunization).

Age Limit

  • Age: Not more than 60 years.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the vacancy notice.

 

Selection Process

  • The appointment will be made purely on merit basis.
  • Only the eligible candidates who have submitted application are required to attend the interview.
  • No individual call letters will be issued for appearing in the interview.
  • No TA/DA shall be payable for appearing in the interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • The appointment will be made purely on merit basis.
  • Interested candidates fulfilling the eligibility are requested to apply in the prescribed format in A4 size paper.
  • While applying for the post, the applicant should ensure that he/she fulfils the eligibility and other norms and that the particulars furnished by him/her are correct in all respects; suppression of information would lead to disqualification at any stage.
  • Interested candidates shall be ready to work in remote / hard areas as and when directed and also may have to travel to remote/hard areas as required.
  • Incomplete/defective applications, applications without photograph of the candidates shall be summarily rejected.
  • The engagement will be on Contract basis for period of 11 months from the day of signing the contract within the stipulated period as per the offer of appointment letter.
  • Any extension or renewal of appointment beyond 11 months will be subject to a review on performance and contribution in work and an agreement on mutually agreed terms.
  • This would not be construed in any manner a promise for the regular appointment under State Health Society (A&N Islands).

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates fulfilling the eligibility are requested to apply in the prescribed format in A4 size paper.
  • Attested photocopies of Mark Sheets and Certificates in support of Educational Qualifications (Degree, Post-graduation, Professional Qualifications etc. as applicable) must be enclosed.
  • Experience certificate(s) specifying nature and period of experience should be enclosed.
  • Application should be sent in a cover superscripted “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF “……………………………………”
  • Applications should be addressed to: A & N Union Territory Health Mission, Office of State Health Society (A&N Islands), Quarter No. AP-III, Atlanta Point, Sri Vijaya Puram-744104, Telefax: 03192-234965, e-mail: [email protected].

  • Qualifications: Senior Assistant (Electronics): Diploma in Electronics/Telecommunication/Radio Engineering. Junior Assistant (HR): Graduation + 30/25 w.p.m English/Hindi Typing speed. Junior Assistant (Fire Services): 10th Pass + 3 years approved regular Diploma in Mechanical/Automobile/Fire with minimum 50% marks; OR 12th Pass (Regular Study) with 50% marks.
  • Essential qualifications: Senior Assistant (Electronics): Diploma in Electronics/Telecommunication/Radio Engineering. Junior Assistant (HR): Graduation + 30/25 w.p.m English/Hindi Typing speed. Junior Assistant (Fire Services): 10th Pass + 3 years approved regular Diploma in Mechanical/Automobile/Fire with minimum 50% marks; OR 12th Pass (Regular Study) with 50% marks.
  • Experience: Senior Assistant (Electronics): Two years (2) relevant experience in the concerned discipline.

Salary/Stipend

  • Senior Assistant (Electronics): Rs. 36000-3%-110000
  • Junior Assistant (HR) and Junior Assistant (Fire Services): Rs. 31000-3%-92000

Age Limit (as on 06-12-2025)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 30 years
  • 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)
  • 5 years for SC/ST
  • Upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for candidates who are in regular service of AIRPORTS AUTHORITY OF INDIA.

Application Fee

  • General, EWS and OBC Category: Rs. 1000/-
  • Women/SC/ST/PWD/Ex-Servicemen and Apprentices who have completed 01 year Apprenticeship Training in AAI: No application fee

Important Dates

Date Description
12/12/2025 Opening Date for On-Line Application
11/01/2026 Last Date for On-Line Application

Selection Process

  • Senior Assistant (Electronics): Written Exam (Computer Based Test). Duration of Exam: 2(Two) hours. Document Verification/Skill Test.
  • Junior Assistant (HR): Written Exam (Computer Based Test). Duration of Exam-2 (Two) hours. Computer Literacy test in MS Office.
  • Junior Assistant (Fire Services): Written Exam (Computer Based Test)- Duration: 2 (Two) hours. Physical Measurement Test, Driving Test, Physical Endurance Test.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only candidates who are Domicile of Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland and Tripura for the posts of Senior Assistant (Electronics), Junior Assistant (HR) and Junior Assistant (Fire Services) for its various airports in North Eastern Region.
  • No application through any other mode will be accepted.
  • The number of vacancies are tentative. Airports Authority of India (AAI) reserves the right to increase or decrease the vacancies depending upon the future requirements. AAI also reserves the right to modify/cancel the recruitment process, if need so arises without issuing any further notice or any reasons what so ever. The decision of the Management will be final and binding and no appeal shall be entertained.
  • Definition of various categories of disability identified suitable for the post shall be defined under RPwD Act. 2016 and subsequent amendments thereof.
  • Ex-Servicemen who have already secured employment in civil sector under Center Government/State Government of in Group-‘C’ & ‘D’ posts on regular basis after availing the benefits of reservation given of Ex-Servicemen to their re-employment are not eligible for reservation for appointment under Ex-Servicemen categories. However, they are eligible for age relaxation only. Age relaxation/ESM reservation is not admissible to sons, daughter and dependent of ESM. Therefore, such candidates should not indicate their category as Ex-Servicemen.
  • Disabled candidates are not eligible for the post of Junior Assistant (Fire Service) due to specific nature of job.
  • The vacancy reserved for Ex-SM/Ex-Agniveers/PWD will be filled from any category and adjusted horizontally against respective categories viz-UR/SC/ST/OBC as the case may be depending upon the category to which the selected candidate belongs to, within the respective total vacancies of the posts.
  • Fees will be accepted through online net banking, Debit card, Credit cards or Internet Banking/UPI etc.
  • Excluding of Bank Charges & Service Tax.
  • For detailed Notification, Please refer AAI website.
  • Candidates should have a valid personal e-mail ID & Mobile No. and must ensure that it is active during the entire recruitment process.
  • The eligibility with respect to Age, Education Qualification and Experience etc. will be determined as on 06/12/2025.
  • Where CGPA/OGPA/DGPA/CPI etc. is awarded in the essential qualification degree examination, percentage (%) of marks shall be arrived by applying the following formula Eg: If CGPA/OGPA/DGPA/CPI is 6.75 (Out of 10), then equivalent percentage (%) of marks would be 6.75*9.5=64.125%.
  • The date of declaration of result/issuance of mark sheets shall be deemed to be the date of acquiring of qualification and there shall be no relaxation on this account.
  • The education and other qualification must be obtained from Govt. recognized institutions as per laid down criteria by Central Govt. for the purpose.
  • AAI will not bear any liability on account of salary/leave salary/pension contribution etc. if any, of previous employment of any candidate already working in Central Government/Autonomous Institution/State Government.

How to Apply

  • Candidates shall apply only ONLINE through Airports Authority of India website www.aai.aero under tab “CAREERS” for the above posts.
  • Post submission, the candidate will be re-directed to make the online payment of application fee.
  • Kindly verify the details and make the payment for application fee via the different payment modes.
  • After successful payment of application fee, candidate will be redirected to his/her application form.

Advertisement
Company Name NAMO Medical Education & Research Institute and NAMO College of Allied Health Sciences (NAMO MERI)
Post Name Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident, Junior Resident, Tutor, Statistician cum Tutor, Epidemiologist cum Assistant Professor, Lab Technician, Medical Social Worker, Health Educator
No of Posts 72 Posts
Salary Rs. 12,000/- to Rs. 3,00,000/- per month
Qualification MBBS to MD/MS/DNB/M.Sc-Ph.D
Age Limit Below 45 years (55 years for specific departments)
Start Date for Apply 12/12/2025
Last Date for Apply 26/12/2025 (Non-Teaching Posts)
Official Website www.dnh.gov.in, namomeri.in

NAMO MERI Notification 2025 PDF

NAMO MERI Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

A) Teaching Posts under NAMO Medical Education & Research Institute:

Post Name Total
Professor 8
Associate Professor 8
Assistant Professor 13
Epidemiologist cum Assistant Professor 1
Senior Resident 19

Sr. No. Post Name Department No. of Vacancy

C) Posts under NAMO College of Allied Health Sciences:

Sr. No. Post Name Department No. of Vacancy
1 Professor Bachelor of Occupational Therapy 1
2 Associate Professor Bachelor of Science in Medical Radiology 1
3 Associate Professor Medicine 2
Total Allied Health Sciences Posts 4

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications:

  • Professor (MD, MS, DNB, M.Sc-Ph.D):
    • Associate Professor in the subject for three years in a recognized medical institution OR
    • Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces having at least three years of experience as Associate Professor in the relevant speciality in a teaching hospital of the Armed Forces
    • Must have published at least two research publications after becoming Associate Professor and must be amongst the first three authors
    • Must have completed the Basic Course in Biomedical Research from a recognised medical institution
    • Shall be required to undergo Basic Course in Medical Education provided their broad specialty subject is covered under undergraduate training
  • Associate Professor (MD, MS, DNB, M.Sc-Ph.D):
    • Assistant Professor in the subject for four years in a recognised medical institution or for five years for those appointed directly as Assistant Professor in Government medical institution OR
    • Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces, having at least five years of clinical experience in the relevant specialty after obtaining the recognised Postgraduate qualification in the subject, of which at least three years teaching experience as Assistant Professor in a teaching hospital of the Armed Forces
    • Must have published at least two research publications after becoming Assistant Professor and must be amongst first three authors
    • Must have completed the Basic Course in Biomedical Research from a recognised medical institution
    • Shall be required to undergo Basic Course in Medical Education provided their broad specialty subject is covered under undergraduate training
  • Assistant Professor (MD, MS, DNB, M.Sc-Ph.D):
    • One year as Senior Resident in the concerned subject in a recognised medical institution OR
    • Specialist Medical Officers of the Armed Forces having at least one year teaching experience or two years of clinical experience after obtaining the requisite postgraduate qualification in the concerned subject OR
    • Non-teaching Consultant or Specialist or Medical Officer, possessing postgraduate medical degree with at least two years of experience in a Government hospital having at least 220 beds OR
    • Diploma holders appointed as Senior Residents in a recognised medical institution before 08.06.2017 having total experience of four years as Senior Resident OR
    • Diploma holders working as Specialist or Medical Officer in the respective departments of a government medical institution having cumulative experience of six years
  • Senior Resident (MD, MS, DNB):
    • Post Graduate Degree in Doctor of Medicine or Master of Surgery OR
    • Diplomate of National Board OR
    • Post graduate medical degree in Master of Science with Doctor of Philosophy in the medical subjects of Anatomy or Biochemistry or Physiology or Pharmacology or Microbiology
  • Junior Resident:
    • Any person possessing a Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery degree
  • Statistician cum Tutor:
    • Master of Science degree in Health Statistics or Medical Statistics or Biostatistics or Statistics
    • Doctor of Philosophy degree
  • Tutor:
    • Any person possessing a Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery degree
  • Lab Technician:
    • Diploma in Medical Lab Technology or equivalent OR
    • B.Sc in Medical lab Technology or equivalent with experience in the concerned field
  • Medical Social Worker:
    • Essential: A Degree from a recognized University
    • Essential: Diploma in Psychiatric Social Work
    • Desirable: One Year experience as a Psychiatric Social Worker
  • Health Educator:
    • Degree in Health Education from Recognized Institute or its equivalent qualification with Three Years Experience OR
    • Diploma in Health Education in recognized Institute or its equivalent qualification with Five Years Experience
  • Professor (Bachelor of Occupational Therapy):
    • Essential: Master's Degree in Occupational Therapy (M.O.T. M.O.Th./M.Sc. O.T.), with eight years' experience as Assistant Professor
    • Desirable: Higher Qualification, including a Ph.D. degree in any discipline of occupational therapy recognized by the UGC, and published work of high standard in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals
  • Associate Professor (Medical Radiology):
    • M.Sc. in Medical Imaging (2 years course) with 10 years teaching experience OR
    • M.Sc. In Medical Imaging (2 years course) with 7 years teaching experience

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience requirements vary by post as specified in educational qualifications
  • Teaching experience in recognized medical institutions is mandatory for senior positions
  • Research publications in indexed journals required for Professor and Associate Professor positions
  • Clinical experience requirements vary from 1 to 10 years depending on the position

Desirable Qualifications:

  • Higher qualifications including Ph.D. degrees in relevant disciplines
  • Published work in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals
  • Additional certifications in specialized areas
  • Experience in recognized teaching institutions

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Rs. 3,00,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Associate Professor: Rs. 2,60,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Assistant Professor: Salary as per institutional norms
  • Epidemiologist cum Assistant Professor: Rs. 1,50,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Senior Resident: Rs. 1,10,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Statistician Cum Tutor: Salary as per institutional norms
  • Tutor: Rs. 1,00,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Junior Resident: Salary as per institutional norms
  • Lab Technician: Rs. 17,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Medical Social Worker: Rs. 12,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Health Educator: Rs. 20,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Professor (Occupational Therapy): Rs. 80,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Associate Professor (Medical Radiology with 10 years exp): Rs. 90,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Associate Professor (Medical Radiology with 7 years exp): Rs. 80,000/- per month (Consolidated)
Note: All salaries are consolidated and on short-term contract basis until vacancies are filled.

Age Limit (as on 12/12/2025)

  • Senior Resident: Maximum 45 Years
  • For Pre-Clinical & Para-Clinical Departments (Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Pathology, Forensic Medicine and Community Medicine): Maximum 55 Years
  • Lab Technician: Not exceeding 45 years
  • Medical Social Worker: Not exceeding 50 years
  • Health Educator: Not exceeding 45 years
  • Other Teaching Posts: Below 45 years at the time of initial appointment
Note: The upper age-limit shall be below 45 years of age at the time of initial appointment for most posts except where specifically mentioned.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 12/12/2025
Application Start Date 12/12/2025
Last Date for Non-Teaching Posts Application 26/12/2025
Last Date for Teaching Posts Application To be announced

Selection Process

  • Application Screening: Initial screening of applications based on eligibility criteria
  • Document Verification: Verification of educational qualifications and experience certificates
  • Interview/Selection Committee: Candidates will be called for interview before the selection committee
  • Merit List: Final selection based on qualifications, experience, interview performance, and research publications
  • Medical Examination: Selected candidates must undergo medical fitness examination
  • Appointment: Appointment will be made on short-term contract basis
Note: The Administration reserves the right to terminate the selection process without assigning a reason.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted in the prescribed format available on official websites
  • One set of attested photocopies of educational qualification and experience certificates must be attached
  • Applications will be summarily rejected if found deviant from the prescribed format and required criteria without assigning any reason
  • No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for attending the interview
  • Incomplete or unsigned applications will be rejected
  • Attested copies of relevant certificates/documents should be attached along with application form
  • All information stated in the application must be true to the best of knowledge
  • If any information is found to be false, candidates are bound to obey the decision of selection committee
  • Candidates should attach birth date certificate (School Leaving Certificate)
  • MBBS/BDS and PG marksheets must be attached
  • GMC/GDC Registration Certificate (both UG and PG) required
  • BCBR Course Certificate if applicable
  • Degree Certificate must be enclosed
  • Teaching/Non-Teaching Experience Certificates required
  • Research Publications (both original and photocopy) with proof of Indexation for teaching posts
  • Copy of Aadhar Card mandatory
  • Domicile Certificate for eligible candidates
  • ST/SC/OBC category certificate if applicable
  • Applications should be accompanied with one recent passport size photograph
  • Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number

Leave Benefits:

  • Casual Leave: 1 Casual Leave per completed month
  • Special Leave: 7 days of special leave twice a year for faculty member per academic year
  • Academic Leave: Provision of academic leave to attend recognized conferences, CME Programs, workshops and examinations at other institutes for faculty members

Research Publication Requirements:

  • Research Publication means only original papers, meta-analysis, systematic reviews and case series
  • Publications must be in journals indexed in Medline, PubMed Central, Science Citation Index, Citation Index Expanded, Embase, Scopus or Directory of Open Access Journals
  • Other journals as may be specified by the Commission from time to time

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official websites: www.dnh.gov.in OR www.vbch.dnh.nic.in OR namomeri.in
  • Step 2: Download the recruitment notification and read carefully
  • Step 3: Download the prescribed application form for respective post:
    • Application form for posts under NAMO Medical Education & Research Institute
    • Application form for posts under NAMO College of Allied Health Sciences
  • Step 4: Fill all required details in the application form carefully
  • Step 5: Paste recent passport size photograph
  • Step 6: Attach one set of attested photocopies of all required documents:
    • Birth Date certificate (School Leaving)
    • Final MBBS/BDS Mark Sheet
    • P.G. Marks Sheet
    • MBBS/BDS GMC/GDC Registration Certificate
    • MS/MD/MDS GMC/GDC Registration Certificate
    • BCBR Course Certificate
    • Degree Certificate
    • Teaching/Non-Teaching Experience Certificate
    • Research Publications with proof of Indexation
    • Copy of Aadhar Card 
  • ST/SC/OBC/Others category certificate
  • Step 7: Fill the checklist of enclosures in the application form
  • Step 8: Sign the undertaking/declaration at the end of application form
  • Step 9: Verify all information before submission
  • Step 10: Submit the complete application with all documents to the respective address:

Submission Addresses:

For Posts Under Address Contact Details
NAMO Medical Education & Research Institute (Medical College) Administrative Office, NAMO Medical Education & Research Institute Campus, Opp. Maliba Petrol pump, Sayli Police Training School Road, Silvassa-396230 Email: [email protected]
Contact: 7624092991
NAMO College of Allied Health Sciences, Silvassa DNH&DD Administrative Office, Institute of Allied Health Sciences, Silvassa DNH & DD in the campus of NAMO Medical Education and Research Institute Sayli, Silvassa Email: [email protected]
Contact: 9638356284
Important: Ensure all documents are attested and application is complete before submission. Incomplete applications will be rejected.

DCI Contract Posts 2025 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for DCI Contract Posts Recruitment 2025 is 25 posts across multiple designations as given below.

Post Name Total Posts
Consultant for Inland Dredging (On Contract Basis) 6

Information Technology Consultant (On Contract Basis) 1
Legal Consultant (On Contract Basis) 1
Resident Manager (On Contract Basis) 1
Assistant Company Secretary (On Contract Basis) 1

Eligibility Criteria for DCI Contract Posts 2025

1. Educational Qualification

  • Consultant for Inland Dredging: CoC as Master (FG) / Mate / Dredge Master (Grade I & II) / MEO Class I & II / Dredge Engineer Grade I & II / Master NCV / Degree in Civil/Mechanical/Marine/Dredging and Harbor Engineering.
  • Project Manager: Diploma in Civil Engineering / Diploma in Survey Engineering / Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering / equivalent qualification from recognized institute approved by Govt. of India / any State Government.
  • Hydrographic Surveyor: Diploma in Civil Engineering or Diploma in Survey Engineering / any equivalent qualification or Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering recognized by Govt. of India / State Govt.
  • Project Consultants (O/P): Master (FG) CoC or Dredge Master Grade I CoC.
  • Information Technology Consultant: Engineering Graduate or MCA.
  • Legal Consultant: 1st or 2nd class Degree in Law of recognized University.
  • Resident Manager: I Class graduate from a recognized University, preferably with MBA.
  • Assistant Company Secretary: Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India.

2. Age Limit

  • Consultant for Inland Dredging: 40 to 65 years.
  • Project Manager: Below 45 years.
  • Hydrographic Surveyor: Below 45 years.
  • Project Consultants (O/P): Up to 50 years.
  • Information Technology Consultant: Up to 45 years.
  • Legal Consultant: Up to 45 years.
  • Resident Manager: Up to 45 years.
  • Assistant Company Secretary: Up to 45 years.
  • Age calculation date: Age and experience shall be counted as on 03.12.2025.

3. Experience (Post-wise)

  • Consultant for Inland Dredging: Minimum 10 years’ experience in dredging/Port/Marine/Shipping related operations, conversant with statutory certificates compliance.
  • Project Manager: 6 years’ experience in civil engineering works/infrastructural development projects/marine construction projects etc., preferably in dredging/desiltation/Inland water works.
  • Hydrographic Surveyor: 1 year experience in land/civil engineering survey works, preferably in Hydrographic surveys.
  • Project Consultants (O/P): 6 years post-qualification experience after obtaining Master (FG) COC or Dredge Master Gr.1 COC, with knowledge of shipping procedures, execution of projects, contracts etc.
  • Information Technology Consultant: 8 years’ experience in applications development/customisation in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations ERP with X++ and Visual Studio; functional & technical knowledge with Microsoft certification preferred.
  • Legal Consultant: 10 years’ experience as practicing lawyer or in Legal Department; experience in arbitration and service matters desirable.
  • Resident Manager: 8 years’ post-qualification experience, of which 2 years in liaison/clearances/PR, passports/visas/emigration, RBI/FX clearances etc.
  • Assistant Company Secretary: At least 1 year post-qualification experience in Board Secretariat as Company Secretary/Assistant Secretary; experience in listed company preferred.

Salary

Here are the salary details (per month) for the DCI Contract Posts 2025:

  • Consultant for Inland Dredging: Rs. 1,50,000 to Rs. 2,00,000 (consolidated).
  • Project Manager (Inland Dredging Works): Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 65,000 (consolidated).
  • Hydrographic Surveyor: Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 40,000 (consolidated).
  • Project Consultants (Operations/Projects): Rs. 1,00,000 to Rs. 1,25,000 (consolidated).
  • Information Technology Consultant: Rs. 1,00,000 to Rs. 1,25,000 (consolidated).
  • Legal Consultant: Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 70,000 (consolidated).
  • Resident Manager: Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 65,000 (consolidated).
  • Assistant Company Secretary: Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 60,000 (consolidated).

Selection Process for DCI Contract Posts 2025

  • Candidates will be shortlisted based on information/declarations submitted in the online application form.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process (interview/other stages) as decided by DCI; details will be notified through the website.
  • Candidature is liable to be rejected at any stage, or service terminated after joining, if any information is found false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria.
  • List of shortlisted and selected candidates will be displayed on the DCI website.

How to Apply for DCI Contract Posts Recruitment 2025?

  1. Candidates will be required to apply online through DCIL website www.dredge-india.com; no other mode of application will be accepted.
  2. Online application link will be open from 03.12.2025 (10.00 hrs) to 23.12.2025 (18.00 hrs); candidates shall apply separately for each position.
  3. Fill the online application form and upload scanned copies of required documents: date of birth proof, caste/disability/Ex-servicemen certificates (if applicable), all qualification certificates and mark sheets from matriculation onwards, CGPA/OGPA conversion proof where applicable, and complete experience certificates.
  4. Upload passport size colour photograph (up to 50KB), signature (up to 50KB), and up to six scanned certificates (each up to 200KB in JPG/PDF); if more than six certificates, merge into combined PDFs.
  5. After successful submission, download the system-generated Application Form with unique acknowledgment number and retain it for future reference.
  6. Ensure all required documents are uploaded; failure to upload any required document will result in the candidature not being considered.
  7. Maintain valid mobile number and email ID, as all communications regarding interview/selection will be sent only to these.

Event Date & Time
Commencement of Online Application 03/12/2025 from 10.00 Hrs
Last Date for Submission of Online Application 23/12/2025 up to 18.00 Hrs
Age & Experience Cut-off Date 03/12/2025

Instructions

  • Candidates must ensure that they fulfill all eligibility criteria before applying; DCI can reject any application at any stage if found ineligible.
  • Applications not submitted online or without required documents/clear uploads will not be considered.
  • Candidates must retain acknowledgement number and application form for all future references.
  • Management reserves the right to cancel, restrict, modify, or alter the recruitment process and to increase/decrease/vacate the advertised posts without notice.
  • All appointments are subject to medical fitness as per Corporation rules.
  • Any canvassing directly or indirectly will disqualify the candidature.
  • Any dispute related to this recruitment will fall under the jurisdiction of Visakhapatnam Court only.
  • Candidates should regularly visit www.dredge-india.com for latest updates and lists of shortlisted/selected candidates.

VPA Executive Engineer (Civil) Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Name of the Post Department No. of Vacant Posts
Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I) Civil Engineering Department, Visakhapatnam Port Authority 03

Eligibility Criteria

  • Applications are invited from eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities who possess the prescribed qualifications and experience as per Recruitment Rules for the post of Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I).
  • Educational qualification for direct recruitment: Degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institution.
  • Experience for direct recruitment: Five years’ experience in Executive cadre in Planning/Construction/Design/Maintenance preferably of Port and Marine Structures in an Industrial/Commercial/Government undertaking.
  • Method of recruitment as per Recruitment Rules: By promotion failing which by absorption/deputation, failing both by direct recruitment.
  • Promotion: From Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) in the scale of pay Rs. 9100–15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade; failing which Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) in the scale of pay Rs. 9100–15100 with 2 years regular service in the grade and combined regular service of 8 years in the scales Rs. 9100–15100 and Rs. 8600–14600 in Civil Engineering Department.
  • Absorption/deputation: Officers holding analogous posts or feeder posts with experience as mentioned in Recruitment Rules in a Major Port.

Salary/Stipend

  • The post of Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I) carries the scale of pay of Rs. 50,000–1,60,000/- (pre-revised Rs. 10,750–16,750) in the Civil Engineering Department, Visakhapatnam Port Authority.
  • Officers selected on deputation will have the option either to get their pay fixed in the deputation post under normal rules or to draw pay of the post held in parent department plus deputation (duty) allowance as per applicable government orders.
  • Dearness Allowance, local allowances, residential accommodation charges, and other benefits during deputation will be regulated as per Visakhapatnam Port Authority rules and the deputation terms.

Age Limit (as on 19-01-2026)

  • As per Recruitment Rules, the upper age limit for direct recruitment to Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I) is 35 years.
  • The crucial date for determining eligibility with respect to educational qualifications, experience and age will be the last date of closing of applications i.e. 19.01.2026.
  • The vacancy is to be filled by promotion/absorption/deputation from eligible officers of Major Port Authorities; direct recruitment is a fallback mode as per Recruitment Rules.

Application Fee

  • The vacancy circular does not mention any application fee for the post of Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I) on absorption/deputation basis.

Selection Process

  • Applications will be considered from eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities forwarded by the Competent Authority of the respective organizations.
  • No advance copy of application from the applicant will be accepted; only applications forwarded by the Competent Authority within due date will be considered.
  • Incomplete applications, applications received after the last date, or without ACRs/APARs or required enclosures will not be considered.
  • The officer selected for the post will be appointed on absorption/deputation basis and will be governed by the terms and conditions of deputation as per Annexure-VII.
  • VPA reserves the right to cancel or change the number of vacancies without assigning reasons; decision of the Appointing Authority is final in all recruitment matters.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited for filling up three vacant posts of Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I) in Civil Engineering Department, Visakhapatnam Port Authority on absorption/deputation basis from eligible officers of Major Port Authorities.
  • Port Authorities are requested to circulate the vacancy among eligible officials and forward applications in the prescribed proforma duly superscribing “Application for the post of Executive Engineer (Civil)” on the envelope to Secretary, Visakhapatnam Port Authority.
  • Applications must be accompanied by certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (2020–2021 to 2024–2025) duly attested, with No Report/Non-availability certificate where APAR for a year is not available.
  • Attested copies of all certificates towards educational qualifications, present and past work experience in respective post and pay scale, duly verified by the administrative port, must be enclosed.
  • Undertaking of the applicant that candidature will not be withdrawn if selected; withdrawal after selection may lead to debarment from future selection in VPA for two years.
  • Applications must include No Objection Certificate from competent authority, Vigilance/Administrative clearance, verification of university certificates and recognition of degrees, and complete service details in prescribed formats.
  • Vacancy circular along with Annexures is also available on VPA website www.vizagport.com.

How to Apply

  • Eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities should submit their applications in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-II) through proper channel.
  • Envelope should be superscribed “Application for the post of Executive Engineer (Civil)” and sent to: Secretary, Visakhapatnam Port Authority, 1st Floor, Administrative Office Building, Port Area, Visakhapatnam – 530035.
  • Applications must be forwarded by the Competent Authority of the respective organizations; advance copies from applicants will not be accepted.
  • Along with the application, forward certified copies of ACRs/APARs for last 5 years, attested copies of educational and experience certificates, undertaking of non-withdrawal of candidature, No Objection Certificate, Vigilance/Administrative clearance, certificate of verification of degree and university recognition, details of penalties if any, and complete service details.
  • Port Authorities must ensure applications with complete details reach VPA on or before 19.01.2026.

Post Name Department Total Posts Pay Level & Basic Pay
Chhattisgarh State Administrative Service (Deputy Collector) General Administration Department 14 Level-12, Rs. 56,100/-

Assistant Jail Superintendent Jail Department 6 Level-6, Rs. 25,300/-
Total 238  

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • Candidate must hold a graduate degree from a University incorporated by an Act of Central/State Legislature in India or an institution declared as a University under UGC Act 1956, or an equivalent qualification recognized by Chhattisgarh Government.
  • Candidates appearing in final qualifying examination or awaiting results may apply for Preliminary Examination, but must produce proof of passing the required degree before Main Examination application/within prescribed time.
  • Candidates with recognized professional and technical qualifications deemed equivalent to a degree by the State Government are also eligible.
  • For reserved category benefits (SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer, PwD, women, ex-servicemen, etc.), candidate must be a local/native resident of Chhattisgarh and possess valid permanent caste and other relevant certificates.
  • Physical standards are prescribed for certain posts like Deputy Superintendent of Police, District Excise Officer, Assistant Jail Superintendent and others; candidates must ensure they meet these standards when opting for such posts.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2025)

  • For Deputy Superintendent of Police (State Police Service): 21 to 28 years, with relaxations:
    • Up to 5 years relaxation in upper age limit for SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer) of Chhattisgarh.
    • Ex-servicemen of Chhattisgarh can deduct entire defence service period from actual age, subject to resulting age not exceeding upper limit by more than 3 years.
    • Certain categories of Government servants, retrenched employees, voluntary home guards, women (including widows/divorcees) and specific award holders get relaxations as detailed, but combined upper age not beyond prescribed maximum (generally 33 years for some service categories, plus notified relaxations).
  • For other posts (except Police Service): Generally 21 to 30 years; for local/native residents of Chhattisgarh, maximum age 35 years, with additional relaxation of 5 years for educated unemployed locals, subject to a ceiling of 45 years including all relaxations.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities get 5 years relaxation in maximum age as per RPwD Act 2016 and relevant Government notifications.

Application Fee

  • For local/native residents of Chhattisgarh belonging to SC, ST, OBC (non-creamy layer) and Persons with Disabilities: Rs. 300/- as examination fee.
  • For all other categories and applicants from outside Chhattisgarh: Rs. 400/- as examination fee.
  • In addition, portal fee, GST and other payment gateway charges as applicable will be payable by all candidates.
  • Only online modes of payment are accepted; bank draft and cheque are not accepted for examination fee.
  • Local residents of Chhattisgarh who actually appear in the written examination/interview are eligible for refund of examination fee on submission of online refund request within 10 days of exam/interview; portal fee, correction charges, service tax etc. are non-refundable.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay scales are as per Chhattisgarh Government pay matrix:
    • Level-12: Basic pay Rs. 56,100/- per month for posts like Deputy Collector, Deputy Superintendent of Police, State Finance Service Officer, State Tax Assistant Commissioner, Labour Officer, Employment Officer, Assistant Director/District Women & Child Development Officer, District Registrar, Chief Municipal Officer Class ‘B’.
    • Level-9: Basic pay Rs. 38,100/- per month for posts like Chief Municipal Officer Class ‘C’, Child Development Project Officer, Subordinate Account Service Officer.
    • Level-8: Basic pay Rs. 35,400/- per month for Nayab Tehsildar.
    • Level-7: Basic pay Rs. 28,700/- per month for State Tax Inspector, Excise Sub Inspector, Deputy Registrar.
    • Level-6: Basic pay Rs. 25,300/- per month for Assistant Jail Superintendent.
  • Other allowances and benefits are admissible as per Chhattisgarh State Government rules applicable to respective services.

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 – Preliminary Examination (Objective Type): Two papers – General Studies (Paper I) and Aptitude Test (Paper II), each of 200 marks and 2 hours; both with multiple-choice questions and negative marking (1/3 of correct-answer marks for each wrong answer). Paper II (Aptitude) is qualifying; merit for Main Examination shortlisting is based on Paper I (General Studies) marks only; minimum qualifying marks: 33% for unreserved and 23% for reserved categories in each paper.
  • Stage 2 – Main Examination (Conventional Type): Seven descriptive papers – Language, Essay, General Studies I to V – each of 200 marks and 3 hours; total 1400 marks. All shortlisted candidates must appear in all papers; absence in any paper leads to disqualification.
  • Stage 3 – Interview/Personality Test: 100 marks; only candidates securing minimum marks in Main Examination as fixed by Commission are called, up to about three times the number of posts; final merit list is prepared based on aggregate of Main Examination (1400) and Interview (100) marks.
  • Preliminary Examination is only a screening test; marks of Prelims are not counted in final selection. Separate unreserved and reserved lists are prepared as per reservation rules, and supplementary lists up to 25% of main list may also be prepared.

How To Apply

  • Candidates must apply online only for State Services Preliminary Examination 2025; any manual or postal applications will not be accepted.
  • Online application can be submitted from 01/12/2025 (12:00 Noon) to 30/12/2025 (11:59 PM) via the link available on the official website www.psc.cg.gov.in.
  • Candidates must carefully read State Service Examination Rules 2008 (as amended), Commission’s Procedure Rules 2014 (as amended), and all instructions in the advertisement before filling the online form to ensure eligibility.
  • Examination fee and portal fee must be paid online only; bank draft or cheque will not be accepted. Candidates should preserve application and fee payment details.
  • After Prelims result, candidates declared qualified for Main Examination must submit a fresh online application for Main Examination within the prescribed dates; failure to do so will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Candidates in Government/PSU/University/other institutional service must obtain and submit No Objection Certificate from competent authority at the time of document verification/interview as per instructions.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Publication date in Employment News/Employment & Planning 03/12/2025
Notification / Advertisement Date 26/11/2025
Start date for online application (Preliminary Exam) 01/12/2025, 12:00 Noon
Last date for online application (Preliminary Exam) 30/12/2025, 11:59 PM
Online error correction (free) window 31/12/2025, 12:00 Noon to 02/01/2026, 11:59 PM
Online chargeable correction window (Rs. 500/-) 03/01/2026, 12:00 Noon to 05/01/2026, 11:59 PM
Preliminary Examination Date 22/02/2026 – Forenoon 10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon and Afternoon 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM
Probable dates for Main Examination 16, 17, 18 and 19 May 2026

Instructions

  • Applications will be accepted only online within specified dates; manual or postal applications will be rejected.
  • Admission to the examination at all stages is purely provisional; issue of admit card does not imply final acceptance of candidature, which is verified after written examination/interview and document scrutiny.
  • Candidates are responsible for ensuring that they meet all eligibility conditions; if found ineligible at any stage or if any information is found incomplete/incorrect/false, candidature/selection can be cancelled and Commission’s decision will be final and binding.
  • Reservation and selection procedures are subject to final orders of Hon’ble Supreme Court in SLP (C) No.19668/2022 and to any modifications in rules notified by Government before last date of application.
  • Reservation benefits for SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer), women, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities, ex-servicemen and other special categories apply only to local/native residents of Chhattisgarh with valid certificates; candidates from other States will be treated as unreserved for such posts.
  • Minimum qualifying marks in each paper of Preliminary and Main Examinations are 33% for unreserved and 23% for reserved categories; Prelims is only qualifying/screening and marks are not counted for final merit.
  • Use of unfair means, misconduct, disobedience, abusive language, damage to answer sheets, violation of exam discipline or carrying banned items (like mobile phones) inside exam premises is punishable and may lead to debarment.
  • There is no provision for revaluation/rechecking of answer scripts; requests for re-evaluation or recounting will not be entertained.
  • No certificate/documents are required to be sent/uploaded for Preliminary Examination; all relevant documents must be produced at the time of document verification before interview for candidates qualified in Main Examination.

“Economic Evaluation and effectiveness of a multi component behavior centered intervention to reduce smokeless tobacco (ST) use among pregnant women of low socio-economic status: A Randomized Control Trial in Urban community setting in India.”

Science and Engineering Research Board, DST (CRG Scheme), Govt. of India.

29th December, 2025 by 5 PM.

Essential Qualifications

For RA (Research Associate) Posts:

  • Post 5 (RA): Ph.D. in Science stream and Post Graduation (M.Sc.) in Physics/Applied Physics or Computer or Mathematical Sciences/Physics or M.Tech in Computer or Computational and Simulation areas or M.Tech from IIT/IISc working on Radio Modulation subject with 4+ years experience

  • Expertise in welding from a recognized University with NET/GATE

Experience

  • General Guidelines: Age limit will be as per Government of India norms for research fellowships
  • Note: Candidates should check specific age criteria as per their category and post applied for

  • Applications are invited from the interested candidates for the following positions in DGRE, Chandigarh
  • The fellowship will be initially for one year duration, which may be extended up to three years based on performance and requirement
  • Original Documents Required: Candidates must bring all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies at the time of interview
  • Eligibility Conditions: Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria as per DRDO/CSIR/DST norms are eligible to apply
  • No TA/DA: No travelling allowance will be provided for attending the interview on the basis of the advertisement

  • Document Submission: Candidates must submit the following at the time of interview:

    • Original certificates of educational qualifications and experience
    • Self-attested copies of all certificates
    • Valid proof of date of birth
    • Category certificate (if applicable)
    • NET/GATE scorecard (if applicable)
  • Interview Selection: For walk-in interviews, the selected person will have to join within 15 days of issue of appointment offer
  • Contract Duration: The positions are purely temporary. The offer of fellowship is entirely at the discretion of DGRE management depending on requirement
  • Project-Based: These positions are project-based and will continue based on satisfactory performance and project requirements
  • Number of Positions: The number of vacancies specified is provisional and may vary
  • DRDO Rules Apply: All other terms and conditions will be as per DRDO/CSIR norms for research fellowships
  • Canvassing Disqualification: Any canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification
  • Director's Decision: The decision of the Director, DGRE will be final and binding in all matters related to the selection
  • State of Nativity: Attested copy of NETGATE certificate and proof of age are mandatory
  • Experience Certificate: Experience certificate from previous employer (if applicable) must be produced

  • Step 1: Download the application format (if provided) or prepare your biodata with all relevant details
  • Step 2: Prepare all required documents:
    • Application form with passport-size photograph
    • All educational certificates (10th, 12th, Graduation, Post-Graduation, Ph.D.)
    • Experience certificates (if applicable)
    • Caste certificate (if applicable)
    • NET/GATE scorecard (if applicable)
    • Date of birth proof
    • Identity proof (Aadhar Card/PAN Card/Driving License)
  • Step 3: Carry both original and self-attested photocopies of all documents
  • Step 4: Attend the walk-in interview on the scheduled date:
    • 29 December 2025: For Posts 1, 2, 3
    • 30 December 2025: For Posts 4, 5, 6, 7
  • Step 5: Report to the venue on time:
    Defence Geoinformatics Research Establishment
    Him Parisar, Plot No. - 91, Sector 37A
    Chandigarh - 160036 (UT)
    Ph: (0172) 2785067/49, Extn: 203
  • Step 6: Attend the interview and present your documents for verification
  • Step 7: Wait for the selection results (selected candidates will be informed directly)
  • Important Notes:
    • No online application or postal application accepted
    • Only walk-in interview mode
    • Candidates must arrive on time
    • No TA/DA will be provided
    • Incomplete applications will be rejected

Eligibility Criteria

  • The advertisement is open only for citizens of India.
  • For Assistant Professor (Engineering/Design): Ph.D. in the relevant field with first class or equivalent at Bachelor’s and Master’s degree level in the appropriate branch as listed in the relevant department table.
  • For Assistant Professor (Sciences/Humanities/Arts): Ph.D. in the relevant field with first class or equivalent at Bachelor’s and Master’s degree level in the appropriate branch, along with NET/SLET/SET qualification or the specified exemption conditions for candidates registered for Ph.D. prior to July 11, 2009.
  • For Associate Professor: Ph.D. in the relevant field with first class or equivalent at Bachelor’s and Master’s level, minimum eight years of teaching/research experience in an academic/research position equivalent to Assistant Professor, and minimum seven publications in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI/ABDC indexed journals with a total research score of 75 as per the given criteria.
  • For Professor: Ph.D. in the relevant field with first class or equivalent at Bachelor’s and Master’s level, minimum ten years of teaching and/or research experience at appropriate levels with evidence of successfully guided doctoral candidates, and minimum ten publications in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI/ABDC indexed journals with a total research score of 120 as per the given criteria.
  • Candidates must apply in the prescribed application proforma and provide self-attested documentary evidence for all claims including scores in the academic/research score tables.
  • Reservation benefits and qualifying marks relaxation are applicable as per Government of India norms for SC/OBC (Non-creamy Layer) candidates, with an OBC certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025.

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Consolidated salary of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month plus Dearness Allowance (DA) as per applicable rates.
  • Associate Professor: Consolidated salary of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month plus DA.
  • Assistant Professor: Consolidated salary of Rs. 57,700/- per month plus DA.
  • House Rent Allowance is admissible at applicable rates; however, on-campus accommodation will not be provided.
  • No increment or additional allowances are admissible during the contract period apart from those specifically mentioned.
  • Professional Development Allowance up to a specified annual limit and certain research-related grants are available during the contract, subject to conditions.

Selection Process

  • Applications will be scrutinized based on scores filled by candidates in the summary sheet as per the specified academic and research score tables.
  • Documentary evidence must be submitted for all parameters claimed in the scoring tables, and verified scores will not exceed the claimed scores.
  • Candidates are shortlisted for participation in the selection process on the basis of their verified scores; mere fulfilment of minimum qualifications does not guarantee call for interview.
  • The selection process comprises a seminar or sample teaching session followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.
  • A maximum of 15 candidates will be called for interview against one post, and 5 additional candidates will be called for each additional post under a category.

How To Apply

  • Candidates must apply using the prescribed application proforma provided in the brochure annexures.
  • Separate applications must be submitted for each post and each department for which a candidate wishes to apply.
  • The application form must be typed, complete, and supported by self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents and proofs for claimed scores.
  • Hard copy of the application along with all enclosures must be sent by speed/registered post to the office of Dean Faculty Affairs, Punjab Engineering College (Deemed to be University), Sector-12, Chandigarh-160012.
  • The envelope containing the application must be superscribed with the name of the post and department applied for.
  • Applications will be considered subject to availability of vacancies at the time of each recruitment cycle under this rolling advertisement.

Important Dates

Notification Date 08 November 2025
Rolling Advertisement Applications will be open throughout the year and processed twice in a year (applications received up to 31st October and 30th April of every year).
Application Closing Date (1st Cycle) 30 December 2025

Instructions

  • Incomplete applications or applications without required documentary evidence will be summarily rejected.
  • Additional documents will not be accepted after submission of the application form.
  • The institute reserves the right to amend the number of posts or not to fill any advertised posts without assigning reasons.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for participation in the selection process.
  • The appointment will be on purely temporary contractual basis for three years, with no increment and no other allowances except those specified.
  • Reservation will be implemented as per the approved roster of the Chandigarh Administration.

  • Shortlisted candidates as per merit will be called for counselling and document verification as per category‑wise vacancies.
  • Recommendation to the concerned department will be made only for those candidates who are found fully eligible in document verification.

How to Apply

  • Visit the official website of PSSSB: https://sssb.punjab.gov.in and click on the “Online Applications” link.
  • Apply online only from 21-11-2025 to 27-12-2025 up to 5:00 PM; no other mode of application will be accepted.
  • For each post, submit a separate online application form and pay separate fee if applying for more than one post.
  • First select the post, then complete registration by entering basic details and educational details; a username/registration number will be generated.
  • Login again using registration details and fill the application form step‑by‑step, upload passport‑size photograph, signature and required educational certificates (Matric with date of birth, 10+2, diploma/degree as applicable).
  • Submit the online application form; fee can be paid from the next working day after form submission up to 29-12-2025.
  • Pay exam fee through SBI challan at any branch, or through Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI as available.
  • After successful fee payment, download and print the final submitted application form and keep it safely for future reference.
  • No correction will be allowed after final submission of the online application form.

Instructions

  • Candidates must apply only through the official website; applications by any other mode will be rejected.
  • Candidates are solely responsible for the correctness of information entered in the online form; no change in category, category‑code or other particulars will be allowed later.
  • All educational qualifications and category certificates must be valid and issued by recognised Boards/Universities/Authorities as per Punjab Government instructions.
  • Reservation benefits are admissible only to domiciled residents of Punjab having valid domicile/residence certificates and relevant caste/category certificates.
  • Incomplete applications, applications without required fee, or without uploading mandatory documents will be rejected.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the written examination or counselling/document verification.
  • All recruitment‑related updates such as exam schedule, admit card, result, merit list, counselling schedule and corrigendum will be displayed only on the official website; no separate letters will be sent.
  • If any document or information is found false at any stage, candidature will be cancelled and legal action may be initiated as per rules.
  • The Board reserves the right to change, modify or cancel any terms, number of vacancies, or selection stages as per requirement.
  • For technical issues in online apply, candidates can contact [email protected]; for other queries they can contact the office during working hours on the notified phone numbers.

Eligibility Criteria for PLW Patiala Act Apprentice 2025

1. Educational Qualification

For Electrician, Mechanic (Diesel), Machinist, and Fitter Trades:

  • Candidates must have passed 10+2 examination with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics with at least 50% marks (for candidates with matriculation or ITI certificate)

Important: Only candidates who have passed by the date 01.12.2025 with National Trade Certificate (NCVT) issued by National Trade Certificate (NTC) or Provisional National Trade Certificate (PNTC) under the Apprentices Act, 1961, as per RBE No. 54/2017 and Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship notification dated 02.03.2017, Schedule-I Column 5 will be eligible.

2. Age Limit

The age limit for PLW Patiala Act Apprentice Recruitment 2025 is:

For Electrician, Mechanic (Diesel), Machinist, and Fitter Trades:

  • Minimum Age: 15 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years

For Welder (Gas & Electrician) Trade:

  • Minimum Age: 15 years
  • Maximum Age: 22 years

Age Relaxation:

  • SC/ST candidates: 5 years relaxation
  • OBC candidates: 3 years relaxation
  • Age relaxation will be given only to those candidates who have valid caste certificate till the last date of application

Age calculation date: As per date of birth recorded in school certificate

3. Nationality

Candidates must be Indian citizens.

4. Disability Certificate for PWD Candidates

Persons with Disabilities applying under PWD category must possess disability certificate as per Annexure-VII. The suitability for PWDs as per RPWD Act for different trades is specified in the official notification.

Selection Process for PLW Patiala Act Apprentice 2025

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

  • Merit-Based Selection: Selection will be based on merit obtained in Matriculation and ITI examinations
  • Merit list will be prepared based on average marks obtained in both Matriculation and ITI examinations
  • For candidates who have passed Matriculation with at least 50% marks and completed 50% marks in ITI affiliated by NCVT or SCVT, marks will be calculated as: (Matriculation marks 70% + ITI marks 80%)/2 = 75%
  • Document Verification: Selected candidates will be called for document verification
  • Medical Examination: Candidates must bring medical certificate signed by Government Authorized Doctor (Gazetted) at the time of document verification

Note: No person will be eligible for selection under Craftsman Training Scheme if they have already benefited from the training.

Eligible candidates can apply online for PLW Patiala Act Apprentice 2025 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: www.plw.indianrailways.gov.in
  2. Under Departments section, go to Personnel department and click on "Misc Activities" link for "Engagement of Act Apprentices"
  3. Read the official notification carefully
  4. Before applying online, keep the following documents/information ready:
    • E-mail ID
    • Latest photograph in JPEG format (scanned, size not more than 100 kb)
    • Signature in Hindi or English in JPEG format (scanned, size not more than 25 kb)
    • Bio-data including name of applicant, father's name, mother's name, and correct name as per matriculation and ITI certificate
    • Matriculation and ITI certificate with marks obtained
    • If CGPA is mentioned, convert it to percentage (multiply CGPA by 9.5)
    • Caste certificate (if applicable)
    • Mobile number
  5. First, register on the National Skill Development Corporation portal: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
  6. After registration, click on 'New User Registration' to create Login Name, Name, City, Mobile No. & email ID
  7. System will send Login Name and Password to applicant's email ID
  8. Login with User Name and Password and click GO button
  9. Fill the application form with correct details
  10. Candidates are advised to fill their details completely before submitting. Save the data first by clicking 'Save Data' button, then click 'Submit' button
  11. System will generate an 'Application Number' - note this carefully
  12. After submission, candidates whose processing fee is not approved must submit the fee within 48 hours
  13. Click 'Here For Payment' link to pay the fee
  14. Select State of Corporate/Institution as 'Punjab', Type of Corporate/Institution as 'Government Department', and select 'PLW Indian Railways Patiala'
  15. Select Payment Category as 'Apprentice Recruitment' and enter your Application Number (Registration Number)
  16. After successful payment, you will receive options to pay fees separately. Select the appropriate option
  17. Take printout of Online Fee Payment e-Receipt for future reference

Important Notes:

  • Candidates must apply through the online medium only. No other mode will be accepted
  • Any mistake during online application will be the candidate's responsibility
  • Applicants should keep their application fee receipt printout safe where processing fee is mentioned
  • Candidates whose processing fee is not approved must submit documents again without any mistake
  • Candidates applying through the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship website on NCVT MIS portal for registration and complete detail filling will have their printout of filled details available

Important Instructions for PLW Patiala Act Apprentice 2025

  • Merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in both Matriculation and ITI examinations
  • Shortlisted candidates (1.5 times the number of vacancies for each trade from the official website of P.L.W./Railway Patiala) will be called for document verification as per the schedule provided under Engagement of Act Apprentices in Departments section under Personnel
  • The verification list will be available on the website till 20.01.2026
  • Selection process will be conducted in February 2026
  • One year of training will be provided for Mechanic (Diesel), Machinist, Fitter, and Welder (Gas & Electrician) trades as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992
  • Candidates must meet the prescribed educational and technical qualifications as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 and other relevant acts and rules
  • The candidates must bring medical certificate signed by Government Authorised Doctor (Gazetted) not below the rank of Asst. Surgeon of Central/State Hospital at the time of documents verification
  • No travel allowance will be provided to candidates appearing for selection under any rules of Apprentices Act, 1961
  • Apprenticeship training period will be as per Apprenticeship Act, 1961 and applicable rules
  • After completion of training, candidates are not guaranteed employment in Patiala Railway Workshop, Patiala. No railway pass, free medical facilities, or PTI-0 facilities will be provided
  • Candidates must bring all documents at their own expense for verification

Advertisement
Company Name Subordinate Services Selection Board, Punjab (PSSSB)
Post Name Hostel Superintendent-cum-PTI, Storekeeper, Librarian, Autoclave Operator/Machine Operator, Junior Technician (Civil/Electrical)
No of Posts 159 total vacancies distributed across the above posts.
Salary Pay scales from Rs. 19,900/- (Level-2) to Rs. 29,200/- (Level-5) and Rs. 25,500/- (Level-4) per 7th CPC, post-wise.
Qualification Matric/10+2 plus CPEd/Diploma in PE, NT Certificate/Diploma in Civil/Electrical Engineering, Library degree/diploma with experience, ITI Mechanical, etc., as per individual post requirements.
Age Limit 18–37 years for General as on 01/01/2025; relaxations for SC/BC/ESM/Govt employees, widows, divorcees as per Punjab rules.
Start Date for Apply  05/12/2025 (online registration and application start)
Last Date for Apply  27/12/2025 up to 05:00 PM (online form and submit), fee payment up to 30/12/2025.
Official Website https://sssb.punjab.gov.in

PSSSB Junior Technician, Librarian and More Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total Posts
Hostel Superintendent-cum-PTI (Punjab Govt, Directorate of Technical Education & Industrial Training – Industrial Training Wing) 68
Storekeeper (same department) 62
Librarian (same department) 3
Autoclave Operator/Machine Operator (Department of Animal Husbandry, Punjab) 2
Junior Technician (Civil) – Punjab State Warehousing Corporation 21
Junior Technician (Electrical) – Punjab State Warehousing Corporation 3

Eligibility Criteria

  • Punjabi language: All posts require knowledge of Punjabi up to Matriculation level, i.e., candidate must have passed Matric with Punjabi or equivalent exam; additionally, a qualifying Punjabi language test (Matric level) with at least 50% marks conducted by the recruiting agency is mandatory for Group-C posts.
  • Hostel Superintendent-cum-PTI: Matric in second division or 10+2; Certificate in Physical Education (C.P.Ed) from recognized institution (preference for Diploma in Physical Education); at least 2 years’ relevant experience.
  • Storekeeper: Matric second class or 10+2; National Trade Certificate/National Apprenticeship Certificate in any Engineering Trade; minimum 1-year experience of storekeeping in Engineering Stores.
  • Librarian: (Option 1) Bachelor in Library and Information Science with at least 1 year practical experience in factory/State Govt/institute recognized by Govt, OR (Option 2) B.A./B.Sc. with Diploma in Library Science and at least 3 years’ practical experience in factory/State Govt/institute.
  • Autoclave Operator/Machine Operator: Matric or 10+2 plus 2-year certificate in Mechanical trade from ITI; preference for candidates with knowledge of running and maintenance of bulk sterilizer/electrical or steam heaters.
  • Junior Technician (Civil): National Trade Certificate in Civil Draftsman trade or Diploma in Civil Engineering with 50% marks from recognized institution.
  • Junior Technician (Electrical): National Trade Certificate in Electrician trade or Diploma in Electrical Engineering with 50% marks from recognized institution.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2025)

  • General category: Minimum 18 years and maximum 37 years.
  • SC/BC of Punjab: Upper age limit 42 years.
  • Punjab and Central Govt employees: Upper age relaxation up to 45 years.
  • Ex-servicemen of Punjab: Upper age as per Punjab Recruitment of Ex-servicemen Rules, 1982; effective age is actual age minus service years, subject to maximum relaxations.
  • Widows, divorcees and certain other married women categories: Upper age relaxation up to 40 years as per Govt instructions.

Salary/Stipend

  • Hostel Superintendent-cum-PTI: Basic pay Rs. 29,200/- per month (Level-5, 7th CPC) under Punjab Industrial Training Non-Ministerial Service Rules 2025.
  • Storekeeper: Basic pay Rs. 19,900/- per month (Level-2, 7th CPC) under same rules.
  • Librarian: Basic pay Rs. 29,200/- per month (Level-5, 7th CPC).
  • Autoclave Operator/Machine Operator: Basic pay Rs. 25,500/- per month (Level-4, 7th CPC) under Punjab Veterinary/Husbandry Service (Group-C) amended rules 2025.
  • Junior Technician (Civil/Electrical): Basic pay Rs. 19,900/- per month (Level-2, 7th CPC) as per Punjab State Warehousing Corporation Staff (Conditions of Service) Regulations.

Application Fee

  • General / Sports / Freedom Fighter: Rs. 1000/-
  • SC / BC / Economically Weaker Section (EWS): Rs. 250/-
  • Ex-servicemen & Dependents: Rs. 200/-
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

Selection Process

  • Selection is based on an Objective Type (MCQ) written examination conducted by PSSSB.
  • Merit list is prepared solely on marks obtained in the written exam; tie-breaking is done by considering age (older higher), educational percentage, and then Matric marks if needed.
  • Based on merit and category-wise vacancies, candidates are called for counselling and document verification; final recommendations are sent to the concerned departments.
  • No candidate gains an automatic right of appointment merely by appearing in the exam or being in the merit list; eligibility is finally determined at counselling/document verification.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online only through PSSSB website https://sssb.punjab.gov.in under “Online Applications” from 05/12/2025 to 27/12/2025.
  • Applicants must complete registration to generate username and password, then log in and fill the step-wise online application form, uploading passport-size photo, signature and required certificates (Matric D.O.B proof, technical qualification, category certificate, etc.) in a single PDF.
  • Application will be accepted only after full fee payment; fee must be paid via SBI challan (any branch) or online via net banking/credit card/debit card/UPI up to 30/12/2025.
  • After fee payment, candidates can download the final application form on the next working day and must keep a copy safely for future reference.
  • No offline applications or late submissions will be accepted; no changes are allowed after final form submission except limited edits before first submit.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Public notice date for vacancies 22/11/2025
Advertisement publication date 28/11/2025
Start of online application 05/12/2025
Last date for online application and submission 27/12/2025 up to 05:00 PM
Last date for fee payment 30/12/2025

Instructions

  • Reservation benefits apply only to residents of Punjab; domicile certificate is required, not older than 5 years, to claim reserved category benefits.
  • SC/BC/ESM/EWS certificates must be as per latest Punjab Government formats; category codes must be carefully selected while applying.
  • Candidates must produce original educational, technical, category, domicile, and experience certificates and their self-attested copies at counselling; failure will result in cancellation.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for written examination or counselling; all communication including exam schedule, admit card, result and merit list will be published on PSSSB website only.
  • PSSSB reserves the right to correct errors in the advertisement, modify or cancel the recruitment process, and its decisions on eligibility and selection will be final.

  • No correspondences for engagement will be entertained.

  • If the marks of 10th Passed is given in CGPA the percentage of the same to be filled up in format (ONLINE Application) also.
  • Enrolment with Employment Exchange is must except for wards of employees of RCF/Kapurthala.
  • Engagement of Act Apprentices will be from the sources of candidates who have registered their names in the nearest Employment Exchanges.
  • Before applying, the candidates should ensure that he/she fulfils the eligibility and other criteria, at any stage of engagement and if erroneously engaged, such candidates shall be summarily dismissed without notice.
  • Candidature of the candidate shall be cancelled if he/she fails to produce the required original testimonials for verification or any other discrepancy noticed.
  • If it is noticed by the Railway administration that the applicant has furnished wrong/fake Certificates/ false certificates, the Railway administration reserves the right to discharge the candidate/selected candidate at any stage without notice even after his selection to undergo training.
  • The Railway administration do not undertake any responsibility for sending reply to the candidates not selected or not called for. No correspondence in respect of the application submitted shall be entertained or replied by this office to any individual or organization.
  • The Railway administration will not be responsible for any printing error.
  • A merit list will be prepared by the Committee who will then place the result before the Head of Workshop/Unit/Division for approval. The result should be declared within 15 days of the closure of receipt of application.
  • The candidates who are called for document verification are advised to bring their medical fitness certificate duly issued by Government authorized doctor (Gaz.) not below the rank of Asst. Surgeon of Central/State Hospital.
  • No daily allowance/conveyance allowance or traveling allowance will be paid to the candidate who will be called for document verification.
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances nor can the fee be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply ONLINE by visiting www.rcf.indianrailways.gov.in Detailed instruction for filling up ONLINE applications will be available on the website.
  • Candidates are required to log on the RCF website www.rcf.indianrailways.gov.in provided for filling ONLINE applications and fill up the personal details/BIO-DATA etc. carefully.
  • Candidates should ensure their name, father name, date of birth exactly match as recorded in Matriculation or equivalent certificate. Any deviation found during Document Verification will lead to cancellation of candidature and also debarment.
  • Candidates are advised to indicate their active mobile number and valid e-mail ID in the ONLINE application and keep them active during the entire engagement process as all important messages will be sent by email/SMS which will be treated as deemed to have been read by the candidates.
  • Candidates trying to submit more than one application with different particulars like Name/Father's name/community/Photo(face)/educational and/ or technical qualifications etc. or with different Email ID/Mobile Number are advised that all such applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates have to keep printout of their application. If found eligible, he/she will be called for Document Verification and the print out of Online application is required to be produced at the time of Document Verification.
  • Candidates are required to upload their passport size coloured photograph (size 3.5cm x 3.5 cm, not older than three months from the date of application in JPG/JPEG format, 100 PDI, Size of the image/file should be between 20 kb-70 kb) with clear front view of the candidates without cap and sunglasses.
  • Candidates are also required to upload their signature (size 3.5 cm x 3.5 cm, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, size of the file should be between 20 kb – 30 kb).
  • The ONLINE application, complete in all respects, can be submitted through ONLINE process to RCF up to 07.01.2026 till 24.00 hours. No physical copy of the application is required to be sent to RCF.
