Advertisement

All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bathinda (AIIMS Bathinda) Recruitment 2025 for 17 posts of Senior Resident, Junior Resident. Candidates with DNB, Master of Dental Surgery, MS/MD Can attend the walkin. The Walk-in interview on 23-12-2025. For detailed information please visit AIIMS Bathinda official website, aiimsbathinda.edu.in.

AIIMS Bathinda Senior Resident (Non-Academic), Junior Resident (Non-Academic) Recruitment 2025 Overview

Company Name All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bathinda (AIIMS Bathinda)
Post Name Senior Resident (Non-Academic), Junior Resident (Non-Academic)
No of Posts 17
Salary Rs 56100 to 67700
Qualification postgraduate degree i.e., MD/MS/DNB/MDS as per MCI rule in the specialty concerned from a recognized University/ Institute.
Age Limit 45 years
Official Website https://aiimsbathinda.edu.in

AIIMS Bathinda Senior Resident (Non-Academic), Junior Resident (Non-Academic) Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total Posts
Senior Resident (Non-Academic) 07
Junior Resident (Non-Academic) 10

Eligibility Criteria

For Senior Resident:

A medical qualification included in the first or second schedule or Part II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act 1956 (persons possessing qualifications included in the Part II of the third schedule should also fulfil the conditions specified in Section 13 (3) of the Act).

A postgraduate degree i.e., MD/MS/DNB/MDS as per MCI rule in the specialty concerned from a recognized University/ Institute.

For Junior Resident:

A medical qualification included in the first or second schedule or Part II of the third schedule of the IndianMedical Council Act 1956 (persons possessing qualifications included in Part II of the third schedule should also fulfil the conditions specified in Section 13 (3) of the Act).

Must be registered with the Central/State Medical Council.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Level – 11 of the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC (Pre-Revised PB – 3), entry pay of ₹67,700/- Per Month plus usual allowances plus NPA admissible under rules. NPA is applicable for Medical Candidates only.
  • Pay Level – 10 of the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC (Pre-Revised PB – 3), entry pay of ₹ 56,100/- Per Month plus usual allowances plus NPA admissible under rules. NPA is applicable for only Medical Candidates.

Age Limit 

  • For Senior Resident:- Not Exceeding 45 (forty five) years
  • For Junior Resident: - Not exceeding 37 (Thirty-seven) years

Important Dates

Date Description Date
Opening Date 13 December 2025
Closing Date (Crucial date for age limit and Essential Qualification) The Date of Walk-In-Interview
Last date for applying on Google form One Day Before The Date of Walk-In-Interview
Date of Interview 23/12/2025

Selection Process

  • Selection will be made on the basis of Walk-in- Interview. Short-listing a candidate for interview will be done on the basis of educational qualification, experience etc. and /or as per the short-listing criteria as may be decided by the Competent Authority.

General Information/Instructions

  • This is a rolling advertisement and will remain valid for one year, or until notified otherwise. The number of vacant posts will be displayed on the website in advance. Walk-in interviews will be conducted in the last week of every month, subject to availability of the vacancy. Candidates are advised to regularly visit the website for updates regarding available vacancies and exact date of walk-in interview.
  • The interview may also extend to the next day, if number of the applicants are more. Hence, kindly prepare yourself and plan your journey accordingly. No TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for attending the interview.
  • Upper age limit shall be determined as on the date of walk-in interview.
  • No age relaxation would be available to SC/ST/OBC Candidates applying for unreserved vacancies.
  • Age relaxation permissible to various categories is as under: - SC/ST Candidates 05 years OBC Candidates 03 years For Persons with Benchmark Disability 10 years
  • Age relaxation will be regulated as per the DoPT instructions.
  • To be eligible for selection for these posts, the candidate should pass the qualifying examination before the date of Interview and result should be declared to this effect on or before this date.
  • The candidates who are in service in any Government Institutions are required to submit No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of Interview.
  • Candidates applying under any of the reserved category posts, viz. SC/ST/OBC/PwBD will be considered subject to Caste/PwBD Certificate issued by the appropriate/ Competent Authority on the prescribed format. Community should be clearly and legibly mentioned in the Certificate.
  • For PwBD Candidates: Reservation to candidates belonging to Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) category is applicable by Govt. of India Policy, which will be provided on Horizontal basis to PwBD candidates in their respective categories. Criteria for Person with Benchmark Disability Candidate: The disability certificate should be issued by a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of the State or Central Govt. Hospitals / Institutions and countersigned by Medical Superintendent /CMO / Head of Hospital / Institution. Reservation for PwBD will be as per the guidelines /Instruction contained in DoP&T OM No. 36035/02/2017-Estt (Res) dated 15.01.2018 with regard to reservation for persons with disabilities. Only such persons would be eligible for reservation under PwBD quota in service/posts who suffer from not less than 40% of physical disability. Person who wants to avail the benefit of reservation would have to submit a Disability Certificate as issued by a Competent Authority in prescribed format. However, the candidature of PwBD applicant is subject to evaluation by a Medical Board duly constituted by the Executive Director of respective AIIMS or by the respective institute. This Medical Board will evaluate suitability of candidates for the post he/she is being considered for. All the instructions of Govt. of India as amended and as applicable in this matter will be followed.
  • For OBC Candidate:- Candidates applying under OBC category must produce the valid caste certificate in the format provided by the DoP&T vide O.M. No. 36036/2/2013-Estt. (Res.) dated 30.05.2014 and further clarification issued by DoP&T OM No. 36036/2/2013 Estt(Res-I) dated 31.03.2016. The certificate must mention the non- creamy layer status of the applicant (Non-creamy layer status issued by an authority mentioned in DOPT Office Memorandum no. 36012/22/93- Estt. (SCT) dated 15.11.1993). The OBC applicants who belong to the “Non-Creamy Layer” and whose caste appears in the Central List of the OBCs (notified by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment on the recommendations of the National Commission for Backward Classes available at the website http://ncbc.nic.in, shall be eligible to be considered under the OBC category (Validity period of OBC Certificate in respect of non-creamy layer status of the applicants as per DOPT Office Memorandum No. 36036/2/2013-Estt. (Res-I) dated 31 March 2016). The validity of the non-creamy layer certificate shall be issued for the financial year 2025 2026 (which is the year of advertisement) (considering income up to financial year ending on 31st Mar, 2025), issued from 1st April 2025 to the date of walk-in interview. If the applicant does not have the OBC non-creamy layer certificate valid for the financial year 2025-2026 at the time of applying, the applicant must submit the previously issued (older) OBC non- creamy layer certificate or the acknowledgment slip of the OBC non creamy layer certificate application. However, at the time when asked to submit/upload the valid certificate, the applicant must produce the applicable certificate valid for financial year (2025- 26) as said above. This additional certificate (if any) must have a reference of his / her already issued original caste certificate.
  • For EWS Candidate:- The vacancies advertised under EWS Category are as per the instructions issued by DoPT, Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pension, Govt. of India, vide OM. No. 36039/1/2019- Estt (Res), dated 31.01.2019. Application under EWS category will be considered subject to submission of Income and Assets certificate on a prescribed format issued by the competent authority and subject to verification of genuineness of the certificate by the issuing authority. In pursuance to DoP&T OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res), dated 31.01.2019, a EWS certificate issued in prescribed format for employment in Central Government on the basis on income of financial year 2024-2025, issued from 1st April 2025 to the date of walk-in interview. If the applicant does not have the EWS Category certificate valid for the financial year 2025- 2026 at the time of applying, the applicant must upload the previously issued (older) EWS certificate or the acknowledgment slip of the EWS certificate application. However, at the time when asked to submit/upload the valid certificate, the applicant must produce the applicable certificate valid for financial year (2025- 26) as said above.
  • Candidates who fail to produce valid category certificate OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PWBD etc. during document verification or as and when required to produce the same, the candidature will be cancelled. All candidates are advised to obtain required valid category certificate in advance to avoid cancellation of candidature at any stage of the recruitment process.
  • Candidates who have claimed the reservation category and failed to produce a valid category certificate as applicable as per published criteria the candidature shall be cancelled in the reserved category, and allocated seats shall be forfeited.
  • On the day of Walk-In-Interview, the candidate is required to be present ‘in person’ with filled Brief of the Candidate and all original certificates at Ground Floor, Admin Block, Medical College Building, AIIMS Bathinda before 09:00 AM along with one set of self-attested photocopies at the time of Walk-In Interview :- Identity Proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhar Card etc). Address Proof. Certificate showing Date of Birth. (Birth Certificate/Matriculation Certificate). Four recent passport size photographs. Class 10th & 12th Marksheet and Certificates. MBBS marksheet and degree certificates. Attempt and Internship Certificate. FMGE certificate conducted by NBE (For foreign graduate). Registration with Medical Council of India/State Medical Council. MD/DNB/MS/MDS degree certificate. (For SR) M.Sc Marksheet and degree certificates. (For non-medical candidates) PhD degree certificates. (For non-medical candidates) Experience Certificate, if any. Candidates working in Government Institution- No Objection Certificate. Publications, if any.
  • Note: Candidates who do not produce the above-mentioned original documents at the time of interview will not be considered for selection.
  • The appointment is for a period of 89 days and further extendable depending upon the performance/ conduct of the candidate, recommendation of the Head of the Department/discretion of the competent authority. This appointment will not vest any right to claim by the candidate for permanent absorption in the institute or for continued appointment, which may be renewed or terminated as decided by the Institute.
  • Candidates have to join within 15 days from the date of issue of appointment letter. No extension will be allowed in any circumstances.
  • All original documents to be brought on the date of interview as mentioned in para 6 above.
  • The above vacancies are provisional and subject to variation. The Executive Director, AIIMS, Bathinda reserves the right to vary the vacancies including reserved vacancies as per the Govt. of India rules/circulars and requirements.
  • Reservation will be as per Government of India Policy.
  • The post of Senior Resident and Junior Resident will be regulated as per the provision of Central Residency Scheme and governed by CCS (Temporary Service) Rules.
  • If an appointee wishes to apply somewhere else or resign within the first 03 (Three) months of joining, then neither he/she will be issued a No Objection Certificate (NOC) nor he/she will receive any Relieving Letter or Experience Certificate.
  • The appointee shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Juniority, Promotion etc, or any other benefits available to the Government Servants, appointed on regular basis,
  • In case, any information given or declaration by the candidate is found to be false or if the candidate has wilfully suppressed any material information relevant to his/her appointment, he/she will be liable to be removed from the service and any action taken as deemed fit by the appointing authority.
  • The candidates are advised to visit the institutional website for any additional information and confirm about date and time / venue before coming. No personal / by post information will be sent.
  • The Competent Authority reserves the right to change the number of vacancies, withdraw the process in full or in part and also the right to reject any or all applications received without assigning any reasons or giving notice etc.
  • The period of experience, wherever prescribed, shall be counted after obtaining the prescribed qualification.
  • The prescribed qualification is minimum requirement and mere possessing the same does not entitle any candidate for selection.
  • This appointment is full time and private practice of any kind is prohibited. He/ She will have to work in shifts and can be posted at any place in the Institute.
  • He/ She should also note that he/she will have to conform to the rules of discipline and conduct as applicable to the Institute employees.
  • No travelling or other allowances will be paid to the candidate for attending the walk-in- interview or joining the post.
  • The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law.
  • Canvassing in any form will render the candidate disqualified for the post.
  • The decision of the Competent Authority regarding selection of the candidate will be final and no representations will be entertained in this regard. The decision of the committee shall be final and binding.
  • All disputes will be subject to jurisdiction of Court of Law at Bathinda.

How to Apply

  • Fill the Google Form with below mentioned link and submit it, without which your application will not be completed:- Google Form Link: https://forms.gle/vwTf7RsER9KPonb96
  • Download the soft copy of the “Brief of the Candidate”, fill in the relevant details by typing in MS-Word, and bring the same on the date of the Walk-in-Interview.

  • Screening Test: In case large number of applications received for the Senior Resident post, a Screening Test may be conducted for short-listing of candidates. The Scheme and the method of Screening Test (Computer Based Test or Offline Test) shall be notified in due course on the website of AIIMS, Bathinda
  • Interview: Candidates called for interview will have to produce all relevant original documents in proof of details furnished in their application form
  • Final Selection: Selection will be made on the basis of interview/ written examination

General Information/Instructions

Reservation Criteria

For PwBD (Person with Benchmark Disability) Candidates:

  • Reservation to candidates belonging to Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) category is applicable by Govt. of India Policy, which will be provided on Horizontal basis to PwBD candidates in their respective categories
  • The disability certificate should be issued by a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of the State or Central Govt. Hospitals / Institutions and countersigned by Medical Superintendent /CMO / Head of Hospital / Institution
  • Only such persons would be eligible for reservation under PwBD quota who suffer from not less than 40% of physical disability
  • Person who wants to avail the benefit of reservation would have to submit a Disability Certificate as issued by a Competent Authority in prescribed format

For OBC Candidates:

  • Candidates applying under OBC category must produce the valid caste certificate in the format provided by the DoP&T vide O.M. No. 36036/2/2013-Estt. (Res.) dated 30.05.2014 and further clarification issued by DoP&T OM No. 36036/2/2013-Estt(Res-I) dated 31.03.2016
  • The certificate must mention the non-creamy layer status of the applicant
  • The OBC applicants who belong to the 'Non-Creamy Layer' and whose caste appears in the Central List of the OBCs shall be eligible
  • The validity of the non-creamy layer certificate shall be issued for the financial year 2025-2026 (which is the year of advertisement), issued from 1st April 2025 to 07th January 2026

For EWS Candidates:

  • Application under EWS category will be considered subject to submission of Income and Assets certificate on a prescribed format issued by the competent authority
  • A EWS certificate issued in prescribed format for employment in Central Government on the basis on income of financial year 2024-2025, issued from 1st April 2025 to 07th January 2026

Important Terms & Conditions

  • Tenure: The appointment is initially for one year and extendable up to maximum 03 (Three) years upon the recommendation of Head of the Department / discretion of the competent authority
  • Joining Period: Candidates have to join within one month from the date of issue of appointment letter. No extension will be allowed in any circumstances
  • Termination: The appointment can be terminated at any time by the Institute by giving one month notice or salary in lieu thereof
  • Full-time Position: This appointment is of full time and private practice of any kind is prohibited
  • Work Requirements: He/she will have to work in shifts and can be posted at any place in the Institute
  • Leave: The leave entitlement of the appointee shall be governed by the Institute's leave rules as amended from time to time
  • No Benefits: The appointee shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc., or any other benefits available to Government Servants appointed on regular basis
  • NOC/Relieving Letter: If an appointee wishes to apply somewhere else or resign within the first 03 (Three) months of joining, then neither he/ she will be issued a No Objection Certificate (NOC) nor he/ she will receive any Relieving Letter or Experience Certificate
  • Experience Counting: The period of experience, wherever prescribed, shall be counted after obtaining the prescribed qualification
  • Government Employees: The candidates who are in service in any Government Institutions are required to submit "No Objection Certificate" from the employer at the time of Interview
  • Discipline: He/ she should conform to the rules of discipline and conduct as applicable to the Institute employees
  • No Travelling Allowance: No travelling or other allowances will be paid to the candidates for interview and joining on selection
  • Court Conviction: The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law
  • Canvassing: Canvassing in any form will lead to a disqualification
  • Jurisdiction: All disputes will be subject to jurisdiction of Court of Law at Bathinda

Important Notes

  • The candidates who applied earlier vide Advertisement No. AIIMS/BTI/RC/SR/2076 dated 18 October 2025 shall be considered, and they are not required to apply again
  • The above vacancies are provisional and subject to variation. The Executive Director, AIIMS, Bathinda reserves the right to vary the vacancies including reserved vacancies as per the Govt. of India rules/circulars and requirements
  • Inadequately filled/ incomplete application form will be summarily rejected and no enquiry or representation will be entertained in this regard
  • Reservation will be as per Government of India Policy
  • Candidates who fail to produce valid category certificate OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PWBD etc. during document verification or as and when required, the candidature will be cancelled
  • The decision of the competent authority regarding selection of candidates will be final and no representation will be entertained in this regard

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications (TBE-XSM-01 Mechanical/Electrical): Diploma in Engineering (full time & regular) in the relevant trade from a recognized Board of Technical Education/Institute, OR Diploma awarded by Indian Air Force/Indian Army/Indian Navy after prescribed training.
  • Experience (TBE-XSM-01 Mechanical/Electrical): Minimum 2 years of working experience in Aircraft Maintenance.
  • Qualifications (TBE-XSM-02 Aerodrome): Intermediate/10+2/equivalent examination in any stream/subject approved by Central/State Education Boards.
  • Experience (TBE-XSM-02 Aerodrome): Minimum 03 years’ experience in aerodrome/flight operations by working at a flying base/station.
  • Candidates must have acquired qualifications through regular mode only.

Salary/Stipend

  • Basic Pay on Induction: Rs. 23,000/- for D6 Channel; Rs. 21,000/- for B4 Channel.
  • Dearness Allowance (revised quarterly) on Basic Pay.
  • Perks & Allowance at the rate of 25% of the Basic Pay (includes Conveyance, Canteen, Washing, Magazine, Professional Development, Special Allowances).
  • Allowance towards medical reimbursement: Lump sum amount of Rs. 1500/- per month.
  • Other benefits: Monthly/Annual Incentive, Quarterly Performance Pay, Night Shift Allowance (if applicable), Uniform, Shoe Allowance, HRA (if company quarter not provided).
  • An annual increase of 3% during the tenure shall be admissible on the Basic Pay subject to satisfactory performance.

Age Limit (as on 10-12-2025)

  • Maximum Age: 28 years.
  • Ex-Servicemen can deduct their service period from their actual age; resultant age must not exceed maximum age limit by more than 3 years.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 10 years for PwBDs.
  • Upper age limit with all relaxations shall not exceed 55 years (56 years for PwBD).

Application Fee

  • Application fee is Rs. 200/- which is non-refundable.
  • Fee is exempted for SC/ST/PwBD categories.

  • Candidates will be shortlisted for a Written Test based on qualification and experience requirements.
  • The Written Test will be 2 ½ hours long, comprising Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) in three parts (General Awareness, English & Reasoning, Concerned Discipline).
  • There is no negative marking; each question carries 1 mark.
  • Candidates must secure at least 50% marks in the written test to qualify.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification in order of merit.
  • Provisional Offers of Engagement will be issued after successful Document Verification and candidates will undergo a Pre-employment Medical examination.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals need to apply.
  • Age and Experience are calculated as on 10-12-2025.
  • Engagement is on a tenure basis for a maximum of four years and does not guarantee regular/permanent employment.
  • Selected candidates will undergo Induction Training for a period of 8 weeks.
  • Selected candidates will be deployed in shifts as per company requirements and are liable to be transferred to any HAL location based on organizational requirements.
  • Candidates possessing higher qualifications than prescribed should not apply, their candidature will be rejected.
  • No relaxation in Health Standards will be allowed during the pre-employment medical examination.

How To Apply

  • Interested and eligible candidates need to apply ONLINE through the HAL website (www.hal-india.co.in).
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfill all eligibility criteria before applying.
  • Applications received through ONLINE mode will be screened as per the norms laid down in the notification.

Event Date

  • Selected candidates in the written test will have to appear before the verification Committees for verification of their original documents.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Senior Project Engineer: First class B.E/B.Tech in Computer Science/IT/ECE or equivalent degree, MCA/MSc (Computer Science or IT)
  • Project Engineer: First class B.E/B.Tech in Computer Science/IT/ECE or equivalent degree, MCA/MSc (Computer Science or IT)
  • For all the posts indicated, the candidates should have qualified from an AICTE/UGC-approved college/Institute or recognized University.
  • In case any University/Institution or college is following an evaluation system of CGPA/DGPA/OGPA or letter grade, wherever applicable, it is mandatory for the candidate to submit proof of Percentage (%) issued by the university/Institution/College and awarded class along with the degree certificate.

Salary/Stipend

  • Senior Project Engineer: Rs.60,000 - 75,000 per month
  • Project Engineer: Rs.39,100 - 50,000 per month

Age Limit

  • Senior Project Engineer: Maximum 40 years as on 26.12.2025
  • Project Engineer: Maximum 45 years as on 26.12.2025

Application Fee

No application fee is charged by C-DAC for applying to this advertisement.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 11-12-2025
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 22-12-2025
  • Interview Date: 26.12.2025
  • Interview Reporting Time: 10 am to 11am only

Selection Process

  • Candidate should meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the advertisement.
  • The qualification and experience prescribed, are the minimum requirements and possession of the same does not automatically make the candidates entitled to be called for written test and/or selection processes.
  • There will be an initial screening based on the academic records and other parameters declared in the online application and only screened-in candidates will be considered for further selection process.
  • The management reserves the right to increase/alter the minimum eligibility criteria/cut-off limits, in the event that the number of applicants is more, for any post(s), at its discretion. Candidates will be selected on the basis of their academic credentials, experience profile, written test marks (if any), performance in the interview, and such other selection processes/parameters, as adopted and deemed fit by management.
  • Mere application and fulfillment of the mentioned qualifications etc., does not entitle a candidate to be called for written/skill test/ interview. C-DAC may restrict the number of candidates to be called to participate in the interview/selection process to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. The candidates should, therefore, furnish all the qualifications and experience possessed in the relevant field, over and above the minimum qualifications prescribed.
  • The selection process shall be carried out by the respective C-DAC Centre based on its requirements and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with the original documents at the time of document verification or at any stage of the recruitment process. If any documents/information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or non-conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at any stage of the recruitment and selection process without any prior intimation.
  • The candidature is also liable for rejection at any stage if C-DAC comes across any evidence/knowledge that the qualification, experience and any other particulars indicated in the application/other forms/formats are not recognized/false misleading and/or amounts to suppression of information/particulars which should have been brought to the notice of C-DAC.

Important Notes

  • C-DAC reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts or not to recruit against any post notified in this notification at its discretion without any notice/notification.
  • It is the responsibility of the candidates to assess his/her own eligibility for the post for which he/she is applying in accordance with the advertisement. In case, it is found at any point of time in the future during the process of selection or even after the appointment that the candidate was not eligible as per the prescribed qualification, experience etc, which could not be found at the time of selection due to whatever circumstances, his/her candidature/appointment shall be liable to be canceled/terminated as case may be without giving any notice.
  • Candidates who are applying for multiple posts should submit a separate application for each post.
  • In case of ambiguity/dispute arises on account of interpretation in a version other than English, the English version will prevail.
  • Candidates are not required to send printouts of the application or any other documents in hard copy to C-DAC.
  • Interview Call Letters, other correspondences (if any), etc. will be sent to candidates only through email to the email ID provided in their online application. No hard copy will be sent.
  • Mere issue of an Interview call letter to the candidate will not imply acceptance of candidature or selection for the post.
  • In the case of internal candidates, please note that the finally selected candidates will have to resign from the current services and join the selected post as fresh employees.
  • All queries pertaining to recruitment including the selection process should be addressed to our Recruitment Team only through [email protected]
  • Kindly note that we have not authorized any agent/ agency to represent C-DAC for anything related to recruitment or its processes.
  • C-DAC reserves the right to cancel or introduce any Personal Interview/Other selection process. C-DAC also reserves the right to cancel/restrict/curtail/enlarge the recruitment process and/or the selection process without any notice and without assigning any reasons.
  • C-DAC reserves the right to fill/not fill up the post or even to cancel the whole or part of the process of recruitment without assigning any reason thereof.
  • All the posts will be filled as per the applicable Rules/guidelines of C-DAC.
  • The candidates are advised to visit the C-DAC website regularly. Notice/ information, Corrigendum, Extension, etc., if any, shall be published on our website www.cdac.in only.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid for attending a written examination/ interview.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification for selection.

Selection Process

  • Stage-I Written examination: 120 marks The written examination (objective type multiple-choice) of 2 hours duration will be conducted on OMR sheets and will test the candidates' proficiency in English language, general knowledge, general aptitude, reasoning and Assamese language (20 marks).
  • The Assamese language proficiency segment will be of qualifying nature. Candidates securing at least 40% marks i.e. 8 out of 20 marks in the Assamese language proficiency segment shall be treated as qualified to appear in the next stage. The marks obtained in the Assamese language segment shall not be taken into account while preparing the merit list.
  • There shall be negative marking in the written examination. For every incorrect answer, 0.25 mark (one-fourth of the marks allotted to the question) will be deducted.
  • Interview/Viva-Voce: 20 marks Candidates equal to 3 times the number of vacancies (1:3) in order of merit in the written examination will be called to appear in the Interview/Viva-Voce and verification of documents. A candidate must secure at least 60% i.e. 12 out of 20 marks in the Interview/Viva-Voce in order to be considered qualified.
  • Final selection will be made on the basis of the total marks obtained by the candidate in the written examination (Stage-I) and Interview/Viva-Voce (Stage-II). Where more than one candidate obtains same grand total marks, the candidate who obtains more marks in the written examination will get preference. Where the marks obtained by such candidates in the written examination are also same, then the candidate who is senior in age will get preference. The Gauhati High Court reserves the right to fix or alter the cut off mark in written examination and Interview/Viva-Voce.

General Information/Instructions

A copy of the email should also be sent to [email protected].
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances. The fee will also not be held in reserve for any other vacancies.
  • Candidates are advised in their own interest to apply online well before the last date and not to wait till the last date, so as to avoid heavy load on internet or website.

However, candidates have to produce their original testimonials regarding educational qualification, claim of reservation, date of birth, caste, working experience (if applicable), etc. at subsequent stages when asked for.
  • No person, who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living or who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, shall be eligible for appointment to any of the aforementioned posts.
  • The admission of candidates at all stages of the selection process shall be purely provisional and subject to their satisfying the prescribed eligibility criteria. If, on verification at any time before or after the selection process, it is found that a candidate does not fulfil any of the eligibility condition, his/her candidature shall stand cancelled without any notice. Mere calling of candidate to written examination/Interview etc. or issuance of admits cards/call letter etc. does not mean acceptance of candidature of any candidate which shall be further scrutinized at every stage and the High Court reserves the right to reject the candidature of any candidate at any time.
  • The provisional list of the candidates and reject list (if any) will be published in the High Court website for the candidates' reference.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to the candidate for appearing in any stages of the selection process.
  • Valid Disability Certificate for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), if applicable, must be issued by competent authority.
  • Candidates who are already in the Government Service in State/Central/PSU may apply after intimating their employers regarding submission of online application forms for the advertised vacancies. They shall have to produce \"No Objection Certificate\" from their present employer at the time of document verification and \"Release Order\" at the time of appointment.
  • The High Court may decide not to issue any admit card/call letter etc. to any candidate and may decide to call candidates to written examination/Interview etc. by publishing a notification in the official website and notice board of the High Court. Candidates are advised to visit the official website (www.ghconline.gov.in) of the High Court regularly for updates and important information. Unnecessary correspondence should be avoided.
  • Application form, which is incomplete in any respect, such as without the photograph and signature upload, is liable to be rejected summarily, unless otherwise decided by the High Court.
  • Any information submitted by an applicant in his/her application will bind the candidate personally. The candidate will be responsible for any mistake made by him/her in the application form and the High Court shall not be responsible or liable in any way.
  • The certificate for claim of benefit of reservation must be issued by the competent authority.
  • If any candidate is found canvassing directly or indirectly, his/her candidature will be rejected.
  • The High Court reserves the right to cancel the advertisement, alter any terms and conditions of the advertisement at any stage.
  • The answer keys of the question paper for the written examination will be uploaded in the Official Website after the examination for reference.
  • The examination materials will be destroyed following the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) laid down in Notification No. 50 dated 26-06-2025 issued by the High Court.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications:

  • Discipline Code 107 - Trade Apprentice (Fitter): Matric with regular full time 2 year ITI (Fitter) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT
  • Discipline Code 108 - Trade Apprentice (Electrician): Matric with regular full time 2 year ITI (Electrician) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT
  • Discipline Code 109 - Trade Apprentice (Electronics Mechanic): Matric with regular full time 2 year ITI (Electronics Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT
  • Discipline Code 110 - Trade Apprentice (Instrument Mechanic): Matric with regular full time 2 year ITI (Instrument Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT
  • Discipline Code 111 - Trade Apprentice (Machinist): Matric with regular full time 2 year ITI (Machinist) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT
  • Discipline Code 101 - Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 102 - Technician Apprentice (Electrical): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 103 - Technician Apprentice (Instrumentation): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 104 - Technician Apprentice (Civil): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 105 - Technician Apprentice (Electrical & Electronics): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 106 - Technician Apprentice (Electronics): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 112 - Graduate Apprentice: Regular full time Graduate in any discipline (BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/University
  • Discipline Code 113 - Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator (Fresher): Class 12th (but below graduate) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/Board
  • Discipline Code 114 - Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator (Skilled Certificate Holders): Class 12th (but below graduate) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% in case of SC/ST/PwBD candidates from a recognized Institute/Board. Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government

Essential Conditions:

  • The qualification prescribed shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a full-time regular course in relevant disciplines
  • Qualification acquired through Part-time/Correspondence/Distance Learning mode shall render the candidate NOT ELIGIBLE
  • For Graduate and Technician disciplines, only those applicants who have acquired the prescribed qualification between 01.04.2022 and 31.12.2025 shall be considered eligible
  • For Trade Apprentices (ITI/Data Entry Operator) only those applicants who have acquired the prescribed qualification between 01.04.2021 and 31.12.2025 shall be considered eligible
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech., MBA or equivalent or MCA/CA/ICWA, LLB or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining the apprenticeship training shall NOT BE ELIGIBLE
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute
  • Candidates possessing Diploma in Engineering in relevant trade/discipline under a recognized lateral entry scheme shall also be considered eligible subject to meeting prescribed percentage of marks

Previous Apprenticeship Training Conditions:

  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training, and the second training shall not be in the same trade
  • There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed
  • No gap shall be required in the case of termination of previous apprenticeship training due to failure on the part of the employer
  • Where an apprentice has terminated a previous apprenticeship contract due to health or financial hardship or relocation, transportation or career changes or language barrier, the waiting period of three month shall apply before the apprentice shall enter into another contract of apprenticeship with the same employer or any other employer and there shall be no waiting period for women

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, Apprentices Rules 1992/2019/2025 as amended from time to time
  • The exact stipend amount will be communicated at the time of engagement
  • Stipend will be paid on monthly basis during the apprenticeship training period

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years (maximum age up to 29 years)
  • Age Relaxation for OBC-NCL: 3 years (maximum age up to 27 years)
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: 10 years (maximum age up to 34 years)
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (SC/ST): 15 years (maximum age up to 39 years)
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (OBC-NCL): 13 years (maximum age up to 37 years)
  • Date of Reckoning: 31.12.2025

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the notification
  • The application process is completely online and free of cost

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 10/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 10/12/2025 (10:00 AM onwards)
Last Date for Registration in NAPS/NATS Portal 09/01/2026 (5:00 PM)
Last Date for Microsoft Form Submission 09/01/2026
Date of Reckoning (Age & Qualification) 31/12/2025
Period of Apprenticeship Training 12 Months

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for selection process
  • No Written Test/Interview: There will be no written test or interview for the selection
  • Merit-Based Selection: Merit list of all the candidates who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the post
  • The shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification
  • Candidates will have to complete Pre-engagement medical fitness test for being adjudged suitable for engagement
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format
  • Shortlisted candidates whose documents including Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting process shall be considered for filling by eligible and qualifying candidates from the panel cum merit list from the same opportunity

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates are advised to register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the NAPS/NATS portals under the respective State as per their Trades
  • Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator) must register at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/
  • Technician Apprentice (Diploma) must register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Graduate Apprentice must register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Candidates need to LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings with the Establishment ID: NATS - EWBKOC000077, NAPS - E05201900011
  • Candidates MUST ensure their profile (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in application
  • Candidates have to apply for ANY ONE DISCIPLINE CODE ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one discipline Code will not be considered
  • The candidature of the applicant would be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to his/her being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation
  • The decision of the Management will be final and binding on all candidates on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of the applications
  • Applications which are incomplete or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria shall not be considered "Eligible" and treated as "Rejected"
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such apprentices
  • Candidates must have an active email ID and Mobile number which must be valid for at least 1 year as all future communications will take place through email alerts
  • Candidates must have PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, and Bank Account linked with Aadhar
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence shall be shared only on the website
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL-Non-Creamy Layer) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to their fulfilling the standards applicable to General category
  • Reservation for PwBD shall be applied on horizontal basis, across all categories, as per Government guidelines
  • PwBD are not eligible to apply for Discipline Code 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register on NAPS/NATS Portal based on your category:
    • Trade Apprentice - ITI/Data Entry Operator: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/
    • Technician Apprentice - Diploma: https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Graduate Apprentice: https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Login to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID/Email ID

Post Name Total Vacancies

Social Category UB AB
OBC/MOBC 27% 27%

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Constable (UB): Higher Secondary (HS) or Class XII passed from Government recognized Board or Council
  • Constable (AB): HSLC or Class X passed from Government recognized Board or Council
  • Applicants having educational qualification of Higher Secondary and above may apply for both Armed Branch and Unarmed Branch with clear preference indication

Essential Requirements

  • Applicant must be a Citizen of India and Permanent Resident of Assam
  • Must be registered with a local Employment Exchange in Assam
  • Must speak Assamese or any other State language fluently
  • Selected applicants will have to submit Proof of Residence after publication of Final Select List (SC, ST, OBC/MOBC exempted)

Experience

  • For Home Guards/VDP/Civil Defence Volunteers: Minimum 1 year service certificate required for reservation quota benefit; Minimum 3 years service for age relaxation
  • For SPOs: Appointment Certificate required for reservation and age relaxation benefits
  • For FMMOs: Certificate issued by Special Branch, HQrs. of Assam Police, Kahilipara, Guwahati required

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 14,000 - 70,000/- per month
  • Grade Pay: Rs. 5,600/-
  • Other Benefits: Allowances as admissible under the Rules
  • Pension Benefits: Selected applicants shall be entitled to pension benefits as per the pension scheme existing at the time of appointment

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years (Applicants born not later than 01-01-2008)
  • Maximum Age: 25 years (Applicants born not before 01-01-2001)

Age Relaxation

  • SC, ST(P) and ST(H): 5 years relaxation beyond upper age limit
  • OBC/MOBC: 3 years relaxation beyond upper age limit
  • Home Guards/VDP/Civil Defence Volunteers (served 3 years or more): Additional 3 years relaxation
  • Former Members of Militant Organization (FMMOs)/SPOs: Additional 10 years relaxation
  • Age will be calculated based on Matriculation/HSLC Admit Card or Certificate issued by recognized Board/Council only
  • No other documents like Horoscope, Affidavit, Birth Extract etc. will be accepted for age proof

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: NIL - There will be no Application Fee for this recruitment

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 05-12-2025
Online Application Start Date 16-12-2025
Online Application Last Date 16-01-2026
Edit Option Available (After Last Date) 5 days from 16-01-2026 (Only once, subject to SLPRB approval)
Last Date for Document Submission 16-01-2026 (All documents must be issued on or before this date)
Age Calculation Date As on 01-01-2026
PET & PST Date Will be notified later on official website
Written Test Date Will be notified later on official website
Viva-Voce Date Will be notified later on official website

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) - 40 marks for Constable (UB) Male & Female, 40 marks for Constable (AB) Female, 60 marks for Constable (AB) Male
  • Stage 2: Medical Examination - Applicants will be examined by Medical & Health Officer for mental and bodily health parameters
  • Stage 3: Physical Standard Test (PST) - Height and Chest measurement (No marks, qualifying in nature)
  • Stage 4: Written Test - 50 marks (100 MCQ questions, 0.5 marks each, no negative marking)
  • Stage 5: Oral/Viva-Voce - 5 marks
  • Academic Weightage: 5 marks (Only for Constable UB based on HS percentage)
  • Biometric verification will be conducted at entry, exit and during all stages of recruitment
  • Shortlisting for Written Test: 5 times the number of posts based on PET merit
  • Shortlisting for Viva-Voce: 2 times the number of vacancies based on PET + Written Test merit

Total Marks Distribution

  • Constable (UB) Male & Female: PET (40) + Written (50) + Viva (5) + Academic (5) = 100 marks
  • Constable (AB) Male: PET (60) + Written (50) + Viva (5) = 115 marks
  • Constable (AB) Female: PET (40) + Written (50) + Viva (5) = 95 marks

Physical Standards

Category Male Height Female Height Male Chest (Normal) Male Chest (Expansion)
General/OBC/MOBC/SC/ST(P) 162.5 cm 154 cm Min. 80 cm +5 cm
ST(H) 160 cm 152 cm Min. 78 cm +5 cm

Medical Standards

  • Applicants must be in good mental and bodily health
  • Must be free from physical deformities and diseases like diabetes, heart disease, hernia, piles, respiratory diseases, knock-knee, flat foot
  • Should not be colour blind or squint eyed
  • Eye Sight: Distance vision should be 6/6 for at least one eye and not poorer than 6/9 for the other without correction; Near vision should be normal
  • Varicose vein shall be considered as temporary disqualification

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants must register in the application portal only once for all advertisements using single Application ID
  • Multiple Application IDs using different mobile numbers will lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Name must be entered exactly as per HSLC Certificate
  • Valid mobile number and email address must be provided and kept active throughout recruitment process
  • Documents required: Latest passport photo (max 450 KB), Signature (max 100 KB in black/blue ink), Age proof, Mark sheets, Employment Exchange Card, Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • All documents uploaded must be issued on or before 16-01-2026
  • Caste Certificate must be from Competent Authority authorized by Govt. of Assam only
  • Admit Card and Identity Proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID/Driving License) mandatory for PET & PST
  • CCTV surveillance and RFID chips will be used for Race events
  • Individual statement of marks signed by applicant and conducting officer will be provided
  • No TA/DA will be admissible for journey and stay during any stage of recruitment
  • The number of posts may increase or decrease at any time due to administrative reasons
  • Final appointment subject to satisfactory Police Verification and Medical Examination Report
  • Selected candidates must undergo basic police training and serve minimum 3 years after posting
  • Selected applicants will be required to work in any District or Unit anywhere in Assam
  • No payment required at any stage except medical investigations in Government Hospital if required
  • Anonymous complaints will not be entertained
  • Incomplete, defective or invalid applications will be summarily rejected
  • Candidature will be rejected for providing wrong information, fake documents, misrepresentation or impersonation at any stage

Written Test Details

  • 100 Multiple Choice Questions on OMR sheet
  • Each correct answer carries 0.5 marks (Total 50 marks)
  • No negative marking
  • Question level: Class IX and X standard
  • Subjects: Elementary Arithmetic, General English, Logical Reasoning/Mental Ability, Assam's History/Geography/Polity/Economy, General Awareness/GK and Current Affairs
  • Languages Available: Assamese, Bodo, Bengali, English

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register on the SLPRB portal at www.slprbassam.in with valid mobile number (Register only once for all advertisements)
  • Step 2: Provide accurate information including Employment Exchange Number, Highest Qualification, Permanent District, Gender, Caste/Category, Date of Birth, and Aadhaar Number
  • Step 3: After successful registration, an Application ID will be generated - keep it safe for future reference
  • Step 4: Login using Application ID or Registered Mobile Number along with Date of Birth
  • Step 5: Apply for the relevant Advertisement (SLPRB/REC/CONST (AB & UB)/727/2025/94)
  • Step 6: Upload mandatory documents - Photograph (450 KB max), Signature (100 KB max), Age Proof, HSLC/HS Mark sheets and Certificates, Employment Exchange Card, Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • Step 7: Upload additional documents if claiming reservation/quota benefits (Home Guard/VDP/SPO/FMMO/Sports/NCC certificates)
  • Step 8: Select post preferences clearly (UB/AB if applying for both)
  • Step 9: Fill in all personal and academic details carefully
  • Step 10: Generate OTP and download the Acknowledgement Slip
  • Step 11: Keep Acknowledgement Slip and Application ID safe for future reference
  • Edit option available for 5 days after last date (only once, subject to SLPRB approval) for inadvertent entry corrections
  • Bring all original documents with one set of self-attested photocopies on the day of PET & PST for verification
  • Detailed instructions available on SLPRB website at time of application submission

Post Name No. of Posts Monthly Fixed Remuneration
Procurement Specialist (World Bank supported Project “Support School Education in Assam” PMU) 01 Rs. 1,20,000/- to Rs. 1,50,000/-

Eligibility Criteria

  • Engineering or Commerce graduate with MBA or Master’s Degree/Post Graduate Diploma (minimum two years duration) in any discipline from any Government recognized university/institution.
  • Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in project procurement and contract management.
  • Experience of procurement rules of the World Bank/Externally Aided Projects (EAP).
  • Proven experience in preparing procurement plans, bid documents, evaluation reports and contracts as per Bank Standard Bidding Documents (SBD) and managing procurement processes.
  • Thorough knowledge of procurement through Government e-Marketplace (GeM) and Assamtenders and ability to upload bids on these platforms.
  • Thorough knowledge of General Financial Rules (GFR), Assam Public Procurement Act 2017, Assam Public Procurement Rules 2020, Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) guidelines and GeM procedures.
  • Age between 18 and 45 years as on 01-01-2025, calculated based on Matriculation/HSLC Admit Card or Pass Certificate issued by recognized Board/Council.

Salary/Stipend

  • The Procurement Specialist will receive a monthly fixed remuneration in the range of Rs. 1,20,000/- to Rs. 1,50,000/-.
  • Remuneration will be paid under the PMU fund of the World Bank supported Project “Support School Education in Assam” and is strictly project-based.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2025)

  • The candidate should not be less than 18 years of age and not more than 45 years of age as on 01-01-2025.
  • The age limit will be calculated on the basis of the Matriculation/HSLC Admit Card or Pass Certificate issued by a recognized Board/Council; no other document will be accepted for age calculation.

Application Fee

  • The advertisement does not mention any application fee for the Procurement Specialist post under the World Bank supported project.

Selection Process

  • Only eligible candidates will be called for test/interview; the exact date and time will be communicated separately.
  • Marking pattern will cover General Awareness, Personality & Aptitude, subject matter in relevant field, and relevant experience for the post.
  • The applicant must secure minimum 50% of the total marks in the interview to be shortlisted.
  • Decision of the Selection Committee in all aspects including acceptance/rejection of applications, conduct of test and final selection will be final and binding.

General Information/Instructions

  • A Project Management Unit (PMU) is being set up in Assam for implementation of the World Bank supported project “Support School Education in Assam” for a period of 5 years, and engagements are purely temporary.
  • The posts are temporary, with initial engagement for 11 months only; contractual engagement will not be regularised under any job/programme of Government of Assam or Samagra Shiksha Axom in future and no right to permanent absorption is created.
  • The link for the recruitment portal will be available on Samagra Shiksha website https://ssa.assam.gov.in and candidates must carefully read the User Guidelines before filling the online application.
  • Claims for correction will not be entertained after submitting online registration and application; the office will not be responsible for non-submission due to errors or other problems.
  • Candidates must be in good mental and bodily health and free from any physical defect likely to interfere with efficient discharge of duties.
  • The authority reserves the right to cancel the advertisement at any time without assigning any reason or in case of non-receipt of suitable candidates.

How to Apply

  • Eligible Indian citizens must apply online through the recruitment portal link available on the Samagra Shiksha website https://ssa.assam.gov.in.
  • Candidates must read the User Guidelines on the recruitment portal carefully before filling the online registration and application form.
  • Applicants must upload supporting documents of educational qualification, experience and other relevant certificates through the portal.
  • Only online applications submitted between 17.12.2025 and 31.12.2025 will be accepted; no offline applications are mentioned.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed separately about the exact date and time of test/interview through appropriate communication channels.

For Assistant Teacher (Arts & Science)

If such condition is detected even after the candidate joins and if the conduct of the candidate will be penalised as per prevailing laws/ rules. The decision of the authority as to the eligibility or otherwise regarding applicant/candidate shall be final. Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

Advertisement
Company Name Birangana Sati Sadhani Rajyik Vishwavidyalaya, Golaghat, Assam (BSSRV)
Post Name Junior Assistant, Office Assistant
No of Posts 2 (1 Junior Assistant, 1 Office Assistant)
Salary Rs. 14,000–60,500 + Grade Pay Rs. 6,400/- (as per 7th CPC) for both posts.
Qualification Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce or any stream + minimum 6 months computer diploma/certificate with proficiency in MS-Office, Internet etc.; English typing 35 wpm desirable for Office Assistant.
Age Limit 21 to 40 years as on 04/01/2026 (upper age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/MOBC/PWBD as per Govt. rules).
Start Date for Apply  24/11/2025 (Starting date of online applications).

BSSRV Junior Assistant, Office Assistant Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Sl. No. Post Name Total Posts
1 Junior Assistant 1
2 Office Assistant 1

Eligibility Criteria

  • For Junior Assistant: Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce or any stream from a recognized University.
  • For Office Assistant: Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce or any stream from a recognized University.
  • Both posts: Minimum 6 (six) months Diploma/Certificate in computer proficiency from a Government recognized institute.
  • Both posts: Proficiency in basic computer applications like MS-Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access), Internet etc. is required.
  • Office Assistant: Desirable – English typing speed 35 wpm (10500 KDPH with average 5 key depressions per word) and experience of working in any higher educational institution.
  • Junior Assistant: Desirable – Experience of working in any higher educational institution.

Age Limit (as on 04-01-2026)

  • Minimum age: 21 years.
  • Maximum age: 40 years.
  • Upper age relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST (up to 45 years); 3 years for OBC/MOBC (up to 43 years); 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PWBD) irrespective of category as per Govt. Memorandum.
  • Age will be calculated based on HSLC/Class X/Class XII Admit Card/Pass Certificate/Marksheet where Date of Birth is clearly mentioned; no other document will be accepted for age proof.

Application Fee

Category Application Fee (Rs.)
General, OBC/MOBC 1500
SC/ST NIL
BPL NIL
PWBD NIL
  • Fee to be deposited in the account “SATI SADHANI UNIVERSITY”, A/C No. 40535146080, IFSC SBIN0000083, State Bank of India, Golaghat Branch, and payment receipt must be submitted with hardcopy.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale for Junior Assistant: Rs. 14,000–60,500 with Grade Pay Rs. 6,400/- as per 7th CPC.
  • Pay Scale for Office Assistant: Rs. 14,000–60,500 with Grade Pay Rs. 6,400/- as per 7th CPC.
  • Other allowances and benefits, if any, will be as per University and Government norms applicable to the posts.

Selection Process

  • Phase-I: Screening Test (OMR-based General Studies MCQ) – 2 hours, 100 marks covering current affairs, Assam & Indian History, Geography, Economy, Indian Polity & Constitution, Numerical Ability, Mental Ability, sports/books/authors/important persons of Assam, literature, culture & festivals of Assam.
  • Phase-II: Written Test (Conventional Type) – General English (Report Writing, Comprehension, Grammar) 50 marks, Office Procedure & General Administration 25 marks, Precis Writing, Drafting & General Knowledge 25 marks; duration 2 hours, total 100 marks.
  • Phase-III: Computer Practical Test and Interaction – Computer Practical Test (50 marks, 1½ hour) and Academic Credentials (50 marks); final merit list will be prepared based on performance in Phase-II and Phase-III.
  • Date, time and venue of examinations/interaction will be notified later on the University’s official website; mere fulfillment of minimum eligibility does not guarantee being called for interview and decision of the Screening Committee shall be final.

How To Apply

  • Visit the online SAMARTH web link https://bssrvnt.samarth.edu.in for submission of application.
  • Fill the online application form with all required details and upload necessary documents as per instructions.
  • Pay the applicable application fee (if any) into the specified bank account and enter transaction details (transaction number, ID, amount) in the online portal.
  • After successful online submission, take a printout (hardcopy) of the online application.
  • Send the hardcopy of the online application along with fee payment receipt and required documents so as to reach the Registrar, Birangana Sati Sadhani Rajyik Vishwavidyalaya, Golaghat, on or before 19/01/2026.
  • Applications without the prescribed fee (where applicable) will not be considered and will be summarily rejected; fees once paid are non-refundable and cannot be reserved for other exams.

Closing Date of Online Applications 04/01/2026
Last Date of Receipt of Hardcopy of Online Applications 19/01/2026

  • Applications without the prescribed fee wherever applicable will be rejected and no representation against such rejection will be entertained.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disability (PWBD) can apply even if the post is not reserved for them but identified as suitable; only those with at least 40% relevant disability are eligible for reservation and relaxations.
  • Government employees of Assam in regular service must upload service certificate and, if seeking pay protection/continuation, a No Objection Certificate from the competent authority.

Eligibility Criteria for HPRCA Hamirpur Junior Office Assistant, Steno Typist and Other 2025

Candidates must possess Graduation from recognized university + Certificate/Diploma in Library Science + Computer knowledge as per Department of Personnel guidelines dated 19.07.2025.

Special Educator (Pre-Primary to Class-V): 10+2 with 50% marks or Graduation AND Diploma in Education (D.Ed.) in Special Education approved by RCI, or D.El.Ed. with RCI recognized qualification. Must have passed the TET.

Steno Typist: Must have passed 10+2 from a recognized Board AND possess a minimum speed in short-hand and typing on computers in both English (60 WPM Shorthand, 25 WPM Typing) and Hindi (60 WPM Shorthand, 25 WPM Typing).

The age limit for HPRCA Hamirpur Junior Office Assistant, Steno Typist and Other Recruitment 2025 is:

Candidates must be Indian citizens, preferably Himachal Pradesh domiciles for reservation benefits.

  • Skill Test: Typing test (qualifying nature)
  • Document Verification
  • Merit List: Based on written exam marks using Z-Score method

Note: Check official notification for exact selection procedure and qualifying marks (45% for General, 40% for reserved)

Essential Qualifications

  • Gender: Female Candidate only
  • Domicile: Himachal Bonafide

  • Maximum Age: 32 years
  • Age Relaxation: Age will be reckoned as on 01-01-2025

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee (All Categories): ₹800.00 (In proceeding fee)
  • Correction Fee: ₹100.00 (A link for correction window shall be opened for a period of seven days, commencing after three working days from the closing date for submission of ORA)
  • Note: The candidates of all categories shall be required to pay ₹100/- as examination fee and ₹800/- is processing fee

Mode of Payment

  • The candidates are requested the requisite fee through "Online Payment Gateway" using Credit Card/Debit Card/ Net Banking/UPI or through such other electronic mode as may be available during payment

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 06.12.2025
Opening Date for Application (ORA) Form 12.12.2025 (10:00 AM)
Closing Date for Submission of Application (ORA) Form 16.01.2026 (till 11.59 PM)
Correction Window Opens After three working days from closing date (7 days period)
Age Calculation Date As on 01-01-2025

Selection Process

  • Mode of Selection: Computer Based Test/ written screening test of 120 marks of 1 ½ hours (one and a half hours) duration (As decided by the Aayog)
  • Examination Pattern: The objective type screening test will consist of 120 multiple-choice questions, with each question carrying 1 mark
  • Syllabus:
    • Subject(s) field(s) upto the level of prescribed essential qualification(s) as notified in the advertisement - 85 questions
    • General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh, Current Affairs - 10 questions
    • Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi of Matric Standard - 25 questions
  • Normalization Method: In case of CBT examination, the score of candidates shall be normalized using Z-Score Method (Mean and Standard Deviation Method) for preparation of the merit list
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
    • General category candidates: 45% marks (petGEN-UR)
    • Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/ Other Backward Classes candidates: 40% marks
    • General category candidates in respect of examination relating to the posts falling in the Scheduled Caste or other reserved categories: Maximum of 5% relaxation (i.e., upto 40% for General category candidates and 35% for candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes)
  • Waiting Panel: While preparing the final result, a category wise waiting list (panel) shall be prepared. The candidates placed in the waiting list/panel shall have no right to be appointed except when a selected/recommended candidate does not join and the waiting list is still in reserved for respective field/s being kept in use same name of waiting list/panel of re-reserved and joining unreserved appointing authority

General Information/Instructions

  • The candidates must read the instructions/other terms and conditions carefully before filling up ORA forms for the post(s) concerned
  • Incomplete ORA submitted without any/full requisite document in support of their eligibility for the concerned post, scanned photograph and signatures of prescribed size etc. will be rejected straightaway
  • ORA must be submitted with complete necessary original certificates/documents and shall not be entertained thereafter whatsoever link will be made available only for the time indicated from 12.12.2025 (10:00 AM) to 16.01.2026 (till 11.59 PM)
  • No Offline Application Form will be accepted by the HPRCA. The candidates are required to apply online through ORA
  • A correction window shall be opened for a period of seven days, commencing after three working days from the closing date for submission of ORA, to be subjected to payment of fee
  • The candidates must be registered on One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling the ORA
  • The candidates must meet the instructions/other terms and conditions carefully before filling up ORA Forms for the post(s) concerned
  • The candidates are supposed to upload the entire mandatory document(s), which will be visible for all future reference regarding the examination/tests, downloading call numbers/call letters/entering for detail etc
  • The candidates are advised to give their working i/public landline/Mobile No. PIN Code and E-mail ID, send it to them in the online recruitment application (ORA) and ensure their working till the completion of selection process to avoid inconvenience
  • The candidates belonging to reserved categories are required to submit Income & Asset Certificate, valid at the time of ORA as well as at the time of document verification
  • The validity of certificate is valid on the date of ORA as well as valid on the date of document verification is required to be seen at the time of documentation
  • The validity of the certificate is valid on the date of certificate as per one year from the date of its issuance
  • Candidates belonging to disabled categories with disability of 40% or more are allowed extra time of minimum 40 minutes for examination of two base duration (i.e. 90 minutes per hour). In case of visually impaired candidates, 2 hours 10 minutes time is allowed for examination with a Scribe, if request for the same to the Centre Superintendent immediately after receipt of his roll number/admit card
  • The prescribed closing date is in respect of Essential Qualification(s) and Experience, if any shall be the prescribed closing date for submission of Online Recruitment Application (ORA) Form i.e. 16.01.2026 till 11:59PM
  • Candidates must visit the Aayog's website from time to time for updates in their own interest
  • The detail of posts, eligibility conditions, mode of selection and other terms and conditions are available in the detailed notification

How to Apply

  • Application Mode: Online through official website of HPRCA
  • Step 1: Register on One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling the ORA
  • Step 2: Visit the official website: https://hprca.hp.gov.in
  • Step 3: Fill the Online Recruitment Application (ORA) Form carefully with all required details
  • Step 4: Upload necessary documents:
    • Recent color photograph (Passport size)
    • Self-attested scanned photograph and scanned signature
    • All required certificates (Educational, Domicile, Category, etc.)
  • Step 5: Pay the application fee of ₹800/- through online payment gateway (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/UPI)
  • Step 6: Submit the completed ORA form before the last date: 16.01.2026 (till 11:59 PM)
  • Step 7: Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference
  • Note: No offline application will be accepted. Candidates must apply only through the online mode
  • Correction Window: A correction window will be available for 7 days after 3 working days from the closing date (subject to payment of ₹100 correction fee)
  • Important: Candidates are advised to visit the Aayog's website https://hprca.hp.gov.in from time to time for updates

Event Date

The selection process depends on the number of eligible candidates:

Advertisement
