GSSSB Physiotherapist Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

Post Name Total Posts
Physiotherapist, Class-3 138

Note:

  • Reserved posts for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) will be announced through a special recruitment campaign separately
  • Ex-Servicemen reservation: 13 posts (10% of total vacancies)
  • The number of vacancies may increase or decrease
  • Reserved vacancies are meant only for candidates originally from Gujarat

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

  • Essential: Bachelor Degree in Physiotherapy obtained from any University established or incorporated by or under the Central or State Act in India; or any other educational institution recognized as such or declared to be deemed as a University under section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956
  • Computer Knowledge: Basic knowledge of Computer Application as prescribed in the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967
  • Language: Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or Both
  • Registration: Candidate shall require to get himself/herself registered with the Indian Association of Physiotherapist, if not already registered at the time of making application
  • Future Registration: Candidate shall require to get registered with the Gujarat State Council for Physiotherapist as soon as the said Council is constituted under section 3 of the Gujarat State Council for Physiotherapist Act, 2011

Experience

  • No prior experience required for this post

Salary/Stipend

  • Initial 5 Years: Fixed pay of Rs. 49,600/- per month as per Finance Department resolutions dated 16/02/2006, 29/04/2010, 06/10/2011, 20/10/2014, 20/10/2015, 18/01/2017, and 18/10/2023
  • After 5 Years: Upon satisfactory service completion, regular appointment in 7th Pay Commission pay scale of Rs. 39,900/- to Rs. 1,26,600/- (Level-7)
  • Additional Benefits: Other benefits as per government resolutions will be applicable
  • Note: This is subject to the judgment in SLP No.14124/2012 and SLP No.14125/2012 pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court

Age Limit (as on 15/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 35 years
  • Age Relaxation for General Category Women: 5 years (up to 40 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Reserved Category Men: 5 years (up to 40 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Reserved Category Women: 10 years (5+5) (up to 45 years)
  • Age Relaxation for General Category PwD Men: 10 years (up to 45 years)
  • Age Relaxation for General Category PwD Women: 15 years (10+5) (up to 45 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Reserved Category PwD Men: 15 years (5+10) (up to 45 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Reserved Category PwD Women: 20 years (5+10+5) (up to 45 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen: Period of service rendered plus 3 years
  • Note: Upper age limit may be relaxed for candidates already in Gujarat Government service as per Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967

Application Fee

Category Preliminary Examination Fee
Unreserved Category Rs. 500/-
Reserved Categories (All Women candidates, SEBC, SC, ST, EWS, PwD, Ex-Servicemen) Rs. 400/-

Important Notes:

  • Application fee must be paid online only through Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or Wallets
  • Transaction charges as per rules will be applicable in addition to examination fee
  • Fee payment last date: 26/12/2025 (23:59 hours)
  • Fee Refund: Candidates who appear for the examination will be refunded the examination fee through the same medium used for payment
  • Candidates who do not appear for the examination will NOT be refunded the fee
  • Fee once paid will NOT be refunded if application is rejected by the Board

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Published 06/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 09/12/2025 (14:00 hours)
Online Application Last Date 15/01/2026 (23:59 hours)
Fee Payment Last Date 17/1/2026 (23:59 hours)
Qualifying Date for Age/Educational Qualification 15/01/2026
Examination Date To be announced on official website

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: One-stage competitive examination through MCQ (Multiple Choice Questions) based Computer Based Response Test (CBRT) / Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) method
  • Examination Parts: The examination will be conducted in two parts - Part-A and Part-B
  • Part-A (60 Marks, 60 Questions):
    • Logical Tests and Data Interpretation: 30 marks
    • Mathematical Tests: 30 marks
  • Part-B (150 Marks, 150 Questions):
    • Indian Constitution, Current Affairs, Gujarati and English Comprehension: 30 marks
    • Subject-related questions and their application: 120 marks
  • Total Questions: 210 questions (Part-A: 60 + Part-B: 150)
  • Total Marks: 210 marks
  • Duration: 3 hours (180 minutes) for both parts combined
  • Negative Marking: 1/4 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer
  • Qualifying Standard: Minimum 40% marks required separately in both Part-A and Part-B for all categories
  • Merit List: Based on total marks obtained in both parts (after meeting qualifying standards)
  • Certificate Verification: Approximately twice the number of vacancies will be called for document verification based on merit
  • Final Selection: Based on merit, subject to certificate verification and medical fitness

General Information/Instructions

Citizenship

  • Candidate must be a citizen of India or hold nationality as per provisions of Rule-7 of Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967

For SC/ST/SEBC Candidates

  • Caste certificate must be in the prescribed format and obtained from competent authority as determined by Gujarat Government
  • SEBC Candidates: Must submit Non-Creamy Layer certificate as per Annexure-4 (Gujarati format) or Annexure-A (Central Government format for reservation under Central Government jobs)
  • Certificate should be based on income of Financial Year 2022-23/2023-24/2024-25
  • Certificate must be obtained between 01/04/2023 to 15/01/2026
  • Married SEBC women candidates must submit certificate based on parents' income, NOT husband's income

For EWS Candidates

  • Must submit Income and Asset Certificate as per Annexure-KH (English) or Annexure-G (Gujarati) format
  • Certificate should be obtained between 24/12/2022 to 15/01/2026
  • Alternatively, Income and Asset Certificate for EWS reservation under Central Government obtained between 01/04/2025 to 15/01/2026 based on Financial Year 2024-25 income is also acceptable

For PwD (Persons with Disabilities) Candidates

  • Disability certificate must be as per notifications/provisions issued by Government of India, Health and Family Welfare Department, Gujarat Government, or Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat Government
  • Eligible disabilities: Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV), Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH), One Arm (OA), One Leg (OL), Both Legs (BL), One Arm and One Leg (OAL), Dwarfism (Dw), Acid Attack Victim (AAV), Spinal Deformity (SD), Spinal Injury (SI) without neurological/limb dysfunction, Specific Learning Disability (SLD) 40-70%, Mental Illness (MI) 40-70%, Multiple Disabilities (MD)
  • 10 years age relaxation for PwD candidates (maximum up to 45 years)

For Ex-Servicemen Candidates

  • Must have rendered at least 6 months service in Navy/Air Force/Army
  • Must possess competent authority's identity card and discharge book
  • Age relaxation: Period of service rendered plus 3 years
  • Candidates retiring within one year from the last date of application can also apply

For Widow Candidates

  • 5% additional marks will be added to total marks/normalized marks obtained in the examination
  • Must not have remarried at the time of appointment
  • If widow status is acquired after application submission or during any stage of recruitment, benefit will be applicable from that stage onwards

For Sports Persons

  • 5% additional marks for candidates who represented at National/International level or Inter-University or All India School level competitions
  • Eligible sports: Athletics (Track and Field), Badminton, Basketball, Cricket, Football, Hockey, Swimming, Table Tennis, Volleyball, Tennis, Weightlifting, Wrestling, Boxing, Cycling, Gymnastics, Judo, Rifle Shooting, Kabaddi, Kho-Kho, Archery, Horse Riding, Shot Put, Rowing, Chess, Handball
  • Certificate must be obtained from prescribed authority in prescribed format

Computer Knowledge

  • Candidates must possess certificate/marksheet of Basic Computer Knowledge from any training institution as per Government resolution dated 13/08/2008 and 18/03/2016
  • Alternatively, any Computer Diploma/Degree/Certificate course from government recognized university/institution is acceptable
  • Certificate of passing Class 10 or Class 12 examination with Computer as a subject is also acceptable
  • Candidates without such certificate can apply but must submit it before appointment, otherwise appointment will be cancelled

Important Guidelines

  • Only online applications will be accepted through https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in
  • Candidates must carefully read the entire advertisement before applying
  • Keep all original certificates ready while filling online application
  • Information filled in online application will be final and cannot be changed after confirmation
  • Upload recent passport size photograph with white background (taken within 1 year from last date of application)
  • Photograph size: 5 cm height x 3.6 cm width
  • Signature size: 2.5 cm height x 7.5 cm width
  • Photo and signature must be in JPG format (maximum 15 kb)
  • Same photograph must be used throughout the recruitment process
  • Keep mobile number and email ID active throughout recruitment process
  • Download and save application form and fee receipt for future reference
  • If multiple applications are submitted, only the last confirmed application will be considered valid

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official website https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in
  • Step 2: Click on "Online Application" and select GSSSB
  • Step 3: Select Advertisement No. 328/202526, Physiotherapist, Class-3 and click on "Apply"
  • Step 4: Read "More Details" section carefully before applying
  • Step 5: Click on "Apply Now" and skip the initial screen to open Application Format
  • Step 6: Fill "Personal Details" carefully (fields marked with red asterisk * are mandatory)
  • Step 7: Fill "Educational Details" section
  • Step 8: Accept terms and conditions in "Assurance" section by selecting "Yes" and click "Save"
  • Step 9: Application Number will be generated - save it for future reference
  • Step 10: Upload photograph and signature as per specifications
  • Step 11: Click on "Confirm Application" and verify all details thoroughly
  • Step 12: Once satisfied, click "Confirm Application" - NO changes possible after confirmation
  • Step 13: Confirmation Number will be generated - save it carefully
  • Step 14: Pay application fee online through Debit Card/Internet Banking/UPI/Wallets before 26/12/2025 (23:59 hours)
  • Step 15: Download and print payment receipt
  • Step 16: Download and print application form for future reference
  • Step 17: Keep checking official website https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in for updates on examination date and admit card

For Technical Support: Contact GSSSB office at Phone: 079-23258916 for any assistance regarding educational qualification, age limit, online application, or fee payment

Eligibility Criteria

  • Senior Scientific Officer (both Centres): Not more than 40 years of age; Ph.D. in relevant discipline OR Master’s degree in Forensic Psychology/Psychology/Criminology/Neuropsychology/Clinical/Investigative Psychology or other Psychology discipline; Ph.D. holders need minimum 2 years’ experience, Master’s degree holders need minimum 5 years’ analysis/research experience in eligible government/research/forensic/industry organizations; desirable experience in polygraph, BEOS, SDS, Eye Detect & LVA.
  • Junior Scientific Officer (Centre for Happiness and Wellbeing): Not more than 35 years; Master’s in Psychology/Criminology/Neuropsychology/Forensic/Clinical/Investigative Psychology or any Psychology/Forensic Psychology discipline or Master’s in Forensic Science with specialization in Psychology/Criminology; 3 years’ analysis/research experience in relevant fields in government/research/forensic labs or industry; Ph.D. full-time counts as max 3 years’ research experience; desirable Ph.D. and experience in polygraph, BEOS, SDS, Eye Detect & LVA.
  • Junior Scientific Officer (Multimedia Forensics): Not more than 35 years; BE/B.Tech in CSE/ECE/IT/Electronics/EEE/Computer Science & Engineering (Cyber Security) OR Master’s in Computer Science/IT/Electronics/Physics/Forensic Science (with physical sciences)/Cyber Forensics/Digital Forensics/Information Security/Cyber Security/Multimedia Forensics/ICT/AI/Data Science/Cyber Security Management; 3 years’ analysis/research experience in relevant field in forensic labs/recognised institutes/industry; Ph.D. full-time counts as max 3 years’ research; desirable Ph.D., familiarity with forensic audio-video tools and FSL experience.
  • Junior Scientific Officer (DNA Forensics): Not more than 35 years; Master’s in Zoology/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Genetics/Human Genetics/Molecular Biology/Life/Biological Sciences/Forensic Biotechnology/Forensic Science (Biology/Biotechnology) OR BE/B.Tech in Biotechnology; 3 years’ analytical/research experience in relevant field in government/recognised labs/research institutes/industry; Ph.D. full-time counts as max 3 years’ research; desirable Ph.D., knowledge of forensic DNA technology and FSL experience.
  • Senior Scientific Assistant (Multimedia Forensics): Not more than 30 years; BE/B.Tech in CSE/ECE/IT/Electronics/EEE/Computer Science & Engineering (Cyber Security) OR same set of relevant Master’s degrees as JSO (Multimedia Forensics) with Forensic Science (physical sciences) eligibility; desirable experience with forensic audio-video tools and FSL work.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Age between 18 and 27 years (relaxable for Govt. servants up to 40 years); Bachelor’s Degree in any one of Physics, Mathematics, Botany, Zoology, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Physical Anthropology, Genetics, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Pharmacy, Forensic Science or Criminology from a recognised University/Institute.

Salary/Stipend

  • Senior Scientific Officer posts are in Pay Level 10 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix with corresponding monthly pay and allowances as per NFSU/GoI rules.
  • Junior Scientific Officer posts are in Pay Level 7; Senior Scientific Assistant in Pay Level 6; Laboratory Assistant in Pay Level 5, all with pay and allowances as applicable to NFSU technical staff.
  • All posts are regular direct recruitment positions with probation and service conditions as per University norms.

Age Limit (as on 18-01-2026)

  • The date for determining eligibility including age shall be the prescribed closing date for submission of online application i.e. 18/01/2026.
  • Upper age: 40 years for Senior Scientific Officer; 35 years for all Junior Scientific Officer posts; 30 years for Senior Scientific Assistant; 18–27 years for Laboratory Assistant with relaxation for Government servants up to 40 years.

Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

Advertisement

Start Date for Apply  16/12/2025 (14:00 hours)
Last Date for Apply  30/12/2025 (23:59 hours)
Official Website https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in

GSSSB Junior Pharmacist, Class-III Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total Vacancies
Junior Pharmacist, Class-III (Paramedical Cadre) 209

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidate must be an Indian citizen or possess nationality as per Rule 7 of the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967.
  • Must possess:
    • A Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy or Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) obtained from a University established by or under a Central or State Act in India, or from an educational institution recognized as or deemed to be a University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956; OR
    • A Diploma in Pharmacy obtained from a University established by or under a Central or State Act in India or from an institution recognized as or deemed to be a University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, with about two years’ experience as a Junior Pharmacist in Government, Government Undertaking or Board, or as a Dispenser in hospitals/dispensaries, or as a Pharmacist or Medical Representative of a pharmaceutical company established under the Companies Act, 2013.
  • Must possess basic knowledge of computer application as prescribed in the Gujarat Civil Services Classification (General) Rules, 1967.
  • Must possess adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both.
  • The candidate selected by direct recruitment is required to be registered with Gujarat State Pharmacy Council under the Pharmacy Act, 1948 at the time of appointment, if not already registered.

Salary/Stipend

  • For the first five years, appointment will be on fixed pay of Rs. 40,800 per month as per Finance Department resolutions dated 16/02/2006, 29/04/2010, 06/10/2011, 20/10/2014, 20/10/2015, 18/01/2017 and 18/10/2023.
  • After completion of five years, subject to satisfactory service and as per applicable resolutions, the candidate will be placed in the pay scale of Rs. 29,200 to Rs. 92,300 (Level-5) of the 7th Pay Commission in the concerned office.
  • The above is subject to the outcome of Hon’ble Supreme Court cases SLP No.14124/2012 and SLP No.14125/2012.

Age Limit (as on 30-12-2025)

  • Minimum age: 18 years (candidate must not be less than 18 years on 30/12/2025).
  • Maximum age: 35 years (candidate must not have completed 35 years on 30/12/2025), subject to relaxations as per Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967.
  • Category-wise upper age relaxations:
    • General category female candidates: 5 years.
    • Reserved category male candidates: 5 years.
    • Reserved category female candidates: 10 years (subject to maximum 45 years).
    • General category PwD male candidates: 10 years (subject to maximum 45 years).
    • General category PwD female candidates: 15 years (subject to maximum 45 years).
    • Reserved category PwD male candidates: 15 years (subject to maximum 45 years).
    • Reserved category PwD female candidates: 20 years (subject to maximum 45 years).
    • Ex-servicemen: Relaxation in upper age equal to length of service rendered in armed forces plus three years, as per rules.

Application Fee

  • As per General Administration Department letter dated 31/01/2024, the examination fee structure is:
    • Preliminary examination fee for Unreserved category candidates: Rs. 500/-.
    • Preliminary examination fee for all reserved category candidates (all women, SEBC, SC, ST, EWS, PwD and Ex-servicemen): Rs. 400/-.
  • The fees paid shall be refunded to those candidates who appear in the examination.
  • All candidates must pay the examination fee only through online mode after submitting application and obtaining confirmation number, up to 02/01/2026 (23:59 hours).
  • Online payment options: Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or Wallets via OJAS website.
  • In addition to examination fee, candidates must bear applicable transaction charges as per norms.
  • Fee will not be accepted after the last date under any circumstances and fee once paid will not be refunded, including in case of rejection of application.
  • Applications without payment of prescribed fee will be treated as invalid and will be rejected without any separate intimation.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Start date for online application (OJAS) 16/12/2025 (14:00 hours)
Last date for online application submission 30/12/2025 (23:59 hours)
Last date for payment of examination fee (online) 02/01/2026 (23:59 hours)
Cut-off date for educational qualification, age limit, Non-Creamy Layer (SEBC), EWS, caste & other eligibility certificates 30/12/2025
Notification date 15/12/2025

Selection Process

  • Selection will be through a single-stage competitive examination of MCQ type using CBRT/OMR method as per General Administration Department resolution dated 08/11/2023.
  • The examination will consist of two parts:
    • Part-A (Total 60 marks):
      - Mental Ability Test and Data Interpretation – 30 marks
      - Quantitative Aptitude – 30 marks
    • Part-B (Total 150 marks):
      - Constitution of India, Current Affairs, Gujarati & English Comprehension – 30 marks
      - Questions related to the concerned subject and its applicability – 120 marks
  • Total questions: 210 (60 in Part-A and 150 in Part-B); total duration: 3 hours (180 minutes) for both parts together.
  • Negative marking: For each wrong answer, 1/4 of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted.
  • Provisional Answer Key will be published and objections will be invited; Final Answer Key will be prepared after considering objections.
  • If any question is cancelled in the Final Answer Key, its marks will be distributed on a pro-rata basis over remaining questions.
  • Minimum qualifying standard: 40% separately in Part-A and 40% separately in Part-B for all categories; this minimum cannot be reduced below 40% for any category.
  • After declaration of provisional result, approximately twice the number of candidates against category-wise vacancies will be called for certificate verification based on merit.
  • Final selection list and waiting list (if applicable) will be prepared category-wise on the basis of marks obtained and as per applicable Government resolutions.
  • Recommendation for appointment will be sent to the concerned Government department; appointment will be subject to satisfaction of the appointing authority regarding suitability, verification of certificates, training and examination, and other service rules.

General Information/Instructions

  • All instructions regarding recruitment will be published on the Board’s website https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in and candidates must check the website periodically.
  • Candidates must keep original certificates of educational qualification, age, school leaving certificate, category (SC/ST/SEBC/EWS), PwD, Ex-serviceman and other eligibility proofs with them while filling online application, and must enter details strictly as per these certificates.
  • Any incorrect information in the application may lead to rejection of candidature at any stage.
  • Reservation is applicable only to candidates belonging to reserved categories of Gujarat State as per rules.
  • Women reservation is provided as per General Administration Department notification dated 11/11/2014; if suitable women candidates are not available, such posts will be filled from male candidates of the respective category.
  • PwD candidates’ reservation for this cadre will be notified separately through a special recruitment drive; hence PwD reservation is not reflected in this advertisement, though eligible PwD candidates may apply as per admissible disability types mentioned.
  • SEBC candidates must produce valid Non-Creamy Layer certificate in prescribed format for financial year 2022-23/2023-24/2024-25, obtained between 01/04/2023 and 30/12/2025, or valid certificate as per Government of India format where applicable.
  • EWS candidates must produce valid EWS certificate as per Annexure-KH / prescribed format issued between 31/12/2022 and 30/12/2025, or valid Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2024-25 within the specified period.
  • PwD candidates shall be given age relaxation and facilities like scribe/compensatory time as per Government notifications and The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, subject to submission of prescribed certificates and forms within the stipulated time.
  • Ex-servicemen will get 10% reservation and age relaxation as per Government rules; if suitable Ex-servicemen are not available, such seats will be filled from candidates of the respective categories.
  • Widow female candidates and eligible sportspersons will get additional marks/relaxations as per relevant Government resolutions, subject to production of required certificates.
  • Computer knowledge certificate of basic computer course or equivalent qualification as per GAD resolutions is mandatory; those not having such certificate at application stage must produce it before appointment, failing which appointment will not be granted.
  • Candidates having foreign university degrees must produce equivalence/recognition certificates from UGC or competent authority within the verification timeline.
  • Any attempt to use unfair means, impersonation, fake documents, misrepresentation, or influence on Board officials will lead to disqualification, cancellation of candidature/selection, debarment from future recruitments and legal action including under Gujarat Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2023.
  • The entire recruitment process will be governed by Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967 and the specific recruitment rules for this cadre, along with relevant Government resolutions and amendments.
  • The Board reserves full right to modify or cancel this advertisement and/or recruitment process at any stage without assigning reasons.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online only; no other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Visit the website "https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in".
  • Click on “On line Application” and then select “GSSSB”.
  • Click on the advertisement for Junior Pharmacist, Class-III, Advt. No. 329/2025-26 and then click “Apply”.
  • On the screen, options “More Details” and “Apply Now” will appear; read the detailed advertisement by clicking on “More Details”.
  • Click “Apply Now” to open the application form; first fill “Personal Details” carefully (all fields marked with * are mandatory).
  • After personal details, fill “Educational Details”.
  • In the “Assurance” (Declaration) section, accept the conditions by selecting “Yes” and click “Save”. After saving, an “Application Number” will be generated; note and keep it safely.
  • Upload recent passport-size photograph and signature in JPG format as per given dimensions and size (Photo: 5 cm height x 3.6 cm width; Signature: 2.5 cm height x 7.5 cm width; maximum size 15 KB), using the “Upload Photograph” option with Application Number and Date of Birth.
  • After uploading photo and signature, go to “Confirm Application”, enter Application Number and Date of Birth, verify all details and then confirm the application. After confirmation, no changes will be allowed.
  • On confirmation, a “Confirmation Number” will be generated; note and keep it safely as it will be required for all further processes including fee payment and admit card download.
  • Click “Print Application”, select Job/Advertisement number, enter Confirmation Number and Date of Birth, and take a printout of the application form for future reference; candidates should retain this printout till completion of recruitment process.
  • Each candidate should submit only one application for this advertisement; if multiple applications are submitted, only the last confirmed application will be considered and earlier applications will be cancelled.
  • After obtaining Confirmation Number, pay the examination fee online through OJAS portal under “Print Application Form / Pay Fees” by selecting the online payment option and completing the transaction before 02/01/2026 (23:59 hours); take printout of the fee receipt/e-receipt and keep it safely.
  • Applications without valid online fee payment (where applicable) will be rejected automatically.

The National Forensic Sciences University (NFSU), a prestigious Institution of National Importance operating under the Ministry of Home Affairs, has announced a significant recruitment drive for 28 various non-academic positions. The university is seeking qualified Indian Nationals to fill key administrative, engineering, and library roles across its numerous campuses nationwide. This direct recruitment offers an opportunity to join a leading forensic sciences institution, with all applications required to be submitted online via the official Samarth Portal between December 18, 2025, and January 18, 2026.

The advertised positions span multiple pay levels and departments, including vital roles like Deputy Registrar, Assistant Registrar, Deputy and Assistant Engineers (Civil/Electrical), Statistical Assistant, and library cadre staff. Candidates with the required educational qualifications and relevant experience are encouraged to apply. The selection process involves either an interview or a written test depending on the post applied for, and successful candidates should note that appointment is transferable across any of the NFSU's campuses nationwide, including Gandhinagar, Delhi, Goa, and Bhopal.

NFSU Various Non-Academic Positions 2025 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for NFSU Recruitment 2025 is 28 posts, distributed across Non-Academic and Library Cadre positions as follows:

Post Name Total Posts
Deputy Registrar 7
Assistant Registrar 9
Deputy Engineer (Civil) 1
Assistant Engineer (Civil) 3

Statistical Assistant 5

Library Assistant 3

Academic Pay. PwBD reservation is horizontal and adjusted against respective categories.

Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility varies by position, encompassing educational qualifications, age limits, and experience requirements.

1. Educational Qualification & Experience

  • Deputy Registrar: Master’s Degree with 55% marks, plus 9 years experience as Assistant Professor (Level 10+) or 5 years as Assistant Registrar or equivalent.
  • Assistant Registrar: Master’s Degree with 55% marks, plus 3 years experience in relevant university fields (Procurement/HR/Academics/Accounts/Examinations).
  • Deputy Engineer (Civil): Bachelor’s in Civil Engineering (55%) (Master's preferred), plus 2 years relevant experience.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil/Electrical): Bachelor’s in Civil/Electrical Engineering (55%). Master’s degree is desirable.
  • Statistical Assistant: Bachelor Degree with Statistics as a special subject.
  • Assistant Librarian: Master’s Degree in Library Science (55%), consistently good academic record, and must have cleared UGC NET/SLET/SET or hold a Ph.D. as per regulations.
  • Library Assistant: Bachelor’s degree in Library & Information Science or equivalent, typing speed 30 wpm in English, and computer knowledge.

2. Age Limit

Age is determined as of the closing date of application:

  • Deputy Registrar: Not more than 50 years.
  • Assistant Registrar / Deputy Engineer (Civil) / Assistant Librarian: Not more than 40 years.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil/Electrical) / Statistical Assistant: 21 to 35 years.
  • Library Assistant: Not more than 32 years.

Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/OBC/Disabled/Ex-servicemen candidates as per Government of India rules. The upper age limit is not applicable to existing government/university employees.

3. Nationality

Candidates must be citizens of India.

Application Fee

The application fee is non-refundable:

  • General/EWS/OBC Candidates: ₹500/- + GST & transaction charges.
  • SC/ST Category, PwBD, and Women candidates: Exempted from paying the application fee.

Salary/Stipend

Posts fall under the 7th Pay Matrix system. Based on general Government of India norms for these levels, the approximate starting basic pay ranges are:

  • Deputy Registrar (Level 12): Basic Pay approx. ₹78,800 per month.
  • Assistant Registrar / Assistant Librarian (Level 10 / Academic Level 10): Basic Pay approx. ₹56,100 per month.
  • Deputy Engineer (Civil) (Level 9): Basic Pay approx. ₹53,100 per month.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil/Electrical) (Level 8): Basic Pay approx. ₹47,600 per month.
  • Statistical Assistant (Level 5): Basic Pay approx. ₹29,200 per month.
  • Library Assistant (Level 4): Basic Pay approx. ₹25,500 per month.

Selected candidates will receive basic pay within the respective pay matrix level, plus other admissible allowances as per government norms.

Selection Process

  • For Sr. No. 01, 02, and 07 (Registrar & Librarian posts): Selection will be based on overall record and performance in an interview. A screening test may be conducted to shortlist candidates.
  • For Sr. No. 03, 04, 05, 06, and 08 (Engineer & Assistant posts): Selection will be based on merit in a written test. The university may conduct a screening test to shortlist candidates.
  • Original documents must be produced at the time of interview/document verification.

How To Apply

Eligible candidates can apply online for NFSU Recruitment 2025 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the NFSU Samarth Portal link: https://nfsunt.samarth.edu.in.
  2. Fill in the online application form with correct details.
  3. Upload all required documents (Photo, Signature, Certificates, Category Certificates/NOC, etc.).
  4. Pay the application fee online if applicable.
  5. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications and fees for each post.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Date 18/12/2025
Online Application Start Date (Portal Open) 18/12/2025 (12:00 PM IST)
Online Application End Date (Last Date for Submission) 18/01/2026 (11:59 PM IST)

Instructions

The positions are for direct recruitment and candidates will be on probation for two years as per university norms. Selected candidates may be posted at any of the NFSU Campuses across India (Gandhinagar, Delhi, Goa, Agartala, Bhopal, Dharwad, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Raipur, Nagpur, Chennai, Jaipur) and positions are transferable across all campuses. No TA/DA will be paid for attending tests or interviews. Candidates in service must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview.

Project Scientist-I 1 (One post)
Project Research Scientist-I 1 (One post)
Total Vacancies 2

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications (Project Scientist-I): Ph.D. in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university.
  • Qualifications (Project Research Scientist-I): Post Graduate Degree in Life Sciences, including the integrated PG degree, from a recognized university.
  • Essential qualifications: All educational qualifications must be from a recognized Board/University. Experience required shall be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications.
  • Desirable (Project Scientist-I): Proficiency in bioinformatics analyses for metagenomes/whole genomes/Nanostring, strong wet lab experience.
  • Desirable (Project Research Scientist-I): First-author paper in a PubMed-indexed journal, expertise in Molecular Biology, microbiology, tissue culture work, familiarity with animal handling, protein purification and biophysical assays.
  • Experience: Post-qualification experience of three years is sometimes required depending on the specific government/ICMR rules for that level, though not explicitly stated as a minimum for these specific roles besides the degree requirement.

Salary/Stipend

Monthly consolidated emoluments are specified for each post:

  • Project Scientist-I: ₹ 75,000/- per month.
  • Project Research Scientist-I: ₹ 56,000/- per month, plus HRA (House Rent Allowance).
  • No claims for regularization of employment will be entertained.

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

The closing date of online application (31 December 2025) is the crucial date for determining eligibility with regard to age.

  • Maximum Age (Project Scientist-I): 40 years.
  • Maximum Age (Project Research Scientist-I): 35 years.
  • Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, 10-15 years for PwBD, up to 5 years for Central Government servants/THSTI employees/Ex-servicemen.

Application Fee

The application fee is non-refundable and must be paid online using Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/UPI.

  • Unreserved, OBC & EWS candidates: ₹ 590/-.
  • SC/ST/Women/PwBD candidates: ₹ 118/-.

Important Dates

Event Date
Recruitment Notice Date 09 December 2025
Last date for receipt of online application 31 December 2025

Selection Process

  • Applications will be scrutinized/shortlisted based on higher/relevant qualifications and experience if a large number are received.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be processed for further selection which involves a Written test/Skill test/Interview.
  • All results/notifications/interview dates will only be published on the THSTI website.

General Information/Instructions

  • These are short-term positions, and extensions are subject to satisfactory performance and project tenure.
  • Appointees have no claim for regularization.
  • Number of vacancies may change based on actual requirements at the time of the test/interview.
  • All communication will only be made through email.
  • Candidates should regularly visit the THSTI website for updates.

How To Apply

  • Eligible candidates may apply online only via the Institute’s website. Applications through any other mode will not be accepted.
  • The online procedure involves Step 1 (Details), Step 2 (Document Upload), Step 3 (Fee Payment), and Step 4 (Submission).
  • Candidates must keep soft copies of photo, signature, CV, and all relevant certificates (10th, 12th, Graduation/PG/PhD, experience, caste) ready in PDF format before applying.
  • After successful submission, an auto-generated email with a reference number will be sent.
  • Candidates are required to keep a printout of the online application form for future reference.

Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

Young Professional-II Recruitment 2025

The Young Professional-II Recruitment 2025 at ICAR-NRCE, Hisar, invites applications from qualified postgraduates who wish to gain research and project experience in the area of surveillance and monitoring of existing and emerging diseases of equines. The selection process of ICAR-NRCE includes shortlisting of candidates on the basis of qualifying academic performance as per an assessment criterion, followed by a panel interview at ICAR-NRCE, Hisar, and the position is purely contractual and co-terminus with the project or as per institute need.

This recruitment offers a consolidated emolument of Rs. 42,000/- per month without any additional allowances, with an opportunity to work in laboratory and field trial activities at ICAR-NRCE and NCVTC, Hisar. The engaged Young Professional-II will support surveillance work, data management, and project-related tasks and must be willing to complete allotted work within time, including duties based on project requirements rather than only on the candidate’s expertise.

Interested and eligible candidates must send their application in the enclosed proforma along with scanned, attested copies of original documents as a single PDF file to [email protected] so as to reach positively by 25 December 2025. No hard copy needs to be sent by post, but shortlisted candidates will have to bring a hard copy of the filled application, CV, passport-size photo, and all original and attested certificates at the time of interview at ICAR-NRCE, Hisar.

ICAR NRCE Young Professional Recruitment 2025 Important Dates

The detailed Young Professional-II Recruitment 2025 notice has been released by ICAR-NRCE with the application deadline and basic schedule for shortlisting and interview. Applications must reach the specified email ID by 25 December 2025, and interviews will be conducted at ICAR-NRCE, Hisar, with date and time to be intimated later via email to shortlisted candidates.

ICAR-NRCE has notified one vacancy of Young Professional-II for the project titled “Surveillance and monitoring of existing and emerging diseases of equines” at ICAR-NRCE, Hisar. The criteria include essential educational qualifications in specified disciplines, desirable experience, and an overall age limit for the Young Professional category as per ICAR rules.

The educational qualifications for the Young Professional-II position under the equine disease surveillance project are as follows.

For Young Professional-II (Project: Surveillance and monitoring of existing and emerging diseases of equines):
Candidates must possess M.Sc / MVSc / M.Tech in Microbiology / Biotechnology / Pathology / Life Sciences from a recognized university/institution (essential qualification). Desirable qualification includes demonstrated experience in data management, with preference for candidates having a one-year certificate course in Computer Sciences, as indicated by an appropriate certificate.

✨ Age Limit (As per Rules)

The minimum and maximum age limits for the Young Professional category are prescribed in the advertisement as per ICAR guidelines. The age limits are calculated as on the closing date of receipt of applications, with relaxation admissible as per Government/ICAR rules.

Young Professional-II Selection Process 2025

The Young Professional-II selection for ICAR NRCE Recruitment 2025 is based on shortlisting of applications followed by a panel interview at ICAR-NRCE, Hisar. At least five applicants will be shortlisted based on their qualifying academic performance as per an assessment criterion, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview via email.

The selection process is carried out in the following stages as mentioned in the advertisement:

1. Shortlisting of Candidates: Applications received through email up to 25 December 2025 will be scrutinized, and at least five applicants will be shortlisted based on their academic qualifications as per assessment criteria framed for the purpose. Shortlisted candidates will receive information about the date and time of interview at ICAR-NRCE, Hisar, through the email address provided in their application.

2. Interview at ICAR-NRCE, Hisar: Shortlisted candidates will undergo a panel interview conducted at ICAR-NRCE, Hisar, where they must present original documents and experience certificates for verification. The appointment of the selected candidate will be subject to being declared medically fit by the prescribed medical authority and compliance with all terms and conditions.

Final Merit: Final selection will be based on the performance of candidates in the panel interview, along with verification of documents and fulfillment of all eligibility conditions as per the project and ICAR-NRCE rules.

ICAR NRCE Young Professional Salary 2025

Candidates selected as Young Professional-II at ICAR-NRCE, Hisar, will receive a consolidated emolument of Rs. 42,000/- per month without any other allowances. The position is purely temporary on contractual basis, and the engagement does not confer any right for regular appointment in ICAR/NRCE.

  8. Step 8: If shortlisted, appear for the panel interview at ICAR-NRCE, Hisar, bringing hard copy of the duly filled application form, CV, passport size photo, and original as well as attested copies of all certificates.

  4. Upload photo, signature & required documents
  5. Pay application fee (if applicable)
  6. Submit the form and take printout

  • Read the examination notice carefully in both Hindi and English; the English version will be treated as final in case of any dispute.
  • Submit the online application well before the last date to avoid website issues due to heavy traffic.
  • Candidates without One-Time Registration (OTR) on the new SSC website (ssc.gov.in) must create a new OTR; old OTRs from ssc.nic.in are not valid.
  • After creating the new OTR, candidates can fill out the online application; the new OTR will remain valid for future exams on the new site.
  • Documents will be verified during DME by CAPFs, so applications are provisional; eligibility claims must match the submitted documents or candidature will be cancelled.
  • Candidates claiming reservation (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/ESM or others) must ensure eligibility and possess valid certificates in the prescribed format.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates migrating to another state must choose whether to take reservation from their state of origin or apply as unreserved from the state of migration; this choice cannot be changed later.
  • If opting for reservation from the state of origin, the candidate must provide details of both current domicile and origin, and produce a valid caste certificate from the origin state.

Senior Resident Recruitment 2025

The Senior Resident (Non-Academic) Recruitment 2025 at AIIMS Patna invites medical postgraduates who wish to pursue a structured three-year residency under the Government of India Residency Scheme in a premier tertiary care teaching hospital. The selection process comprises an MCQ-based written examination followed by a personal interview, and the final merit list will be prepared based on combined scores of both stages. Candidates appointed as Senior Residents will receive pay at Level 11 of the 7th CPC matrix with Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) and usual admissible allowances.

This recruitment offers excellent academic exposure, clinical training and teaching experience in departments such as General Medicine, General Surgery, Anaesthesiology, Paediatrics, Radiodiagnosis, Radiation Oncology, Pathology/Lab Medicine, Ophthalmology and many more. The total number of advertised vacancies is 117, with department-wise, category-wise distribution and reservation, including 4% horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs). Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the AIIMS Patna website from 18.12.2025 to 10.01.2026 by filling the application form, uploading required documents and paying the prescribed application fee. After online submission, candidates must take a printout of the application, which along with original and self-attested copies of documents, is to be produced at the time of interview and document verification. The written examination is scheduled on 25 January 2026 at AIIMS Patna, followed by interviews on 29th, 30th and 31st January 2026.

Senior Resident Selection Process 2025

The selection process for AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2025 is based on a combination of written test and personal interview. Candidates must qualify the written test with minimum prescribed marks to be shortlisted for the interview stage.

1. Screening of Candidates (Written Test):
An MCQ-based written test will be conducted for all eligible applicants for the advertised Senior Resident posts. The test will consist of 80 questions carrying one mark each, with no negative marking. The written examination will be held on 25 January 2026 from 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM at the Examination Hall, Admin. Building, AIIMS Patna.

Qualifying Marks in Written Test:
UR: 50% OBC-NCL/EWS: 45% SC/ST: 40%

2. Interview:
Candidates who qualify in the written examination (maximum three times the number of seats in each specialty) will be called for the personal interview. The interview will be conducted on 29th, 30th and 31st January 2026 at the Committee Hall, Admin. Building, AIIMS Patna, and will carry 20 marks. Candidates have to report at 9:00 AM in the E-Classroom, Administration Building, AIIMS Patna on the interview day.

Final Merit:
The final selection list will be prepared on the basis of combined marks of the written test and interview. In case of ties (same total marks), the tie will be resolved by date of birth, with the older candidate ranked higher.

Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

New Mangalore Port Authority (NMPA), a major port under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, Government of India, has invited applications for the engagement of Graduate and Diploma Apprentice Trainees under the Apprentices Act, 1961, as amended. This opportunity offers 31 training slots across various fields, including Graduate in Civil (5), Mechanical (7), Electrical (4), Computer Science (1), B.Com (3), B.A (1), and Diploma in Computer Science (1), Civil (1), Mechanical (1), Electrical (3), and Commercial Practice (4). The training is for a period of one year, with a monthly stipend of Rs. 9,000/- for graduates and Rs. 8,000/- for diploma holders, aimed at providing hands-on experience in port operations and related disciplines to fresh pass-outs from 2022 to 2025.

Eligible candidates must have passed their qualifying examination in the specified years and should not have prior apprenticeship experience. Applications, in the prescribed format along with semester certificates, caste certificate, and Aadhaar, must be submitted to the Secretary, Administration Department, NMPA, Panambur - 575010, on or before December 29, 2025. This apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment but serves as a valuable stepping stone for career development in the maritime sector.

Eligibility Criteria

    • Degree in Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering / Computer Science from a Government-recognised institute/university.
    • Post-qualification experience of 14 years in Railways / Metro Railways / Suburban Railways or a company dealing with design/construction of any Railway/Metro network involving modern signalling systems.
    • At least 5 years’ experience at a senior level in maintenance of signalling/telecommunication assets of Railways / Metro Railway / large Telecom Service Provider organisation.
  • Deputy General Manager (Stores)
    • Degree in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Mechanical / Civil Engineering.
    • Experience in store functions in Railways / Railway PSUs / PSUs / Modern Metro System / reputed private firms.
    • Minimum 14 years in handling large value stores, inventory management, tendering & procurement of project spares/tools & equipment and general items on digital / GeM platform.
  • Deputy General Manager (P-Way)
    • Degree in Civil Engineering.

  • Deputy General Manager: Consolidated pay of Rs. 1,64,000/- per month on contract.

  • Allowances: GPA (Group Personal Accident Insurance), GMC (Group Medical Coverage), Transport and other applicable allowances as per prevailing rules of the Company.

Age Limit (as on 20-12-2025)

  • General Manager (Signalling / Telecom): Maximum 55 years on Contract; 56 years on Deputation.
  • General Manager (Operations): Maximum 55 years on Contract; 56 years on Deputation.

  • Deputy General Manager (SSM): Maximum 48 years.
  • Deputy General Manager (AFC / Tele): Maximum 48 years.
  • Deputy General Manager (Stores): Maximum 48 years.
  • Deputy General Manager (P-Way): Maximum 48 years.

  • Details of application fee are not mentioned in the notification.

Event Date & Time
Date of Notification 20/12/2025
Last Date for Online Application 15/01/2026
Last Date & Time for Receipt of Signed Print Copy with Documents 20/01/2026, 04.00 PM

Selection Process

  • Candidates who have been shortlisted only will be called for interview.
  • Selection will be made through interview by a Committee constituted by the Competent Authority.
  • Post-qualification experience only will be considered; mere possession of minimum experience does not confer any right to be called for interview/selection.
  • If adequate suitable candidates are not available, age relaxation may be considered for deserving candidates during shortlisting, subject to approval.
  • Knowledge of Kannada will be given preference.
  • BMRCL reserves the right to assess the fitness or otherwise of selected candidates.

General Information/Instructions

  • Appointments are on Contract / Deputation basis in the O&M Wing of BMRCL.
  • Internal candidates working in BMRCL who have completed a minimum of five years of experience in the immediate one lower level may also apply for this contractual appointment.
  • Any canvassing by or on behalf of candidates or bringing political/other external influence regarding selection/appointment will be a disqualification.
  • Documents in support of qualification and relevant experience must be sent along with the application; non-submission of documents will lead to rejection at any stage.
  • BMRCL reserves the right to review/cancel the notified vacancies at its discretion at any stage of the recruitment process; such decisions are final and binding.
  • BMRCL shall not be liable for any damage/injury/loss sustained during the recruitment process and journey.
  • Any candidate found guilty of impersonation, submitting fabricated documents, making false/incorrect statements, suppressing facts or using unfair means will have their application rejected.
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfil the eligibility and other norms; furnishing false information will be a disqualification and BMRCL will not be responsible for consequences.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing time/date to avoid last minute rush; BMRCL is not responsible for network problems or issues at the candidate’s end.
  • Candidates should have a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, kept active during the entire recruitment process; shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail/SMS to appear for interview at their own cost.
  • Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must read the entire vacancy notification and instructions carefully to understand eligibility, age limits, conditions and recruitment process details.
  • To access the online application, candidates must visit the BMRCL website www.bmrc.co.in → Careers section and open the desired recruitment notification.
  • Candidates shall select the post applied for and fill in the requisite details in the online application form.
  • After submitting the application form online, candidates must save and print the computer-generated online application form, affix the latest passport-size photograph, and send the hard copy along with self-attested copies of all supporting documents.
  • Self-attested documents to enclose:
    • Original passport-size photograph affixed on the printed application form.
    • Age proof – Birth Certificate / 10th Standard Certificate.
    • Educational qualification certificates (from 10th Standard to last degree).
    • Experience certificates (present & previous employments).
    • NOC/Through Proper Channel letter (if applicable).
    • Copy of detailed Resume/Biodata/CV.
    • Duly attested copies of last five years’ APAR (if applicable).
    • Vigilance clearance & Integrity certificate (if applicable).
    • Any other relevant certificates (if any).
  • Candidates already working in Central / State Government / Autonomous Body / PSU who cannot produce NOC along with application must produce “No Objection Certificate” from present employer at the time of interview; otherwise their candidature will not be considered. Undertakings or copies of applied NOC/resignation will not be accepted in place of NOC.
  • For Deputationists: application must be filled online, printed and submitted through parent organisation along with NOC, D&AR and Vigilance Clearance and APAR ratings for preceding 5 years to BMRCL address.
  • Applications must be sent through Speed Post / Courier to:
    General Manager (HR),
    Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited,
    III Floor, BMTC Complex, K.H. Road,
    Shanthinagar, Bengaluru – 560027
    superscribing the envelope as “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ……………..”.
  • For clarification, candidates may contact [email protected].

BEML Limited has announced a Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST and OBC candidates, aiming to fill 50 backlog vacancies across various positions in Group A, Group B, and Group C categories. The recruitment includes roles such as Dy. General Manager, Asst. General Manager, Sr. Manager, Manager, Officer/Engineer, Asst. Engineer, Diploma Trainee, and Office Assistant Trainee.

Candidates applying for these positions must meet specific eligibility criteria, including educational qualifications such as a First Class full-time Engineering Degree, MBA, CA/ICWA, or a Diploma for certain posts. The salary scales range from ₹90,000 to ₹2,40,000 for higher positions like Dy. General Manager and Asst. General Manager, while Diploma Trainees will receive a stipend ranging from ₹17,000 to ₹25,500 depending on the contract year. The age limit for applicants varies by post and category, with relaxations for SC/ST and OBC candidates, as well as an additional 10-year age relaxation for PwD candidates. Interested candidates must apply online by 7th January 2026.

BEML Special Recruitment Drive Recruitment 2025 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name BEML Limited (BEML)
Post Name Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST & OBC – Group ‘A’ (Dy. General Manager, Asst. General Manager, Sr. Manager, Manager, Officer/Engineer), Group ‘B’ (Asst. Engineer) & Group ‘C’ (Diploma Trainees, Office Assistant Trainees) Backlog Vacancies
No of Posts 50
Salary Rs 16,900 to 2,40,000
Qualification Post-wise essential qualifications include: First Class full-time Degree in Engineering in relevant disciplines; CA/ICWA/CMA; First Class full-time MBA with Finance as major; two-year full-time First Class PG degree/diploma in HR/IR/Personnel Management/MSW/MA Social Work (HR/IR); First Class Master’s Degree in Hindi with English at degree level; Three years First Class Diploma (for Diploma Trainees); First Class full-time Graduate Degree (for Office Assistant Trainees), with additional desirable qualifications and experience as per each post description.
Age Limit Grade VII – 50 years (SC/ST), 48 years (OBC); Grade VI – 47/45 years; Grade V – 44/42 years; Grade IV – 39/37 years; Grade II – 34/32 years; Grade I – 34/32 years; Wage Group S1 & B – 34/32 years; PwD: additional 10 years; maximum age with relaxation not beyond 57 years.
Start Date for Apply  19/12/2025.
Last Date for Apply  07/01/2026 (till 18.00 Hrs).
Official Website bemlindia.in

BEML Special Recruitment Drive Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Designation Total
Dy. General Manager 13
Asst.General Manager 15
Sr.Manager 05
Manager 05
Officer/Engineer 03
Asst. Engineer 01
Diploma Trainee 06
Office Assistant 02

Eligibility Criteria

  • Only Indian Nationals may apply.
  • Age, Qualification and Experience should be as on 07th January 2026.
  • Under qualifying marks, First Class is reckoned at 60% aggregate (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST & PwD); candidates with CGPA/credits must provide conversion formula.
  • SC/ST candidates must submit SC/ST Caste Certificate in the prescribed format for Government of India posts.
  • OBC candidates must submit OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate in the prescribed Government of India format and a self-undertaking of OBC (NCL) status; OBC certificate should not be older than six months as on last date.
  • PwD candidates must submit PwD certificate in the prescribed format; age relaxation of additional 10 years is applicable for PwD with minimum 40% disability.
  • Post Qualification Experience (PQE) is counted only after obtaining the required qualification; only employment after the requisite qualification is considered.
  • Private sector candidates must be employed in regular capacity and submit experience certificate on company letterhead.
  • Candidates employed in Central/State Govt., Autonomous bodies, Quasi-Govt. and PSUs must apply through proper channel or produce NOC, and should have worked at least one year in immediate lower scale (not applicable to Grade II, Group B & C).
  • Candidates must ensure that they fulfill all eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, age, category, PwD as applicable); any false information or discrepancy leads to cancellation/termination.
  • Post-wise essential qualifications include: First Class full-time Degree in Engineering in relevant disciplines; CA/ICWA/CMA; First Class full-time MBA with Finance as major; two-year full-time First Class PG degree/diploma in HR/IR/Personnel Management/MSW/MA Social Work (HR/IR); First Class Master’s Degree in Hindi with English at degree level; Three years First Class Diploma (for Diploma Trainees); First Class full-time Graduate Degree (for Office Assistant Trainees), with additional desirable qualifications and experience as per each post description.

Salary/Stipend

  • Dy. General Manager (Grade VII): Pay Scale Rs. 90,000 – 2,40,000.
  • Asst. General Manager (Grade VI): Pay Scale Rs. 80,000 – 2,20,000.
  • Sr. Manager (Grade V): Pay Scale Rs. 70,000 – 2,00,000.
  • Manager (Grade IV): Pay Scale Rs. 60,000 – 1,80,000.
  • Officer/Engineer (Grade II): Pay Scale Rs. 40,000 – 1,40,000.
  • Asst. Engineer (Grade I): Pay Scale Rs. 30,000 – 1,20,000.
  • Diploma Trainees (Wage Group S1 on absorption): Pay Scale Rs. 23,910 – 85,570; stipend Rs. 17,000/- PM during 1 year training; Rs. 20,500/- PM & Rs. 25,500/- PM during first and second year of contract.
  • Office Assistant Trainees (Wage Group B on absorption): Pay Scale Rs. 16,900 – 60,650; stipend Rs. 20,000/- PM in first year and Rs. 23,500/- PM in second year of contract.
  • Besides Basic Pay, eligible for Variable Dearness Allowance, Perquisites & Allowances (currently 13.78% of Basic Pay under Cafeteria System), Company Accommodation/House Rent Allowance, Provident Fund, Gratuity, PRP etc. as per Company rules.

Age Limit (as on 07-01-2026)

  • Dy. General Manager (Grade VII): Upper age limit – 50 years for SC/ST, 48 years for OBC.
  • Asst. General Manager (Grade VI): Upper age limit – 47 years for SC/ST, 45 years for OBC.
  • Sr. Manager (Grade V): Upper age limit – 44 years for SC/ST, 42 years for OBC.
  • Manager (Grade IV): Upper age limit – 39 years for SC/ST, 37 years for OBC.
  • Officer/Engineer (Grade II): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • Asst. Engineer (Grade I): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • Diploma Trainees (Wage Group S1 – on absorption): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • Office Assistant Trainees (Wage Group B – on absorption): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • For PwD candidates, upper age limit relaxable by additional 10 years over and above SC/ST/OBC relaxation; maximum age with relaxation shall not exceed 57 years.
  • Upper age limit can be relaxed for candidates of all categories subject to equivalent years of excess PQE, within the maximum limit of 57 years.

Application Fee

  • Eligible and interested OBC candidates applying for the above positions (not applicable for SC/ST/PwDs) must pay a non-refundable fee of Rs. 500/-.
  • Fee payment link is provided at the end of the online application form.
  • SC/ST/PwD candidates are exempted from payment of application fee as per the notification.

Important Dates

Event Date / Details
Date of Advertisement 03/12/2025 (Advt. No. KP/S/28/2025).
Crucial Date for Age, Qualification & Experience 07/01/2026.
Last Date for Online Registration 07/01/2026 up to 18:00 Hrs (online registration site available till this date and time).
Last Date for Receipt of Applications through Proper Channel (for Govt./PSU employees) Within 10 days from closing date of advertisement (i.e., within 10 days from 07/01/2026) to Sr. Manager, Recruitment Cell, BEML Soudha, Bengaluru.
Written Exam Date (for L036, L037, L038, L039) To be notified; assessment/written exam at Bangalore and details to be communicated via e-mail.
Intimation of Assessment / Interviews Intimation regarding assessments, provisional offer/final offer etc. will be only through e-mail; shortlisted/selected list will be uploaded on www.bemlindia.in under the advertisement in career portal.

Selection Process

  • Eligible candidates will be shortlisted for assessment based on eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, age, category, PwD etc.).
  • Based on assessment, shortlisted candidates must undergo pre-employment medical examination and original document verification; appointment is subject to meeting medical standards and satisfactory medical report.
  • Any shortcoming during document verification (falsification, wrong declaration, non-production of originals) results in rejection.
  • For post codes L036, L037, L038 and L039, selection will be based on written exam at Bangalore (to & fro fares reimbursed based on eligibility) assessing domain ability (not for L039), reasoning ability, general awareness and English ability.
  • Merely meeting conditions of advertisement does not entitle a candidate to be called for assessment; Screening Committee may adopt its own criteria for shortlisting.
  • Only candidates meeting all eligibility norms need apply; receiving call for assessment/interview does not guarantee selection.

General Information/Instructions

  • Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST & OBC for Group ‘A’ (9th Attempt), Group ‘B’ & Group ‘C’ (7th Attempt) backlog vacancies.
  • BEML Limited is a multi-technology company under Ministry of Defence with core sectors Defence & Aerospace, Rail & Metro, Power, Mining & Construction; the drive is aligned with expansion initiatives like Vande Bharat sleeper trains, Metro coaches, high mobility vehicles, special application engines, AI-based mining equipment etc.
  • Only Indian Nationals may apply.
  • Age, qualification & experience are counted as on 07/01/2026; First Class is 60% aggregate (relaxable for SC/ST & PwD).
  • Candidates must upload all required documents (10th, 12th, degree/diploma, mark sheets with conversion formula, PG certificates, ID proof, caste/PwD certificates, experience letters, latest pay slip, detailed resume, current reporting structure) as per checklist; incomplete applications without documents are rejected.
  • Applications of Govt./PSU employees must be forwarded through proper channel or accompanied by specific NOC; such forwarded applications must reach BEML Soudha within 10 days from closing date.
  • Intimation of assessment, offers etc. will be via e-mail only and list of shortlisted/selected candidates will be hosted on www.bemlindia.in; BEML is not responsible for non-delivery due to invalid e-mail or mobile.
  • No request for change in category, address, e-mail, mobile number, test centre location etc. as declared in online application will be entertained.
  • Any canvassing or influencing related to recruitment/selection will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Corrigendum/Addendum, if any, will be hosted only on BEML website.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply online only (mandatory) after going through guidelines and ensuring correctness of data entered.
  • Online application form can be accessed in the career page at www.bemlindia.in; online registration site is available till 18:00 Hrs on 07th January 2026.
  • Candidates must have a valid e-mail ID and mobile number for registration and further correspondence; change of e-mail or mobile will not be entertained during the recruitment process.
  • A Registration number will be generated and should be noted for all future correspondence.
  • While filling online application, experience section should first list latest experience, followed by previous experiences; a brief pen picture of experience relevant to the position must be written.
  • Candidates must upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, category certificates, academic certificates and mark sheets, identity proof, experience documents, detailed resume, current reporting structure and latest pay-slip as per checklist.
  • Experienced candidates must provide detailed pen picture of each experience; all experience documents must clearly indicate start and end dates of each employment.
  • OBC candidates (except SC/ST/PwD) must pay the non-refundable Rs. 500/- fee through the link at the end of application form.
  • Candidates with queries may e-mail [email protected].

Salary/Stipend

  • Assistant Professor (Regular remuneration): Consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 90,000/- per month (for candidates having Ph.D. degree in the relevant discipline).
  • Assistant Professor (Lower remuneration): Consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 75,000/- per month (for candidates with Master’s degree with first class/60% and qualified UGC/CSIR NET in relevant branch).
  • Assistant Professor (when NET not conducted in desired subject, with Master’s degree and very good academic record): Consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 68,000/- per month.
  • Lecturer (Contractual): Candidates having minimum qualifying Master’s degree with first class or 60% or equivalent at Master’s level and very good academic record throughout shall be paid consolidated remuneration of Rs. 68,000/- per month.

Age Limit (as on Last Date of Application)

  • Maximum age: 45 years for all Assistant Professor positions in all disciplines.
  • The upper age limit will be reckoned as on the last date prescribed for receipt of applications.

Application Fee

  • For General category, OBC and EWS candidates: Rs. 1,000/-.
  • For SC/ST candidates: Rs. 500/-.
  • For Women and PwD candidates: Exempted from payment of application fee.
  • A copy of the transaction receipt should be uploaded with the application form.
  • Method of payment: BHIM or QR code or payment through NEFT to “National Forensic Sciences University Dharwad”, Account No. 2248100100002804, Punjab National Bank, IFSC Code PUNB0224810.

Selection Process

  • The application received in response to the advertisement will be scrutinized and only shortlisted candidates will be considered for the further selection process.
  • A personal interview shall be conducted and details will be notified on the NFSU website; shortlisted candidates will be informed in due course as per recommendation of the screening committee.
  • The University may conduct a screening test before the interview on the same day or one day prior to interview date, if the number of applications is more.
  • Mode of selection includes personal interview and, if conducted, screening test; candidates who appeared for interview may be considered for a lower post if otherwise suitable.

General Information/Instructions

  • The filling up of the advertised posts shall be on need basis and purely temporary; engagement does not confer any right or title to claim permanent appointment at the University.
  • The posts are contractual for a period of 11 months which can be further extended on the basis of performance or till the recruitment of regular incumbent is done or whichever is earlier.
  • The University reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all the posts without assigning any reason and to accept or reject any application.
  • The University shall verify antecedents and documents submitted by candidates at the time of appointment; if documents are found fake or information suppressed, services are liable to be terminated.
  • NFSU Dharwad Campus reserves the right to offer the post at a level lower than advertised, draw reserve panels, consider candidates in-absentia, relax qualifications/experience, or increase/decrease number of posts.
  • The interview will be conducted in offline mode only; online interview requests will not be entertained and no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
  • These recruitments shall be made in compliance with the Reservation Policy of the Government of India and upper age limit will be reckoned as on last date of application.
  • Qualifications must be obtained from UGC recognized universities/deemed universities or RCI/BCI/PCI/AICTE approved autonomous institutions and should be equivalent to AIU-recognized courses where applicable.
  • Papers published only in UGC Care approved list, SCOPUS, Thomson Reuter, Emerald, ABDC or other internationally renowned journals will be considered.
  • Candidate will be required to produce all original documents relating to educational qualifications, experience and other essential requirements at the time of interview, failing which candidature stands cancelled.

How to Apply

  • All candidates are required to fill the application form available on university website (https://nfsu.ac.in/career).
  • Apply through the given online link and upload the filled application form along with other required documents in a single PDF file before the last date of application.
  • The incomplete application form will not be entertained; hard copy of the application form with other documents will be required to be submitted at the time of interview.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post should pay the application fee separately and submit separate applications for each post, otherwise the application will be summarily rejected.
  • The candidates will be shortlisted for interviews based on the eligibility criteria and information will be placed on the university website and forwarded to candidates’ registered email.
  • All communication to eligible candidates will be by email only; for queries, candidates may contact NFSU Dharwad Campus authorities via email at [email protected].

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications:

  • Chief General Manager (Digital Transformation): Full-time First Class Degree in Engineering (Preferably Computer Science, IT, Electronics & Communication) from a recognized University/Institution. PG Degree/Diploma in Management/MBA will have added advantage.
  • General Manager (Construction Equipment): Full-time First Class Degree in Engineering in Mechanical/Automobile from a recognized University/Institution. PG Degree/Diploma in Management/MBA will have added advantage.
  • Deputy General Manager (Engine Assembly): First Class Degree in Mechanical/Thermal/Automobile Engineering from a recognized University/Institution.
