  • Assistant Manager (R&D Maritime): First Class Engineering Degree in Mechanical/Naval Architecture/Ocean Engineering from a recognized University/Institution.
  • Officer/Assistant Manager (Security): Graduate in any Discipline from a recognized university/institution with specified training qualifications from Defence Forces or Police/Intelligence training institutions or NCC-C Certificate with 2 years security experience.
  • Assistant Manager/Manager (Raj Bhasha): First Class full-time Master's Degree in Hindi or its equivalent from any recognized university with English as a subject at the Degree Level. Preference will be given to those having Ph.D. in Hindi.
  • Assistant Manager (Paediatrician): Degree in MBBS along with DCH/MD/DNB (Paediatrics) from MCI recognized Institute/College.

  • General Manager: Minimum 19 years of professional experience in manufacturing/marketing of construction equipment or heavy machinery industry, with at least 5 years in a leadership role

  • Grade-IV (Manager): Rs. 60,000 – Rs. 1,80,000 per month
  • Grade-VII (Deputy General Manager): Rs. 90,000 – Rs. 2,40,000 per month
  • Grade-VIII (General Manager): Rs. 1,00,000 – Rs. 2,60,000 per month
  • Grade-IX (Chief General Manager): Rs. 1,20,000 – Rs. 2,80,000 per month
  • Besides Basic Pay, candidates will be eligible for Variable Dearness Allowance, Perquisites & Allowances (currently 13.78% of the applicable Basic Pay under the Cafeteria System), Company Accommodation/House Rent Allowance, Provident Fund, Gratuity, PRP etc. as per the prevailing Company Rules
  • The pay fixation will be guided by the extant rules of BEML Limited, applicable at the time of issuance of Offer of appointment

Age Limit (as on 31.12.2025)

  • Grade-II (Officer/Engineer): Maximum 29 years
  • Grade-III (Assistant Manager): Maximum 30 years
  • Grade-III (Assistant Manager Medical): Maximum 30 years
  • Grade-IV (Manager): Maximum 34 years
  • Grade-VII (Deputy General Manager): Maximum 45 years
  • Grade-VIII (General Manager): Maximum 48 years
  • Grade-IX (Chief General Manager): Maximum 51 years

  • The list of shortlisted/selected candidates for final selection will be uploaded on Company's website

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals may apply
  • Candidates shall apply for single position which is most suitable. In case of multiple applications, only the most relevant application will be considered

  • Candidates are required to apply ONLINE only through the official website www.bemlindia.in
  • Access the online application form in the career page at www.bemlindia.in
  • The online registration site will be available till 18:00 Hrs on 31st December 2025
  • Candidates should have a valid e-mail and mobile number for Registration
  • Fill in all the required details carefully in the online application form
  • Note the Registration number generated for all future correspondences
  • While filling the online application, the experience section should be filled by providing latest experience first followed by previous experiences
  • In the space provided against the experience, write a pen picture of the experience relevant to the position applied
  • Upload the following documents (mandatory):

    • 12th Marks card
    • Qualifying Degree Marks cards (with CGPA conversion formula if applicable)

    • Detailed Resume
    • OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PwD certificate (as applicable)
    • All Experience Certificates/Documents clearly indicating start & end dates of each employment
    • Latest pay-slip
    • Current reporting structure (for DGM/GM/CGM positions)

    • Recent photograph
    • Signature (on clear white background in black ink)
  • Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- online (if applicable) by clicking "Pay Application Fee Online"
  • Submit the completed application form online before the last date
  • Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference
  • Incomplete applications without uploading required documents will be summarily rejected

NMPA Chief Engineer Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

One post of Chief Engineer (Civil) in the scale of pay of Rs. 100000-260000 in New Mangalore Port Authority will be vacant with effect from June 1, 2026. The post is to be filled by absorption through a composite method from officers of Major Ports.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications (Essential):
    • Degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institution.
    • Fifteen years experience in executive cadre in Planning/Construction/Design/Maintenance preferably of Port and Marine Structures in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking.
  • For absorption through composite method: Officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs. 80000-220000/- with three years regular service in the grade in the Civil Engineering Department in a Major Port Trust shall be eligible. The feeder post is Deputy Chief Engineer in the pay scale of Rs.80000-220000/-.

Salary/Stipend

  • Initial Scale of Pay: Rs. 100000-260000.
  • Note: The pay scale will be upgraded to the scale of pay of Rs.120000-280000/- after completion of three years regular service in the post, subject to fulfilling relevant conditions.

Age Limit (as on 01 June 2026)

  • There is 45 upper age limit specified for candidates applying via the absorption through composite method.
  • The crucial date for eligibility criteria will be the date of arising of the vacancy, i.e., June 1, 2026.

Selection Process

  • The selection is by merit, for which the benchmark in overall grading in the Annual Confidential Reports/APARs will not be below "Very Good" for the last five years (2020-2021 to 2024-2025).
  • Selection is made by the Services Selection Committee.
  • Port officials who withdraw their candidature after selection by the Services Selection Committee will be liable for debarment from future selection to HOD level posts in all Major Ports for a period of two years.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only applications submitted through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways (https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in) shall be accepted.
  • No application other than those submitted through OAP shall be accepted.
  • The administrative Ports are required to forward the hard copy applications with required documents (certified APARs, integrity certificate, vigilance clearance, NOC, etc.) to NMPA by January 30, 2026.
  • Incomplete applications or those received after the due date will not be considered.

How To Apply

  • Register and apply online through the 'online Application Portal' (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at `https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in` between December 16, 2025, and January 15, 2026.
  • Take a print-out of the online application form uploaded in OAP.
  • The print-out should be signed and sent through the proper channel (via the administrative Port Authority Secretary/Chairperson) along with certified copies of educational qualifications, experience, PPOs, and attested APARs for the last 5 years.
  • The envelope containing the hard copy must be superscribed "Application for the post of Chief Engineer (Civil) in New Mangalore Port Authority".
  • The hard copy must reach The Secretary, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore - 575 010 before January 30, 2026.

IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow 2025 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2025 is 2 posts under the R&D project titled “Towards Trusted-node Free Hybrid Quantum Secure Communication Network (TAHQEECAT)” under National Quantum Mission (NQM), Department of Science and Technology, New Delhi.

 

The area of specialization/research includes Quantum Computing, Quantum Key Distribution Systems, Cryptography, Communication, and Networking.

 

Eligibility Criteria for IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow 2025

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must meet one of the following options to apply for IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow positions:

 

  • Option A: M.E./M.Tech./MS(R) or equivalent degree in CSE/ECE/EE with 60% marks or equivalent CGPA. A relaxation of 5% in marks is applicable for SC/ST/PwD/EWS/OBC-NCL candidates. Students awaiting final results are also eligible to apply.
  • Option B: B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. in CSE/ECE/EE with 60% marks or equivalent CGPA, with 5% marks relaxation for SC/ST/PwD/EWS/OBC-NCL candidates. A valid GATE qualification is mandatory for B.Tech candidates. Students awaiting final results may also apply. Candidates without a valid GATE qualification may be considered for a lower salary as per DST guidelines.

 

2. Age Limit

The upper age limit for IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2025 is 28 years. The upper age limit is relaxable by up to 5 years for SC/ST/PwD/EWS/OBC-NCL candidates as per rules.

 

3. Nationality

Candidates must be Indian nationals to apply for this IIT Jammu JRF recruitment.

 

Salary/Stipend for IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow 2025

The consolidated salary for IIT Jammu JRF is Rs. 37,000/- plus 18% HRA per month for years 1–2 and Rs. 42,000/- plus 18% HRA per month for year 3, as per DST guidelines. The position is initially for one year and may be extended based on performance, and is co-terminus with the project. There is also a possibility to enroll in the M.Tech/Ph.D. programme at IIT Jammu, subject to institute eligibility criteria and recommendation of the selection committee.

Selection Process for IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow 2025

Candidates will be shortlisted as per project requirements and minimum eligibility, and IIT Jammu will conduct an appropriate written examination followed by an interview for eligible candidates in line with existing guidelines.

 

Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the written test and interview schedule through email and must appear with an updated CV and original plus attested photocopies of mark sheets/certificates supporting their academic qualifications. The written test and interview will be conducted using the offline platform.

 

 

How to Apply for IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2025?

Eligible Indian nationals can apply online for IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow 2025 by submitting the application form through the institute’s recruitment portal.

 

  1. Visit the online application portal: apply.iitjammu.ac.in.
  2. Select the relevant tab: [contract/project staff/JRF/SRF] on the application portal.
  3. Fill in the application form duly with all required details.
  4. Upload scanned copies of required certificates, mark sheets, and supporting documents.
  5. Ensure that all information, documents, and photographs uploaded are authentic, as the applicant is responsible for their correctness.
  6. Submit the online application form on or before 25/12/2025.

Event Date

Online Application End Date 25/12/2025
Last Date for Receiving Application 25/12/2025

 

Instructions for IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow 2025

  • The applicant is solely responsible for the authenticity of all information, documents, and photographs submitted with the application.
  • Possessing the prescribed qualifications does not guarantee a call for written test or interview; candidates may be shortlisted based on merit and project requirements.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the written test and interview via email and must provide a valid email ID and phone number in the application form.
  • Shortlisted candidates must appear for written test and interview with updated CV and original plus attested photocopies of all supporting mark sheets/certificates.
  • Candidates called for interview must reach IIT Jammu at their own cost; TA/DA is not admissible for interview or for joining if offered the position.
  • Candidates already employed must produce a relieving certificate from their employer if selected.
  • IIT Jammu reserves the right to cancel or modify the advertisement at any time. In case no suitable candidate is found, hiring may continue as per funding agency guidelines.

In this article, you’ll find the CBSE Group A, B & C Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

CBSE Various Posts Recruitment 2025 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)
Post Name Various Posts (Assistant Secretary, Assistant Professor & Assistant Director, Accounts Officer, Superintendent, Junior Translation Officer, Junior Accountant, Junior Assistant)
No of Posts 124
Salary Pay Level-2 to Pay Level-10 (7th CPC)
Qualification Varies post-wise (Bachelor’s/Master’s Degree in relevant discipline)
Age Limit 18 to 35 Years (as on 22-12-2025)
Start Date for Apply 02-12-2025
Last Date for Apply 27-12-2025 (11:59 PM) (Extended)
Official Website https://www.cbse.gov.in

Eligibility Criteria

  • Assistant Secretary: Bachelor’s Degree from a recognized University/ Institution.
  • Assistant Professor & Assistant Director (Academics): Post Graduate Degree in any discipline with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) from a recognized University/ Institute with provision of applicable concession to the respective categories
  • Assistant Professor & Assistant Director (Training): Post Graduate Degree in any discipline with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) from a recognized University/ Institute with provision of applicable concession to the respective categories
  • Assistant Professor & Assistant Director (Skill Education): Post Graduate Degree in any discipline with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) from a recognized University/ Institute with provision of applicable concession to the respective categories
  • Accounts Officer: Bachelor’s degree of a recognized University/ Institution with Economics/ Commerce/ Accounts/ Finance/ Business Studies/ Cost Accounting as one of the subject. OR Bachelor’s degree of a recognized University/Institution and having SAS/JAO(C) examination conducted by any Account/Audit Services/Department of the Central/State Govt. OR Post Graduate of a recognized University/Institution with Economics/ Commerce / Accounts/ Finance/ Business Studies/ Cost Accounting as one of the subject. OR M.B.A. (Finance)/Chartered Accountant/ICWA
  • Superintendent: Bachelor’s Degree from a recognized University or equivalent
  • Junior Translation Officer: Master’s Degree of a Recognized University in Hindi with English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the Degree Level. OR Master’s Degree of a Recognized University in English with Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the Degree Level.
  • Junior Accountant: 12th Class from a recognized Board/ University/ Institution with Accountancy/ Business Studies/ Economics/ Commerce/ Entrepreneurship/ Finance/ Business Administration/ Taxation/ Cost Accounting as one of the subject. AND A typing speed of 35 w.p.m. in English or 30 w.p.m. in Hindi on Computer.
  • Junior Assistant: 12th Class or equivalent qualification from a recognized Board or University.

Age Limit (as on 22-12-2025)

  • Assistant Secretary, Accounts Officer: Maximum 35 years
  • Assistant Professor & Assistant Director posts, Superintendent, Junior Translation Officer: Maximum 30 years
  • Junior Accountant, Junior Assistant: Maximum 27 years
  • Age relaxation applicable as per Government of India rules (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD/ESM etc.)

Application Fee

Category Fee (Expected as per previous pattern)
For SC/ ST/ PwBD/ Ex-Servicemen/ Women
Group- A posts ₹ 250
Group- B posts ₹ 250
Group- C posts ₹ 250
For Unreserved/OBC/EWS
Group- A posts ₹ 1750
Group- B posts ₹ 1050
Group- C posts ₹ 1050
For Board’s Regular Employee(s) NIL

(Exact fee will be mentioned on the online application portal)

Important Dates

Event Date
Starting Date of Online Application 02-12-2025
Extended Last Date of Online Application 27-12-2025 (11:59 PM)
Extended Last Date for Payment of Fee 27-12-2025 (11:59 PM)

Selection Process

  • All India Competitive Examination (CBSE Direct Recruitment Quota Examination 2026 – DRQ2026)
  • Written Examination (Computer Based Test)
  • Skill Test/Interview (wherever applicable)
  • Document Verification & Medical Examination

How To Apply

  • Apply online only through the official CBSE recruitment portal (link will be activated on 02-12-2025)
  • No other mode (post/hand/mail) will be accepted
  • Upload scanned photograph, signature and required certificates
  • Pay application fee online (if applicable)
  • Take printout of final submitted application for future reference

CBSE Group A, B & C Recruitment 2025 - FAQs

1. What is the total number of vacancies in CBSE Recruitment 2025?
Ans: Total 124 vacancies.

2. When will the online application start?
Ans: Online application starts from 02-12-2025.

3. What is the last date to apply online?
Ans: Last date is 27-12-2025 (11:59 PM).

5. Is there any application fee for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates?

Ans: All India Competitive Examination (CBSE DRQ 2026), Skill Test/Interview (if applicable).

Ans: Maximum 27 years for Junior Accountant & Junior Assistant.

8. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
Ans: Anywhere in India at any office of CBSE (Headquarters, Regional Offices, CoE, etc.).

ESIC Recruitment 2025

Advertisement

Employees State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) Recruitment 2025 for 41 posts of Teaching Faculty. Candidates with DNB, M.Phil/Ph.D, MS/MD Can attend the walkin. The Walk-in starts from 23-12-2025, and ends on 24-12-2025. For detailed information please visit ESIC official website, esic.gov.in.

ESIC Medical College Jaipur Teaching Faculty Recruitment 2025 Overview

Company Name Employees' State Insurance Corporation Medical College & Hospital, Jaipur (ESIC Medical College & Hospital Jaipur)
Post Name Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor (Teaching Faculty including Army Retired Medical Teachers)
No of Posts 41
Salary Professor: Pay Level 13, basic pay ₹ 1,23,100/-; Associate Professor: Pay Level 12, basic pay ₹ 78,800/-; Assistant Professor: Pay Level 11, basic pay ₹ 67,700/-; with NPA@20% (wherever applicable & admissible), DA@55%, HRA@20%, TA@₹ 7200
Qualification Academic qualification & teaching/research experience as per NMC Gazette notification dated 30.06.2025
Age Limit Not exceeding 67 years as on date of walk-in-interview
Walkin Date Walk-in interview dates: 23.12.2025 & 24.12.2025 (Reporting Time: 09:00 AM to 11:00 AM)
Official Website www.esic.gov.in

Eligibility Criteria

  • Engagement of Teaching Faculty is on contractual basis (including Army retired medical teachers) for ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Jaipur, Rajasthan.
  • Academic qualification and teaching/research experience for all posts (Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor) are as per NMC Gazette notification dated 30.06.2025.
  • Age limit for all categories: Not exceeding 67 years as on date of walk-in-interview.
  • Candidates must ascertain their eligibility as per NMC Gazette notification dated 30.06.2025 to appear for the interview.
  • Superannuated AFMS Medical Teachers must submit an Equivalent Teaching Experience Certificate issued by DGAFMS for retired Army Medical Teachers at the time of the interview.

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Pay Level 13 as per 7th CPC with basic pay ₹ 1,23,100.00; salary and other allowances include NPA@20% (wherever applicable & admissible), DA@55%, HRA@20%, TA@₹ 7200.
  • Associate Professor: Pay Level 12 as per 7th CPC with basic pay ₹ 78,800.00; salary and other allowances include NPA@20% (wherever applicable & admissible), DA@55%, HRA@20%, TA@₹ 7200.
  • Assistant Professor: Pay Level 11 as per 7th CPC with basic pay ₹ 67,700.00; salary and other allowances include NPA@20% (wherever applicable & admissible), DA@55%, HRA@20%, TA@₹ 7200.
  • The amount of remuneration will be revised automatically whenever there is revision in the rate of Dearness Allowance, effective from the date of notification of Government orders; arrears of pay & allowances shall not be admissible for any rate revision with retrospective effect.

Age Limit

  • Maximum age: Not exceeding 67 years as on the date of walk-in-interview.

Application Fee

  • SC/ST/PWD, Female candidates & Ex-servicemen: NIL.
  • All other categories: ₹ 225/-.
  • Mode of payment: Demand draft of ₹ 225/- (as applicable) in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No. 1" drawn on any scheduled bank, payable at Jaipur, to be submitted along with the application form.
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.
  • Only demand drafts drawn on any scheduled bank will be accepted; application fee paid by any other mode will not be accepted.
  • The demand draft must be issued after the date of this advertisement.

Important Dates

Date of Walk-in-Interview 23.12.2025 & 24.12.2025
Department-wise Interview Date ANATOMY, BIOCHEMISTRY, PHARMACOLOGY, PATHOLOGY, FORENSIC MEDICINE, COMMUNITY MEDICINE, ICU, GENERAL MEDICINE, DERMATOLOGY, EYE, ANAESTHESIOLOGY: 23.12.2025
MEDICAL ONCOLOGY, CARDIOLOGY, GASTROENTEROLOGY, UROLOGY, NEPHROLOGY, NEUROLOGY, ENCOCRINOLOGY, BLOOD BANK, DENTAL, ACCIDENT & EMERGENCY, RADIOLOGY: 24.12.2025
Reporting Time 09:00 AM to 11:00 AM
Notification Date 11-12-2025

Selection Process

  • The selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the interview before the selection board.
  • The result will be displayed on the website.
  • Selected candidates will have to join immediately after receiving the offer of appointment.
  • Number of vacancies is provisional and may increase or decrease depending on actual requirement.

General Information/Instructions

  • These posts are purely contractual and may be terminated on either side with one month's notice; selection does not confer the right of confirmation or continuation, as these posts are to be filled by selection and appointment of regular candidates.
  • Mere submission of an application does not confer any right on the candidate to be interviewed; opportunities for interview are provisional.
  • Applications should be submitted on the day of the interview along with the required testimonials in the prescribed format only; candidates must bring all documents in original with self-attested copies; incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Wrong declarations, submission of false information, or any other action contrary to law will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage.
  • The interviews will be conducted at the Dean Office, 2nd Floor, ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Jaipur; ESIC reserves the right to change the centre if necessary.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview.
  • ESIC reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage at its discretion; such decision will be binding on all concerned.
  • Candidates eligible for a higher post (Professor/Associate Professor) may be interviewed for a lower post (Associate Professor/Assistant Professor), and if selected, may be considered for placement with suitable upgradation of the lower post for the tenure or till appointment of regular incumbent, as per relevant ESIC HQRS office memoranda.

How to Apply

  • All candidates have to report with duly filled proforma as annexed in the notification, along with testimonials as desired.
  • Venue of Interview: Dean Office, 2nd Floor, ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Jaipur.
  • Applications should be submitted on the day of the interview along with required testimonials in the prescribed format only.
  • Candidates must attach two recent passport-size photographs with the application form.
  • Candidates must attach self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials in support of age (Date of Birth), educational qualifications, experience, research papers, publications, Pension Payment Order (PPO) etc., and produce originals at the time of interview.
  • Candidates claiming EWS reservation must attach Income and Asset certificate as per DoPT letter No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31.01.2019.
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates must attach caste certificate; OBC & EWS certificates must be as per Central Government format and not more than one year old at the time of interview.
  • Registration Certificate issued by DMC must be attached for Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts.
  • Superannuated AFMS Medical Teachers must submit Equivalent Teaching Experience Certificate issued by DGAFMS for retired Army Medical Teachers at the time of interview.
  • Relieving/No Objection Certificate (NOC) from previous/current employer must be produced, if applicable.

ESIC Medical College Jaipur Teaching Faculty Recruitment 2025 - FAQs

1. What are the dates of the walk-in interview for ESIC Medical College Jaipur Teaching Faculty 2025?

Ans: The walk-in interviews will be held on 23.12.2025 and 24.12.2025, with reporting time from 09:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

2. For which posts is ESIC Medical College Jaipur conducting the walk-in interview?

Ans: The walk-in interview is for engagement of Teaching Faculty positions – Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor – including Army retired medical teachers, on contractual basis.

3. What is the maximum age limit for ESIC Jaipur Teaching Faculty recruitment 2025?

Ans: The upper age limit is not exceeding 67 years as on the date of walk-in-interview.

4. What are the essential qualifications for ESIC Medical College Jaipur Teaching Faculty 2025?

Ans: Academic qualification and teaching/research experience are as per NMC Gazette notification dated 30.06.2025, and candidates must ascertain their eligibility accordingly.

5. What is the application fee for ESIC Jaipur Teaching Faculty walk-in interview 2025?

Ans: SC/ST/PWD, Female candidates & Ex-servicemen are exempted from fee; for all other categories the fee is ₹ 225/-, payable via demand draft in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No. 1" drawn on any scheduled bank, payable at Jaipur.

6. What is the pay scale for Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor in ESIC Medical College Jaipur?

Ans: Professor: Pay Level 13 with basic pay ₹ 1,23,100/-; Associate Professor: Pay Level 12 with basic pay ₹ 78,800/-; Assistant Professor: Pay Level 11 with basic pay ₹ 67,700/-, along with NPA@20% (wherever applicable & admissible), DA@55%, HRA@20%, TA@₹ 7200.

The Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) has announced the recruitment of 12 Non-Teaching Positions across various posts. The available positions include Medical Officer (Female), Private Secretary, Technical Assistant, Laboratory Assistant, Upper Division Clerk (UDC), Laboratory Attendant, and Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS). Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online via the official CURAJ website, with the last date for submission being 20th January 2026.

The salary for the positions ranges from Pay Level 01 to Pay Level 10, depending on the post, in line with the 7th CPC. For example, the Medical Officer is at Pay Level 10, while the Multi-Tasking Staff is at Pay Level 01. The educational qualifications required for the posts vary, with requirements ranging from 10+2 to MBBS, along with relevant experience for specific roles.

Qualification 10+2 to MBBS (varies by post)

Start Date for Apply 19/12/2025
Last Date for Apply 20/01/2026 (11:59 PM)
Official Website www.curaj.ac.in

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

Group A

  • Medical Officer (Female): MBBS recognized by Medical Council of India (MCI)

Group B

  • Private Secretary: Bachelor's Degree from recognized University/Institute with three years experience as Stenographer/Personal Assistant at Pay Level 06 in 7th CPC

Group C

  • Technical Assistant (Instrumentation): B.Tech./B.E. in Instrumentation/Biomedical Engineering/Physics/Electrical/Electronics & Communication with at least 60% marks with two years working experience
  • Technical Assistant (Earth Sciences): Bachelor's degree in Biology/Environmental Science with Chemistry with at least 60% marks with two years working experience in Environmental Analysis and Monitoring
  • Laboratory Assistant (Engineering & Technology): Bachelor's degree in Engineering from recognized University
  • Laboratory Assistant (Earth Sciences): Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Information Technology/BCA from recognized University/Institute
  • Upper Division Clerk: Bachelor's Degree with at least 50% marks or pass in Master's Degree with two years experience as Lower Division Clerk and knowledge of Computer Applications
  • Laboratory Attendant: 10+2 or equivalent with Science subjects from recognized Board
  • Multi-Tasking Staff: Matriculation or equivalent pass OR ITI pass

Desirable Qualifications

  • Medical Officer: Post Graduate Medical Qualification from institution recognized by MCI; Working experience in Hospital attached with Medical College/Corporate Hospital; Preference to experienced candidates
  • Laboratory Assistant (Engineering): Experience in Science Laboratories of Academic/Research institutions
  • Laboratory Assistant (Earth Sciences): Experience in computational Laboratory (hardware & software) of Academic/Research institutions
  • Laboratory Attendant: Experience of working in Science Laboratory

Essential Skills

  • Private Secretary: Proficiency in Stenography in English/Hindi with minimum speed of 100 w.p.m.; Proficiency in Typing in English/Hindi with minimum speed of 35/30 w.p.m.; Knowledge of computer applications (proficiency to be evaluated - qualifying nature)
  • Upper Division Clerk: Knowledge of Computer Applications

Experience Requirements

  • Experience counted only after fulfilling minimum educational qualification
  • Experience counted only if candidate has at least 6 months of continuous service with employer
  • Private Secretary: Three years experience as Stenographer/Personal Assistant at Pay Level 06 in 7th CPC or relevant pay band in 6th CPC
  • Technical Assistants: Two years working experience in relevant field
  • Upper Division Clerk: Two years experience as Lower Division Clerk in Central/State Government University/Research Institution/Autonomous organization

Salary/Stipend

  • Medical Officer (Female): Pay Level 10 as per 7th CPC
  • Private Secretary: Pay Level 07 as per 7th CPC
  • Technical Assistant: Pay Level 05 as per 7th CPC
  • Laboratory Assistant: Pay Level 04 as per 7th CPC
  • Upper Division Clerk: Pay Level 04 as per 7th CPC
  • Laboratory Attendant: Pay Level 01 as per 7th CPC
  • Multi-Tasking Staff: Pay Level 01 as per 7th CPC
  • Other Benefits: All emoluments and conditions of service as prescribed by University/UGC/Government of India
  • Pension: Governed by National Pension System (NPS) of Government of India applicable w.e.f. 01.01.2004
  • Age of Superannuation: As prescribed by University/UGC/Government of India

Age Limit (as on 20/01/2026)

  • Medical Officer (Female): 40 years
  • Private Secretary: 35 years
  • Technical Assistant: 32 years
  • Laboratory Assistant: 30 years
  • Upper Division Clerk: 32 years
  • Laboratory Attendant: 30 years
  • Multi-Tasking Staff: 30 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD: As per University/UGC/GoI rules
  • Age Relaxation for Central/State Government Employees: Up to maximum 5 years (for those having at least 3 years regular working experience in same line or allied cadres)
  • Age Relaxation for Ex-servicemen: As per applicable rules
  • CURAJ Employees: Age limit shall not apply to employees of Central University of Rajasthan

Application Fee

  • General/EWS/OBC Candidates: Rs. 1,500/-
  • SC/ST/PWD Candidates: Rs. 750/-
  • Regular Employees of CURAJ: Nil (No fee)
  • Payment Mode: Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, UPI
  • Important Note: Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications with separate fees for each application
  • Refund Policy: Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Advertisement Released 19/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 19/12/2025
Last Date for Online Application Submission 20/01/2026 up to 11:59 PM
Last Date for Hardcopy Submission 27/01/2026 up to 05:00 PM
Last Date for Candidates from Remote Areas 02/02/2026 up to 05:00 PM
Eligibility Determination Date 20/01/2026 (Last date of application)

Selection Process

  • Step 1: Online Application Submission - Candidates must apply online through www.curaj.ac.in in prescribed format
  • Step 2: Hardcopy Submission - After online submission, print application form and send with all enclosures and fee receipt to Registrar (Recruitment Cell)
  • Step 3: Scrutiny of Applications - Applications will be scrutinized based on essential qualifications and eligibility criteria
  • Step 4: Shortlisting - Where applications are large, University may restrict candidates to reasonable limit based on qualifications/experience higher than minimum prescribed
  • Step 5: Written Test/Trade Test/Computer Test - University may conduct written test/trade test/computer test or any other test as per requirement of post
  • Step 6: Interview - Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview
  • Step 7: Document Verification - Candidates must bring all original testimonials/certificates for verification at time of trade test/written test/interview
  • Final Selection: Based on performance in tests/interview and verification of documents
  • Reserve Panel: University may draw up reserve panel/waiting list valid for one year from date of selection committee
  • Evaluation Method: University/Selection Committee may decide its own method of evaluating performance of candidates

General Information/Instructions

  • Qualification and Service Conditions: As prescribed by University/UGC/Government of India, amended from time to time
  • Minimum Qualifications: Candidates must possess at least minimum essential qualifications. Mere possession does not entitle candidature for interview
  • Higher Qualifications Encouraged: University encourages candidates possessing higher qualifications and experience
  • Self-Assessment: Responsibility of candidate to assess own eligibility. Suppression of information, fake documents, false information leads to cancellation
  • Grading System: Where grading system followed, equivalent grade point required
  • Already Employed Candidates: Should apply through proper channel or submit advance copy with NOC at interview. Must submit certificate that no disciplinary proceeding pending and Vigilance Clearance Report
  • Canvassing: Canvassing in any form may lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Ex-servicemen: Must submit discharge certificate/pension payment order and documentary proof of rank. Those in defence service need certificate of relief. Those already in civil post not considered for ex-serviceman relaxation
  • PWD Candidates: Must have at least 40% relevant disability. Certificate issued by competent authority authorized by Central/State Government
  • UR Posts: For UR posts, reserved category candidates treated at par with unreserved category. No relaxation provided - selection based on merit only
  • OBC Certificate: Should not be issued before six months from date of submission and should clearly state candidate does not fall under creamy layer
  • National Pension System: Selected candidates governed by NPS (earlier New Pension Scheme) applicable w.e.f. 01.01.2004
  • Antecedent Verification: University shall verify antecedents/documents at any time. If fake documents/clandestine background detected, services terminated
  • University Rights: University reserves right to withdraw advertisement, increase/decrease posts, fill or not fill posts, consider in-absentia candidature, draw reserve panel, consider late applications, decide shortlisting criteria, consider appointment on direct recruitment/deputation/contract, relax qualifications in deserving cases
  • Amendments: Any amendment/update/addendum/corrigendum will be posted on University website only
  • No Correspondence: No correspondence regarding postal delays, conduct/result of tests/interviews, reasons for not being called
  • Final Decision: In case of dispute/ambiguity, decision of University shall be final
  • Territorial Jurisdiction: Rajasthan High Court Bench Jaipur for any disputes/legal proceedings

How to Apply

Online Application Process

  • Step 1: Visit official website www.curaj.ac.in
  • Step 2: Register and fill online application form in prescribed format
  • Step 3: Pay application fee using Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking or UPI
  • Step 4: Submit online application before 20/01/2026 (11:59 PM)
  • Step 5: Take printout of online application form

Hardcopy Submission Process

  • Step 1: After online submission, take printout of submitted application form
  • Step 2: Attach all required documents (self-attested) with application
  • Step 3: Put application with enclosures in envelope
  • Step 4: Superscribe envelope with "Application for the post of _________ (Post Category)"
  • Step 5: Send to: Registrar (Recruitment Cell), Central University of Rajasthan, NH-8, Bandarsindri, Kishangarh, District - Ajmer, 305817 (Rajasthan)
  • Step 6: Hardcopy must reach by 27/01/2026 (05:00 PM)
  • For Remote Areas: Candidates from Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, J&K, Lahaul & Spiti, Pangi Sub Division, Andaman & Nicobar, Lakshadweep may send by 02/02/2026 (05:00 PM)

Documents to be Enclosed (Self-attested)

  • Online payment receipt of prescribed application fee (original)
  • Photocopy of certificate in support of Date of Birth
  • Photocopies of all documents related to qualifications
  • Photocopies of certificates related to experience
  • Any other document in support of qualifications, experience as mentioned in form
  • Photocopy of SC/ST/OBC/PWD certificate (where applicable)
  • Every page of application, annexure and certificates must be self-attested
  • Experience certificates should be on organization letterhead with date of issue, specific period of work, name and designation of issuing authority with signature
  • Certificates not in English or Hindi need to be translated (preferably to English or Hindi) and self-attested

Important Instructions

  • Applications accepted only in prescribed format through online mode
  • Separate application for each post with separate fee
  • CV/Resume/Bio-data sent directly by post or email cannot be considered
  • Candidates advised to visit website regularly for updates
  • University not responsible for postal delays or technical reasons
  • Applications received after last date due to postal delay will be summarily rejected
  • Incomplete applications or applications not meeting criteria will be rejected

Instruction

Candidates who have undergone training under similar scheme for one year or more in any other PSUs will not be eligible to apply.
Age Limit UR/EWS: 28 years, OBC (NCL): 31 years, SC/ST: 33 years; relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL & 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.

CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Name of the Company Location of HQ with State Number of Training Slots
Coal India Ltd. Kolkata, West Bengal 7
Bharat Coking Coal Ltd. Dhanbad, Jharkhand 12
Central Coalfields Ltd. Ranchi, Jharkhand 15
CMPDIL Ranchi, Jharkhand 7
Eastern Coalfields Ltd. Sanctoria, West Bengal 12
Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd. Sambalpur, Orissa 20
Northern Coalfields Ltd. Singrauli, Madhya Pradesh 20
South Eastern Coalfields Ltd. Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh 20
Western Coalfields Ltd. Nagpur, Maharashtra 12
Total 125

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Chartered Accountant (CA) conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
  • OR candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates who have undergone training under similar scheme for one year or more in any other PSUs will not be eligible to apply.
  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

Salary/Stipend

  • The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is purely for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.
  • The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • There should be no misconception or claims by the beneficiary for employment in CIL or its subsidiaries on completion of training.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date)

  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for UR/EWS category is 28 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for OBC (NCL) category is 31 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for SC/ST category is 33 years.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL and 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit to SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates is not applicable for consideration against unreserved posts.
  • Crucial date for claim of SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD status or any other benefit viz. reservation, upper age limit etc. where not specified otherwise, will be the 1st date of the month in which advertisement has been published.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

 

Selection Process

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.
  • Students would be required to give choice of 9 companies (in the order of preference) among CIL or its subsidiary companies i.e. CIL (HQ), ECL, BCCL, CCL, CMPDIL, NCL, MCL, SECL & WCL.
  • Selection will be based on the merit ranking based on marks obtained in Intermediate Exam and posting will be done based on the preference of posting given and seniority position in the Merit List.
  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.
  • In case there is shortfall in joining in the original panel, then this shortfall (for the respective category) will be filled from the Waiting List Panel.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates are informed that applying for engagement as Industrial Trainee shall not give them the right to be engaged as trainee in the company and company reserves the right to reject any candidate without assigning any reason.
  • Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.
  • Preference will be given to the Land Owners and also to the wards of employees as defined in the scheme.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates can contact the Helpline No. 033 7110 4262 between 10.00 Hours to 17.00 Hours on all working days.
  • The selected candidates will be allowed for training subject to being found medically fit based on Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a period of 15 months training and would be required to give an undertaking to the effect that they would complete the entire period of training unless otherwise removed by the company.
  • They shall maintain absolute integrity and maintain the secrecy of the documents they may come across during course of training.
  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates meeting the above requirements may apply ONLINE and upload scanned copy of certificates in CIL Online application portal in career page of CIL website (coalindia.in).
  • All the fields in the form need to be filled up.
  • Candidates must provide nine choices of posting of CIL/subsidiaries in preferential order.
  • Upload recent passport size color photograph.
  • Upload scanned image of candidate’s signature in dark blue or black ink.
  • Upload proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Matriculation/HSC Mark Sheet).
  • Upload copy of AADHAR Card.
  • Upload Intermediate Examination Certificate of CA/CMA & Mark Sheets of intermediate examination of CA/CMA in chronological order.
  • Upload Community Certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates.
  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.
  • Before registering/applying online, the candidates should ensure that they have a valid email ID, which should remain valid till the selection of trainee process is completed.
  • After submitting the application through online mode, a Registration-Cum-Application Form will be generated, which candidates are required to take print out of and submit along with copies of other uploaded documents at the time of certificate verification.
  • No manual/paper applications will be entertained directly.

1. What is the starting date to apply for CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Starting date to apply is 26.12.2025 (from 10.00 hours).

2. What is the last apply date for CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Last apply date is 15.01.2026 (up to 17.00 hours).

3. What is the eligibility to apply for CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Chartered Accountant (CA) conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India OR intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India and have not undergone similar training in other PSUs for one year or more.

4. What is the maximum age limit to apply for CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Maximum upper age limit is 28 years for UR/EWS, 31 years for OBC (NCL) and 33 years for SC/ST, with applicable relaxations for PwDs.

5. How many vacancies are being recruited under CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Total 125 training slots are available across CIL and its subsidiaries.

6. What is the stipend for CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.

7. What is the duration of training for Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) in CIL?

Ans: The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.

8. Is there any claim for employment in CIL after completion of Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) training?

Ans: Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.

9. What is the method of selection for CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Selection is based on percentage of marks in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as per reservation policy and preference to Land Owners and wards of employees, with merit ranking and preference of posting.

10. How can candidates apply for CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Candidates must apply online through CIL Online application portal in the career page of CIL website (coalindia.in) and upload all required documents in the prescribed formats and sizes.

11. Are there any reservations for PwD candidates in CIL Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Yes, total 5 seats are reserved for PwD candidates within the overall 125 seats, as per Government of India guidelines.

12. What preference is given to Land Owners and wards of employees in this recruitment?

Ans: Additionally, 15% reservation is made for preference in selection and posting to the Land Owners and 20% reservation is made for preference in selection and posting to the wards of employees, as defined in the scheme.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply Offline through the official DLSA MP website. The last date to submit the application form is 02-01-2026. In this article, you’ll find the DLSA MP Deputy Chief, Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel and More Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Offline application form.

The District Legal Services Authority (DLSA), MP, under the guidance of the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) and Madhya Pradesh State Legal Services Authority, has invited applications for the engagement of Legal Aid Defense Counsels on contract basis as per the Legal Aid Defense Counsel Scheme (L.A.D.C.S.). This initiative aims to provide quality legal assistance to accused persons in criminal cases from pre-arrest stage to appeal and all intermediate stages. A total of 10 posts are available: 01 Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel, 03 Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsels, and 06 Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsels, exclusively for the District Legal Services Authority, MP.

The positions are full-time contractual roles where selected advocates will handle cases assigned by DLSA MP and are prohibited from undertaking any private practice during the contract period. Honorarium ranges from Rs. 35,000/- for Assistant to Rs. 80,000/- for Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel, based on minimum bar practice experience (0-3 years for Assistant, 7 years for Deputy Chief, and 10 years for Chief in specified courts). Applications in the prescribed format must be submitted in person or by registered post to the DLSA MP office by 02.01.2026 (5:00 PM). The scheme follows NALSA's modified guidelines and MP State Legal Services Authority SOPs, with details available on official court websites.

  • In case candidate face any difficulty while applying to respective NATS while positions/slots for Northern Coalfields Limited, through online mode by utilizing the NATS web portal that is, may contact to HRD Department, NCL by writing an email to: [email protected]

  • Before applying for above apprentice positions, candidates have to first register themselves in online NATS portal by utilizing https://portal.mhrdnats.gov.in/ .

DLSA Dhar Notification 2025 PDF

District Legal Services Authority Dhar Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

Total vacancies: 06 posts for District Dhar (Category C District).

Post Name (पद का नाम) No of Vacancy
Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel  01
Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel  02
Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel  03

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications (Chief LADC): Minimum 10 years of practice in Session Court is mandatory.
  • Qualifications (Deputy Chief LADC): Minimum 07 years of practice in Session Court is mandatory.
  • Qualifications (Assistant LADC): Minimum 0 to 03 years of practice in Judicial Magistrate level court is mandatory.
  • Desirable: LL.M. Degree (if available), Ph.D. in Law (if available), Knowledge of Information Technology and Legal Software Tools.
  • Experience: Relevant experience related to practice on the Criminal side.

Salary/Stipend

  • Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel: Rs. 65,000/- per month (Honorarium) for Category C districts.
  • Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel: Rs. 45,000/- per month (Honorarium) for Category C districts.
  • Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel: Rs. 25,000/- per month (Honorarium) for Category C districts.
  • The selected advocates cannot engage in any private practice during the contract period.
  • The salary, terms, and conditions are subject to NALSA Modified Scheme 2022 and MPSLSA SOP guidelines.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Date 11.12.2025
Last Date for Application Submission (Personal/Regd. Post) 30.12.2025 by 5:00 PM

Selection Process

  • Selection is based on merit, taking into account knowledge, skills, practice, and experience.
  • A Screening Committee will examine the applications as per rules; incomplete or false applications will be rejected.
  • A list of eligible and ineligible candidates will be pasted on the DLSA Dhar notice board.
  • Eligible candidates will be called for a separate interview as per the applied post, before a selection committee chaired by the Principal District & Sessions Judge.
  • The final appointment is subject to the approval of the Executive Chairman, MPSLSA, Jabalpur.

General Information/Instructions

  • The engagement is on a contractual basis initially for a period of two years, with a stipulation for extension on a yearly basis subject to satisfactory performance.
  • The number of posts may be increased or decreased as per the requirements and instructions of the MPSLSA, Jabalpur.
  • Selected advocates cannot engage in any private practice or take other retainerships during the contract period.
  • Chief and Deputy LADC are eligible for 15 days' leave in a calendar year pro-rata, while Assistant LADC are eligible for 12 days.
  • Performance of every human resource shall be assessed every six months.

How To Apply

  • Interested candidates can download the application form from the official websites: https://mphc.gov.in, https://madhyapradesh.nalsa.gov.in, and https://dhar.dcourts.gov.in.
  • Applications can also be obtained from the notice board and office of the DLSA Dhar.
  • Each post requires a separate application form.
  • Duly filled application forms along with self-attested copies of required documents (judgments, memos/vakalatnamas, bail orders, degrees, experience certificates, IT knowledge proof) must be submitted.
  • Submit applications in the office of the Secretary, DLSA Dhar, either personally or through registered post, on or before December 30, 2025, by 5:00 PM.

  • Indian Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar is an Institute of National Importance under the Institutes of Technology Act, 1961
  • Applications must be submitted through ONLINE process only

Educational Qualification

The educational qualifications for various posts have been detailed below:

For Institute Engineer:

  • A first class degree (Bachelor's/Master's) in Civil/Electrical Engineering

For Technical Officer Level-III:

  • M.Tech/MCA with good IInd class in Computer Science OR B.Tech with good IInd class in Computer Science OR Ph.D. in Computer Science

For Deputy Registrar (Direct):

  • A Master's degree with at least 55% of the marks or its equivalent grade of 'B' in UGC 7 point scale

For Deputy Registrar (Deputation):

  • Officers from the Central/ State Governments/ UTs/ their Universities or Institutions/ Autonomous bodies/ Government Laboratories/ Statutory organizations/PSU/PSE

For Executive Engineer (Electrical/ Mechanical):

  • Bachelor Degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or equivalent OR Master Degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

For Medical Officer (Psychiatry):

  • MD/MS from a University, recognized by Medical Council of India (MCI) in the appropriate branch of a medicine OR PG Diploma from a University, recognized by Medical Council of India (MCI), in the appropriate branch of medicine

For Medical Officer (Gynaecology):

  • MD/MS in Obstetrics & Gynaecology from a University recognized by MCI OR Post Graduate Diploma in Obstetrics & Gynaecology (DGO) from a University recognized by MCI

For Assistant Registrar:

  • Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade of ‘B’ in the UGC 7 pt scale along with a good academic record

For Security Officer:

  • Commissioned Officer of Army/Navy/Air Force or Deputy Superintendent of Police or Assistant Commandant of Police/Security Force OR a graduate

  • Female candidates who have changed first/last/middle name post marriage must take special note of this. In case of candidates who have changed their name, will be allowed only if they produce original Gazette notification/their original marriage certificate/affidavit in original.

Examination Centers

  • Online Exam for all posts will be conducted in centers at following locations: Haldwani Distt. Nainital (Uttarakhand), Dehradun (Uttarakhand), Roorkee (Uttarakhand), Bareilly (Uttar Pradesh), Meerut (Uttar Pradesh), Moradabad (Uttar Pradesh), Lucknow (Uttar Pradesh), Jaipur (Rajasthan), Delhi/NCR, Ambala (Haryana).
  • Candidates will have to choose any three centers of their preference and convenience.
  • No request for change of centre/venue/date/session for Examination shall be entertained.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel any of the Examination Centres and/or add some other Centres, at its discretion.
  • Choice of center once exercised by the candidate will be final.

Multiple Applications

  • A candidate can apply for the Post of Customer Service Associate (CSA) and can also apply for the Post of Officers.
  • However, a candidate can apply for only one post in officer's cadre i.e. for Officer Scale-I (PO/SO) or Scale-II (PO/SO).
  • Candidates have to separately apply and pay application fees/intimation charges for each post for which they apply.
  • In case of multiple Applications for a post, only the latest valid (completed) application in each post will be retained and the application fee/intimation charges paid for the other multiple registrations will stand forfeited.

Guidelines for Persons with Disabilities

  • The visually impaired candidates and candidates whose writing speed is adversely affected permanently for any reason can use their own scribe at their cost during the online examination.
  • The candidate will have to arrange his/her own scribe at his/her own cost.
  • The scribe arranged by the candidate should not be a candidate for the same examination.
  • Those candidates who use a scribe shall be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination or as otherwise advised.
  • A compensatory time of twenty minutes per hour or otherwise advised shall be permitted for the candidates with locomotor disability and cerebral palsy where dominant (writing) extremity is affected to the extent of slowing the performance of function (minimum of 40% impairment).
  • Visually Impaired candidates (who suffer from not less than 40% of disability) may opt to view the contents of the test in magnified font and all such candidates will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour or otherwise advised of examination.

Important Notes

  • The candidates can be posted/subsequently transferred to any of the existing/proposed Branches/Offices of the Bank as per Banking exigencies.
  • In case of experience, the relevant experience certificate must contain specifically experience in Bank/FIs related sector.
  • Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process partly/entirely at any time.
  • The Bank reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
  • The application fee once paid will NOT BE REFUNDED for any reason nor would be held in reserve for any future examination or selection.
  • Decision of the Bank in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding on the candidate.
  • Candidates reporting late i.e. after the reporting time specified on the call letter for Examination will not be permitted to take the examination.
  • Candidates may be required to be at the venue for about 4 hours including the time required for completion of various formalities.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online only from 12.12.2025 to 01.01.2026 and no other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Candidates to go to the recruitment section of Bank's website at www.nainitalbank.bank.in and click on the option "APPLY ONLINE" which will open a new screen.
  • To register application, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id.
  • A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen.
  • Before applying online, candidates will be required to have a scanned (digital) image of their photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), signature, left thumb impression and hand written declaration as per specifications.
  • The text for the hand written declaration is: "I, (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • After filling all details, click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • The payment can be made by using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, an e-Receipt will be generated.
  • Candidates are required to take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form containing fee details.
  • After registering online candidates are advised to take a printout of their system generated online application forms.
  • Call letters for online test can be downloaded from Bank's website www.nainitalbank.bank.in.
  • Intimation for downloading call letter will also be sent through e-mail/SMS.
  • Candidates need to affix recent recognizable photograph on the call letter and appear at the examination centre with Call Letter, Photo Identity Proof and Photocopy of the same Photo Identity Proof.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Publication Date To be published in Employment Newspaper/Rozgar Samachar
Application Start Date Not Specified
Last Date for Receipt of Applications 21st day from the date of publication in Employment Newspaper
Trade Test (Practical) Date Will be communicated via E-mail to shortlisted candidates

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting: Candidates will be shortlisted for Trade Test (Practical) on the basis of percentage of marks obtained in the final examination of NTC/NAC
  • Shortlisting Ratio: Candidates will be called for Trade Test 1.25 times of the number of positions to be filled in the order of percentage of marks obtained in final examination of NTC/NAC
  • Trade Test (Practical): Shortlisted candidates will be called for Trade Test (Practical) which will be of qualifying nature only. The syllabus will be as per trade test specification of semi-skilled grade of the relevant trade
  • Merit Decision: The merit will be decided solely based on percentage of marks obtained in the final examination of NTC/NAC (In case possessing both NTC/NAC, the percentage of marks of NTC will be considered)
  • Disqualification: Candidates who fail in Trade Test will be disqualified

Resolution of Tie (In order of preference)

  • Ex-Trade Apprentices of Ordnance Factories will get preference in case of Tie
  • The candidate older in age will get preference
  • Alphabetical order of Names

General Information/Instructions

  • Nationality: Only Indian Nationals may apply
  • Job Profile: As per the requirements of Technical Trades related to Project/Augmentation of capacity of TPDK-1, T-90 (OH) and T-72 in OLF (A unit under IOL)
  • Tenure of Engagement: 01 year initially, which may be extended one year at a time up to a maximum period of 03 years (Total 04 years, including initial period) based on functional requirement and individual's performance
  • Nature of Engagement: All positions are on Fixed Term Full Time (Contract) Basis only
  • Place of Posting: At OLF Dehradun (A Unit under India Optel Limited). However, engaged individuals shall be liable to be transferred to any unit, Project Establishment, Office or any other location in any part of the country
  • Document Verification: Candidates must bring all requisite relevant documents along with originals for verification at the time of Trade Test (Practical)
  • NOC Required: Candidates currently serving in Government/Quasi Government/PSU/Autonomous Body must submit No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their present employer at the time of Trade Test (Practical)
  • Medical Fitness: Engagement will be subject to submission of Medical Fitness Certificate issued by Competent Civil Medical Authority
  • Contract Agreement: The finally selected candidate will have to sign a contractual agreement with IOL
  • No Regular Employment: The Contract shall not confer any rights or claim of extension/absorption/Permanent Employment in the Company
  • Admit Card: Call letters for Trade Test (Practical) will be forwarded to the candidates by E-mail only
  • Result Declaration: The result of the final selection will be published only on DOO (C&S) website https://ddpdoo.gov.in. Selected candidates will also be informed through E-mail
  • Company Facilities: Tenure based personnel will be entitled for safety and protective gears, equipment, kits as per Company norms and Unit Industrial Meal Canteen Facility
  • Female Personnel: Entitled to Maternity Benefits as per the provisions under the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961
  • Company Quarters: May be given subject to availability and approval by paying Licence fee as prescribed (In this case HRA will not be given)
  • Termination: The engagement can be terminated at any time by giving one month's notice by either party or payment of monthly remuneration in lieu of notice
  • Jurisdiction: Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in appropriate Courts/Tribunals/Forums in Dehradun (Uttarakhand State), which shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction

How to Apply

  • Application Format: Download the prescribed application format (Annexure-A) from DOO (C&S) website https://ddpdoo.gov.in at 'Join Us' Tab
  • Filling Instructions: Fill the application form in BLOCK LETTERS only
  • Required Documents: Attach self-attested copies of all requisite documents pertaining to qualifications, experience, past employment, present employment, salary proof, caste & category certificates
  • Submission Mode: Send application by POST ONLY to the following address:
    The Chairman & Managing Director
    India Optel Limited, OFILDD Campus
    Raipur, Dehradun (Uttarakhand) - 248008
  • Envelope Superscription: The envelope must be clearly superscribed as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ……………………….. ON FIXED TERM CONTRACT BASIS"
  • Email & Mobile: Enter active E-mail ID and Mobile number which should be valid throughout the engagement process. All important communications will be sent to this E-mail ID/Mobile number
  • Photograph: Paste recent passport size photograph (self-attested in front) on the application form
  • Complete Information: It is mandatory to fill all relevant information such as qualification details, experience details (if any), percentage of marks etc.
  • Name Matching: Any variation in name/surname in Application form with educational/professional certificates will result in cancellation
  • Incomplete Applications: Non-attachment of required documents will be treated as incomplete application and will be rejected
  • Check for Updates: Candidates must check the website regularly for any further updates, corrigendum, or addendum

Candidates applying for these positions must meet specific eligibility criteria, including educational qualifications such as a First Class full-time Engineering Degree, MBA, CA/ICWA, or a Diploma for certain posts. The salary scales range from ₹90,000 to ₹2,40,000 for higher positions like Dy. General Manager and Asst. General Manager, while Diploma Trainees will receive a stipend ranging from ₹17,000 to ₹25,500 depending on the contract year. The age limit for applicants varies by post and category, with relaxations for SC/ST and OBC candidates, as well as an additional 10-year age relaxation for PwD candidates. Interested candidates must apply online by 7th January 2026.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications (Chief Manager): M.E. / M.Tech in Civil Engineering with experience in CAD / CAM & Automated Project Management Systems. 15 years experience in relevant pay levels.
  • Qualifications (Manager): Graduation in any discipline. 12 years relevant administrative experience in relevant pay levels.
  • Qualifications (Asst Administrative Officer/Assistant/Junior Assistant): Graduation in any discipline with relevant administrative/clerical experience in specified pay levels.
  • Qualifications (Junior Engineer): 3-year Diploma in Electrical Engg (8 yrs experience) OR B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engg (3 yrs experience) in relevant pay levels.
  • Qualifications (Library & Info Asst): Bachelor's Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science or equivalent. 6 years relevant experience.
  • Qualifications (Accountant/Junior Accountant): b.com/Inter-CA/Inter-ICWA with 6/5 years relevant post qualification experience in specified pay levels.
  • Relevant experience means experience in administrative/office clerical matters, preferably in Central/State Govt. Service or academic institutions.
  • Experience should not include Apprenticeship and Training of any form.

Salary/Stipend

  • Chief Manager (Level-13): Rs. 123100-215900 (Gross Pay: Rs. 2.25 Lakh/month appx.).
  • Manager (Level-10): Rs. 56100-177500 (Gross Pay: Rs. 1.00 Lakh/month appx.).
  • Asst Administrative Officer (Level-07): Rs. 44900-142400 (Gross Pay: Rs. 77,000 /month appx.).
  • Junior Engineer/Library Asst/Assistant/Accountant (Level-06): Rs. 35400-112400 (Gross Pay: Rs. 62,000 /month appx.).
  • Junior Assistant/Junior Accountant (Level-04): Rs. 25500-81100 (Gross Pay: Rs. 45,000 /month appx.).

Age Limit (as on 12 January 2026)

  • Chief Manager: Maximum 50 years.
  • Manager: Maximum 45 years.
  • Asst Administrative Officer: Maximum 40 years (OBC(NCL): 43 years).
  • Junior Engineer/Library Asst/Accountant/Junior Accountant: Maximum 35 years.
  • Assistant: Maximum 35 years (OBC(NCL): 38 years, SC: 40 years).
  • Junior Assistant: Maximum 35 years (ST: 40 years).
  • Age calculation is as on the last date of online application submission (12 January 2026).
  • Age relaxation for Ex-servicemen/PwD is as per Govt. of India Rules. No upper age limit for departmental candidates holding regular position in IIM Kozhikode.

Application Fee

  • Application fee of Rs. 118/- inclusive of GST is to be paid through an online payment system.
  • There is no application fee for SC/ST/Differently Abled/Women and Departmental Candidates of IIM Kozhikode.
  • Fee once remitted will not be refunded.
  • A separate fee is to be paid for each post if applying for multiple positions.

Selection Process

  • Method of selection:
    • Chief Manager: Interview only (at IIM Kozhikode Campus).
    • Manager: Interview only (at IIM Kozhikode Campus).
    • Assistant Administrative Officer: Written Test only.
    • Junior Engineer/Library Asst/Assistant/Accountant/Junior Assistant/Junior Accountant: Written test only.
  • Shortlisted candidates alone will be called for the selection process.
  • Certificate verification will be part of the selection process.
  • The Institute reserves the right to fix the criteria for selection beyond minimum qualifications.

General Information/Instructions

  • Posts are on a regular basis. Place of posting can be IIM Kozhikode main campus or Kochi campus.
  • Selected candidates will join at the entry pay of the concerned Pay Level; no pay protection benefits.
  • Candidates must not apply for outside employment for the initial three years after joining.
  • Incomplete/unsigned applications and applications without proper supporting documents will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates working in Govt/PSUs must forward applications through the proper channel or submit NOC at the time of written test/interview.

How To Apply

  • Application is to be submitted online from December 12, 2025, to January 12, 2026, on the IIM Kozhikode website careers portal.
  • After online submission, take a printed copy of the application, sign it, and attach self-attested copies of all relevant documents (SSLC for DOB, education proof, experience certs, salary proofs, community certs, vigilance clearance, etc.).
  • Send the complete hard copy by Speed Post/Registered Post/Courier to: `HR In-charge, Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode, IIM Kozhikode Campus P.O, Kozhikode, Kerala - 673 570`.
  • The envelope must be clearly superscribed with "Application for the post of , Post Code ".
  • Hard copy must be received by January 21, 2026, 5:30 PM.

FCRI Project Staff ITI, Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total Posts
Project Staff ITI Machinist 2 (Gen-1, OBC-NCL-01)
