Eligibility Criteria

  • Project Staff ITI Machinist: Essential qualifications: First Class ITI in Machinist trade in a two-year vocational programme, Experience: Experience in Shop floor/Workshop involving fabrication, Assembly, workpiece and piping component fabrication/ machining, knowledge of both hand tools usage and specialized machine tools, etc.,
  • Project Staff ITI Fitter: Essential qualifications: First Class ITI in Fitter trade in a two-year vocational programme, Experience: Experience in Shop floor/Workshop involving fabrication, Assembly, workpiece and piping component fabrication/ machining, knowledge of both hand tools usage and specialized machine tools, etc.,
  • Project Staff ITI Welder: Essential qualifications: First Class ITI in Welder trade in a One-year vocational programme, Experience: Experience in Shop floor/Workshop involving fabrication, Assembly, workpiece and piping component fabrication/ machining, knowledge of both hand tools usage and specialized machine tools, etc.,
  • Project Staff ITI Plumber: Essential qualifications: First Class ITI in Plumber trade in a One-year vocational programme, Experience: Installation, repair and maintenance of water supply systems and sewage/drainage system, and should have a knowledge of water supply system / line layout design for both hot & cold water, piping (PVC/UPVC/GI) and accessories.
  • Project Staff ITI Electrical: Essential qualifications: First Class ITI in Electrical trade in a two-year vocational programme, Experience: a. Possession of “Electricity Worker Permit” issued by Department of Electrical Inspectorate or 3 years experience in Industries with 500 kW or above connected load. b. Trouble shooting of faults and rectification of electrical installations. c. Taking reading of energy meters, Ammeters, Voltmeters d. Maintenance of lead Acid and VRLA type batteries.
  • Project Staff ITI – MRAC: Essential qualifications: First Class ITI in MRAC trade in a two-year vocational programme, Experience: a) Installation, Operation and Maintenance of different types of Air-conditioning / refrigeration Systems including packaged A/C, Centralised A/Cs, Chiller plants, Split A/Cs, Window A/Cs, etc., Desirable: Candidates with atleast one year operation & maintenance of packaged A/Cs, centralised A/cs and Chiller plants.
  • Trainee Engineer (Graduate in B.E/B.Tech)
  • Trainee Engineer (Diploma)

Salary/Stipend

  • Project Staff ITI: 1st Year: Rs.17500/- (consolidated)
  • Project Staff ITI: 2nd Year: Rs.19500/- (consolidated)
  • Trainee Engineer (Graduate B.E/B.Tech): Rs.28000/- Stipend
  • Trainee Engineer (Diploma): Rs.21000/- Stipend

Age Limit (as on 30-12-2025)

  • Project Staff ITI: Age: 28 years
  • Trainee Engineer (Graduate in B.E/B.Tech): 30 years
  • Trainee Engineer (Diploma): 28 years

Important Dates

Notification Date 20.11.2025
Applications Starting Date 26/11/2025
Closing Date 30/12/2025 (5.30 PM)

Selection Process

  • Method of Recruitment: Test and Interview.
  • Minimum 30% marks in Test is required to qualify for the interview.
  • Merely qualifying the written exam will not make the candidate eligible to attend the interview. Cut off marks for the interview will be decided by the selection committee based on the number of posts at the time of interview.
  • The test shall be based on a. Specific experience criteria mentioned b. Aptitude in relevant engineering discipline c. General aptitude (logical reasoning, numerical ability)
  • Test will be of multiple choice question type
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview/written examination.

General Information/Instructions

  • The selected persons will be engaged initially for a fixed term of ONE YEAR, which may be extended to a maximum period of 2 years, subject to the performance of the candidate assessed during and at end of each year. The term of engagement will not be extendable beyond THREE years.
  • Selected personnel will be paid a consolidated remuneration as below. There are no other allowances carried with the Posts.
  • ONLY Candidates willing to work for a minimum period of ONE YEAR may apply.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to Apply.
  • All candidates shall have consistent scores of above 65% marks (aggregate) in all examinations starting from Class X onwards.
  • Relaxed qualifying norm for SC/ST candidates: minimum 60% marks (aggregate) in all semesters / all years in the Qualifying examination.
  • Mere possession of minimum qualifications / experience will not entitle any candidate to be called for Test / Interview.
  • Age limit is age as on last date of Application. Age relaxation is admissible as per Government of India order/Norms. Candidate belonging to SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS should enclose self-attested photocopy of valid caste certificate along with the application (OBC Certificate should be in the format as prescribed by the Government of India).
  • Candidates who fail to produce the valid documents at SL No 6 above will be considered for General (UR) category only.
  • FCRI reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any time / not fill up the posts notified, without assigning any reasons thereof.
  • Only candidates who are willing to attend to duties on any shift shall apply.
  • Only candidates willing to work anywhere in India shall apply. The duties / assignments may entail tours/travel anywhere for any length of period.
  • Candidates shall have good health and fitness. Selected candidate shall submit Medical Fitness Certificate in specified Format at the time of joining. Candidates subsequently found to be medically unfit or found to be having consistent health issues affecting their duty/ attendance/etc. for prolonged periods will be terminated.
  • Eligible Leave: One-day Casual Leave for every completed 1 month. No leave encashment is permitted. For absence beyond eligible Casual Leave balance, pro-rata deduction shall be made to consolidated pay for the month. Eligible for Medical Leave upto 15 days for each calendar year (pro-rata reduction for reduced duration of engagement) on submission of Medical Certificate and shall be followed by submission Medical Fitness Certificate at the time of rejoining for duty. No other types of Leave are permissible. Leaves are not encashable. Leaves are specific to each calendar year and cannot be carried forward.
  • The selected persons shall be required to assist with on-site assignments, other duties and functions as may be assigned by his/her reporting officer.
  • FCRI reserves the right to terminate the contract at any point of time with a Notice period of 1 months, except in case of disciplinary actions for misconducts where Contract will be terminated with immediate effect.
  • A Notice period of 1 months is applicable if the selected person wishes to get relieved before completion of his/her engagement or 1 month pay in lieu.
  • Candidates applying for being engaged on the basis of this notification for tenure basis at FCRI shall not have any preferential claims / rights / guarantees for future employment to regular posts, or in any manner in relation to other open market candidates.
  • The tenure is specific to contract agreement and in no case extendable beyond THREE Years.
  • At the time of interview, Candidates shall produce for verification all original documents as proof of details furnished in the application and photocopy of each. Any discrepancies found in the certificate will attract the disqualification of application. Non-production of the original certificates at the time of interview/ written test will also disqualify the candidate disqualified.
  • Please note that in case the details provided by you in the application / at the time of interview is not supported by the documents or found to be incorrect at the time of joining or at a later date, you are liable to be terminated from the Institute, without any notice.
  • Candidates are advised to visit the website concerning all updates / corrigendum or other matters concerning this Notification including dates of Written Test/Interviews, etc. No other announcements may be expected in newspapers or other media
  • Incomplete applications, and those forwarded to any other emails / whatsapp of FCRI employees or those applications sent without mentioning the subject line as stated above will be summarily rejected. No enquiries or follow up calls of candidates will be entertained with reference to the Notification. Candidates are advised to visit FCRI website for all information concerning the Notification.
  • FCRI has not engaged any person or agencies or entities for collecting of applications or any purposes related to recruitments. Candidates are advised to strictly adhere to the details mentioned in this Notification and NOT fall into promises / traps of unscrupulous agents for any recruitment processes at FCRI.
  • Please report information, if any, on such incidents directly to following address with relevant proof / evidences / supporting materials: The Head (P&A), Fluid Control Research Institute, Kanjikode West, Palakkad, Kerala. PIN: 678 623.

How to Apply

  • “Application Form” may be downloaded from FCRI website, filled up, signed and sent with all relevant enclosures as cited in List below. ENCLOSURE with Application Form: Scanned copies of relevant certificates (in PDF format file) shall be enclosed in the email along with the completed application Form.
  • a) Class X Certificate in Proof of Date of Birth
  • b) Class X Marksheet
  • c) Consolidated semester wise Marksheet of ITI Trade
  • d) ITI / NCVT Certificate
  • e) Certificate issued by Competent Authority in proof of SC/ST, OBC (NCL), EWS, as the case may be.
  • f) Certificate of Experience in actual process / manufacturing industry from employer.
  • All pages of the Application and Certificates shall be signed by the candidate.
  • The Application Form (filled up MS Word file saved as non-image PDF format) with all requisitioned enclosures (scanned into a single PDF File) shall be emailed to [email protected] with Subject line “Project Staff- ITI”. No Physical copies of Applications need to be sent. Hence Candidates shall ensure the scanned pdf copies of Application Form and certificates shall be clear and legible.
  • Please mention only the following in the email body: Notification Number & Date, Name of Post, Post CODE, Branch of Engineering, Name of Candidate, Phone number of Candidate (preferably WhatsApp number), Category (General / Reserved)
  • Candidates shall submit ONLY one Application for One post.
  • Canvassing in any Form shall invite disqualification of the candidature,

Eligibility Criteria for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

1. Super Specialist (Entry Level)

Essential Qualifications:

  • A recognized medical qualification included in the first or second Schedule or Part-II of the third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956
  • Holders of educational qualifications included in Part-II of the third Schedule should also fulfill the conditions stipulated in sub-section (3) of section (13) of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956)
  • MCh/DM/DNB or equivalent in the concerned Super specialty
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • Entry Level: No specific experience mentioned

2. Super Specialist (Senior Consultant)

Essential Qualifications:

  • A recognized medical qualification included in the first or second Schedule or Part-II of the third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956
  • Holders of educational qualifications included in Part-II of the third Schedule should also fulfill the conditions stipulated in sub-section (3) of section (13) of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956)
  • MCh/DM/DNB or equivalent in the concerned Super specialty
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • Candidates with at least five years post super specialty qualification experience will be considered for engagement as Consultant (Senior Level)

3. Specialist (Junior)

Essential Qualifications:

  • Post Graduate Degree/DNB, or Diploma in concerned speciality after MBBS with TCMC registration
  • For Casualty/ICU: PG Degree or PG Diploma holders in Anaesthesiology/General Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine/Emergency Medicine and registered with Medical Council
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • Three years experience in respective specialty for degree holders, OR
  • Five years experience in respective specialty for Diploma holders

4. Specialist (Senior)

Essential Qualifications:

  • Post Graduate Degree/DNB, or Diploma after MBBS with TCMC registration
  • For Casualty/ICU: PG Degree or PG Diploma holders in Anaesthesiology/General Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine/Emergency Medicine and registered with Medical Council
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • Five years experience in respective specialty for degree holders, OR
  • Seven years experience in respective specialty for Diploma holders

5. Senior Resident (Pay Level 11)

Essential Qualifications:

  • For Superspeciality departments: DM/DrNB in concerned superspeciality is preferred over MD/DNB in General Medicine
  • For Specialty departments: Post Graduate Degree/DNB, or Diploma in concerned specialty after MBBS with TCMC registration is required
  • For ICU: PG Degree or PG Diploma holders in Anaesthesiology/General Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine/Emergency Medicine/Critical care medicine and registered with Medical Council is required
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • No specific experience mentioned for Senior Resident

Salary/Stipend for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

1. Super Specialist (Full Time)

  • Entry Level: Rs. 2,00,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Senior Level: Rs. 2,40,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Working Hours: 09:00 AM to 04:00 PM on weekdays and 09:00 AM to 01:00 PM on Saturdays
  • Contract Duration: One year or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • Should attend emergency calls and visit as and when required
  • Remuneration revisable as per ESIC Headquarters instruction from time to time

2. Super Specialist (Part Time)

  • Entry Level: Rs. 1,00,000/- per month
  • Additional Rs. 20,000/- admissible as visiting charges in case of emergency (if willing)
  • Rs. 1,200/- for additional every hour, beyond 16 hours subject to the justification of competent authority
  • Consultant (Sr. Level): Rs. 1,50,000/- per month
  • Additional Rs. 20,000/- admissible as visiting charges in case of emergency (if willing)
  • Rs. 1,500/- for every additional hour work beyond 16 hours (4 days × 4 hours) a week subject to the justification of competent authority
  • Working Hours: 4 hours session per day × four days in a week (16 hours)
  • Contract Duration: One year contract or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • Remuneration revisable as per ESIC Headquarters instruction from time to time

3. Specialist (Full Time)

  • Junior Specialist (Level 11): Rs. 1,38,108/- per month (Approximate amount as per HQ instruction dated 08.12.2022)
  • Senior Specialist (Level 12): Rs. 1,60,752/- per month (Approximate amount as per HQ instruction dated 08.12.2022)
  • Working Hours: 09:00 AM to 04:00 PM on weekdays and 09:00 AM to 01:00 PM on Saturdays
  • Contract Duration: One year contract or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • Should attend emergency call as and when it is required
  • Remuneration Revisable as per ESIC HQ instruction from time to time

4. Specialist (Part Time)

  • Remuneration: Rs. 60,000/- per month
  • Additional Rs. 15,000/- admissible as visiting charges in case of emergency (if willing)
  • Rs. 800/- for additional every hour beyond 16 hours, subject to the justification of competent authority
  • Working Hours: 4 hours session per day × four days in a week (16 hours)
  • Contract Duration: One year contract or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • Remuneration Revisable as per ESIC HQ instruction from time to time

5. Senior Resident (Pay Level 11)

  • Total Emoluments (Level 11 as per VIIth CPC): Approximately Rs. 1,38,108/- per month (For PG Degree holders)
  • An amount of Rs. 1,350/- will be deducted for SRs who possess only Diploma
  • Contract Duration: One year contract or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • To work as per ESIC norms for Senior Residency
  • Remuneration will be paid as per orders issued by ESIC Headquarters from time to time

Age Limit (as on 07/01/2026)

Super Specialist (Full Time/Part Time)

  • Maximum Age: Not exceeding 69 years as on the date of interview (07/01/2026)
  • Tenure beyond 70 years is not allowed
  • No minimum age specified

Specialist (Full Time/Part Time)

  • Maximum Age: Not exceeding 69 years as on the date of interview (07/01/2026)
  • Tenure beyond 70 years is not allowed
  • No minimum age specified

Senior Resident (Pay Level 11)

  • Maximum Age: Not exceeding 45 years as on the date of interview (07/01/2026)
  • Age Relaxation: Relaxation for SC, ST & OBC as per rules
  • No minimum age specified

Application Fee for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

Category Application Fee
General & OBC Candidates Rs. 250/- (Rupees Two Hundred and Fifty only)
SC/ST Candidates Rs. 50/- (Rupees Fifty only)
PWD/Female Applicants Exempted (No Fee)

Mode of Payment:

  • Application fee to be paid by way of Demand Draft drawn in favour of "Employees' State Insurance Fund – Account No 1" payable at Kollam
  • The Demand Draft should be submitted at the time of interview along with application form

Selection Process for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

The selection process for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025 will be based on the following criteria:

  • Walk-in Interview: The selection will be based on qualification, experience & interview
  • The interview will be conducted at ESIC Model and Super Specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam on 07/01/2026
  • Candidates will be assessed based on their educational qualifications, post-qualification experience, and performance in the personal interview
  • All original documents will be verified at the time of interview
  • Only shortlisted candidates based on qualification and experience will be called for final selection
  • The decision of the interview committee will be final and binding

General Information and Instructions for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

  • The applicants should bring along application in the prescribed proforma, all original documents including caste certificate (if applicable), one set of Xerox copies of all original documents, two recent passport size photographs (one affixed on the application) and the requisite application fee in the form of demand draft at the time of interview
  • Application forms, printing, or photocopying facilities will not be provided at the interview venue under any circumstances
  • Those who belong to OBC/SC/ST category should produce valid caste certificate issued by the Tahasildar/Revenue Divisional Officer
  • OBC certificate should be in the prescribed form as per Government of India instructions which should certify that the candidates do not belong to Creamy layer
  • EWS certificate must be valid and issued by Tahasildar/Revenue Divisional Officer in the prescribed form as per Government of India instructions
  • Candidates applying in PWD Category must possess disability certificate issued by a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of the State or Central Government Hospitals/Institutions
  • Candidates who have already completed Senior Residency for 3 years in any Central Institutions are not eligible for the post of Senior Resident
  • Private practice of any kind will not be allowed except for Part time Superspecialists/Part time Specialists
  • No TA/DA will be admissible for Interview
  • Vacancies indicated may change as per actual requirement on the date of interview
  • Canvassing in any form shall be a disqualification
  • The Selected Specialist/Super Specialist must have a professional indemnity policy which should cover the period of contractual engagement. The policy is meant to cover professional liability falling on them as a result of error and omissions committed by them while rendering professional services
  • The minimum sum assured per annum should be:
    • Rs. 30 lakh for Anesthesiologists, Cardiac Surgeons, Neuro Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons etc.
    • Rs. 20 lakhs for General Surgeons, Gynecologists, Obstetricians etc.
    • Rs. 10 lakhs for Physicians, Dentists, Radiologists, Pathologists etc.
  • A copy of the Insurance & Premium and receipt must be submitted within 7 days from the date of engagement
  • The appointing authority reserves the right to terminate the service of appointee at any time even before the tenure without assigning any reason by giving one month notice or immediately in case of any disciplinary action
  • Similarly, the engaged person will have to give one month prior notice before resigning or will have to pay an amount equivalent to one month's remuneration in lieu of the notice period
  • The appointing authority reserves the right to cancel the offer/advertisement without assigning any reason thereof
  • In case of selection, the candidate has to enter into an agreement with Medical Superintendent, ESIC Model & Super specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs 200/-
  • The selected candidate has to submit a security deposit of Rs 15,000/- as DD in favour of ESIC Account No 2 payable at Kollam at the time of joining, which is refundable after successful completion of contract & production of no-due certificate
  • In case of applicants who are working in Central government/State government institutions, NOC should be obtained from the authority concerned and to be submitted in due course
  • Part time Engagement of one contractual employee in two ESIC hospital at the same time shall not be permissible
  • PWD candidate will be selected against suitable/notified posts as per government rules
  • The hospital is in the process of getting accreditation for conducting in house DNB training courses in various specialities

How to Apply for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

This is a Walk-in Interview process. Candidates need to follow these steps:

  • Step 1: Download the official notification from ESIC website: https://www.esic.gov.in/recruitments
  • Step 2: Download the application form (Annexure 1) from the notification PDF
  • Step 3: Fill the application form completely in CAPITAL LETTERS ONLY with all required details:
    • Personal Information (Name, Father's/Husband's Name, Date of Birth, Category, Age)
    • Educational Qualification details with Year of passing, University, and Percentage of Marks
    • Experience details with Name of Hospital, Post Held, Period (From-To), Total Period
    • MCI Registration Number and Name of Medical Council
    • Present and Permanent Address
    • Contact Number & Email ID
    • Place where presently working
    • Particulars of DD (Number and Date)
  • Step 4: Affix one recent passport-size photograph on the application form
  • Step 5: Prepare Demand Draft for application fee:
    • Rs. 250/- for General/OBC candidates
    • Rs. 50/- for SC/ST candidates
    • PWD/Female candidates are exempted
    • DD should be drawn in favour of "Employees' State Insurance Fund – Account No 1" payable at Kollam
  • Step 6: Prepare all required documents in original and one set of self-attested Xerox copies:
    • MBBS Degree certificate
    • MCI/Central Council Registration Certificate (For basic and additional Qualifications)
    • Matriculation certificate in support of Date of Birth
    • PG Degree/Diploma Certificate (Qualification prescribed for the post)
    • Experience Certificate
    • Caste Certificate and Non creamy layer certificate, if applicable
    • PWD Certificate, if applicable
    • LPC/No Due Certificate from previous employer, if applicable
    • Any other relevant document
    • 2 Passport Size Photos
  • Step 7: Report to the interview venue on 07/01/2026 at 09:00 AM
  • Step 8: Registration will be done from 09:00 AM to 10:00 AM at Conference Hall, ESIC Model and Super Specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam
  • Step 9: Submit the filled application form along with all original documents, one set of Xerox copies, two passport-size photographs, and Demand Draft at the registration counter
  • Step 10: Attend the interview as per the schedule

Important Notes:

  • Application forms, printing, or photocopying facilities will NOT be provided at the interview venue under any circumstances
  • Candidates must bring their own filled application form and all documents
  • Late arrivals after registration time may not be entertained
  • Check the official website regularly for any corrigenda or updates

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.

  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.

  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.
  • Before registering/applying online, the candidates should ensure that they have a valid email ID, which should remain valid till the selection of trainee process is completed.

Credit Officer Eligibility Criteria 2025-26

Candidates willing to apply for Credit Officer posts must ensure that they fulfil the required Credit Officer Eligibility Criteria 2025-26 as specified by Bank of India. Credit Officer Selection Process 2025-26

The Credit Officer selection is based on shortlisting candidates through an online examination and/or direct shortlisting followed by a personal interview. The screening focuses on assessing the candidate's reasoning, quantitative aptitude and professional knowledge in their selected discipline in addition to English language. Only those who qualify in the screening stage and rank sufficiently high in merit are invited for the interview.

The selection process is carried out in main stages as explained below.

1. Scrutiny and Shortlisting of Applications: Applications are shortlisted on the basis of documents uploaded in support of eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, category, etc.) at the time of registration. Only candidates whose documents clearly establish eligibility are taken forward for the online test and/or interview.

2. Online Examination:

  • Mode: Online objective test.
  • Structure: English Language (25 questions, 25 marks), Reasoning (25 questions, 25 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 questions, 25 marks), Professional Knowledge relevant to the post (75 questions, 75 marks); total 150 questions for 150 marks, composite time of 120 minutes.
  • Language: All tests except English are bilingual (English & Hindi); English Language test is only qualifying and its marks are not added in merit.
  • Qualifying Marks: Minimum 35% in each test for General/EWS; SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates get 5% relaxation.
  • Negative Marking: 1/4th of the marks assigned to each question is deducted for every wrong answer; no penalty for unanswered questions.

3. Interview: Candidates who secure the minimum qualifying marks in the online tests and rank high in order of merit (category-wise) are called for a personal interview, generally in the ratio of about 1:3 to the number of vacancies. The interview carries 100 marks with minimum qualifying marks of 50% for General/EWS and 45% for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates.

Final Merit: If both online exam and interview are conducted, final merit is prepared by combining scores of online examination (Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude and Professional Knowledge) and interview in a 70:30 ratio, subject to candidates qualifying in both stages. If the online exam is not conducted, selection will be based solely on interview marks in descending order of merit up to the number of vacancies.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifying degrees and academic requirements for OCES/DGFS-2026 include B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc.(Engineering)/5-year Integrated M.Tech. in eligible engineering disciplines such as Civil, Chemical, Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Metallurgical Engineering with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks, as detailed in the notification.

  • For screening based on GATE Score, candidates must have valid GATE-2024, GATE-2025 or GATE-2026 scores in the relevant GATE subjects/papers corresponding to their discipline as mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Only regular educational degrees obtained through full-time/on-campus mode are considered; degrees obtained through correspondence, distance education/learning, by research or part-time modes are not eligible.

  • Candidates graduating in the academic year 2025-26 and awaiting final results may apply, subject to completion of all academic requirements for the qualifying degree before 31 July 2026 and submission of final marksheet by 31 December 2026 (for OCES) or as per DGFS institute requirement.
  • Applicants must be citizens of India and, for those working in Central/State Government units/PSUs/Aided Institutes, a No Objection Certificate from their organization must be produced at the time of selection interview.

Salary/Stipend

  • During training, OCES Trainee Scientific Officers and DGFS fellows are paid a stipend of ₹ 74,000/- per month.
  • OCES Trainee Scientific Officers receive a one-time book allowance of ₹ 30,000/- during the training period.
  • DGFS fellows are reimbursed tuition fee for the M.Tech. programme and receive a one-time contingency grant of ₹ 60,000/- per annum for two years, along with funding up to ₹ 4,00,000 under the BRNS fast track project scheme for project-related equipment/consumables.
  • On appointment, Scientific Officers are placed in Group-A post of Government of India in Level 10 of 7th CPC Pay Matrix with basic pay of ₹ 56,100/-; total monthly emoluments including dearness allowance, house rent allowance and transport allowance are approximately ₹ 1,35,000/- for those posted in Mumbai.

Selection Process

  • Selection to OCES/DGFS-2026 is a two-step process consisting of screening of candidates followed by a Selection Interview.
  • Screening for Selection Interview is conducted through two alternative channels: an online screening examination and GATE-score-based shortlisting.
  • The online screening examination is conducted in eight engineering OCES disciplines (codes 21-28) and five science OCES disciplines (codes 41-43, 45 and 46) at more than fifty cities across India.
  • Candidates meeting eligibility criteria with valid GATE-2024, GATE-2025 or GATE-2026 scores in prescribed papers may be screened in for Selection Interview on the basis of GATE scores.
  • Cut-off GATE scores for Screening Interview are decided after conclusion of the online exam, and candidates are advised to maximize their chances by availing both screening avenues.
  • Selection Interviews for shortlisted candidates in all disciplines except Geology and Geophysics are conducted at BARC Training School, Mumbai; interviews in Geology and Geophysics disciplines are held in Hyderabad.
  • Outstation applicants travelling for Selection Interview are eligible for reimbursement of to-and-fro AC-III tier normal train fare by shortest route or actual fare, whichever is less, upon submission of original tickets.
  • Final selection is solely on the basis of performance in Selection Interview, subject to medical fitness as determined by DAE doctors.

General Information/Instructions

  • OCES-2026 is a one-year Orientation Course conducted at BARC Training Schools at BARC, Mumbai and AMD, Hyderabad for engineering graduates and science postgraduates, leading to appointment as Scientific Officers in DAE units or Atomic Energy Regulatory Board upon successful completion.
  • DGFS-2026 is a two-year DAE Graduate Fellowship Scheme for engineering graduates who secure M.Tech. admission in designated DGFS institutes and specializations, and who perform well in OCES Selection Interviews.
  • On successful completion of OCES/DGFS training, Trainee Scientific Officers are posted as Scientific Officers in various DAE units such as BARC, IGCAR, RRCAT, VECC, HWB, NFC, BRIT, NPCIL, BHAVINI, AMD, UCIL, DCSEM and AERB, based on programme needs and trainee performance.
  • Selected candidates must execute an agreement and personal indemnity bond to serve DAE for at least three years after completion of training; the bond covers stipend, book allowance, tuition fee and contingency grants as applicable.
  • DAE strives to maintain gender balance and encourages women candidates to apply for OCES/DGFS-2026 programmes.
  • Only online applications are accepted, and applicants are advised to regularly visit the online application portal for important updates and information.
  • Records of applicants for BARC Training Schools OCES/DGFS-2026 programme will not be preserved beyond four months from the date of publication of the final selection result.
  • In all matters concerning OCES/DGFS-2026 recruitment, decisions of the competent authority in BARC, Mumbai are final and binding; disputes are subject to exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Mumbai, India.

Eligibility Criteria

The total number of vacancies is 18 across various positions and locations (indicative SBU/Location is Travel - Delhi unless specified otherwise):

1 Deputy Manager [Travel] 1 Delhi

15 Junior Officer / Officer (A&F) 1 Mumbai
Total Vacancies   18  

Eligibility Criteria

The cut-off date for post-qualification experience & maximum age is 04.01.2026. All qualifications must be full-time from UGC/AICTE recognized institutes.

  • Qualifications: MTM or Equivalent / MBA / Graduate Engineer / MCA / B.E/ B. Tech in Computer Science or IT / Any Graduate (Bachelor’s Degree 10+2+3).
  • Essential qualifications: Specific degree/diploma depending on the post. CA/ICWA is not considered for these roles. Engineering courses via ODL mode are generally not accepted.
  • Desirable: Experience in the Travel business for most roles. IT related qualifications for specific roles.
  • Experience: Varies by post. Freshers may apply for FTO-1 roles. Other roles require 2 to 11 years of minimum relevant experience depending on degree level and position.

Salary/Stipend

Compensation will be linked to the candidate's qualification and experience. The positions are on a three-year fixed-term contract.

  • Selected candidates are entitled to statutory benefits including PF, ESI (if covered), Bonus as per Payment of Bonus Act, 1965 (if covered), and Gratuity as per rules.
  • Exact monthly salary figures are not provided in the advertisement.

Age Limit (as on 04-01-2026)

The maximum age limit is determined as on the cut-off date of 04.01.2026.

  • Maximum Age for FTE-1 posts (Assistant Manager roles): 32 years.
  • Maximum Age for FTE-2 posts (Deputy Manager roles): 35 years.
  • Maximum Age for FTE-4 post (Senior Manager): 40 years.
  • Maximum Age for FTO-1/FTO-2 posts (Junior Officer/Officer roles): 30 years.
  • Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC(NCL), up to 15 years for PwBD depending on category, as per Government of India directives.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Advertisement Release Date 10 December 2025
Online Application Commencement Date 10 December 2025 (1000 hours)
Last Date & Time for Online Application Submission 04 January 2026 (2359 hours)
Cut-off date for Age and Experience calculation 04 January 2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates will be shortlisted based on eligibility, relevance and quality of experience.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test, group discussion, and/or personal interview, or a combination of these modalities, at the company's discretion.
  • The venue and schedule for the selection process will be intimated via email only.
  • Candidates must bring original certificates and self-attested photocopies for verification at the time of the interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • The posts are on a fixed-term contract of 3 years.
  • Locations mentioned are indicative; selected candidates can be placed anywhere in India or outside the Country depending on business requirements.
  • Only online applications submitted through the official portal will be considered. Applications sent via email or post will be rejected.
  • Candidates must check the Company's website regularly for all updates regarding the recruitment process.
  • No candidate beyond 58 years of age shall be engaged.

How To Apply

  • Applicants must apply online through the e-recruitment portal on the Balmer Lawrie website (www.balmerlawrie.com).
  • First, candidates need to register on the portal to create a profile.
  • After creating the profile, apply against the appropriate position under the “Employment Opportunities” tab.
  • Ensure all details, including start and end dates of work experience in DD.MM.YYYY format, are entered correctly.
  • Online submission is permitted from 10.12.2025 (1000 hours) till 04.01.2026 (2359 hours).
  • Candidates should keep a printout of the final submitted online application for their records.

DIAT Post-Doctoral Fellowship Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT)
Post Name Post-Doctoral Fellowship
Salary Rs. 35,000 – Rs. 55,000 per month + Research Grant & Overheads
Qualification Ph.D. degree within 3 years, or thesis submitted
Age Limit Up to 35 years (relaxable for reserved & women candidates)
Start Date for Apply 11/19/2025
Last Date for Apply 01/27/2026
Official Website drdo.gov.in

DIAT Post-Doctoral Fellowship Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Post Name Total Post Count
Post-Doctoral Fellowship Multiple (up to 20 for foreign nationals)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Ph.D. degree holders within three years of the award of the Ph.D. degree, or those who have submitted a Ph.D. thesis.
  • Applicants about to submit their thesis are also eligible, subject to submission before award expiry.
  • Research publications in high-impact-factor SCI journals.
  • Open to Indian nationals, Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs), Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs), and up to 20 foreign nationals.

Salary/Stipend

  • Fellowship: Rs. 55,000/- per month for awardees.
  • Rs. 35,000/- per month for candidates with thesis submitted but not yet awarded.
  • Research Grant: Rs. 2,00,000/- per annum.
  • Overheads: Rs. 1,00,000/- per annum.

Age Limit (as on 01-27-2026)

  • Maximum Age: 35 years as on 27 Jan 2026.
  • Relaxation: Up to 5 years for SC/ST/Physically Disabled & Women; 3 years for OBC Non-Creamy Layer.

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee Mentioned.

Important Dates

Notification Date 11/19/2025
Start Date 11/19/2025
Last Date 01/27/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates may apply at any time, selection twice a year (June & December).
  • Shortlisting based on applications received two months prior to interview.
  • Selection based on presentation of research proposal and interview by committee.
  • Foreign nationals can be considered in absentia.
  • Selection for foreign nationals subject to clearance by DIAT/DRDO HQ.

How To Apply

  • Download and fill application form from DIAT website www.diat.ac.in.
  • Attach CV, publications, research plan, Ph.D./provisional certificate, and any relevant documents.
  • Send filled application in a sealed envelope titled "Application for Admission to Post Doctoral Programme in the Department/School of ______" to Joint Registrar (Academics), DIAT, Girinagar, Pune 411025.
  • Application should reach DIAT on or before January 27, 2026.
  • Email for queries: [email protected]

Instructions

  • Selected candidates should join within 2 months of appointment.
  • Must undertake full-time research at DIAT.
  • Annual progress evaluation for fellowship extension.
  • DIAT alumni not eligible for PDF at DIAT under this scheme.
  • Acknowledge DIAT support in all publications, patents, reports.
  • Assist department with PG/PhD student support and labs/conference duties.
  • Accommodation provided if available; medical benefits as per DIAT rules.

Mumbai Port Authority Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer Recruitment 2025 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Mumbai Port Authority (MbPA)
Post Name Dy. Chief Mechanical Engineer
No of Posts 1 (one post)
Salary Pay scale Rs. 80000-220000 (Dy. HoD level post)
Qualification Degree or equivalent in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognised university/institution with 12 years’ experience in relevant discipline in executive cadre in an Industrial/Commercial/Government undertaking
Age Limit Upper age limit 42 years for direct recruitment as per Annexure I
Start Date for Apply  08.12.2025 (Online Application Portal opening)
Last Date for Apply  06.01.2026 (Online Application Portal closing)
Official Website www.mumbaiport.gov.in 

Mumbai Port Authority Deputy Chief Mechanical Engineer Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name No. of Posts
Dy. Chief Mechanical Engineer 1 (one post in this recruitment; Annexure shows 4 as cadre strength)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential qualification: Degree or equivalent in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognised university/institution.
  • Essential experience: Twelve years’ experience in relevant discipline in executive cadre in an Industrial/Commercial/Government undertaking.
  • For absorption through composite method: Officers holding analogous posts or the post of Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts in the respective discipline of Mechanical & Electrical Engineering Department in the scale of pay of Rs.13000-18250 with 3 years’ regular service in the grade in the respective discipline in a Major Port Trust; or Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts with 2 years’ regular service and a combined regular service of 7 years in the scales of pay of Rs.10750-16750 and Rs.13000-18250 in the respective discipline in a Major Port Trust.
  • For deputation: Officers holding analogous posts or officers holding post of Superintending Engineer and equivalent posts in the respective discipline of M&E Engineering Department in the scale of pay of Rs.13000-18250 with 3 years’ regular service in the grade in the respective discipline in Government/PSUs/Autonomous bodies will be eligible.
  • Selection is by merit and the benchmark in overall grading in the APARs/ACRs should not be below “Very Good”

Salary/Stipend

  • The post of Dy. Chief Mechanical Engineer in Mumbai Port Authority is in the pay scale of Rs. 80000-220000 under composite method.

Age Limit (as on 01-12-2025)

  • Upper age limit for direct recruitment: 42 years
  • The crucial date for eligibility criteria (including age, qualification and experience) is the date of arising of vacancy i.e. 01.12.2025, as per Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways circular No. A-29018/4/2081/PE-I dated 11.8.2021.

Application Fee

  • No application fee details are mentioned anywhere in this recruitment notice.

Important Dates

Description Date
Date of arising of vacancy (crucial date for eligibility) 01.12.2025
Recruitment Notice date 02 December 2025
Online Application Portal (OAP) application period 08.12.2025 to 06.01.2026
Last date for Ports to forward applications with enclosures to MbPA 21.01.2026 (on or before)

Selection Process

  • The post of Dy. Chief Mechanical Engineer is to be filled by absorption through composite method from officers of Major Ports fulfilling eligibility criteria as per Annexure I.
  • Selection is by merit and overall grading in APARs should not be below “Very Good”.
  • As per Ministry guidelines dated 11.8.2021 regarding filling up Dy. HoD level posts, a Port official who withdraws candidature after selection by the Services Selection Committee will be liable for debarment from future selection to Dy. HoD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for two years.
  • Incomplete applications or applications received after due date will not be considered.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited from eligible and willing officers of all Major Port Authorities possessing the prescribed qualifications and experience as mentioned at Annexure I.
  • Applications shall be submitted through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Shipping (website http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in) from 08.12.2025 to 06.01.2026; no application submitted other than OAP will be accepted.
  • The candidate has to submit the hard copy of the application form uploaded in OAP to his administrative Port for onward forwarding to Mumbai Port Authority.
  • Administrative Ports must forward applications, superscribing “Application for the post of Dy. Chief Mechanical Engineer in Mumbai Port Authority”, with all required documents on or before 21.01.2026; no piecemeal/part forwarding will be considered.
  • As per Ministry circular, if advance copy of application is received but the application through proper channel is not received within 15 days of last date of receipt of applications, the candidature will not be considered.

How to Apply

  • Eligible and willing officers of all Major Port Authorities must apply through Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Shipping at http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in between 08.12.2025 and 06.01.2026.
  • After submitting application in OAP, the candidate must submit the hard copy of the application form to his administrative Port for onward forwarding to Mumbai Port Authority.
  • Administrative Ports shall forward applications in an envelope superscribing “Application for the post of Dy. Chief Mechanical Engineer in Mumbai Port Authority” along with: (1) Certified copies of APARs for the last 5 years (2020-21 to 2024-25), attested by an officer not below Dy. HoD on each page. (2) Statement showing year-wise availability of APARs and grading, signed by HoD/Secretary, or “No Report Certificate” where APAR is not available. (3) Attested photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification and present/past work experience in respective post and pay scale. (4) No Objection Certificate from the respective Port. (5) Undertaking of the applicant that candidature will not be withdrawn if selected by Services Selection Committee. (6) Administrative clearance (Annexure II). (7) Vigilance report in prescribed format (Annexure III). (8) Details and documents of any major/minor penalty imposed in last 10 years, if applicable.
  • Applications received after 21.01.2026 or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Science/Engineering/Mathematics/Statistics/Commerce/Information technology or a Three-Year Diploma in engineering and technology.
  • Essential qualifications: Minimum 60% marks in the qualifying degree for all categories.
  • Experience: For Commerce category with a minimum of 1 year of experience in the relevant field (if applying for YP-I).

Salary/Stipend

  • A consolidated amount of Rs. 30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) p.m. will be paid to the selected Young Professional-I (Y.P.-I).
  • The Income Tax or any other Tax liable to be deducted as per the prevailing rules will be deducted at source before effecting payment of monthly salary.

Age Limit (as on 26-12-2025)

  • Maximum age: 45 years.

Important Dates

Event Date

  • Selection will be conducted via a Walk-In-Interview (Hybrid Mode).
  • Link for the hybrid mode interview will be shared through the communicated email ID of the applicants.
  • Candidates must bring all original experience/testimonials at the time of the interview for verification.
  • The Director's decision will be final and binding in all respects.

General Information/Instructions

  • The engagement does not constitute a regular job or appointment of any nature in the ICAR.
  • Working hours for the YPs will be the same as regular employees of ICAR.
  • YPs are eligible for 08 days casual leave and 02 restricted holidays on a pro-rata basis.
  • Female YPs are entitled to maternity leave as per provision in the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act 2017.
  • No T.A./D.A. will be paid for appearing in the interview. TA/DA is admissible to YPs for undertaking domestic tour for official work.

How To Apply

  • The application should be filled as per the attached Application form in PDF format.
  • The form and all relevant documents should be sent through email to [email protected] on or before 26th December, 2025, 11.00 am.
  • Candidates must affix a recent passport size photograph on the application form and self-attest photocopies of certificates for age, qualifications, experience, testimonials and other credentials.
  • Candidates who are already employed in Govt. Organization must produce a "No Objection Certificate" from the present employer.

General Information/Instructions

  • One post of Materials Manager in Mumbai Port Authority has fallen vacant w.e.f. 11.4.2025. The post is to be filled by absorption through composite method from officers of Major Ports, fulfilling the eligibility criteria as mentioned at Annexure I.
  • As per the Ministry's circular No. A-29018/4/2081/PE-I dated 11.8.2021, in case of receipt of advance copy of application from any candidate, his candidature will not be considered if his application is not received through proper channel from the Port within 15 days of the last date of receipt of applications. Therefore, Major Ports are requested to forward the applications with complete set of enclosures on or before 21.1.2026. Applications received after 21.1.2026 will not be considered.
  • While forwarding the application, the Major Ports are to enclose all relevant documents at a time. No piecemeal / part forwarding will be considered.
  • The crucial date for eligibility criteria will be the last date of closing of applications, i.e. 6.1.2026 in terms of Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways' circular No. A-29018/4/2081/PE-I dated 11.8.2021.
  • As per the Ministry's guidelines dated 11.8.2021 regarding filling up the Dy. HoD level posts in Major Port Authorities, Port official who withdraws his candidature for the post after his selection by the Services Selection Committee, will be liable for debarment from future selection to Dy. HoD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for a period of two years.

How to Apply

  • Applications are invited from eligible and willing officers of all the Major Port Authorities possessing the prescribed qualifications and experience as mentioned at Annexure I. No application submitted other than OAP will be accepted.
  • The candidate has to submit the hard-copy of the application form uploaded in OAP to his administrative Port for onward forwarding to MbPA.
  • The administrative Ports are required to forward the applications of the candidates superscribing "Application for the post of Materials Manager in Mumbai Port Authority" on or before 21.1.2026 along with the following documents :
  • (i) certified copies of APARs for the last 5 years (2020-21 to 2024-25), duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD on each of the pages;
  • (ii) a statement showing year-wise availability of APARs and grading duly signed by the HOD/Secretary. If APAR for a particular year during the last 5 years is not available, "No Report Certificate" may be furnished along with APARs of the preceding years;
  • (iii) Attested photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification, present and past work experience in the respective post and pay scale.
  • (iv) No objection certificate from the respective Port.
  • (v) Undertaking of the applicant that he will not withdraw his candidature, if selected by Services Selection Committee;
  • (vi) Administrative clearance of the concerned port (Annexure II)
  • (vii) Vigilance report is to be furnished in the prescribed format (Annexure III).

IIIA Dated 09.12.2020 and as amended from time to time.

Maternity leave shall be as per maternity Benefit Act of GOI.

  • The consultant shall be completely accountable for any advice/service rendered by them during their engagement in this Institute in view of the norms of ethical business and professionalism.

  • Experience in the relevant grade pay should be on regular basis. Pay scale granted under MACP/ACP/Adhoc basis will not be considered as qualifying experience.
  • No TA/DA shall be admissible for appearing in walk-in-Interview or joining the assignment or on its completion/termination.
  • Incomplete application or not submitted in prescribed format or without photo and signature shall be summarily rejected.
  • Submission of incorrect or false information shall disqualify the candidature at any stage.
  • Since the posts are purely being on temporary/contractual basis, no benefit of Provident Fund, Leave Travel Concession, Medical, etc. will be available to the appointee.
  • Age limit and experience will be considered as on the Date of Walk-In-Interview.
  • The Director, ICMR - NIRRCH has the right to accept/reject any application without assigning any reason thereof and no correspondence/recommendation will be entertained tin this matter.
  • The Institute reserve the right to frame a panel for waitlisted candidate which will be valid for a period of one year.
  • The Institute reserve the right to adopt criteria for short listing the application in case of receipt of large number of application.
  • Canvassing and bringing outside influence in any form for short listing or employment will be treated as disqualification and the candidate will be debarred form selection process.
  • The Director reserves the right to increase/decrease the number of posts as per requirement.
  • Qualification and experience should be in relevant discipline/field and rom a reputed institution/organization recognized by relevant authority.
  • Mere fulfilling the essential qualification/ experience does not guarantee to appear before interview board for selection.
  • The post is filled-up on purely temporary basis and contractual basis & the candidate will have no right to claim for any type of Permanent Employment under ICMR - NIRRCH or continuation of his/her services in any other project.
  • Any Addendum/ Corrigendum in respect of above vacancies, notice shall be issued on website https://nirrch.res.in and https://www.icmr.gov.in/employment-opportunities only no separate notification shall be issued in the press.
  • Application are requested to regularly visit the website to keep themselves updated.

The selection process consists primarily of an interview, with screening and shortlisting based on eligibility and qualifications.

  • Applications will be screened for eligibility based on age, qualifications, and experience.

The ISRO Propulsion Complex (ISRO IPRC), Mahendragiri, has announced the latest Graduate and Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2025 notification. A total of 85 vacancies are available across various engineering and non-engineering disciplines for eligible Indian candidates. These positions are for a one-year training period under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Candidates must apply via an off-line walk-in interview process, not online. Walk-in interviews are scheduled for 10/01/2026 and 11/01/2026.

The selection for these apprenticeship positions is based purely on the highest marks secured in the qualifying examination. Applicants need to download the application form from the official IPRC website and bring the completed form, along with original and self-attested copies of certificates and a valid photo ID, to the walk-in interview venue. These roles offer monthly stipends of Rs. 9,000/- for graduates and Rs. 8,000/- for technicians, but do not guarantee permanent employment within ISRO after the training period.

Age Limit Upper age limit as on 01/12/2025: UR/EWS – 43 years, OBC(NCL) – 46 years, SC – 48 years, ST – 43 years.
Start Date for Apply  22 December 2025, 10:00 Hrs (Opening of online registration)
Last Date for Apply  20 January 2026, 17:00 Hrs (Closing of online registration); 21 January 2026, 17:00 Hrs for online submission for candidates already registered and fee-paid within time limit.

NLCIL Security Guard Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Grade Total Vacancies Reservation
Security Guard W-3 30 UR – 15, EWS – 2, OBC(NCL) – 8, SC – 5 (ST candidates can apply against UR vacancies and will be considered under general standard of merit without age relaxation).

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates must have served in Indian Army / Navy / Air Force, holding the rank of Havildar / Petty Officer / Sergeant or below ranks in Indian Army / Navy / Air Force respectively, before discharge.
  • Candidates must possess minimum educational qualification of Pass in X Std. / SSLC / Matriculation from a recognized Board.
  • Candidates should have worked in Indian Army / Navy / Air Force for at least 15 years as on the crucial date and should also have registered with the District Sainik Welfare Board as on the crucial date.
  • Only those candidates whose Performance Rating is at least ‘Very Good’ and Medical Category is “AYE” or “SHAPE – I” on retirement, as mentioned in the Discharge certificate/Book from Indian Armed Forces, are eligible to apply.
  • Desirable qualifications include proficiency in reading, writing and speaking the local language (Tamil) and knowledge of playing band instruments in the Armed Forces.
  • Only Indian Nationals who have acquired the notified qualification from appropriate statutory authority in India are eligible to apply.

Salary/Stipend

  • The pay scale for the post of Security Guard in W-3 grade is ₹ 20,000 – 81,000.
  • The approximate Cost to Company (CTC) per annum is ₹ 5.47 lakhs.
  • In addition to the CTC, selected candidates will be eligible for Unified Incentive Scheme (annually) as per rules.
  • Medical treatment for self and dependents and Group Insurance will be provided as per company rules.
  • Eligible type of unfurnished residential accommodation will be provided at standard rent in Company Townships, subject to availability.

Age Limit (as on 01-12-2025)

  • Upper age limit for Security Guard (W-3) as on 01/12/2025: UR – 43 years, EWS – 43 years, OBC(NCL) – 46 years, SC – 48 years, ST – 43 years.
  • Age relaxation for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and SC candidates is as per Government of India guidelines and is applicable only when valid caste certificates are uploaded at the time of registration.
  • Candidates belonging to ST category can apply against UR vacancies and will be considered under general standard of merit without age relaxation.
  • OBC(NCL)/SC/ST candidates applying against UR vacancies will be considered under general standard of merit and no age relaxation will be extended.

Application Fee

  • Ex-servicemen candidates are exempted from payment of application fee.
  • Ex-servicemen candidates are required to pay a non-refundable amount of INR 236/- (inclusive of 18% GST) towards processing fee.
  • Payment of processing fee must be made through the prescribed online mode within the time limits specified in the important dates section.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Opening of Online registration of application 22/12/2025 at 10:00 Hrs
Closing of Online registration of application 20/01/2026 at 17:00 Hrs
Last Date for Online payment of Fees 20/01/2026 at 23:45 Hrs
Last date for Online submission of application for candidates already registered and paid fees within time limit 21/01/2026 at 17:00 Hrs

Selection Process

  • Only candidates who produce all necessary original documents and are found eligible during document verification will be allowed to attend the further selection process (Written Test & Physical Test).
  • Selection will be based on Written Test (100 marks – 70% weightage), Service Weightage and Performance Rating (20 marks – 15% weightage) and Physical Test (30 marks – 15% weightage).
  • The Written Test will be for 100 marks with three parts: Part-I (40 questions of General Awareness), Part-II (30 questions of Quantitative Aptitude) and Part-III (30 questions of Logical Reasoning), comprising 100 objective type questions with equal marks and no negative marking; duration is 120 minutes and the question paper will be in English language only.
  • Service Weightage is awarded based on years of service: above 20 years – 10 marks; above 18 years and up to 20 years – 8 marks; above 15 years and up to 18 years – 5 marks; Performance Rating based on entry in Discharge Book: Excellent/Outstanding – 10 marks, Very Good – 8 marks (maximum 20 marks).
  • Physical Test consists of Walk/Run (1.6 kms), Sit-up and Push-up, each graded as Excellent, Good and Pass with marks 10, 7 and 5 respectively, for a maximum total of 30 marks; candidates must pass all three tests to be considered for final selection.
  • Minimum qualifying marks in Written Test are 50 out of 100 for UR/EWS candidates and 40 out of 100 for SC/OBC(NCL) candidates against reserved posts; only those who secure minimum qualifying marks in Written Test are eligible for Physical Test.
  • Project Affected Persons (PAPs) of NLCIL Neyveli Projects will be allowed 20 bonus marks in the Written Test, limited to one beneficiary per award, subject to prescribed conditions and supporting documents.
  • Final selection will be in order of merit based on total marks in Written Test, Service Weightage & Performance Rating and Physical Test, subject to candidates securing minimum qualifying marks in each component and meeting category-wise requirements; tie cases will be resolved first by date of birth (elder candidates placed higher) and then by alphabetical order of first name.

General Information/Instructions

  • NLC India Limited is a premier ‘NAVRATNA’ Government of India Enterprise, and applications are invited from eligible candidates for the post of Security Guard in W-3 grade for NLCIL Neyveli Units.
  • Only Indian Nationals who have passed the notified qualification are eligible to apply, and the notified qualification must have been acquired from appropriate statutory authority in India.
  • NLCIL reserves the right not to fill up any or all posts notified and vacancies may be increased or decreased depending upon organizational requirements.
  • Candidates permitted to appear for the Written Test are eligible for reimbursement of to and fro travelling expenses to the extent of sleeper class rail fare by shortest route, on production of travel proof including reservation and tatkal charges, if any.
  • Candidates removed, terminated or who deserted their employment from any organisation will not be considered; persons already resigned from NLCIL may apply if they fulfil eligibility criteria.
  • Scrutiny of applications and shortlisting will be based solely on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of online application; failure to upload legible and complete documents may lead to rejection of candidature.
  • Any legal proceedings arising out of this advertisement or related to applications can be instituted only in Chennai, and the jurisdiction will be courts/tribunals/forums at Chennai.
  • NLCIL’s Appointing Authority’s decision in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, selection, posting and related issues will be final and binding, and no correspondence will be entertained.

How to Apply

  • Candidates should apply only through online mode in NLC India Limited website www.nlcindia.in.
  • Before registering or applying online, candidates should ensure that they have a mobile number and valid, active personal email ID and keep them active for the entire selection process, as all communications will be sent via SMS/email.
  • Candidates have to upload required scanned copies of documents/certificates in prescribed format to establish their eligibility; applications without required documents are liable for rejection.
  • Candidates should submit only a single application for the post; in case of multiple applications, the last registered application will be considered.
  • After uploading required documents, candidates should submit their application online, take a printout of the registration-cum-application form and produce it along with self-attested copies of certificates/documents at the time of document verification.
  • No manual or paper applications will be entertained and candidates should not send hard copies to NLCIL.

Eligibility Criteria

General Information/Instructions

The appointing authority shall issue appointment orders in phases based on the actual vacancies available at the time of appointment.
  • Defence personnel released or likely to be released from the Armed Forces due to disability incurred in forward areas while on duty, will also be selected if they are found to be otherwise qualified and if the Medical authorities are satisfied that the disability is not such as would render them incapable of efficiently Discharging the duties of an Assistant Surgeon (General) with Speciality qualifications.
  • If no qualified and suitable women candidates are available for selection against the vacancies reserved for them, those vacancies will be filled by male Candidates belonging to the respective communal categories.
  • Separate reservation of 3.5% within the 30% reservation available for Backward Classes (Other than Muslim) is applicable to Backward Class Muslims(BCMs). All the concessions/relaxations / benefits applicable to BC candidates are applicable to BC Muslim candidates as well.

Tamil Nadu Medical Service Assistant Surgeon (General) with Speciality qualification LD, LC, CP, DF, MuD, AC, SLD (40%-80%Disability)

  • Reservation for Ex-servicemen:- Rule 18 of Special Rules for Tamil Nadu Medical Services, as amended in G.O.(Ms)No.322, Health and Family Welfare Department, dated: 15.07.2025 will be applicable Five percent (5%) posts are reserved for member of the service who were deputed for military duty and for non-service candidates who rendered military service in connection with Short Service Commission or Regular Service Commission as per the 200-point roster of Government of Tamil Nadu. Every candidate claiming to be an Ex-servicemen, if already discharged, should produce the Discharge Certificate from the Defence services, pension, payment order etc. and if the candidate is serving personnel (yet to be discharged) the candidate has to produce an undertaking as in Annexure 8A (in Annexure–8) and form of certificate for serving personnel in Annexure 8B (in Annexure–8).
  • Words of Masculine gender in these instructions should wherever the context so requires, be taken to include feminine gender.
  • No Maximum age limit shall mean that the candidates should not have completed 60 years of age as on 01.07.2025 or at the time of selection/appointment to the post.

  • Please note that all the particulars mentioned in the online application including Name of the Candidate, Post Applied, Communal Category, Date of birth, Address, Email ID, etc. will be considered as final and no modifications will be allowed after the last date specified for applying online. Candidates are requested to fill in the online application form with utmost care as no correspondence regarding change of details will be entertained.
  • The candidates shall register their mobile number in the application to receive SMS. All communication from the MRB will be through e-mail and SMS to the candidate’s registered email ID /mobile number only.
  • Payment of fee can be done through on-line mode only.
  • In case of candidate wishes to pay fees through the online payment gateway, i.e. Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit card and Mobile Wallet Payment, an additional page of the application form will be displayed wherein candidates may follow the instructions and fill in the requisite details to make payment.
  • After submitting your payment information in the online application form, please wait for the intimation from the server, DO NOT press Back or Refresh button in order to avoid double charge.
  • If the online transaction has been successfully completed a Registration Number and Password will be generated. Candidates should note the same for future reference.
  • If the transaction is successful, Registration Slip will be generated. Candidates are advised to take a printout of Registration Slip (copy of filled-in application form) for future reference.
  • After submitting the application, candidates can save/ print their application in PDF format.
  • On entering Registration Number and password, Candidates can download their application and print, if required.
  • Candidates need not send the printout of the online application or any other supporting documents to the Board. The certificates will be normally verified only when the candidates become eligible for next stage of selection.
  • The certificates produced in support of claim(s) made by the candidates, as per Notification, should be, whenever required as directed by the Board without fail.
  • Candidates are advised in their own interest to apply on-line and remit fee much before the closing date and not to wait till the last date to avoid last- minute internet connectivity issues.
  • MRB will not be responsible for delayed submission (or) remitting of payment.
  • Under no circumstances, a candidate should share/mention e-mail ID or Mobile Number with any other person. In case a candidate does not have a valid personal e-mail ID, they should create a new e- mail ID before applying on-line and must maintain that email account.
  • No modification in fee payment through on-line mode is permitted.
  • Candidates should carefully fill in the details in the On-Line Application at the appropriate places and click on the “SUBMIT” button at the end of the On-Line Application format. Before pressing the “SUBMIT” button, candidates are advised to verify each and every particular filled in the application. The name of the candidate or his/her father/ husband’s name etc. should be s p e l t correctly in the application as it appears in the certificates. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification:

Candidates must possess ONE of the following qualifications as per 10+2+3/4 pattern:

  • Graduate Degree in any Discipline from any University or Institution recognized by University Grant Commission - 2 Posts

    • Must possess knowledge in Computer Application
  • Bachelor of Engineering / Technology Degree in Computer Science OR Information Technology OR Electronics & Communication or equivalent recognized by AICTE from any University or Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission - 33 Posts
  • Bachelor's Degree in Law from any University or Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission - 2 Posts
  • Bachelor's Degree in Commerce from any University or Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission - 9 Posts
  • Bachelor of Engineering / Technology Degree in Civil or Electrical or equivalent recognized by AICTE from any University or Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission - 4 Posts

Cooperative Training Eligibility:

Candidates will be eligible for Cooperative Training if they have completed any of the following:

  • Diploma in Cooperative Management conducted by Tamil Nadu Cooperative Union
  • Higher Diploma in Cooperative Management conducted by Chennai National Cooperative Union and Madurai Cooperative Union
  • Diploma in Rural Home Management (Cooperation) from Vaikundam National Cooperative Institute
  • B.Com (Honours) Cooperation
  • M.Com (Cooperation)
  • M.A (Cooperation)
  • Cooperative Studies diploma awarded by any University recognized by UGC
  • B.A (Cooperation)
  • M.Com (Cooperation)

Note: Candidates who have not completed the above-mentioned courses but have studied Book Keeping, Banking, Cooperation, and Auditing subjects can be considered eligible for Cooperative Training.

Important: Ex-Servicemen who have served in Indian Army without any break and possess any Bachelor's Degree will be considered eligible for posts requiring "Any Bachelor's Degree" qualification but NOT for posts requiring B.E/B.Tech in CS/IT/ECE, Law, Commerce, or Civil/Electrical Engineering.

Salary/Stipend
