  • All educational certificates other than Central Board/State Board shall be accompanied with Government notifications declaring the equivalence of such qualifications for service under Central Government

Sports Qualification

  • Players who have participated or won medals in International or National level competitions between 15/01/2024 to 15/01/2026
  • Individual Event (International): Sportsperson who have participated or won medals in any International Sports tournament/competition/Championship as member of the Indian contingent conducted/recognized by International Sports Federation affiliated/recognized by IOC/IOA/MOYAS
  • Individual Event (National): Players who have won medals in National Games/Senior National Championship/National Open Championship or Youth/Junior National Championship conducted/recognized by National Sports Federation affiliated/recognized by IOA/MOYAS
  • Team Event (International): Sportsperson who have participated or won medals in international sports tournament/competition/Championship conducted/recognized by International sports federation affiliated/recognized by IOC/IOA/MOYAS
  • Team Event (National): Sportsperson who have won medals in National Games/Senior National Championship/National Open Championship or Youth/Junior National Championship while representing any State/UT/Sports Control Board/recognized federation
  • Sportsperson should be the main playing member of the team and not in reserved list for team events
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 12 marks (for all categories UR/SC/ST/OBC)

Desirable

  • First Preference: Candidates who have represented the country and won medals in order of their priority (Gold/Silver/Bronze/participation) in Senior, Junior or Youth categories in international tournament/competition/championship
  • Second Preference: Candidates who have represented and won medals or position up to 3rd place in National Games/Senior National Championship/National Open Championship or Youth/Junior National Championship

Salary/Stipend

  • Basic Pay: Level -3, Rs. 21,700-69,100/- as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix
  • Other Allowances: All other allowances as applicable to all Central Government employees
  • Pension Scheme: Candidates recruited will be governed/covered by the New Pension Scheme w.e.f. 01.01.2004 and other schemes issued by Government from time to time
  • Additional Benefits: All allowances admissible to Central Government employee from time to time under the rules

Age Limit (as on 18th August, 2025)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 23 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): 3 years
  • Age Relaxation for Departmental Candidates: 5 years with 3 years continuous service, plus additional 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC
  • Only the Date of Birth as recorded in the Matriculation Certificate will be accepted for determining the age
  • OBC (NCL) certificate should have been obtained within one year before the closing date of online application

Application Fee

Category Application Fee
Male (General/UR) Rs. 159/-
Male (OBC) Rs. 159/-
Female (All Categories) Exempted
SC/ST (All) Exempted
  • Payment mode: Online through BSF Recruitment website https://rectt.bsf.gov.in only
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances
  • Fee paid by modes other than prescribed will not be accepted and application will be rejected

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date December 2025
Online Application Start Date 27/12/2025 at 00:01 AM
Online Application Last Date 15/01/2026 at 11:59 PM
Sports Achievement Period (Eligible Competitions) 15/01/2024 to 15/01/2026
Age Calculation Date 18th August, 2025

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - Scrutiny of Applications: Online application forms and uploaded certificates will be scrutinized. Candidates securing minimum qualifying 12 marks will be issued online admit cards
  • Stage 2 - Documentation: Verification of all original documents/certificates pertaining to age, education, caste, sport achievement, proof to avail age and height relaxation. Biometric identification will be captured
  • Stage 3 - Physical Standard Test (PST): Height, chest measurement (for male), and weight verification as per prescribed standards
  • Stage 4 - Merit List Preparation: Merit list will be drawn on the basis of marks obtained by candidates as per sports achievement marking table
  • Stage 5 - Detailed Medical Examination (DME): Candidates selected in order of merit will undergo DME as per medical guidelines issued by MHA
  • Stage 6 - Review Medical Examination (RME): Appeal against DME can be submitted within 24 hours with Rs. 25/- fee through Indian Postal Order along with Medical Fitness Certificate
  • Tie Breaking Rules: Higher marks, International achievement over National, National Games over Senior National Championship, younger age, alphabetical order in English
  • Final Selection: Based on merit, PST, and Medical fitness

General Information/Instructions

  • The posts have All India liability and selected candidates can be posted anywhere in India and even abroad
  • On appointment, candidates shall be governed by BSF Act 1968 and BSF Rule 1969
  • Selected candidates shall have to undergo Basic Training and other prescribed courses
  • These vacancies are not open for physically challenged persons or ex-servicemen
  • The vacancies are tentative and may increase or decrease without any notice
  • BSF reserves the right to make changes in sequence of recruitment procedure or cancel/postpone recruitment at any stage
  • Recruitment is only for meritorious sportspersons who are medal winners/position holders and/or participants as per prescribed criteria
  • No TA/DA or other expenses for appearing for recruitment will be paid to candidates
  • Candidates should come prepared for more than one day stay under their own arrangements
  • Recruitment in BSF is totally transparent, fair and purely on the basis of performance. No payment is required except nominal application fee
  • Falsification of documents will lead to criminal action besides cancellation of candidature
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to summary rejection
  • Mere qualifying prescribed tests does not confer right for selection
  • Candidates involved/convicted/arrested in any criminal case will not be considered
  • Performance of sportspersons shall be reviewed every year. If standard is not up to required level, they will be given option to merge with combatised GD cadre or be discharged from service
  • If candidate tenders resignation within 10 years from date of enrolment (for reasons other than joining Central/State Govt position), resignation shall be accepted only upon reimbursement of full cost of training or three months pay and allowances (whichever is higher)
  • All disputes will be subject to jurisdiction of courts within territorial limits of Delhi only

How to Apply

  • Application Mode: ONLINE ONLY through BSF Recruitment website https://rectt.bsf.gov.in
  • Step 1: Visit the official BSF Recruitment website https://rectt.bsf.gov.in
  • Step 2: Read the official notification and instructions carefully
  • Step 3: Create profile on the recruitment portal before applying
  • Step 4: Upload copy of certificate/document for sports discipline in support of highest medal/position or highest level of participation in sports achievement
  • Step 5: Fill the online application form with accurate details
  • Step 6: Upload required documents including passport size photograph (same as to be submitted during documentation)
  • Step 7: Pay application fee online (if applicable) - Rs. 159/- for Male UR/OBC candidates
  • Step 8: Submit the application form
  • Step 9: Take printout of submitted application form for future reference
  • Step 10: Provide genuine and functional email ID and mobile number for receiving admit card and other communications
  • Important: No application will be accepted offline. Candidature of candidates who submit application offline will be rejected summarily
  • Documents Required: Matriculation Certificate (for age proof), Educational certificates, Sports achievement certificates, Caste certificate (if applicable), OBC NCL certificate (obtained within 1 year), Domicile Certificate/PAN/Aadhaar/Driving License/Voter ID/Passport, Passport size photographs, NOC (for government employees)

  • Candidates must upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, category certificates, academic certificates and mark sheets, identity proof, experience documents, detailed resume, current reporting structure and latest pay-slip as per checklist.
  • Experienced candidates must provide detailed pen picture of each experience; all experience documents must clearly indicate start and end dates of each employment.
  • OBC candidates (except SC/ST/PwD) must pay the non-refundable Rs. 500/- fee through the link at the end of application form.

Selection Process

Candidates will be shortlisted for Interview based on the scrutiny of application as per the criteria laid down in the advertisement.

Verification of eligibility claims of the candidates with original documents will be done on the day of interview. However, candidates, at the discretion of Management, may be called for documentation on any other day before scheduling the personal interview.

Details of candidates shortlisted for Documentation/ Personal Interview will be posted on PHL website only. Call Letters to shortlisted candidates will also be sent to their registered e-mails IDs.

During Document Verification, the candidate will have to produce his/her all Original Certificates in support of age, caste, qualification, experience etc. along with a proof of identity and one set of self-attested photocopies of the Certificates. If the identity of the candidate is in doubt or he/she is not able to produce the requisite documents or there is mismatch of information in the documents, his/her candidature will be rejected. No additional time will be given for producing original documents.

Candidates already working in Central Government/State Government/Autonomous Body/Public Sector Undertaking are required to submit their application through proper channel or produce "No Objection Certificate" from the present employer on the day of interview, failing which his/her candidature will not be considered. Other claims such as undertaking to resign in the event of selection, acknowledged copy of application for NOC/resignation letter, experience certificates etc. shall not be considered in place of NOC.

In case a candidate does not appear for Document Verification along with original documents, he/she shall not be eligible for further selection procedure and his/her candidature shall summarily be rejected.

After Document Verification, the provisionally shortlisted candidates will be interviewed by an approved panel of 5-6 members.

Final selection will be made in order of merit prepared on the basis of marks obtained by the candidates in interview subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria prescribed for the post.

Name of the candidates provisionally selected for appointment will be declared on PHL website. The Offer of Appointment shall be issued to the provisionally selected candidates on their Registered email IDs only.

Selection of candidates shall be provisional, subject to verification of documents relating to eligibility criteria, character and antecedents and other documents submitted by the candidate and is also subject to his/her meeting the requisite medical standards for the post and other requirements applicable for appointments under the rules of PHL.

Appointment of successful candidates will be subject to further verification of concerned documents related to Age, Qualification, Caste & Medical fitness certificates etc. from the issuing authorities so that the candidate is suitable in all respects for appointment to the service/post.

How to Apply

  • Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria may apply online through the link available on www.pawanhans.co.in  under tab "Careers". No other mode of submission of applications will be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Before filling online application, the candidate should keep scanned copies of all educational qualification certificates, experience certificates, CTC/ Pay scale, Salary Slips, Photograph, caste, class etc. at hand.
  • Candidates should enter their Name, Father's Name and Date of Birth as recorded in the Matriculation certificate only. In case of subsequent change in name, candidates should indicate their changes only in the Online Application. However, other details should match with the Matriculation Certificate. Gazette Notification or any other legal document as applicable should be submitted at the time of Document Verification.
  • After filling online application form, applicants are required to take print out of duly filled-in & signed online application form and send the same after affixing a recent passport size photograph accompanied with copies of self-attested testimonials in support of age, caste/class, qualification, experience, Pay/CTC, etc. and proof of payment of application fee of Rs. 295/- to Head (HR), Pawan Hans Limited, (A Government of India Enterprise), Corporate Office, C-14, Sector-1, Noida - 201 301, (U.P.) on or before 02.01.2026. Candidates belonging to SC, ST and PwBD are exempted from payment of application fee.

Event Date
Commencement of Online Application 15th December, 2025 (10:00 AM IST)
Closing Date for Online Application 13th January, 2026 (06:00 PM IST)
Crucial date for determination of age Last date prescribed for the receipt of ONLINE application

Selection Process

  • As per The Selection Tests Rules, 2025, through a two-stage process as under:
  • Stage 1: Eligibility Test - A multiple-choice questions (MCQ) based screening test examining general awareness, analytical ability, aptitude, and logical ability
  • Stage 2: Selection Test - Qualifiers from Stage 1 (or exempted) will appear for a grade-specific written test on domain knowledge in civil engineering, infrastructure projects, and related areas
  • Personal Interview - Conducted by a nominated Selection Committee for shortlisted candidates based on written test scores
  • Special Provision: Applicants with experience of working in NHIDCL for a total period of 5 years (i.e. 1825 days or more) as on the date of this advertisement shall be exempted from Stage-1: Eligibility Test. However, they must undergo Stage-2: Selection Test (Specific Written Test and meet all other eligibility criteria
  • Syllabus for Eligibility Test and Specific Written Test: The detailed syllabus is available on the NHIDCL website
  • Final Selection: Final selection shall be based on NHIDCL Cadre Rules

General Information/Instructions

  • One post of Sr. Manager for category D (autism, intellectual disability, Specific Learning Disability, mental illness etc.) and one post of Dy. General Manager for category B (deaf & hard of hearing) under PwBD reservation will be made applicable for the above vacancies horizontally
  • Eligibility for Availing Reservation: To avail community reservation, candidates must belong to a caste listed in the Central Government reserved communities list. Candidates would be required to submit valid SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD certificates at the time of document verification
  • PwBD category reservation will be limited to under mentioned disabilities: B. Deaf & hard of hearing D. Autism, intellectual disability, Specific Learning Disability, mental illness etc
  • Functional Requirements for PwBD Categories are: Sitting, Standing, Walking, Bending, Jumping, Climbing, Manipulation by Fingers, Reading & Writing, Seeing (SE), Communication (C)
  • Reserved Category candidates applying for unreserved posts will not be eligible for any relaxations
  • Name variations in certificates should be supported by such legal documents, as may be required under provisions of law/guidelines
  • Government/PSU candidates are required to submit NOC / relieving letter from their current organizations at the time of document verification prior to issuance of "Offer of Employment"
  • Number of vacancies may increase or decrease based on NHIDCL requirements
  • Selected Candidates may be posted anywhere in India or abroad. NHIDCL at present operates through 14 Regional Offices in different States/UTs with its Corporate HQ at New Delhi
  • NHIDCL at any stage may cancel the advertisement or selection process without assigning any reasons
  • Candidates must keep their email ID active for one year; no change in the email ID would be allowed
  • Corrigendum/addendum/errata will be posted only on NHIDCL's website at www.nhidcl.com under the heading "Career/Current Vacancies"
  • Canvassing or external influence will disqualify the candidate from selection
  • Candidates should avoid middlemen / recruitment agents / consultants and fraudulent job promises
  • All disputes are subject to Delhi High Court jurisdiction, with the English version prevailing for interpretation
  • All appointments in NHIDCL shall be subject to the successful completion of a background verification process (BGV). The BGV may inter alia include verification of the candidate's identity, address, educational and professional qualifications, character antecedents and any other information as deemed necessary by NHIDCL
  • If at any point of time, before or after the appointment, the outcome of the background verification is found to be unsatisfactory, NHIDCL reserves the right to withdraw or cancel the offer of employment/ appointment
  • The personal information collected during the verification process/selection process shall be handled in accordance with applicable laws, rules, and NHIDCL's policies. It shall be used only for purpose of assessment and verification relevant to employment
  • For detailed information, candidates may refer to NHIDCL Cadres (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Rules, 2025, which are available on the NHIDCL website. It may be noted that provisions of these rules shall apply and supersede any of the instructions given in this Recruitment Notice, if found to be contradictory
  • In case of any doubt & queries please contact to: [email protected]

How to Apply

  • Visit the official NHIDCL website: www.nhidcl.com → Career → Click on "Current Vacancies 2025 - Apply Online"
  • Register using valid email ID and mobile number. Upload scanned copies of recent passport-size photo, signature, 10th Certificate/DoB proof, educational certificates

Educational Qualifications

Area of Experience Required

    • Conducting Board/Committees' meetings and General Body Meetings

Salary/Stipend

  • Annual CTC: Approximately ₹ 9.96 Lakhs

  • Retention Bonus: Rs. 20,000/- upon completion of each 6 months of service
  • PF/EPS/Gratuity: As per POWERGRID rules (PF deduction @ 12% of Basic Pay and DA)
  • Mobile Phone & Digital Services: Reimbursement limited to Rs. 45,000/- (excl. taxes) for block of 2 years
  • Leave Benefits: 12 days Casual Leave, 10 days Sick Leave, 30 days Earned Leave per year + EL encashment, Maternity/Paternity Leave, Quarantine Leave as per rules
  • Medical Benefits: For self and family (spouse, 2 dependent children & dependent parents) - OPD ceiling: One month's Basic Pay + DA annually, IPD coverage: Rs. 5 Lakhs medical insurance
  • Group Personal Accident Insurance: Covered under POWERGRID scheme

Age Limit (as on 31.12.2025)

  • Upper Age Limit: 29 years
  • Minimum Age: 18 years (Indian Nationals only eligible)
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): 3 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: As per Government of India directives
  • Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen: Period spent in service plus 3 years (subject to conditions)
  • Age Relaxation for Candidates with POWERGRID Experience: Up to maximum 5 years (over and above category relaxation) for those who worked as CS Professional on contract for at least one year

Application Fee

Category Application Fee
SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen Exempted
All Other Candidates Rs. 400/- (Non-refundable)

Selection Process

  • Selection will involve Interview only of eligible and shortlisted candidates
  • Management reserves right to conduct a Screening Test to restrict number of candidates for Personal Interview if required
  • If Screening Test conducted:
    • It shall be for elimination purpose only with no weightage in final merit
    • Qualifying marks: UR category - 40%, Reserved category - 30%
    • Candidates qualifying will be shortlisted for interview based on marks in prescribed ratio
  • Final Selection: Based on marks secured in Interview only
  • Qualifying Marks in Interview:
    • UR/EWS: 40%
    • OBC(NCL)/SC/ST/PwBD: 30%
  • Candidates can appear in Screening Test/Personal Interview in Hindi or English
  • Final engagement subject to medical fitness as per company's prescribed standards
  • Selected candidates will be empanelled as per merit and appointment offered based on actual requirement from Subsidiaries/SPV companies

General Information/Instructions

  • Engagement Nature: Purely temporary and contract basis initially for 2 years, extendable for one year each for 3 years (maximum 5 years total)
  • Employment Type: Fixed Term Employment (FTE) - No claim for regular employment or relaxation in future regular posts
  • Work Location: Subsidiaries/SPV companies of POWERGRID across various locations
  • Nationality: Only Indian Nationals of age 18 years or above are eligible
  • PwBD Sub-categories Identified:
    • VI - Blind (B) / Low Vision (LV)
    • HI - Deaf (D) / Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD - One Arm/Both Arm/One Leg/Both Leg/Cerebral Palsy/Leprosy Cured/Dwarfism/Acid Attack victims/Muscular Dystrophy/Spinal Deformity/Spinal Injury
    • Multiple Disabilities involving above
  • PwBD Eligibility: Persons suffering from not less than 40% of relevant permanent disability eligible for relaxation
  • Health Standards: Candidates must meet POWERGRID's health standards - no relaxation allowed
  • Certificate Requirements:
    • OBC (NCL): Latest certificate based on income for FY 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, issued on/after 01.04.2025
    • EWS: Income & Asset Certificate for FY 2024-25, issued on/after 01.04.2025
    • SC/ST/PwBD: Certificates in GOI prescribed format from competent authority
  • Opportunity for Regular Posts: POWERGRID may provide opportunity to eligible FTEs (after minimum 2 years) for selection to regular posts through internal selection process
  • Training/Internship: Will not be counted as experience
  • Date Calculation: Date of issuance of final mark sheet shall be taken as date of acquiring qualification; Result Declaration Date treated as date of ICSI Membership Certificate
  • Govt/PSU Employees: Required to apply through proper channel with NOC
  • Multiple Applications: Only one application per candidate; if multiple, last registered/fee-paid application considered
  • Legal Jurisdiction: NCT of Delhi for any case/dispute

How to Apply

  • Apply ONLY through Online Registration System of POWERGRID
  • Visit official website: www.powergrid.in
  • Navigate to: Careers Section → Job Opportunities → Openings → "Engagement of Experienced Company Secretary Professional (On Contract) on Fixed Tenure Basis-2025"
  • Possess valid Email ID, Alternate Email ID, Mobile number and Alternate Mobile number before registration
  • Keep email ID and mobile number active for at least one year
  • Documents to Upload (in specified format & size):
    • Recent passport size colour photograph - white background (50 KB, .jpg)
    • Signature in Blue/Black Ink (50 KB, .jpg)
    • Date of Birth Proof - Matric/Birth Certificate (3 MB, .pdf)
    • ICSI Associate Member Certificate & Mark Sheets - all years/semesters in one pdf (10 MB, .pdf)
    • Experience Certificate/proof of minimum 01 year post qualification experience (3 MB, .pdf)
    • Caste/EWS/PwBD Certificates if applicable (3 MB, .pdf)
    • NOC from present employer if working in Govt/PSU (3 MB, .pdf)
    • Ex-Servicemen certificates if applicable (3 MB, .pdf)
  • Upload legible copies only - mobile phone scans/clicks not readable will not be considered
  • All photocopies must be self-attested
  • Fill all details carefully including Name, DOB, Address, Qualification, Experience
  • Pay application fee (if applicable) through online mode
  • On submission, system will generate "Resume" with Registration Number
  • Take printout of completed application for future reference
  • Application can be edited/updated till last date - cannot be altered after that
  • Check website and registered email regularly for updates
  • No hard copies to be forwarded to POWERGRID
  • Query Email: [email protected] (Subject: "Comp.Secy.-2025 (Post ID-499)- ")

UPSC NDA & NA Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Academy/Service Male Female Total
National Defence Academy - Army (157th Course commencing January 2027) 198 10 208
National Defence Academy - Navy (All Executive Branch) 37 05 42

Total 370 24 394

Note: Indian Army publishes vacancies for Men and Women separately. Though notified through common notification, NDA/Naval Academy men and women are separate entries with selection done separately in gender-pure manner as per vacancies notified.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications:

  • For Army Wing of NDA: 12th Class pass of the 10+2 pattern of School Education or equivalent examination conducted by a State Education Board or a University
  • For Air Force and Naval Wings of NDA and for 10+2 Cadet Entry Scheme at Indian Naval Academy: 12th Class pass with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics of the 10+2 pattern of School Education or equivalent
  • Candidates appearing in the 12th Class under 10+2 pattern can also apply
  • Such candidates must submit proof of passing by 10th December 2026
  • Important: Candidates appearing in 11th class are NOT eligible

Nationality:

  • Citizen of India, OR
  • Subject of Nepal, OR
  • Person of Indian origin migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African Countries (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia) or Vietnam with intention of permanent settlement in India
  • Certificate of eligibility required for categories (ii) and (iii) except Gorkha subjects of Nepal

Marital Status:

  • Candidates must be UNMARRIED (both male and female)
  • Male divorcee/widower candidates cannot be treated as unmarried and are not eligible
  • Candidates must undertake not to marry until completion of full training
  • Marriage subsequent to application date will lead to disqualification
  • Marriage during training will result in discharge and liability to refund all expenditure

Age Limit (as on 01-07-2027)

  • Minimum Age: 16.5 years - Born not later than 01st July 2010
  • Maximum Age: 19.5 years - Born not earlier than 01st July 2007
  • Only unmarried male/female candidates born between 01/07/2007 and 01/07/2010 are eligible
  • Date of birth accepted only from Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate or equivalent
  • No subsequent change in date of birth allowed
  • No other document relating to age (horoscopes, affidavits, birth extracts, etc.) will be accepted

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount
General/OBC Male Candidates Rs. 100/- (Rupees One Hundred Only)
Female Candidates No Fee
SC/ST Candidates No Fee
Wards of JCOs/NCOs/ORs studying in Military/Sainik Schools No Fee (Certificate required)
  • Payment Mode: Visa/Master/RuPay Credit/Debit Card/UPI Payment or Internet Banking
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances
  • No fee exemption available for OBC candidates
  • Applications without prescribed fee (unless exempted) shall be summarily rejected

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 10/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 10/12/2025
Last Date for Online Application 30/12/2025 (up to 06:00 PM)
Examination Date 12/04/2026
Written Result Declaration May 2026 (Tentative)
SSB Interview Period June 2026 to July 2026 (Tentative)
Course Commencement (NDA - 157th Course) 01/01/2027
Course Commencement (Naval Academy - 119th INAC) 01/01/2027
Certificate Submission Deadline (appearing candidates) 10/12/2026

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - Written Examination: Conducted by UPSC
  • Paper-I: Mathematics - 300 marks, Duration: 2.5 hours (For IMA/INA/AFA only, not for Naval Academy 10+2 Entry)
  • Paper-II: General Ability Test - 600 marks, Duration: 2.5 hours
    • Part A: English - 200 marks
    • Part B: General Knowledge - 400 marks (Physics, Chemistry, General Science, Social Studies, Geography, Current Events)
  • Total Written Marks: 900
  • All questions will be objective type
  • Question papers in Mathematics and Part B of General Ability Test will be bilingual (Hindi and English)
  • Candidates must use Black Ball Pen only for marking answers
  • Negative Marking: 0.33 marks (one-third) deduction for each wrong answer
  • Commission has discretion to fix qualifying marks in any or all subjects
  • Stage 2 - Services Selection Board (SSB) Interview: 900 marks
  • Two-Stage SSB Selection:
    • Stage I: Officer Intelligence Rating (OIR) tests and Picture Perception & Description Test (PP&DT) - Shortlisting based on combined performance
    • Stage II: Interview, Group Testing Officer Tasks, Psychology Tests, and Conference - Conducted over 4 days
  • For Air Force Candidates: Computerized Pilot Selection System (CPSS) required
  • CPSS is conducted only once - grades secured hold good for every subsequent interview
  • Candidates who fail CPSS cannot apply for Flying Branch but can be considered for Ground Duty branches
  • Stage 3 - Medical Examination: Special Medical Board at designated Armed Forces Medical Services Hospitals
  • Candidates must secure minimum qualifying marks separately in written exam and SSB test
  • Final merit list based on total marks (Written + SSB) subject to medical fitness and eligibility
  • Selection done separately for male and female candidates in gender-pure manner

Salary/Stipend

  • During Training at NDA (3 years): Fixed stipend of Rs. 56,100/- per month (starting pay in Level 10)
  • Cost of training including accommodation, books, uniforms, boarding, and medical treatment borne by Government
  • Pocket expenses (approximately Rs. 3,000/- per month) to be met by candidates/parents
  • Financial assistance of Rs. 2,500/- per month available if parent's income is less than Rs. 45,000/- per month
  • Initial Deposit on joining NDA: Rs. 40,376/- (includes pocket allowance, insurance, incidental expenditure)
  • After Commissioning as Lieutenant:
    • Lieutenant: Pay Level 10 - Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500/- per month
    • Captain: Pay Level 10B - Rs. 61,300 - 1,93,900/- per month
    • Major: Pay Level 11 - Rs. 69,400 - 2,07,200/- per month
    • Lt. Colonel: Pay Level 12A - Rs. 1,21,200 - 2,12,400/- per month
    • Colonel: Pay Level 13 - Rs. 1,30,600 - 2,15,900/- per month
  • Military Service Pay (MSP): Rs. 15,500/- per month (fixed) from Lieutenant to Brigadier
  • Additional Allowances:
    • Dearness Allowance (as applicable to civilians)
    • Dress Allowance: Rs. 20,000/- per year
    • Transport Allowance (TPTA): Rs. 7,200/- + DA (higher cities) or Rs. 3,600/- + DA (other places)
    • Children Education Allowance: Rs. 2,250/- per month per child (for two eldest children)
    • Hostel Subsidy: Rs. 6,750/- per month per child
    • Free Ration in kind in peace and field areas
    • Field Area Allowances (depending on posting)
    • Para Allowance: Rs. 10,500/- per month
    • Special Forces Allowance: Rs. 25,000/- per month
  • Insurance Coverage:
    • During Training: Rs. 15 lakh (one-time premium of Rs. 7,200/-)
    • After Commissioning: Rs. 1.25 Crore (monthly subscription of Rs. 12,500/-)

Physical Standards

Height Requirements:

  • Male Candidates: Minimum 157 cm
  • Female Candidates: Minimum 152 cm
  • For Flying Branch: Minimum 162.5 cm (both male and female)
  • For Gorkhas and candidates from Hills of North Eastern region, Garhwal, Kumaon: Minimum reduced by 5 cm
  • Growth allowance of 2 cm for candidates below 18 years

Weight Requirements:

  • Weight should be proportionate to height and age as per prescribed charts
  • Minimum and maximum weight limits specified for different height and age groups
  • Weights below minimum or above maximum (except for documented body builders/wrestlers) not acceptable

Visual Standards for NDA/NA Entry:

  • Uncorrected Vision: 6/12 in each eye
  • Corrected Vision: 6/6 in each eye
  • Limits of Myopia: -1.0 D Sph
  • Limits of Hypermetropia: +2.0 D Sph
  • Astigmatism: ±1.0 D Cyl (within limits of myopia and hypermetropia)
  • Binocular Vision: III
  • Colour Perception: CP Pass (assessed by Ishihara test at SMB, Anomaloscope at AMB/RMB)
  • Kerato-refractive surgery (PRK/LASIK/SMILE) acceptable in all branches except submarine, diving and MARCO (subject to conditions)
  • Surgery must be at least 12 months before examination, performed after age 20

Dental Standards:

  • Minimum 14 dental points required
  • Any 4 of 6 anterior teeth and any 6 of 10 posterior teeth must be present in good functional opposition
  • Mouth opening of at least 30 mm required
  • No more than two mobile teeth acceptable

Other Physical Standards:

  • Chest circumference: Minimum 77 cm for male candidates
  • Chest expansion: Minimum 5 cm
  • Hearing: Must hear forced whisper at 610 cm distance with each ear
  • Must be free from diseases, deformities, and medical conditions affecting military duty
  • Permanent body tattoos only permitted on inner face of forearm (elbow to wrist) and back of hand

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must apply online only through https://upsconline.nic.in
  • No other mode of application is allowed
  • Universal Registration Number (URN) required for all UPSC examinations
  • Live Photo Capture mandatory while filling Common Application Form (CAF)
  • Aadhaar Card strongly recommended as ID document
  • One Photo ID Card mandatory (Aadhaar/Voter Card/PAN/Passport/Driving License/School Photo ID)
  • Candidates cannot withdraw applications after submission
  • No corrections/alterations allowed after application submission
  • e-Admit Card will be issued on last working day of preceding week of examination
  • No Admit Card will be sent by post or email
  • Candidates must reach examination venue at least 30 minutes prior
  • Face Authentication mandatory at examination venue
  • Mobile phones and electronic devices strictly banned
  • Use Black Ball Pen only for marking answers
  • Question Paper Representation Portal (QPRep) available for 7 days after examination
  • Helpdesk: 011-24041001 or email: [email protected] (10:00 AM to 5:30 PM on working days)
  • Government strives for gender balance - Women candidates encouraged to apply
  • Candidates already in Government Service or Armed Forces must inform their Head of Office/Commanding Officer
  • Candidates appearing for SSB interview entitled to AC III Tier railway fare for first appearance

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit official website https://upsconline.nic.in
  • Step 2: Create Account and generate Universal Registration Number (URN)
  • Step 3: Fill Common Application Form (CAF) with personal details
  • Step 4: Upload recent photograph and capture live photo
  • Step 5: Fill Examination Specific Module with preferences for Services (Army/Navy/Air Force in order of preference 1 to 4)
  • Step 6: Upload required documents and Photo ID details
  • Step 7: Select Examination Centre (first-apply-first-allot basis with ceiling on most centres)
  • Step 8: Pay application fee online (if applicable) through Credit/Debit Card/UPI/Net Banking
  • Step 9: Submit application and note down Application Number
  • Step 10: Download and save e-Admit Card when available
  • Important: Indicate at least one preference for service allocation (mandatory)
  • Note: Candidates must register on www.joinindianarmy.nic.in after qualifying written exam to receive SSB call
  • Note: Candidates with Navy first choice: Register on www.joinindiannavy.gov.in
  • Note: Candidates with Air Force first choice: Also register on www.joinindianarmy.nic.in for AFSB
  • Note: Email ID given to UPSC must be same as Directorate General of Recruiting website

Ambedkar University Delhi invites applications from eligible candidates for 71 faculty posts (20 Professor, 23 Associate Professor, 24 Assistant Professor across various Schools and disciplines) and 4 other academic staff posts (Librarian, Assistant Librarian, Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports) on regular basis. The University focuses on humanities and social sciences and offers programmes across four campuses at Kashmere Gate, Karampura, Lodhi Colony and Qutab Institutional Area, aiming to reconceptualise social sciences through innovative curriculum and pedagogy.

This recruitment offers attractive academic pay levels under the 7th CPC, including Pay Level 14 for Professor and Librarian, Level 13A for Associate Professor, and Level 10 for Assistant Professor, Assistant Librarian and Assistant Director of Physical Education and Sports, with salary ranges up to Rs. 2,18,200/- depending on the post. The posts are distributed across Schools such as Culture and Creative Expressions, Design, Development Studies, Education Studies (including ITEP), Global Affairs, Public Policy & Governance, Human Ecology, Legal and Socio-Political Studies, Letters, Management, Undergraduate Studies, Vocational Studies, and Heritage Research & Management.

Interested and eligible candidates must first submit their application form online through the AUD website from 20 December 2025 to 09 January 2026 and then send a hard copy of the filled online application along with self-attested supporting documents to the Deputy Registrar (Recruitment & Promotion Cell), AUD, Kashmere Gate Campus, so as to reach by 16 January 2026 up to 17:30 hrs. Applications will be shortlisted in accordance with UGC Regulations 2018 and applicable norms, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for interviews or presentations, with details notified on the University website and via email.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 Important Dates

The Detailed Advertisement No. AUD/55-1(49)/Rect./2025 clearly mentions the schedule for online application, last date and receipt of hard copies for the Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025. Candidates must adhere strictly to these dates as applications received after the deadlines will be summarily rejected and the University will not be responsible for postal delays.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

The University has notified 20 Professor, 23 Associate Professor, and 24 Assistant Professor posts across various Schools, along with 1 Librarian, 2 Assistant Librarian, and 1 Assistant Director of Physical Education and Sports posts, making a total of 71 vacancies. Certain posts marked with an asterisk are backlog reserved vacancies for specific categories, and there is horizontal reservation of 7 posts for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) across various categories (a to e) as per DoPT OM dated 15.01.2018 and related notifications.

PwBD reservation covers categories such as blindness and low vision, deaf and hard of hearing, locomotor disability including cerebral palsy and related conditions, autism and intellectual disability, and multiple disabilities, with functional requirements regulated as per Gazette of India notification dated 07.01.2021 and DoPT guidelines. The notification also clarifies that candidates who had applied earlier for certain Assistant Professor posts in Social Science & Humanities and Global Studies against previous advertisement must apply afresh but are exempted from paying application fee with reference to earlier payment.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Eligibility Criteria 2025

Candidates willing to apply for the Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and other academic staff posts must ensure that they satisfy the eligibility criteria as per UGC Regulations 2018 and applicable NCTE/AICTE/other regulatory body norms. The notification clearly states that eligibility conditions regarding qualifications, experience, research publications and research score will be as per the latest UGC/NCTE/AICTE rules and the detailed discipline-wise criteria given in the advertisement.

✨ Educational Qualification

The educational and professional qualifications vary by post and discipline but broadly follow UGC Regulations 2018 and related bodies.

For Professor (various disciplines):
An eminent scholar with a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, actively engaged in research with minimum 10 research publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Regulations 2018, along with at least 10 years of teaching/research experience at University/National Level Institutions including supervision of doctoral candidates. Alternatively, an outstanding professional with a Ph.D. and significant contribution to the field with at least 10 years’ experience and a national award instituted by Government of India and conferred by the President of India may be considered in specific cases as detailed in the notification.

For Associate Professor (various disciplines):
A good academic record with a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, Master’s degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade), and minimum 8 years of teaching/research experience equivalent to Assistant Professor in a University/College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with at least 7 publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Regulations 2018. Additional discipline-specific desirable qualifications such as experience with quantitative techniques, data handling, or interdisciplinary law and social science backgrounds are mentioned for some posts.

For Assistant Professor (various disciplines):
A Master’s degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in a relevant/allied subject from an Indian University or equivalent foreign degree, along with NET/SLET/SET qualification or exemption through Ph.D. in accordance with UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations 2009/2016, with detailed conditions for candidates registered before 11 July 2009 (including viva voce, external evaluation, publications, and paper presentations) certified by the concerned University. In professional/technical disciplines such as Design or Management, qualifications include Ph.D. with First Class at Bachelor’s or Master’s level, specified industry/teaching experience, and minimum numbers of SCI/UGC/AICTE-approved journal publications, as detailed in relevant sections of the advertisement.

For Librarian and Assistant Librarian:
Librarian requires a Master’s Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science with at least 55% marks, at least 10 years’ experience as Librarian at University/College/teaching level or College Librarian, evidence of innovative library services including ICT, and a Ph.D. in Library/Information/Documentation/Archives & Manuscript-Keeping. Assistant Librarian requires Master’s in Library/Information/Documentation Science with at least 55%, knowledge of computerization, and NET or exemption through Ph.D. meeting UGC norms, with detailed pre-2009 Ph.D. conditions.

For Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports (Women only):
Master’s Degree in Physical Education and Sports or Physical Education or Sports Science with 55% marks, record of representing University/College at Inter-University/Inter-Collegiate competitions or State/National championships, and NET (or Ph.D.-based exemption) in Physical Education/Physical Education & Sports/Sports Science. An alternative qualification is being an Asian Games or Commonwealth Games medal winner with at least a Post-Graduation degree, along with physical fitness test norms detailed for women candidates.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Selection Process 2025

The selection process for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 is based on merit through all-India advertisement and recommendations of duly constituted Selection Committees, as per UGC Regulations 2018 and AUD norms. Applications will be scrutinised and shortlisted according to academic qualifications, research publications, research score, and other criteria, and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, presentation or seminar or a combination thereof as decided by the University.

The selection process is carried out in the following stages:

1. Scrutiny / Screening of Applications: A Scrutiny/Screening Committee will examine all applications and prepare a list of eligible and not-eligible candidates based on stipulated guidelines, eligibility conditions and shortlisting criteria as per UGC Regulations and University norms. The lists of eligible and not-eligible candidates (with reasons for ineligibility) will be uploaded on the University website, and candidates shown not-eligible will have an opportunity to submit grievances/clarifications with documentary evidence within a stipulated time.

2. Final Shortlisting & Interview Call: After considering grievances, the Committee will finalise the list of eligible candidates, and on the basis of academic record, publications, experience and research score, a reasonable number of candidates will be called for interview. If the number of applications is large, the University may restrict candidates by applying higher qualifications/experience than minimum prescribed, and in some cases may postpone interviews if there are not enough candidates.

3. Interview / Presentation / Seminar: Shortlisted candidates will be required to appear before the Selection Committee for interview and may be asked to give a presentation or seminar as part of the selection process. Candidates residing outside India may be interviewed via video conferencing (e.g., Skype or other modes) if requested in advance.

Final Merit: Final selection will be based on performance in the interview (and presentation/seminar where applicable), with academic/research scores used only for shortlisting, not for final selection. Appointments will be made in accordance with UGC Regulations 2018 and subsequent amendments, and the University reserves the right to increase, decrease or cancel posts, and any dispute will fall under the jurisdiction of the High Court of Delhi.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Application Fee 2025

Applicants are required to pay a non-refundable application fee depending on their category while submitting the online application form. The fee must be paid online through the payment gateway (credit/debit card/net banking) provided on the University website and proof of payment should be retained by candidates.

  • Payment must be made online only through the University portal; other modes are not accepted.
  • Candidates who had applied earlier for specified re-advertised posts are exempted from paying fee again against reference of their previous payment, subject to conditions mentioned in the notification.
  • Application fee once paid is non-refundable, and incomplete applications or those without fee (where applicable) will be rejected.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Salary 2025

All posts carry UGC pay scales under the 7th Central Pay Commission along with admissible allowances as per University, Government of India and GNCTD norms. The notification provides clear academic pay levels and corresponding pay scales for various teaching and other academic staff positions.

  • Along with basic pay, selected candidates are entitled to Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance and other benefits as per applicable government and University rules.
  • Conditions of service, including age of superannuation and career advancement, will follow UGC/Government of India/GNCTD norms and AUD Statutes and Ordinances.

How to Apply for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 and subsequently submit hard copies as per the instructions. The step-by-step application process is as follows.

  1. Step 1: Visit the official University website https://aud.delhi.gov.in on or after 20 December 2025.
  2. Step 2: Click on the recruitment/careers/notification link for “Detailed Advertisement for Recruitment to Various Teaching and Other Academic Staff Posts – AUD/55-1(49)/Rect./2025”.
  3. Step 3: Read the detailed advertisement carefully, including school-wise posts, eligibility qualifications, UGC/AICTE/NCTE norms, reservation and instructions.
  4. Step 4: Click on “Apply Online” and complete registration using a valid email ID and mobile number.
  5. Step 5: Fill the online application form with personal details, educational qualifications, teaching/research experience, publications and research score details as required.
  6. Step 6: Select the appropriate post, School, discipline and category; if applying for more than one discipline/post/category, submit separate applications and fees as applicable.
  7. Step 7: Upload scanned copies of relevant documents (certificates, mark sheets, experience letters, category certificates, Ph.D. compliance certificates Annexure I/II where required, etc.) as per the specified format and size.
  8. Step 8: Pay the non-refundable application fee online through credit/debit card/net banking/payment gateway, if applicable for your category.
  9. Step 9: Submit the application form online and take a printout of the successfully submitted online application.
  10. Step 10: Arrange self-attested copies of all supporting documents and index/paginate them in the order of essential eligibility criteria, and enclose with the printed application in an envelope clearly mentioning the name of post/discipline on top.
  11. Step 11: Send the hard copy by Registered/Speed Post so as to reach on or before 16 January 2026 (17:30 hrs) at: Deputy Registrar (Recruitment & Promotion Cell), Room No. 31A, Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi, Lothian Road, Kashmere Gate Campus, Delhi – 110 006.

Important Links:

  • Official Notification PDF: Download Here
  • Apply Online: https://audrec.samarth.edu.in/

Important Instructions for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025

  • Application form must be submitted in online mode only within the prescribed time limit; hard copy of the online application with self-attested documents must also reach the University by the specified date and time.
  • Applicants applying for more than one discipline or for multiple categories of the same post must submit separate online applications and pay separate fees where applicable, selecting all relevant categories before final submission.
  • Hard copy applications must include proper indexing and pagination of all annexed documents in the order of essential eligibility criteria, failing which the application may not be taken up for screening and may be rejected without assigning reasons.
  • Applicants must possess the prescribed qualifications, experience and eligibility as on the closing date of application and should upload/submit specific certificates (including Ph.D. compliance certificates Annexure I/II) as required.
  • The University will shortlist/screen applications strictly as per UGC Regulations 2018, relevant regulatory body norms and AUD rules; academic and research score calculated online is indicative and subject to scrutiny.
  • The mere possession of minimum qualifications does not entitle candidates to be called for interview; the University may restrict the number of candidates called for interview by prescribing higher criteria.
  • All communications, including lists of eligible/not-eligible candidates, interview dates and any updates, will be published on the University website and/or communicated via email; candidates must regularly check the website and email.
  • The University may verify authenticity of certificates/documents at any time; if any information is found false or suppressed, services of the candidate may be terminated without prejudice to further action.
  • The University reserves the right to increase, decrease, or cancel the number of advertised posts, and its decision in all matters related to recruitment will be final and binding.
  • Any legal dispute in connection with this recruitment will fall under the territorial jurisdiction of the High Court of Delhi.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) - AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025

Q1. What is the last date to apply for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A1. The last date to apply online is 09 January 2026 up to 23:59 hrs, and the hard copy of the application must reach the University by 16 January 2026 up to 17:30 hrs.

Q2. What is the age limit for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A2. Age and service conditions, including age of superannuation, are as per University/UGC/Government of India/GNCTD norms; candidates must satisfy these norms as on the closing date of application.

Q3. How many vacancies are available in AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A3. There are 67 teaching posts (20 Professor, 23 Associate Professor, 24 Assistant Professor) and 4 other academic staff posts (1 Librarian, 2 Assistant Librarian, 1 Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports), totaling 71 posts.

Q4. What is the selection process for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A4. Selection is through scrutiny/screening of applications using UGC norms and academic/research scores, followed by interview and possibly presentation/seminar before duly constituted Selection Committees, with final selection based on interview performance.

Q5. What is the application fee for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025?
A5. UR/OBC/EWS candidates must pay Rs. 1000/- (non-refundable), while SC, ST, PwBD and Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

Q6. Is there any written examination in this recruitment?
A6. The notification specifies recruitment on the basis of merit through advertisement and interviews by Selection Committees; it does not mention a separate written examination, and the process is primarily based on screening and interview.

    • Post-Graduation in concerned subject / any specialization in concerned subject with a minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade provided that the candidate has studied the subject(s) mentioned in the note below at the graduation level and three years integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed. from NCTE recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks
    • (B) Qualified in the Central Teachers Eligibility Test (Paper-II) conducted by Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)
    • (C) Competency to teach through English and Hindi Medium
    • ** Training to be undergone: A Person With B.Ed (Special Education) qualifications shall undergo, after appointment an NCTE recognition 6-month Special Programme in Elementary Education

Educational Qualification for Non-Teaching Posts:

  • Head Master: Primary Teachers who have rendered at least Five years of regular service. Essential Educational Qualification: Qualified in the Central Teacher Eligibility Test Paper-I conducted by the Govt. of India
  • Finance Officer:
    • Eligibility Criteria: 01 year's regular service as Section Officer with Bachelor Degree in Commerce from Recognized University OR
    • 04 years' regular service in the grade as Assistant Section Officer with the following qualification: Bachelor Degree in Commerce or Economics or ICWA (inter) or IDMA (inter) or MBA (Finance) with at least 02 years of regular service
  • Section Officer: 03 years regular service in the grade as Asst. Section Officer/Steno Grade-II/UDC Senior Scale
  • Assistant Section Officer: 03 years regular service in the grade in KVS
  • Senior Secretariat Assistant: 03 years regular service in the grade in KVS
  • Junior Secretariat Assistant: Sub-staff with atleast 03 years' regular service in KVS

Desirable Experience:

  • For the post of Head Master and Trained Graduate Teachers, candidates should possess CTET Paper I in case of PRTs applying for Head Master and Paper II in case of PRTs applying for TGTs
  • There will be 5% relaxation in qualifying marks for SC/ST/PwBD candidates as per existing KVS guidelines
  • They need to pass their qualifying exam in first attempt or in two attempts without any break in attempt

Salary/Stipend

  • Salary will be as per 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) Pay Matrix
  • Principal, Vice-Principal, PGTs, TGTs, and other posts will receive salary as per their respective pay levels
  • Additional allowances like HRA, DA, and other applicable allowances will be provided as per government norms
  • Specific salary details are not mentioned in the recruitment notification

Age Limit (as on 01.01.2026)

  • For filling posts through LDE/LDCE: Cut-off date will be 01.01.2026 for determining age, length of service and Educational qualification
  • Age relaxation: Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government of India norms
  • SC/ST candidates: 5 years age relaxation
  • OBC candidates: 3 years age relaxation
  • PwBD candidates: Age relaxation as per government rules
  • Upper age limit relaxation is available for internal candidates as per service rules

Application Fee

  • Application fee details are not mentioned in the recruitment notification
  • Candidates should check the official website for fee-related information while applying online

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 11.12.2025
Cut-off date for determining eligibility criteria 01.01.2026
Closing date of submission of application form for CTET (wherever applicable) 01.01.2026
Activity pertaining to LDE/LDCE 12.12.2025
Activation of Online Link for LDE/LDCE 12.12.2025

Last Date for the Applicants for online submission of Application 26.12.2025
Hardcopy verification by the Controlling Officer 09.01.2026
Final submission 09.01.2026
Date of LDCE Examination 15.02.2026

Selection Process

  • The LDE/LDCE will be conducted on the Centers tentatively located in the cities of Regional Offices of KVS
  • It is mandatory that the Applicants hold the requisite required Degree/ professional degree qualification at the time of examination
  • The examination will be conducted in two parts:
    • Tier-I: Subject Knowledge Examination (Combination of Pen-Paper and OMR Based) - 40 marks duration 2½ hours
    • Tier-II: Personal Interview/Screening Test - 60 marks
  • Being a promotional post, minimum qualifying marks in Tier-I/Interview/Personal Interview/Screening Test for the application shall be 35% for GEN/OBC/EWS and 33% for SC/ST and PwBD applicants
  • In the Unreserved category whereas 35% for SC/ST and PwBD applicants
  • The marks secured in the online written examination shall be the basis of seniority cum qualifying the written examination (Tier-I)
  • Such candidates will be called for interview on the basis of qualifying marks scored in the written examination (Tier-I)
  • The Selection for Interview, Judgement (availability) will also be on the basis of seniority cum qualifying the written examination (Tier-II) in the ratio of 1:4 OR 1:2
  • For Finance Officer and Section Officer selection will be on the basis of seniority cum qualifying marks scored in the written examination (Tier-II) as per the vacancies under respective category
  • For the post of ASST and JSA, the selection will be on the basis of marks scored in the written examination (Tier-I) for Finance Officer and Section Officer
  • CTET qualification is mandatory for TGT posts and CTET Paper I for Head Master posts
  • Candidates possessing the essential qualification/service as mentioned will only be eligible to be selected through LDE/LDCE
  • Final Merit List: The final merit list will be prepared on basis of marks obtained in written examination and Personal Interview/Screening Test of 100 marks for the post of Finance Officer and Section Officer. However, there will be no interview for the post of Finance Officer and Assistant Section Officer, Senior Secretariat Assistant and Junior Secretariat Assistant

General Information/Instructions

  • The Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan will be conducting Limited Departmental Examination (LDE)/ Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE) for filling up the Teaching and Non-Teaching Posts from amongst eligible teachers/Officials of KVS
  • Candidates possessing the essential qualification/service as mentioned will only be eligible to be selected through LDE/LDCE
  • Candidates can apply for only one post even if they are eligible for more than one post
  • Utmost caution is to be taken by the Applicants in filling the online application form and information given by him/her should be relevant and correct as per service records. In case of any wrong data/information entered by the candidate as inaccurate/wrong information which may lead to disqualification of the candidate
  • No change in the application will be permitted once application is filled
  • The LDE/LDCE will be conducted on the Centers tentatively located in the cities of Regional Offices of KVS
  • The Controlling Officers will be responsible for verifying the correctness of the information furnished in application form by the applicants
  • The Controlling Officer will verify the grading of APAR on the basis of APAR if available with them on his Laptop/PC or through the schedule by relevant years
  • If the applicant fails to furnish Service Verification Certificate, the applicant will not be considered for evaluation
  • In the event of selection of the Applicant through the LDE/LDCE, the credentials of the applicant will be verified
  • Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) has been ensured in accordance with the provisions of Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016
  • Persons with disability of 40% or more, if so desires, will have to bring their own scribe to write the examination. The scribe must be from a lower academic qualification than the candidate
  • PwBD candidates shall be permitted 20 additional minutes per hour of examination time or minimum of one hour for examination of three hours duration
  • Candidates studying in the post through LDE cannot apply for vacancies under LDE/LDCE
  • No change will be allowed after final submission of application
  • After final submission, the applicable fees (if any) as well as other documents will be kept in record with signature of the applicant & certifying officer
  • All candidates who are undergoing training under Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) subjects are also eligible to apply
  • Merit list will be uploaded on KVS website. The names of applicants will be provided on their respective Regional Office KVS website
  • Disciplinary action shall be initiated against any employee by KVS for misuse of position or by abusing the Sangathan

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply ONLINE only through the KVS official website
  • Visit the official website: www.kvsangathan.nic.in
  • Look for the "Employment" section or notification for LDE/LDCE 2025
  • Click on the relevant recruitment notification link
  • Read all instructions carefully before filling the online application form
  • The application syllabus for LDE/LDCE Examination is available on KVS website www.kvsangathan.nic.in under the link "Employment" sub menu-> "Syllabus"
  • Fill in all required details accurately including personal information, educational qualifications, and service details
  • Upload scanned copies of required documents:
    • Recent passport-size photograph
    • Signature
    • Educational certificates
    • Service certificates
    • Caste certificate (if applicable)
    • PwBD certificate (if applicable)
  • The Controlling Officer will create the list of the Portal and credentials from CBSE Help Desk provided to the eligible employee and register all the employees applying for LDE through the portal
  • The applicant will use the Employee code and register all the respective employee ID to login to the portal
  • After registration of the applicant by the Controlling Officer, the link will be mailed to the applicant for filing the application
  • Using the link generated by Controlling Officer, the applicant will fill the ONLINE application and submit
  • After successful online submission, take a printout of the application form
  • Get the printout verified by the Controlling Officer with signature and stamp
  • The hardcopy verification by the Controlling Officer should be completed by 09.01.2026
  • Keep the verified hard copy safely for future reference
  • Important: No change will be allowed after final submission of application
  • Candidates should retain the registration number/application number for future correspondence

IRCON International Limited, a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) under the Ministry of Railways, has issued Advertisement No. C-24/2025 for the recruitment of 02 posts (UR-01, OBC-01) of Senior Works Engineer/S&T on contract basis for its Bengaluru Kavach Project. The initial contract is for one year, extendable based on performance and project needs. Selection will be through walk-in interviews scheduled for 06.01.2026 from 10:00 AM onwards at IRCON's office in National Games Village, Koramangala, Bengaluru. Eligible candidates must report with the prescribed application format, original documents, and self-attested copies for verification, as detailed in the notification available on www.ircon.org.

1. What is the starting date to apply for MVH Junior Resident (MBBS) 2025?

Ans: This recruitment is through Walk-in-Interview; there is no separate online/offline application start date mentioned.

2. What is the last apply date for MVH Junior Resident (MBBS) 2025?

Ans: This recruitment is through Walk-in-Interview on 07/01/2026; no separate last apply date is mentioned.

3. What is the Eligibility to apply for MVH Junior Resident (MBBS) 2025?

Ans: MBBS from a recognized university, completion of one year internship not before 2 years as on date of interview, enrollment with Delhi Medical Council, and the candidate must not have completed 01 year Junior Residency in any Govt. hospital in India.

4. What is the Maximum Age Limit to apply for MVH Junior Resident (MBBS) 2025?

Ans: Age on date of interview shall be 30 years for General candidates, 35 years for SC/ST and 33 years for OBC candidates. Under relaxation, upper age limit is 40 years.

5. How many vacancies are being recruited by MVH Junior Resident (MBBS) 2025?

Ans: Total 04* vacancies (ST=02, SC=01, EWS=01). The number of vacancies may vary.

6. What is the salary for MVH Junior Resident (MBBS) 2025?

Ans: Emoluments are as per Pay Matrix 10 of 7th CPC with basic of Rs. 56,100/- per month plus other allowances as admissible.

7. What is the mode of selection for MVH Junior Resident (MBBS) 2025?

Ans: Selection will be through Walk-in-Interview conducted on 07/01/2026, after verification of original documents and self attested copies.

8. Is hostel accommodation available for MVH Junior Resident (MBBS) 2025?

Ans: Hostel accommodation is compulsory for Junior Residents.

9. Are there any relaxation provisions for MVH Junior Resident (MBBS) 2025?

Ans: As per circular no. F.121/26/2010/H&FW/1996-2045 dated 10/06/2011, upper age limit under relaxation is 40 years, Post Graduate doctors may be allowed if fresh graduates are not available, and Junior Residents who have completed one year of Junior Residency may again appear for interview if no fresh Junior Residents are available, with no extension beyond one year under relaxed provisions.

10. Will TA/DA be provided for attending MVH Junior Resident (MBBS) 2025 interview?

Ans: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

The NHSRC is also mandated to contribute to health policy / programme design and evaluation.
  • Since its inception in 2006, NHSRC has been a repository of knowledge and a center of excellence for its agenda. This organization has professional linkages with a plethora of domestic and international bodies involved in the field of Public Health. There have been a number of personnel who have served with NHSRC and gained invaluable experience enabling them to graduate to next rung of professional ladder. Vast exposure to Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, and its processes is a unique feature of NHSRC.

This is an opportunity to support health systems strengthening at scale, learn from district and sub district implementation, undertake knowledge translation, and enable realization of the National and Global Goals.
  • The position reports to the Executive Director (ED), NHSRC and is on Contractual basis. Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: The applicant should possess a Masters’ Degree in Economics/Political Science/International Relation with a specialization in trade/economics.

  • Desirable: M.Phil/Ph.D on related issues is desirable.
  • Experience: The applicant should have a demonstrable research experience in the field of international trade, energy and climate change.

Salary/Stipend

  • The remuneration package will be commensurate with the experience and profile of the selected candidate, subject to a maximum of Rs. 09 lakh per annum and deduction of applicable taxes. The amount of consultancy fee so fixed shall remain unchanged during the term of engagement.

  • Minimum Age: 26 years
  • Maximum Age: 45 years

Important Dates

Date Description
09/12/2025 Advertisement Date
31/12/2025 Last Date for Receiving Applications

Selection Process

  • Ministry of External Affairs will review the applications and shortlist the candidates for interview / written test. The shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email.

General Information/Instructions

  • The contract can be extended further depending on assessment of performance, mutual willingness and depending on the requirement. The contract may be terminated on one month’s notice from either side or on payment of one month’s pay in lieu thereof. Unauthorized absence may lead to termination of the engagement.
  • The applicant should only be an Indian national.
  • The engagement will be strictly contractual and will not confer any other benefits to the selected candidate.
  • The Consultant shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc. or any other benefits available to the regular employees of the Ministry.
  • No HRA shall be admissible.
  • The engagement of the Consultant is on full time basis. Normal working hours will be from 0900 to 1730 hrs. Working hours is subject to change from time to time. Saturdays/Sundays will remain closed as weekend off. In exigencies, he/she may be required to work beyond office hours and/or on holidays. No extra allowance or remuneration for such work is admissible. He/She shall not accept any other professional appointment, paid or otherwise in government or private sector or in any other organization of any kind during the term of engagement with this Ministry.
  • Paid leave of absence may be allowed at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Accumulation of leave beyond a calendar year may not be allowed. Leave cannot be claimed as a matter of right. Leave will not be allowed for more than 10 days at a time. Discretion is reserved to the Head of Division to refuse or revoke leave in the public interest. Leave encashment will not be permissible on unspent leave. Unspent leave will lapse on commencement of notice period. No other leave of any kind shall be admissible to him/her. In case he/she remains absent from duty beyond entitled leave, a proportionate deduction from the consolidated fee as applicable will be made.
  • In case the Consultant is required to travel as part of his/her duties, the Ministry will take care of his/her travel, accommodation and per-diem costs, as per Ministry’s guidelines.
  • The selected person will be required to enter into a contract with the Ministry in a prescribed format w.e.f. the actual date of engagement as Consultant.
  • Incomplete application and those received without supporting documents will be summarily rejected.
  • The date, time and venue of the interview will be conveyed through email at the email address provided by the applicants.
  • Applicants will have to make their own arrangements to reach the place of interview.
  • No TA/DA will be payable by the Ministry to Applicants for attending interview.
  • The decision of the Government regarding selection of candidate will be final.

How to Apply

  • The applicants who fulfil the eligibility criteria may submit application indicating their interest in working for the Ministry of External Affairs as per proforma at Annexure I.
  • Documents / certificates in support of educational qualifications, experience in Govt. service should be attached with the application.
  • Applications along with supporting documents can be submitted to the Ministry through either of the following modes:
  • OFFLINE MODE:- By registered post in an envelope labelled as “Application for the position of Consultant in the ED Division of Ministry of External Affairs”. This is to be sent to the following address. Under Secretary (PF&PG) Ministry of External Affairs, Room No. 4071, Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, 23-D, Janpath, New Delhi-110011
  • ONLINE MODE:- Through email with the subject clearly mentioning the name of the candidate and the position against which the application is being submitted. The email is to be sent to the following email address: [email protected]

The total number of vacancies for TRAI Consultant Recruitment 2025 is 2 posts, one each for NSL‑I Division and IT Division at TRAI Headquarters, New Delhi. Both posts are initially for one year on contract, extendable based on individual performance and future requirements, and the number of vacancies is tentative with a reserve panel to be prepared.

Post Code Post Name No. of Posts
01 Consultant (Artificial Intelligence) 01

Eligibility Criteria

  • Consultant (Artificial Intelligence): B.Tech/B.E/MCA/MSc in Computers/Information Technology or equivalent as essential qualification; M.Tech in Computers/IT or equivalent as desirable, along with certification in AI/ML/DL/Data Science such as Certified Data Scientist or Certified AI Engineer.
  • Essential post‑qualification experience for AI Consultant: minimum 8+ years in Telecom/IT field with at least 3 years’ experience in AI/ML/DL (Deep Learning) domain and technology strategy roles, plus strong skills in AI/ML/DL, GenAI, analytics, modern digital platforms, tools like Power BI/Tableau/Qlik/Looker, programming (Python, R, SQL, Java, Julia, SAS), AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PySpark, Scikit‑Learn, Hugging Face, RegTech), regulatory frameworks (EU AI Act, DPDP Act, IT Act, etc.), and domain expertise in telecom and broadcasting with good communication skills.
  • Consultant (Data Privacy & Cyber Security): B.Tech/B.E in Electronics/Telecommunication/Electrical and Electronics/IT/Computers, or MCA/MSc or equivalent as essential qualification; M.Tech in relevant disciplines and security certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, CISSP/CISM/CISA as desirable.
  • Essential post‑qualification experience for Cyber Security Consultant: minimum 8+ years in IT field with at least 5 years’ experience in security focusing on threat analysis, incident response and security architecture, plus skills in programming (Python, SQL, Java), IT infrastructure, cloud security, virtualization, SOAR tools, firewall/IDS/IPS/VPN configuration, penetration testing, security assessment, risk analysis, EDR/SIEM, DPDP and data protection rules, cyber‑attack analysis, strategic planning, ISO‑2700/ITIL, CTI frameworks (MISP, OpenCTI, MITRE) and STIX/TAXII.
  • Candidates must be eligible Indian citizens and must upload clear, self‑attested copies of birth, educational and experience documents, with experience matching post‑qualification periods as specified.

Age Limit (as on 03-12-2025)

  • Maximum Age (both posts): Not more than 45 years as on the date of issue of the vacancy circular (03 December 2025).

Salary/Stipend

  • For both Consultant (Artificial Intelligence) and Consultant (Data Privacy & Cyber Security), the remuneration is Rs. 24 lakh to Rs. 30 lakh per annum, to be fixed within the band based on the candidate’s experience.
  • The fee is all‑inclusive; no additional transport allowance, dearness allowance or house rent allowance is admissible, and monthly consolidated remuneration is paid after deduction of applicable taxes, within one week of completion of each month, based on attendance.

Event Date

Online Application Start Date 03/12/2025 (from date of issue of vacancy circular)
Online Application End Date 24/12/2025

  • Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on the information and documents submitted in the online application for engagement as Individual Consultants on contract basis at TRAI Headquarters, New Delhi.
  • The final selection and engagement will follow the General Terms and Conditions for engagement of Consultants in TRAI, and TRAI reserves the right to cancel the process at any time without assigning reasons.

How to Apply

  • Eligible candidates desirous of being considered for Consultant (Artificial Intelligence) and Consultant (Data Privacy & Cyber Security) in NSL‑I/IT Divisions of TRAI HQ must submit their applications through online mode only on URL: https://vacancies.trai.gov.in.
  • Applications sent by post, e‑mail or any mode other than the online portal will not be considered, and candidates must upload self‑attested copies of documents showing date of birth, educational qualifications (from 10th onwards with degree certificates and all semester mark sheets), and post‑qualification experience certificates on employer letterheads clearly indicating appointment and relieving/continuity dates and nature of work, along with any other relevant documents.

Instructions

  • The services of Consultants will be governed by the “General Terms and Conditions of engagement of consultant” enclosed as Annexure‑A, covering duration, legal status, conduct standards, confidentiality, intellectual property rights, remuneration, TA, leave, tax, authenticity and termination provisions.
  • Consultants are engaged initially for one year and may be extended annually up to a maximum of four years based on requirement and suitability; TRAI may terminate the contract by giving one month’s notice or without notice in specified circumstances, and the Consultant may also seek termination by giving one month’s written notice.

For MTS (Peon):

For MTS (Sweeper):

Age Calculation Date 20-01-2026 (Closing date)
Date of Issue of Documents On or prior to 20-01-2026
