Document Verification Will be communicated on admit card

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Scrutiny of Applications - All applications will be scrutinised subject to eligibility criteria and necessary documents
  • Stage 2: Shortlisting - Only candidates whose applications are shortlisted will be issued admit card
  • Stage 3: Document Verification - All shortlisted candidates will undergo document verification before written examination
  • Stage 4: Biometric Capture - Photograph and thumb impression will be captured
  • Stage 5: Written Examination - OMR based objective type examination of 80 questions (80 marks) of 01 hour duration
  • Stage 6: Merit List Preparation - Strictly based on marks obtained in written examination
  • Admit card will be sent by post in the envelope enclosed with the application
  • In case of tie in marks, the candidate older in age will be higher in merit

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Chartered Accountant (CA) conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
  • OR candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates who have undergone training under similar scheme for one year or more in any other PSUs will not be eligible to apply.
  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

Salary/Stipend

  • The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is purely for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.
  • The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • There should be no misconception or claims by the beneficiary for employment in CIL or its subsidiaries on completion of training.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date)

  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for UR/EWS category is 28 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for OBC (NCL) category is 31 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for SC/ST category is 33 years.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL and 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit to SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates is not applicable for consideration against unreserved posts.
  • Crucial date for claim of SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD status or any other benefit viz. reservation, upper age limit etc. where not specified otherwise, will be the 1st date of the month in which advertisement has been published.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

 

Selection Process

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.
  • Students would be required to give choice of 9 companies (in the order of preference) among CIL or its subsidiary companies i.e. CIL (HQ), ECL, BCCL, CCL, CMPDIL, NCL, MCL, SECL & WCL.
  • Selection will be based on the merit ranking based on marks obtained in Intermediate Exam and posting will be done based on the preference of posting given and seniority position in the Merit List.
  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.
  • In case there is shortfall in joining in the original panel, then this shortfall (for the respective category) will be filled from the Waiting List Panel.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates are informed that applying for engagement as Industrial Trainee shall not give them the right to be engaged as trainee in the company and company reserves the right to reject any candidate without assigning any reason.
  • Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.
  • Preference will be given to the Land Owners and also to the wards of employees as defined in the scheme.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates can contact the Helpline No. 033 7110 4262 between 10.00 Hours to 17.00 Hours on all working days.
  • The selected candidates will be allowed for training subject to being found medically fit based on Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a period of 15 months training and would be required to give an undertaking to the effect that they would complete the entire period of training unless otherwise removed by the company.
  • They shall maintain absolute integrity and maintain the secrecy of the documents they may come across during course of training.
  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates meeting the above requirements may apply ONLINE and upload scanned copy of certificates in CIL Online application portal in career page of CIL website (coalindia.in).
  • All the fields in the form need to be filled up.
  • Candidates must provide nine choices of posting of CIL/subsidiaries in preferential order.
  • Upload recent passport size color photograph.
  • Upload scanned image of candidate’s signature in dark blue or black ink.
  • Upload proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Matriculation/HSC Mark Sheet).
  • Upload copy of AADHAR Card.
  • Upload Intermediate Examination Certificate of CA/CMA & Mark Sheets of intermediate examination of CA/CMA in chronological order.
  • Upload Community Certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates.
  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.
  • Before registering/applying online, the candidates should ensure that they have a valid email ID, which should remain valid till the selection of trainee process is completed.
  • After submitting the application through online mode, a Registration-Cum-Application Form will be generated, which candidates are required to take print out of and submit along with copies of other uploaded documents at the time of certificate verification.
  • No manual/paper applications will be entertained directly.

Eligibility Criteria for MECON Recruitment 2025

1. Educational Qualification

The educational qualification requirements vary by post code:

Post Code 01: Junior Engineer (Mechanical) - 03 Posts

  • Qualification: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (Full Time/Regular)
  • Experience: Minimum 16 years of post qualification experience in construction/supervision of project in Hydrocarbon Industry (Hydrocarbon process plants, Hydrocarbon/Crude/Petroleum product/Oil/Gas Steel pipelines, Petrochemical plant, LPG plant, Refinery/POL depot, Gas compressor station, Petroleum product pumping station)
  • Marks Required: 60% for UR/OBC/EWS, 55% for SC/ST/PwD

Post Code 02: Junior Engineer (Mechanical) with NDT - 05 Posts

  • Qualification: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering & NDT Level-2 Certification (Full Time/Regular)
  • Experience: Minimum 16 years of post qualification experience in construction/supervision of project in Hydrocarbon industry
  • Marks Required: 60% for UR/OBC/EWS, 55% for SC/ST/PwD

Post Code 03: Junior Engineer (Civil) - 25 Posts

  • Qualification: Diploma in Civil Engineering (Full Time/Regular)
  • Experience: Minimum 16 years of post qualification experience in Design/Site Supervision for Building Construction/Industrial projects
  • Marks Required: 60% for UR/OBC/EWS, 55% for SC/ST/PwD

Post Code 04: Junior Engineer (Civil) - 05 Posts

  • Qualification: Diploma in Civil Engineering (Full Time/Regular)
  • Experience: Minimum 16 years of post qualification experience in Construction/Supervision of Industrial project preferably in Hydrocarbon Industry
  • Marks Required: 60% for UR/OBC/EWS, 55% for SC/ST/PwD

Post Code 05: Junior Engineer (Electrical) - 02 Posts

  • Qualification: Diploma in Electrical / Electrical and Electronics Engineering (or combination of engineering branches where electrical is one branch) (Full Time/Regular)
  • Experience: Minimum 16 years of post qualification experience in Design/Construction of Electrical works for Building/Infrastructure/Industrial Projects
  • Marks Required: 60% for UR/OBC/EWS, 55% for SC/ST/PwD

Post Code 06: Junior Officer (HR) - 02 Posts

  • Qualification: BBA / Graduate in any degree (Regular/Full Time/Open and Distance learning mode from UGC recognized university)
  • Experience: Minimum 16 years of post qualification experience in entire gamut of HR
  • Marks Required: 60% for UR/OBC/EWS, 55% for SC/ST/PwD

Post Code 07: Junior Officer (Admin) - 02 Posts

  • Qualification: BBA / Graduate in any degree (Regular/Full Time/Open and Distance learning mode from UGC recognized university)
  • Experience: Minimum 16 years of post qualification experience in administrative work
  • Marks Required: 60% for UR/OBC/EWS, 55% for SC/ST/PwD

Important Notes on Qualification:

  • The requisite educational qualification for post code 01 to 05 should have been acquired through a Regular/Full Time Course only
  • For post code 06 & 07 it should be acquired through Regular/Full Time/Open and Distance learning mode from UGC recognized university
  • Rounding of percentage (%) will not be acceptable under any circumstances i.e. 59.99% will not be rounded off as 60%
  • Wherever percentage of marks is not awarded and only grades are awarded, on a 10-point scale grade of 6.0 will be considered as 60%

2. Age Limit

The age limit for MECON Recruitment 2025 is:

  • Maximum Age: 50 years (as on 06/11/2025)
  • Age Relaxation:
    • 5 Years for SC/ST candidates
    • 3 Years for OBC (NCL) candidates
    • 10 Years for PwD (UR) candidates
    • 13 Years for PwD (OBC NCL) candidates
    • 15 Years for PwD (SC/ST) candidates
    • 5 Years for candidates who are domicile of J&K during 01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989
    • As per Government guidelines for Ex-Servicemen
  • Additional Age Relaxation: 01 year of age relaxation for every 01 year of additional experience, limited to maximum 03 years only
  • Maximum Age with Relaxation: 52 years
  • Cut-off Date: 06/11/2025 for deciding age and work experience

3. Nationality

Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.

4. Work Experience Requirements

  • The work experience shall be in full time job on regular salary basis and in relevant area as stipulated against respective posts
  • Period of on the job training undertaken as Management Trainee (MT)/Executive Trainee (ET)/Graduate Trainee (GT) in only PSUs shall be considered
  • Period of apprenticeship under Apprenticeship Act, 1961 and its amendments shall be considered
  • Articleship/Internship/Academic Project/Teaching/Research experience shall NOT be considered
  • Entrepreneurial experience and freelance experience will NOT be considered

Selection Process for MECON Recruitment 2025

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

Stage 1: Online Application Scrutiny

  • Verification of eligibility criteria, qualifications, and experience
  • Checking of uploaded documents

Stage 2: Shortlisting for Personal Interview

  • Shortlisting shall be done on or before the date of Interview
  • Based on scrutiny of applications and supporting documents
  • Merely possessing prescribed qualifications and experience does not entitle a person to be called for interview

Stage 3: Personal Interview

  • Provisionally shortlisted candidates will be called for Personal Interview
  • Interview date, time, and venue will be uploaded on MECON's website
  • Information will also be communicated through registered email IDs
  • Further scrutiny of documents will be done on the date of interview

Stage 4: Document Verification

  • All original certificates/documents must be produced at the time of interview
  • If any claim is not substantiated, candidate will not be allowed to appear for interview

Stage 5: Medical Examination

  • Selected candidates will undergo Medical Examination
  • Joining shall be subject to being found medically fit by Medical Board of Company's Hospital (Ispat Hospital, Shyamali, Ranchi)
  • Decision of Medical Board will be final and binding

Final Selection:

  • Final list of selected candidates will be uploaded on MECON's website
  • Candidates will be informed about reporting date through registered email IDs
  • The mode of selection may be changed at the discretion of Management

Note: The decision of Chairman & Managing Director, MECON Limited in all matters relating to selection will be final and binding.

Application Fee for MECON Recruitment 2025

  • General/OBC (NCL)/EWS Candidates: Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One Thousand only) - Non-Refundable
  • SC/ST/PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Internal Candidates: Exempted (No Fee)
  • Payment Mode: Online through payment gateway provided by MECON

Important Notes:

  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances
  • There will be no other mode of payment of application fee
  • Applications without fee/less fee shall be rejected
  • Candidates are advised to verify their eligibility criteria before applying

How to Apply for MECON Recruitment 2025?

Eligible candidates can apply online for MECON Recruitment 2025 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: www.meconlimited.co.in
  2. Go to "Careers" → "Career Opportunities" section
  3. Find the "Junior Engineer & Junior Officer Recruitment 2025" notification link
  4. Read the official notification carefully (Download PDF for reference)
  5. Click on "Click here to apply Online" link
  6. Register with your email ID, mobile number, and Aadhar number
  7. Fill in the application form with correct details:
    • Personal information
    • Educational qualifications with marks/percentage
    • Work experience details
    • Post preference and post code
    • Category details (if applicable)
  8. Upload required documents:
    • Recent passport-size colour photograph (JPG/JPEG, max 40 KB)
    • Signature with Blue/Black ink pen (JPG/JPEG, max 40 KB)
    • Matriculation/10th Certificate (for age proof)
    • Diploma/Graduation/Post-Graduation certificates
    • All semesters/years mark sheets or consolidated mark sheet
    • Work Experience Certificates/Documents
    • PAN Card and Aadhar Card (mandatory)
    • Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC NCL/EWS/PwD/Ex-Servicemen) if applicable
    • All documents should be self-attested, legible, and non-encrypted
    • Merge multiple documents into single PDF (max 1 MB)
  9. Pay the application fee online (Rs. 1000/- for General/OBC/EWS)
  10. Review all details carefully before final submission
  11. Submit the application form
  12. Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference
  13. Keep the printout for producing at the time of interview (if shortlisted)

For Candidates through Proper Channel:

  • Candidates employed in Central/State Government/PSU/Autonomous bodies should either:
    • Forward application through Proper Channel, OR
    • Produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview
  • For proper channel: Complete online application and forward hard copy to: "AGM I/c (HR), Recruitment Section, HR Department, MECON Limited, Doranda, Ranchi, Jharkhand - 834002" through present employer

Important Instructions for MECON Recruitment 2025

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply
  • Online application mode only - No other mode is allowed
  • Candidates should not wait till the last date and apply well within time
  • MECON shall not be responsible if candidates are unable to submit due to last minute rush
  • Read instructions carefully before filling online application
  • No modifications allowed after submitting the online application form
  • Each document uploaded should be duly self-attested
  • Documents should be legible and non-encrypted
  • Aadhar Card is mandatory - Any mismatch in Aadhar number will lead to rejection
  • Furnishing wrong/false information will lead to disqualification
  • Company takes no responsibility to collect any certificate/remittance sent separately
  • Candidates must produce all original certificates/documents at the time of interview
  • Certificates in languages other than Hindi/English should be accompanied by certified translation
  • SC/ST & OBC (NCL) candidates applying against UR posts shall be considered on General category merit
  • Mere submission of application gives no right for claiming employment
  • MECON reserves the right to:
    • Raise minimum eligibility standards for shortlisting
    • Fill or not fill or partially fill any vacancy
    • Increase/decrease vacancy without assigning reasons
    • Cancel/modify/alter the recruitment process
  • Candidates not shortlisted/not selected shall not be communicated
  • Canvassing in any form shall disqualify candidature
  • Any dispute will be settled within jurisdiction of Ranchi (Jharkhand) only
  • All correspondence shall be through email/notices on MECON website only
  • Candidates should retain same email ID and mobile number active for at least 1 year
  • No change in email ID & mobile number will be allowed after submission

Travelling Allowance (TA) for Interview

Out station candidates appearing for personal interview shall be reimbursed TA as follows:

Grade Travelling Allowance
E-0 III Tier A/C (3A)/ CC by Rail/Rs. 7 per Km by road or at actual, whichever is less, subject to production of receipt/ticket and/or boarding pass. Rail fare should be regular rail fare (No premium Tatkal).

Important:

  • Candidates must submit filled in TA form along with proof of travel (tickets for both onward & inward journey)
  • Bank account number and IFSC Code required for TA payment
  • If any claim is not substantiated at interview, no TA shall be paid
  • Without NOC (for employed candidates), no TA shall be paid

Eligibility Criteria for AIIMS Deoghar Senior Resident (Non-Academic) 2025

  • For Transfusion Medicine & Blood Bank, required qualification is MD (Transfusion Medicine & Blood Bank) or DNB (Transfusion Medicine & Blood Bank).

2. Age Limit

  • Upper age limit: 45 years as on the day of interview.
  • Relaxation: Up to 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and for OPH candidates up to 5 years (UR), 8 years (OBC), and 10 years (SC/ST) as per rules.
  • Candidates who have already completed 3 years of Senior Residency will not be considered.

3. Other Conditions

  • Eligibility with respect to age, qualification and experience is determined on the date of interview/written test.
  • Persons with disabilities must produce valid disability certificates from competent authorities at the time of interview.

  • OBC: Rs. 1000/-

  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview/written test.
  • Vacancies are subject to change at the discretion of Executive Director & CEO, AIIMS Deoghar.

How to Apply for AIIMS Deoghar Senior Resident (Non-Academic) Recruitment 2025?

  • Download the prescribed Offline Application Form for Senior Resident (Non-Academic) from the AIIMS Deoghar website.
  • Fill the form completely and paste a recent self-attested passport size colour photograph.
  • Attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents (DOB proof, MBBS/PG mark sheets and degrees, internship completion, attempt and experience certificates, registration certificates, caste/EWS/PwD certificates, NOC, etc.) along with the Demand Draft/NEFT proof of fee where applicable.
  • Send the filled application form with enclosures by Speed Post to “Registrar Office, 4th Floor, AIIMS Devipur (Academic Block), Deoghar – 814152, Jharkhand”, superscribing the envelope with “Application for the Post of SR in the Department of ___”.
  • Additionally, send a soft copy of the same application and enclosures as a single PDF (max 5 MB, legible) with fee proof to the email ID: [email protected].

Instructions

  • The appointment is full-time and private practice of any kind is strictly prohibited; candidates may be required to work in shifts and can be posted anywhere in the Institute as per administrative discretion.
  • Engagement is under Central Residency Scheme and CCS (Temporary Service) Rules; it does not confer any right to permanent absorption.
  • Canvassing in any form or furnishing false information will lead to disqualification and possible removal from service.
  • Candidates leaving/resigning/terminated before completion of tenure must give one month’s notice or pay salary in lieu of the shortfall period.
  • All updates including interview dates, changes, and results will be displayed only on the AIIMS Deoghar website; candidates must check it regularly.

Post Name Specialization No. of Posts
Functional Area Expert (FAE) in Ecology & Biodiversity (EB) Botany 1
Functional Area Expert (FAE) in Ecology & Biodiversity (EB) Zoology 1
Total Vacancies   2

Eligibility Criteria

To be eligible, candidates must hold a Master's degree in life sciences such as Zoology, Botany, Forestry, Environmental Science, Ecology, or similar fields from a recognized Indian university and be a citizen of India. A Ph.D. in a relevant discipline and previous accreditation with QCI as FAE (EB) are considered advantageous. Applicants need a minimum of 5 years of overall experience in Ecology & Biodiversity, with at least 3 years specifically in EIA-related work.

Salary/Stipend

Consultants will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹ 60,000/- based on attendance and performance. Additional allowances include ₹ 3,000/- per month for conveyance, ₹ 9,600/- per month for accommodation, and reimbursement for mobile bills up to ₹ 399/- per month. TA/DA for official tours will follow the entitlement rules for existing E3 grade executives of CIL.

Age Limit (as on 09-12-2025)

The maximum age limit for applicants is 65 years as of the advertisement publication date. The minimum age is not explicitly stated.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Publication Date 09.12.2025
Last Date for receipt of physical application forms via Speed Post/Registered Post 29.12.2025 by 5 pm
Interview Date(s) To be intimated via email and published on the website

Selection Process

The selection process involves screening of applications followed by an interview. Applications that meet the essential criteria will be scored, and up to five candidates per specialization will be shortlisted for a personal interview based on these scores. Interviews may be conducted virtually or physically at CMPDIL HQ in Ranchi, and the final results will be posted on the CMPDIL website.

General Information/Instructions

This is a purely contractual engagement for one year, potentially extendable by another year depending on performance and organizational needs. This is a consultancy arrangement, not an employer-employee relationship. The work location will be CMPDIL HQ in Ranchi or one of its Regional Institutes. Selected candidates must provide a Statement of Good Health before joining. The contract can be terminated by either party with one month's notice or payment in lieu thereof.

How To Apply

Interested applicants should download the application form (Annexure-I) from the CMPDIL website (www.cmpdi.co.in). The form must be filled out in black ink, signed with a self-signed photograph attached, and submitted along with self-attested copies of all required documents (age proof, educational certificates, experience, NOC if applicable). The completed application and enclosures should be sent in a sealed envelope via Speed Post or Registered Post to the specified address before the deadline. The envelope must be clearly marked "Application for the post of Consultant – FAE (EB) in CMPDIL". The application must reach the General Manager (Environment), 7th Floor, CMPDIL HQ, Gondwana Place, Kanke Road, Ranchi, Jharkhand – 834 008 by 5 pm on 29.12.2025.

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications (Department-wise)

Engg. in Instrumentation OR Instrumentation & Control OR Electronics & Instrumentation OR Electronics & Instrumentation & Control OR Industrial Instrumentation OR Process Control Instrumentation OR Electronics & Electrical OR Applied Electronics & Instrumentation OR Electronics & Communication OR Electronics & Control

  • Transportation: Degree in Engineering (any specialization) OR Full time regular MBA (Materials Management/Supply Chain Management) OR PG Diploma in Materials Management (02 years regular course recognized as equivalent to MBA by UGC/AICTE)
  • Human Resource: MBA/Integrated MBA/Post Graduate Degree or Diploma of minimum 02 years duration in HRM/Personnel Management & Industrial Relations from recognized University/Institute. Degree in Law (LLB) is desirable
  • Pharmacy: Degree in Pharmacy from an institute recognized by Pharmacy Council of India/AICTE. Must be registered as Pharmacist under Pharmacy Act, 1948 with valid License

Essential Educational Qualification Requirements

  • The prescribed essential/mandatory Educational Qualification should be completed on full time regular basis with minimum 60% marks, except for CA/CMA

  • Only Matriculation/10th certificate is the authentic document for verification of date of birth
  • All educational certificates other than Central Board/State Board shall be accompanied with Government notifications declaring equivalence
  • Computer Literacy is desirable for all candidates

Experience Requirements

  • General Manager (E-8): 26 years of post-qualification work experience
  • Deputy General Manager (E-7): 23 years of post-qualification work experience
  • Chief Manager (E-6): 20 years of post-qualification work experience

  • Work experience should be after acquiring relevant educational qualification and should be in-line executive experience
  • Management Trainee/Graduate Engineer Trainee experience counted only if regularized in same Company
  • Apprenticeship training under Apprentices Act, 1961 will not be counted as post-qualification executive work experience
  • Experience on contract basis through empaneled agencies/contractors (except in RFCL and its Promoter Organizations - NFL, EIL & FCIL) will not be considered
  • Preference will be given to candidates having in-line executive experience in Chemical and Fertilizer Industry

Desirable

  • Candidates with specific domain experience in respective departments as mentioned in detailed advertisement
  • Hands-on experience in continuous operating plants preferably in process industry
  • Conversance with latest practices, DCS control system, maintenance practices, troubleshooting
  • Computer literacy
  • For IT posts: Hands on experience of SAP shall be given preference

Salary/Stipend

  • E-2 (Assistant Manager): Rs. 50,000 - 1,60,000/- per month (CTC: Rs. 17.40 Lakhs per annum)
  • E-3 (Deputy Manager): Rs. 60,000 - 1,80,000/- per month (CTC: Rs. 20.88 Lakhs per annum)

  • E-5 (Senior Manager): Rs. 80,000 - 2,20,000/- per month (CTC: Rs. 27.84 Lakhs per annum)
  • E-6 (Chief Manager): Rs. 90,000 - 2,40,000/- per month (CTC: Rs. 31.32 Lakhs per annum)
  • E-7 (Deputy General Manager): Rs. 1,00,000 - 2,60,000/- per month (CTC: Rs. 34.80 Lakhs per annum)
  • E-8 (General Manager): Rs. 1,20,000 - 2,80,000/- per month (CTC: Rs. 41.76 Lakhs per annum)
  • Additional Benefits: Industrial Dearness Allowance, Company Accommodation/House Rent Allowance (not payable while posted at Unit where Company accommodation is available)
  • Other Perquisites: Leaves, Earned Leave Encashment, Medical Facilities, Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, Group Personal Accident Insurance & other welfare schemes as per Company rules
  • Performance Related Pay (PRP): Extended as and when applicable as per Company rules
  • Contributory Superannuation Benefit Fund Scheme: Extended as and when applicable as per Company rules

Age Limit (as on 15.01.2026)

  • General Manager (E-8): Maximum 55 years
  • Deputy General Manager (E-7): Maximum 50 years
  • Chief Manager (E-6): Maximum 50 years

  • Age Relaxation for candidates domiciled in J&K (01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989): 5 years
  • Maximum age after all relaxations: Should not exceed 56 years as on cutoff date

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - Scrutiny of Applications: Based on information in Application Form and submitted documents, candidates meeting eligibility criteria will be provisionally shortlisted
  • Stage 2 - Computer-Based Test (if required): In case of large number of applications, computer-based test in Delhi-NCR region and/or any other city(ies) of India may be conducted for shortlisting candidates. No TA/Boarding & Lodging facilities will be provided
  • Stage 3 - Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interview. Minimum qualifying marks: 50% average marks in interview
  • Merit List Preparation: In case of tie in total marks after personal interview, percentage of marks in qualifying examination will be considered. If percentage is also equal, date of birth will be considered (candidate born earlier will be senior)
  • Document Verification: Candidates will be called for personal interview provisionally. Those not meeting eligibility criteria or not in possession of complete requisite documents will not be allowed to attend interview
  • Travelling Allowance: - E-5 to E-8 posts: Single return air fare (economy class)/rail fare for AC I/Executive class chair car/road mileage at prescribed rates - E-1 to E-4 posts: To and fro single AC II return rail fare from nearest railway station to place of interview by shortest route
  • Medical Examination: Selected candidates will be medically examined and certified fit by Medical Officer of Company or Medical Officer not below rank of Civil Surgeon/Chief Medical Officer/Medical Superintendent of State/Government Hospitals
  • Character & Antecedents Verification: Appointment will be provisional and subject to verification of Character & Antecedents and Caste/PwBD Certificate from concerned District Authorities/Competent Authorities

  • EWS vacancies are tentative and subject to Government of India directives. Appointment against EWS vacancies shall be provisional
  • PwBD reservation is applied on horizontal inter-locking basis in either of UR/SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS vacancies

  • OBC candidates falling in creamy layer are not entitled to OBC reservation benefits and shall be treated as Unreserved candidates
  • Details once submitted in online application form will be final. No change in correspondence address/email/mobile/category shall be entertained
  • Candidates employed in Central/State Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies shall produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) at time of interview
  • Selected candidates shall initially be posted at Ramagundam Plant, Telangana or Corporate Office, Noida but may be posted anywhere in India at discretion of Management
  • Selected candidates would be required to work in general and/or rotating shifts (including night shift) depending upon job requirement
  • Candidates should possess valid email ID which should remain active for at least one and half year from cutoff date
  • All future communications shall be through email/SMS to candidates found prima-facie eligible
  • Canvassing in any form shall be considered disqualification for employment
  • In case it is detected at any stage that candidate does not fulfill eligibility criteria or furnished false information, candidature/appointment will be cancelled/terminated forthwith
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at New Delhi only
  • In case of any ambiguity/dispute, English version on website shall prevail

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit RFCL official website: https://www.rfcl.co.in → Careers section
  • Step 2: Read the complete advertisement carefully and ascertain eligibility before applying
  • Step 3: Click on online application link for Advertisement No: Rectt/02/2025
  • Step 4: Register with valid email ID and mobile number (mandatory). These should remain active for at least 1.5 years from cutoff date
  • Step 5: Fill the online application form with accurate details. Details can be edited/modified before final submission but once finally submitted cannot be changed
  • Step 6: Upload all required documents: - Educational qualification certificates - Experience certificates - Caste certificate (if applicable in prescribed format) - PwBD certificate (if applicable in prescribed format) - Other relevant documents
  • Step 7: Pay application fee online (if applicable): - Rs. 1000/- for E-5 to E-8 level posts (UR/OBC/EWS only) - Rs. 700/- for E-2 to E-4 level posts (UR/OBC/EWS only) - SC/ST/PwBD/ExSM/Departmental candidates exempted
  • Step 8: Submit the online application form and take printout for records
  • Step 9: Send hard copy of online application along with self-attested copies of all requisite supporting documents in sealed envelope super-scribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ……… IN RFCL - 02/2025" by post to:
    Chief General Manager (HR),
    Ramagundam Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited,
    Corporate Office,
    4th Floor, Wing – A, Kribhco Bhawan, Sector-1,
    Noida, Uttar Pradesh – 201301
  • Step 10: Ensure hard copy reaches by 22/01/2026 (29/01/2026 for far-flung areas). Candidates from far-flung areas should super-scribe "FAR-FLUNG AREA" on envelope
  • Important Notes: - Only one application per candidate per post is allowed - Incomplete applications or applications not supported by self-attested copies of relevant documents will be summarily rejected - Applications received at any other address of RFCL or after due date will be rejected - Keep copy of Application Form and Fee receipt for future reference - For issues related to form fill up & payment, contact: [email protected]

RFCL Multiple Posts Recruitment 2025 - FAQs

1. What is the starting date to apply for RFCL Multiple Posts 2025?

Ans: Starting Date to apply is 17/12/2025 at 08:00 HRS.

2. What is the last apply date for RFCL Multiple Posts 2025?

Ans: Last apply date is 15/01/2026 at 17:00 HRS for online application. Hard copy should reach by 22/01/2026 (29/01/2026 for far-flung areas).

3. What is the Eligibility to apply for RFCL Multiple Posts 2025?

Ans: Eligibility varies by post. Generally requires B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc.(Engg.), M.Sc., MBA, CA, CMA, MCA, or Degree in Pharmacy with minimum 60% marks on full-time regular basis, along with 4 to 26 years of relevant post-qualification work experience depending on the level of post.

4. What is the Maximum Age Limit to apply for RFCL Multiple Posts 2025?

Ans: Maximum age varies from 40 to 55 years depending on post level. Age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/ExSM as per Government guidelines.

5. How many vacancies are being recruited by RFCL Multiple Posts 2025?

Ans: Total 36 Vacancies across various departments (UR: 22, SC: 05, ST: 01, OBC: 04, EWS: 04, PwBD: 04).

6. What is the application fee for RFCL Multiple Posts 2025?

Ans: Rs. 700/- for E-2 to E-4 level and Rs. 1000/- for E-5 to E-8 level for UR/OBC/EWS candidates only. SC/ST/PwBD/ExSM/Departmental candidates are exempted from application fee.

7. What is the salary for RFCL Multiple Posts?

Ans: Salary ranges from Rs. 50,000 - 2,80,000/- per month (Level E-2 to E-8) with CTC ranging from Rs. 17.40 Lakhs to Rs. 41.76 Lakhs per annum, plus other allowances and benefits.

8. What is the cut-off date for reckoning eligibility criteria?

Ans: The cut-off date for determining eligibility in respect of age, minimum educational qualification and experience is 15/01/2026.

10. What is the selection process for RFCL Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Selection will be based on scrutiny of applications, computer-based test (if required for shortlisting), and personal interview. Candidates need to qualify interview with minimum 50% average marks. Final selection will be based on merit in personal interview.

Preliminary Evaluation Process for the merit list- 1. The highest percentage of marks obtained in Essential Qualification (5 Marks) 2. Having a desirable qualification (5 Marks) 3. Working Experience (10 Marks)
  • Candidate applying on deputation shall be given preference in the selection of the above positions based on the personal interview only.

General Information/Instructions

  • Headquartered in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh Medical Supplies Corporation Ltd. (UPMSCL) is registered under the Companies Act 2013 and set up with a seed capital of Rs. 20 Crores from the state exchequer. It is headed by an IAS officer and acts as the nodal organization for centralized procurement and distribution of drugs and equipment to Government Health Facilities in Uttar Pradesh.
  • UPMSCL' Vision is to ensure availability of quality drugs, medical equipment at lowest cost at all public health facilities
  • Besides procuring medicines and equipment, UPMSCL will also enter into private-public partnerships for bringing changes in the health sector.
  • 1) Ensuring coverage of all the essential drugs under Rate Contract;
  • 2) Facilitating supplier selection, contract negotiation and share of business allocation;
  • 3) Establishment and execution of Centralized procurement systems for the procurement of drugs, consumables and medical equipment in Uttar Pradesh;
  • 4) Ensuring quality control and availability of all the drugs & consumables and medical equipment at district drug warehouses, procured through UPMSCL;
  • 5) Ensuring timely payments to the suppliers against the procurement of drugs, consumables and medical equipment by UPMSCL;
  • 6) Maintaining records related to indents/ requirements, purchase orders, supply and consumption of drugs, consumables and medical equipment and support in the preparation of annual forecasting and budgeting process;
  • 7) Reconciliation of indents vs budgetary allocations and budget variance analysis for procurement of drugs, consumables and medical equipment;
  • 8) Procurement of medical equipment or other materials based on purchase requests received from others department / organization of Government of Uttar Pradesh.
  • For more information about the organization, please visit http://www.upmscl.in
  • UPMSCL is inviting applications from eligible candidates for General Manager (Equipment Procurement) in Equipment Procurement, position on Deputation/Contractual basis.
  • *For Contractual Positions are eligible for 3% annual increment up to max limit. If any selected candidate has last drawn salary is more than entry level of above structure, in this case offer may be increased by giving 3% hike on the last drawn salary but subject to max.
  • Applications not received in the prescribed format will be rejected. The application format may be downloaded from the website: upmscl.in.
  • Regular government employees are encouraged to apply on deputation.
  • Candidates are required to have a valid personal email ID / Mobile no. It should be kept active during this recruitment process. Under no circumstances, he/she should share/ mention email ID/ Mobile no. of any other person.

  • Candidates should send a duly filled-out Application Form with a recent passport-size photograph affixed thereon, along with self-attested copies of certificates in support of qualifications, experience, age, etc.
  • Any request for a change of address and enclosing supporting documents later on will not be entertained.
  • Candidates are requested to retain one copy of the duly filled application form and other testimonials with them.
  • Incomplete applications and those not supported by self-attested copies of certificates are liable to be summarily rejected.
  • Applications received after the due date will not be entertained. The Company is not responsible for any postal delays.
  • Regular government employees are encouraged to apply on deputation. In the case of the selection of the candidate on deputation, an NOC would be required from the parent department at the time of the interview.
  • Vacancies shall be subject to the State Reservation Policy of Uttar Pradesh.
  • Candidates having domicile of Uttar Pradesh state who are claiming reservation in their respective category must submit the Caste certificate along with permanent residential proof issued by the competent authority. A candidate having domicile of other state will be treated under the unreserved category.
  • For open market positions, it will be on a contractual basis, initially for a period of three years, extendable thereafter based on performance, and subject to further approval by UPM SCL. For deputation positions, it will be guided by the deputation rules.
  • UPM SCL reserves the right to cancel any or all positions at any stage of the recruitment process. The number of vacant positions may vary at any stage of the recruitment process.

The decision of P. Medical Supplies Corporation Ltd. in any matter relating to recruitment at any stage of the recruitment process will be final and binding upon the candidates.
  • Please note that July 1, 2025, shall be taken as a reference date for computing age, qualification, experience, etc.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel: At least 7 years practice in criminal cases; excellent knowledge and understanding of criminal law; excellent oral and written communication skills; proficiency in legal research; thorough understanding of ethical duties of a defence counsel; must have worked as defence counsel in at least 20 Sessions trial cases, attaching certified copies of Vakalatnamas for proof; proficiency in information technology.

Purba Bardhaman Health Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

Post Name Number of Posts
Community Health Officer (CHO)-BAMS 04 (EWS-1, SC-1, ST-1, UR-1)
Medical Officer (NUHM) 05 (SC-2, ST-1, OBC-B-2)

Total 44

Eligibility Criteria

  • Community Health Officer (CHO)-BAMS: Passed BAMS from recognized Institute/University. Must have registration certificate/provisional certificate from Paschim Banga Ayurved Parisad (West Bengal Ayurved Council). Proficiency in Bengali/local language and dialect. Desirable: Competency in MS Office & Internet
  • Medical Officer (NUHM): MBBS from MCI recognized institute with 1 year compulsory internship. Must be registered under West Bengal Medical Council
  • Staff Nurse (NUHM): Completed GNM training course from institute recognized by Indian Nursing Council/W.B. Nursing Council OR Completed B.Sc. Nursing Course. Must be registered under W.B. Nursing Council. Proficiency in local language. Must be permanent resident of West Bengal
  • Multi Rehabilitation Worker (NPHCE): Bachelor degree in Physiotherapy with at least 2 years of working experience in a hospital. Desirable: Master degree in Physiotherapy
  • Attendant (Female only) for NRC: Higher Secondary Passed with good command on Bengali language. Preference to local eligible candidates (preferably residing within 5 km from facility)

Salary/Stipend

  • Medical Officer (NUHM): Rs. 60,000/- per month Consolidated
  • Staff Nurse (NUHM): Rs. 25,000/- per month Consolidated
  • CHO-BAMS (After training): Rs. 20,000/- per month + Maximum incentive of Rs. 5,000/- per month as PLI based on approved parameters
  • Multi Rehabilitation Worker: Rs. 18,000/- per month Consolidated
  • CHO-Nursing (During training): Rs. 10,000/- per month as stipend
  • CHO-BAMS (During training): Rs. 10,000/- per month as stipend
  • Attendant (NRC): Rs. 5,000/- per month Consolidated

Age Limit (as on mentioned date)

  • Medical Officer: Maximum 67 years as on 01.01.2025
  • CHO-BAMS: Maximum 40 years as on 01.04.2025 (Age relaxation as per Government norms)
  • Staff Nurse: Maximum 40 years as on 01.01.2025 (Age relaxation as per Government norms)
  • Multi Rehabilitation Worker: Minimum 21 years and Maximum 40 years as on 01.01.2025
  • Attendant (NRC): Minimum 20 years and Maximum 40 years as on 01.01.2025 (Relaxation for SC, ST & OBC)

Application Fee

  • General/Unreserved candidates: Rs. 100/-
  • Reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/EWS): Rs. 50/-
  • Payment Mode: Bank deposit through NEFT OR Online payment
  • Bank Details for NEFT:
    • Account Name: DISTRICT HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE SAMITY (NON-NHM)
    • Account Number: 0187132000008
    • IFSC Code: CNRB0000187
  • Bank deposit copy (with UTR no.) OR receipt/screenshot of online payment must be submitted with printed copy of application during checking and verification

Important Dates

Notification Date 08/12/2025 & 09/12/2025
Online Application Start Date Available from 08/12/2025
Last Date for Online Application 24/12/2025
Document Verification Notice Within 31/12/2025

Selection Process

  • CHO-BAMS: Academic result (85%) + Interview (15%). Total Marks: 100
  • Medical Officer: MBBS Marks from Final Examination (80%) + PG degree (10 marks) + Diploma (5 marks) + Experience (10 marks). Total Marks: 100
  • Staff Nurse: Selection based on marks obtained in qualifying examination (proportionate marking)
  • Multi Rehabilitation Worker: Class X (10 marks proportionate) + Class XII (10 marks proportionate) + Bachelor degree in Physiotherapy (10 marks proportionate) + Master degree in Physiotherapy (5 marks additional) + Experience (10 marks) + Interview (5 marks). Total Marks: 50
  • Attendant (NRC): Madhyamik excluding additional marks (10 marks proportionate) + Higher Secondary excluding Environment & Additional marks, Best 5 including Bengali & English (20 marks proportionate). Total Marks: 30
  • Selection conducted by District Level Selection Committee, Purba Bardhaman
  • Panel list validity: One year from date of approval

How To Apply

  • Visit official website: www.wbhealth.gov.in
  • Navigate to Online Recruitment section
  • Fill up online application form carefully with all required details
  • Upload proper signature and photograph
  • Last date to fill up online application: 24/12/2025
  • Pay application fee through Bank NEFT or Online payment
  • Download hard copy/print copy of online registration form from link: https://hr.wbhealth.gov.in/Index.aspx → Application Print
  • Retain the print copy for document verification purpose
  • No need to send hard copy by post
  • For document verification, bring: Print copy of online application form, NEFT documents/receipt/screenshot of payment, and other supporting documents for age proof, caste, educational qualification etc.

Instructions

  • Applicant must be permanent resident of West Bengal
  • Applicant must have knowledge of local languages (should be able to read, write and speak in Bengali)
  • Age relaxation will be given for reserved candidates as per existing norms of State Government
  • Only online applications will be accepted
  • Application forms not properly filled in or incomplete will be liable to be cancelled
  • If online application details differ with original testimonials, application shall be liable to be cancelled
  • If proper signature and photograph are not uploaded, application shall be liable to be cancelled
  • Essential academic qualification must be completed on or before last date of online application
  • Candidates found ineligible at any stage will not be called for subsequent stages
  • Eligible candidates must go through all stages of recruitment. Skipping any stage will result in disqualification
  • All posts are purely contractual in nature with initial period of engagement up to March 2026
  • May be renewed for further period depending on satisfactory performance and approval of higher authority
  • If incumbent proposes to give her work without covering 1 month notice, remuneration will be adjusted accordingly
  • Decision of competent authorities regarding recruitment is final
  • Competent authorities may cancel recruitment process at any stage
  • For CHO posts (Nursing Category B and BAMS): Candidates must sign bond agreement to serve after successful completion of training. Failure to serve bond period requires payment of Rs. 2 lakhs
  • Experience certificate must consist of: Name of post, Employer's name, Employee's name, Date of joining, Date of leaving (otherwise invalid)
  • All marks must be calculated excluding marks of Additional Subject. No rounding off of marks will be granted. Proportionate marking up to 2 decimal points will be considered
  • For EWS (E.C) categories: As per Gazette Notification by Labour Department, Gov. of W.B., vide no. Labr/110-Emp/EC/1M-01/2025 dated 13/06/2025

Important Notes

  • Place of Posting:
    • CHO-Nursing & CHO-BAMS: Any operational SC-Suswasthya Kendra of Purba Bardhaman
    • Medical Officer & Staff Nurse: U-PHC of Burdwan, Kalna & Katwa ULB (Municipality)
    • Multi Rehabilitation Worker: Rural Hospital/BPHC of Purba Bardhaman
    • Attendant: NRC at BMCH of Purba Bardhaman
  • Provisional list for original testimonial verification will be published within 31st December 2025 on websites: www.purbabardhaman.nic.in and www.wbhealth.gov.in
  • If message "Duplicate Registration!" appears during online application (for candidates who have applied before for same post), enter last name two times in "* Enter Last Name:" field

Contact Details

  • Office: Office of the Chief Medical Officer of Health, District Health & Family Welfare Samity, Purba Bardhaman
  • Memo Numbers:
    • CHO-Nursing: 1026/DH&FWS/II-19/A
    • CHO-BAMS: 1027/DH&FWS/II-19/B
    • Medical Officer & Staff Nurse: 1029/DH&FWS/II-4
    • Multi Rehabilitation Worker: 1036/DH&FWS/II-9/A
    • Attendant: 1035/DH&FWS/II-18/C
  • Date: 08/12/2025 & 09/12/2025

Sl. No. Name of Posts UR TOTAL
1 Operator (Crane) on Contract Basis 1 1
2 Operator (MHE & Transporter) on contract basis 1 1
Total   2 2

Eligibility Criteria

  • Applicants must be Indian citizens.
  • For Operator (Crane):
    • Education: Pass in SSLC and ITI –NTC (National Trade Certificate) in the trade of Fitter/Machinist/Electrician/Electronic Mechanic.
    • Experience: Minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in operating cranes in a relevant company (Shipbuilding, Engineering, Logistics, Government/Semi-Government).
    • Desirable: Radio remote operation, electrical maintenance of cranes, working knowledge in Hindi/Bengali.
  • For Operator (MHE & Transporter):
    • Education: Pass in SSLC and ITI –NTC (National Trade Certificate) in any trade.
    • Experience: Minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in operating Material Handling Equipment (MHE).
    • Desirable: Good communication skills and working knowledge in Hindi/Bengali.
  • Experience acquired after the date of passing the qualification shall only be considered.

Salary/Stipend

  • The consolidated pay for candidates meeting the minimum experience requirement (3 years) is ₹23,300/- per month.
  • They are also eligible for compensation for extra hours of work up to ₹5,830/- per month.
  • Higher pay may be offered to candidates with experience beyond the minimum 3 years, subject to technical review.

Age Limit (as on 29-12-2025)

  • The upper age limit prescribed for the posts shall not exceed 45 years.
  • Applicants should be born on or after 30 December 1980.
  • Age relaxation for Ex-servicemen is applicable as per Government of India Guidelines, but the total age shall not exceed 50 years.

Application Fee

  • An application fee of ₹300/- (Non-refundable, plus bank charges extra) should be remitted using online payment options (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking/wallets/UPI etc.).
  • The fee is applicable to all candidates except those belonging to the SC/ST category.
  • Applications will only be considered upon receipt of the application fee (if applicable).

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 09.12.2025
Commencement of Online Application 09.12.2025 (10:00 hrs)
Last Date of Online Application 29.12.2025
Experience/Eligibility Cut-off Date 29.12.2025

Selection Process

  • The method of selection involves two phases:
    • Phase I: Objective Type Test (30 marks) - General (10) and Trade related (20).
    • Phase II: Practical Test (70 marks) - Qualifying grades converted into marks.
  • The objective test will be 35 minutes duration with 30 MCQs. There will be no negative marks.
  • Minimum pass marks in each test for unreserved candidates is 50% (Hooghly CSL may relax if candidates are insufficient).
  • Candidates must pass certificate verification to be shortlisted for the Practical test.

How To Apply

  • Applicants must apply online via the website www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page -> Hooghly CSL) or www.hooghlycsl.com (Career page).
  • Online application facility is available from 09.12.2025 to 29.12.2025.
  • Applicants should not submit more than one application.
  • All certificates for age, qualification, experience, caste, and a recent photograph must be uploaded in the online portal.
  • Applicants need not send the online application printout/certificates/fee by post.
  • A printout of the online application with the unique registration number should be retained for future correspondence.

Instructions

  • The posts are purely temporary/contractual in nature for a maximum period of five years.
  • The job involves working at heights and materials handling; PwBD candidates should not apply due to safety risks.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the selection process.
  • Candidates must frequently check the Hooghly CSL website for updates related to the selection process and to download call letters.
  • Mere application submission does not confer any right to employment.
  • Legal proceedings shall be instituted only in the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Howrah/Kolkata.

  • CSIR-CMERI will not undertake detailed scrutiny of applications for the eligibility and other aspects before Physical and Personality Assessment Test / Written Examination and, therefore, candidature of each of the applicant will be purely provisional. Candidates must go through the requirements of essential qualification (EQ), experience, age, physical and medical standards etc. and satisfy themselves that they are eligible for the post. The scanned copies of the certificates/documents in support of their Educational Qualifications, Caste/Category, Essential Experience, previous employment, ‘No Objection Certificate’ from present employer etc. are required to be uploaded on the online portal while applying for the post. The document verification of the certificates of EQ, essential experience, caste/ category, etc., will be conducted / carried out at later stage and if during the verification, it is found that the candidate does not possess the required essential qualification, etc. as per the advertisement or any claim made in the application is not substantiated by certificates/ documents, the candidature of candidate will be cancelled. No enquiry for clarification as to eligibility will be entertained.
  • Date of Birth filled by the candidate in the online application form and the same recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary Examination Certificate will only be accepted for determining the age and no subsequent request for change will be considered or granted.
  • The candidate should mention, in the online application, all the qualifications and experience in the relevant area supported by documents and ensure that all details are complete and accurate. The candidates must fill in their Name, Date of Birth, and father’s name/mother’s name in the online application strictly as given in the SSC/Matriculation/10th Standard certificate. In case, a candidate claims a change of his/her name after matriculation or marriage or remarriage or divorce etc., then it should also be mentioned in the respective field in the online application and the Candidate claiming a change in name must submit a copy of Gazette Notification/Affidavit from the appropriate authority in support of change of name/mismatch in name/ variation in name of candidate/ parents (if applicable).
  • The period of experience rendered by a candidate on part time basis, daily wages etc will not be counted while calculating the valid experience for the post.
  • The prescribed qualification should have been obtained through recognized Institutions, etc. The prescribed essential qualifications are the minimum mentioned against the post. Mere possession of the same does not entitle a candidate to be called for Physical test and/or written test for selection. If on verification either before or after at any of the stages of selection process, it is found that a candidate does not fulfil any of the eligibility conditions, his/her candidature/selection will be summarily rejected/cancelled forthwith.
  • The candidate should ensure to submit her/his application complete in all respect along with the required certificates/documents in support of relevant educational qualification, caste/ community, age, experience, discharge book, etc., as attachments.
  • Incomplete applications i.e. application without photograph or unclear photograph, unsigned application, without application fee (wherever applicable), etc. and without required documents / certificates/ undertaking in support of claims made by the candidates in the Online application form, are liable to be rejected. Any discrepancy found between the information given in application and as evident in original documents will make the candidate ineligible for the post.
  • If any document/Certificate furnished is in a language other than Hindi or English, a transcript thereof in Hindi/English of the same duly attested by a Gazetted Officer or Notary has to be submitted.
  • Applicants working in Government Departments, Autonomous Bodies, Public Sector Undertakings and government funded Research Agencies, etc. as a regular employee must inform their department or office and upload a ‘NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE’ (NOC) from their present employer at the time of submitting the online application (as per attached format), failing which their candidature will NOT be considered.
  • The decision of the CSIR-CMERI/ CSIR in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, action for furnishing false information/claims, mode of selection and conduction of physical/ written test, etc. will be final and binding on the candidates. CSIR-CMERI reserves the right to cancel the advertisement or reserves the right not to fill up the post without assigning any reason thereof.
  • The selection process is subject to the CSIR/GoI instructions prevalent at a given point of time during various stages of selection process.
  • This is to be noted that, if any declaration given or information furnished by a candidate is found to be false or if he/she is found to have willfully suppressed any material information, his/her candidature may be cancelled at any stage and/or he/she will be liable to removal from service even after joining and such other action(s) as deemed necessary may be taken by the Competent Authority.
  • The incumbent shall be placed on probation for a specified period from the date of his joining the post. The probationary period may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the Competent Authority. After successful completion of the probationary period, he/ she will be considered for continuation in accordance with the extant rules.
  • Applicant must disclose as to whether any of his/her close or blood relative(s) is/are employee(s) of CSIR-CMERI or CSIR or any other laboratory/ Institute of CSIR, in the Application Form.
  • Candidates shall not be reimbursed / paid any Travelling Allowance / Daily Allowance for appearing for Physical/ Written test.
  • The recruitment for the above post is governed by the rules for Isolated Category of staff as amended from time to time. Hence all other terms and conditions not stipulated herein will be applicable as per the said Recruitment Rules.
  • The selected candidate shall serve under the administrative control of the Director of the Institute.
  • Canvassing in any form and /or bringing in any influence political or otherwise will be treated as a disqualification for the post.
  • Further, notifications regarding selection, details of eligible candidates to be called for physical test and written examination and any updates/ subsequent information / notification / corrigendum / addendum regarding this recruitment drive shall be notified on the CSIR-CMERI website only. Hence, applicants are advised to visit regularly the Institute website i.e. https://www.cmeri.res.in.
  • The Director, CSIR-CMERI reserves the right to cancel the advertisement, amend, delete and add terms & conditions to this Advertisement without assigning any reason thereof.
  • NO INTERIM ENQUIRY OR CORRESPONDENCE WILL BE ENTERTAINED.

How to Apply

  • Eligible and interested candidates are required to apply online through CSIR-CMERI official website http://www.cmeri.res.in only. No other mode of application will be considered.
  • If a candidate does not have a valid E-mail ID, he/she should create a new valid e-mail ID before applying online. Candidate must enter his/her correct and active e-mail ID and mobile number in the online application, as communication shall be made by the CSIR-CMERI through this number / email ID only. The registered email address should be active till the completion of recruitment process.
  • For online application process please refer “How-to-apply online” instructions, “Fee Payment Procedure’, etc. available on the above- mentioned website. Candidates are advised to go through the instructions for filling of the online application carefully.
  • The online application is to be submitted in six distinct steps, as below: a. Registration b. Primary Details c. Educational and Employment details d. Online Payment e. Upload Certificate details f. Application submission
  • The deadlines for the above-mentioned stages of application are as follows: -  Start Date for commencement of submission of Online application: 06.12.2025 at 10:00 AM.  Last Date for submission of Online application: 05.01.2026 at 05.00 PM.
  • The Candidate is required to upload his/her recent passport size scanned colour photograph, signature and also relevant certificates at the specified places in the online application portal. In case the face in the photograph is blurred or unclear or signature or essential documents uploaded is unclear / smudged, the candidate’s application shall be rejected.
  • If a candidate submits multiple online applications using different email ID, only the last completed application will be considered. Candidates should retain a copy of the application print-out and the payment details for their records.
  • The candidate must register with his/her name, email ID. After successful registration, the candidate can log in using his/her credentials to apply through the Online Application Portal. Once the application form is completed, the candidate can upload all relevant supporting documents and verify the application to ensure it is accurate and complete. After finalizing the application, the candidate must click 'Submit' button and upload/enter the payment details, if applicable, to successfully submit the application form. Once the application is submitted, no further modifications or amendments will be permitted. It is important to keep a printout of the completed application form. Candidates should NOT send a hard copy of the application after submission. They will be requested to submit a hard copy at the appropriate time which will be notified subsequently.

NIPER Kolkata Teaching and Non-Teaching Posts Recruitment 2025 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research Kolkata (NIPER Kolkata)
Post Name Professor, Associate Professor, Finance & Account Officer, Estate & Security Officer, Public Relation Officer
No of Posts 05
Salary Pay Level 8 to Pay Level 14 (7th CPC) + DA, HRA, TA and other allowances
Qualification Ph.D., Post Graduate Degree, Bachelor Degree (as per post requirements)
Age Limit 35 to 50 years (varies by post)
Start Date for Apply 10.12.2025
Last Date for Apply 09.01.2026

NIPER Kolkata Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

Designation Total Posts
Teaching Posts
Professor 1
Associate Professor* 1
Non-Teaching Posts
Finance & Account Officer 1
Estate & Security Officer 1
Public Relation Officer* 1
Total Vacancies 5

Eligibility Criteria

T-01: Professor (Medicinal Chemistry)

  • Essential Qualifications: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent grade at the preceding degree in the appropriate branch with very good academic record throughout
  • Experience: At least 10 years of Teaching/Research/Industrial experience with published works of high quality, well recognized and established reputation of having made conspicuous seminal contribution to knowledge in Pharmaceutical and allied areas
  • Desirable:
    • Expertise in Pharmacoinformatics/computational chemistry/Cheminformatics/Bioinformatics with strong knowledge in development of various software and webservers in drug discovery and development
    • Exposure in HPC (High Performance Computing) is preferable
    • Proven publication record in molecular docking, molecular dynamics, quantum medicinal chemistry, virtual screening QSAR (all from own independent work)
    • Experience in Artificial Intelligence in Drug Discovery is an added advantage
    • Preference to candidates with ability to collaborate with experimental pharmaceutical scientists
    • Experience in establishing computational facilities, software installation, system administration, bug fixing
    • Demonstrated adequate experience of independent Research in terms of guided Masters' students and minimum of 2 PhD students
    • Preference to candidates having minimum of 3 years' experience at the level of Associate Professor or equivalent industry experience
    • Completed EMR or Industry sponsored projects, technology transfers, strong record of undertaking consultancy work, Patents, demonstrated excellence in teaching

T-02: Associate Professor (Pharmaceutical Analysis)

  • Essential Qualifications: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent grade at the preceding degree in the appropriate branch with very good academic record throughout
  • Experience: At least 8 years of Teaching/Research/Industrial experience with published works of high quality, well recognized and established reputation of having made conspicuous seminal contribution to knowledge in Pharmaceutical and allied areas
  • Desirable:
    • Preference to candidates having Post Graduate Degree in Pharmaceutical Analysis
    • Experience and expertise in pharmaceutical and bio-analytical techniques, AQbD, impurity profiling, data integrity, cGMP, GLP, ICH guidelines, instruments' calibration, validation and regulatory requirements of DCGI, USFDA etc.
    • Hands-on experience in handling sophisticated instruments like HPLC, LC-MS-MS and GC-MS
    • Experience in using instruments for analysis of API/finished dosage forms as per IP, USP, BP
    • Knowledge in characterization of biological products and stability testing, trouble shooting skills
    • Demonstrated adequate experience of independent research in terms of guided Masters' students and at least one Ph.D. student
    • Execution and/or recipients of sponsored/EMR projects and publication in SCI journals

NT-01: Finance & Accounts Officer

  • Essential Qualifications: Post-Graduation in Commerce/Economics from a recognized University/Institution
  • Experience: 10 (Ten) years of experience in dealing with Finance and Accounts in Central/State Govt. organizations/University/Research Institutions or Central/State Autonomous Bodies/other recognized Institutions of repute
  • Desirable:
    • Five/Eight years of experience at Pay Level-11/10 dealing with Finance and Accounts
    • MBA in finance from a recognized University/Institution
    • Conversant with operation of computers for accounting software like Tally, etc.

NT-02: Estate & Security Officer

  • Essential Qualifications: Bachelor degree in any discipline from a recognized university/institute
  • Experience: Five (05) years of experience in commissioned service in Army/Navy/Air Force/Para Military Force or Police only not below the rank of captain or equivalent/Dy. SP of police
  • Desirable: Experience in constructing and management of Civil/Electrical works of educational buildings and security arrangement to the institutes/campus & Hostels

NT-03: Public Relation Officer

  • Essential Qualifications: Post Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university/institute
  • Experience: At least Five (05) years of experience in Public Relation/Training and Placement Cell in Central/State Govt. Organizations or University/Research Institute or Central/State autonomous/other recognized institute of repute
  • Desirable:
    • MBA or Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Mass Communication
    • Ability to compose & edit press releases, newsletters
    • Preference to candidates having experience in placement activities
    • Experience in coordinating with central/state Govt./PSU/autonomous organizations
    • Experience in logistic arrangement of dignitaries/guest including hospitality arrangements for conferences/events/meetings

Salary/Stipend

  • T-01 Professor: Pay Level 14 (7th CPC)
  • T-02 Associate Professor: Pay Level 13 (7th CPC)
  • NT-01 Finance & Account Officer: Pay Level 12 (7th CPC)
  • NT-02 Estate & Security Officer: Pay Level 10 (7th CPC)
  • NT-03 Public Relation Officer: Pay Level 8 (7th CPC)
  • Additional Benefits:
    • Dearness Allowance (DA)
    • House Rent Allowance (HRA)
    • Transport Allowance (TA)
    • Reimbursement of Medical Expenses
    • Leave Travel Concession
    • Children Education Allowance
    • National Pension System (defined contribution)

Age Limit (as on 09-01-2026)

  • T-01 Professor: Not exceeding 50 years (for Direct Recruitment)
  • T-02 Associate Professor: Not exceeding 45 years (3 years relaxation for OBC-NCL = 48 years)
  • NT-01 Finance & Account Officer: Not exceeding 45 years for Direct Recruitment; Not exceeding 56 years for Deputation
  • NT-02 Estate & Security Officer: Not exceeding 45 years
  • NT-03 Public Relation Officer: Not exceeding 35 years (3 years relaxation for OBC-NCL = 38 years)
  • Age Relaxation as per Government of India Rules:
    • OBC (NCL): 3 years against reserved posts only
    • SC/ST: 5 years against reserved posts only
    • Departmental Candidates: Relaxable up to 5 years as per norms for Direct Recruitment (For NIPER candidates selected through appropriate selection committee)
    • For Deputation (T-01, T-02): 3 years prior to superannuation in the parent organization
  • Note: Age limit and eligibility conditions shall be reckoned as on the last date for submission of online applications i.e., 09.01.2026

Application Fee

Category Application Fee Mode of Payment
Teaching Posts (All) Rs. 2,000/- Online Only
Non-Teaching Posts (Pay Level 10 and above) Rs. 2,000/- Online Only
Other Non-Teaching Posts (Below Pay Level 10) Rs. 1,000/- Online Only
SC/ST Candidates NIL (No Fee) -
Persons with Disability (PwD) NIL (No Fee) -
Women Candidates NIL (No Fee) -
Deputation Applicants NIL (No Fee) -
  • Important Note: The fee once paid will not be refunded or re-adjusted under any circumstances

Important Dates

Event Date Time
Notification Date 10.12.2025 -
Date of Commencement of Online Application 10.12.2025 10:00 AM
Last Date of Receipt of Online Application & Payment of Fees 09.01.2026 06:00 PM
Last Date of Receipt of Hard Copy of Successfully Submitted Online Application at NIPER-Kolkata along with all Enclosures 23.01.2026 05:00 PM
Last Date for In-Person Submission of Hard Copy at Institute 23.01.2026 11:00 AM to 05:00 PM (Working Days)
Last Date for Applications Through Proper Channel (for Govt/PSU employees) 15 days after 23.01.2026 -

Selection Process

For Teaching Posts (T-01 to T-02):

  • Phase 1: Seminar Presentation
  • Phase 2: Interview
  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to give seminar presentation before a duly constituted Committee
  • Only the candidates recommended by the Committee based on their performance in the seminar presentation shall attend the Interview before the Selection Panel
  • No separate call letter will be sent by post; email communication will only be sent
  • Candidates advised to visit website https://niperkolkata.edu.in regularly

For Non-Teaching Posts:

  • NT-01 (Finance & Account Officer): Performance in the Interview
  • NT-02 & NT-03: Written Test, Skill Test/Performance in the Interview
  • Selected candidates based on the written test will be called for Skill Test/Interview

Additional Selection Information:

  • Admission to Written Test/Skill Test/Interview is strictly provisional
  • Director/Screening Committee reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on educational qualification/experience/papers published
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be called for Interview/Written Test/Skill Test
  • Online interviews can be arranged for overseas candidates only (subject to submission of request and approval by competent authority)
  • No TA/DA and accommodation shall be provided for attending the Written test/Skill test/Interview

General Information/Instructions

  • The applicant must be a Citizen of India
  • Application once submitted cannot be altered/resubmitted under any circumstances
  • Candidates can apply for more than one post if they fulfill the eligibility criteria; separate application and fee required for each post
  • Incomplete online application or hard copy without relevant supporting documents will be rejected
  • Mere fulfillment of minimum qualifications and experience does not entitle any candidate to receive call letter
  • Applicants serving in Govt./Semi-Govt./PSUs/Autonomous organization must send application "Through Proper Channel" with No Objection Certificate
  • Applicants on deputation must submit APARs of last 3 years, Vigilance clearance certificate and Integrity Certificate
  • Selection Committee reserves rights to recommend higher initial pay and position to exceptionally qualified candidates
  • Maximum age limit and eligibility conditions reckoned as on last date for online application submission (09.01.2026)
  • Experience for Teaching posts considered from date of completion of Master's Degree, excluding experience while pursuing Ph.D.
  • Appointments under Direct Recruitment: Regular with probation period of 1 year (T-01, T-02, NT-01) and 2 years (NT-02, NT-03)
  • Deputation is for 3 years, extendable as per GoI norms at institute's discretion
  • Reservations for SC, ST, OBC(NCL) and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities as per existing Government of India norms
  • Candidates must produce original testimonials at time of interview
  • The institute will not be responsible for non-receipt of applications due to postal delay/loss
  • Candidates who obtained degrees from institutions declared fake/derecognized by UGC/AICTE/PCI not eligible
  • Canvassing in any form may lead to disqualification
  • Any dispute arising from this advertisement shall be subject to sole jurisdiction of Hon'ble Courts at Kolkata only
  • All correspondence will be through email only as per details in application form
  • Applicants advised to regularly visit Institute's Website for any corrigendum/addendum

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official website: www.niperkolkata.edu.in
  • Step 2: Click on the appropriate link for online application:
    • For Teaching Posts: https://niperkrecruitment.in/teaching/
    • For Non-Teaching Posts: https://niperkrecruitment.in/nonteaching/
  • Step 3: Fill in the online application form with correct details (ensure all data is accurate before submission)
  • Step 4: Upload required documents (self-attested copies):
    • Date of Birth Certificate/Degree Certificates
    • Mark sheets
    • Experience Certificates
    • Category Certificate (if applicable)
    • No Objection Certificate (for Government employees)
    • For Ph.D. candidates: Documents for date of registration and completion
  • Step 5: Pay the application fee online (if applicable)
  • Step 6: Submit the online application and download the PDF of completed form
  • Step 7: Take a printout of the successfully submitted online application
  • Step 8: Send the hard copy along with all self-attested documents by Registered/Speed Post/Courier to:

    The Registrar I/c
    NIPER-Kolkata
    168, Chunilal Bhawan
    Maniktala Main Road
    Kolkata - 700054
     
  • Step 9: Superscribe the envelope with "Name of the Post Applied", "Post Code" and "Advertisement No. NIPER-K/P-VII/2025"
  • Step 10: Alternatively, submit hard copy in person at the institute during 11 AM to 5 PM on all working days up to 23.01.2026
  • Step 11: Hard copy must reach the Institute on or before 23.01.2026 up to 05:00 PM
  • Step 12: Keep checking email and official website regularly for updates on selection process
  • Important: Each application must be sent in a separate envelope containing only one application
  • Note for Government Employees: Send advance copy before due date; final application must be received through proper channel within 15 days of closing date

  • Applicant should possess MBBS degree of any university recognized by the Medical Council of India in the Allopathic system of medicine.

  • Applicant should have a minimum of two (02) years’ post qualification experience practicing Allopathic system of medicine in any hospital or clinic as a Medical Practitioner.
