Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Chartered Accountant (CA) conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
  • OR candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates who have undergone training under similar scheme for one year or more in any other PSUs will not be eligible to apply.
  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

Salary/Stipend

  • The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is purely for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.
  • The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • There should be no misconception or claims by the beneficiary for employment in CIL or its subsidiaries on completion of training.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date)

  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for UR/EWS category is 28 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for OBC (NCL) category is 31 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for SC/ST category is 33 years.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL and 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit to SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates is not applicable for consideration against unreserved posts.
  • Crucial date for claim of SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD status or any other benefit viz. reservation, upper age limit etc. where not specified otherwise, will be the 1st date of the month in which advertisement has been published.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

 

Selection Process

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.
  • Students would be required to give choice of 9 companies (in the order of preference) among CIL or its subsidiary companies i.e. CIL (HQ), ECL, BCCL, CCL, CMPDIL, NCL, MCL, SECL & WCL.
  • Selection will be based on the merit ranking based on marks obtained in Intermediate Exam and posting will be done based on the preference of posting given and seniority position in the Merit List.
  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.
  • In case there is shortfall in joining in the original panel, then this shortfall (for the respective category) will be filled from the Waiting List Panel.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates are informed that applying for engagement as Industrial Trainee shall not give them the right to be engaged as trainee in the company and company reserves the right to reject any candidate without assigning any reason.
  • Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.
  • Preference will be given to the Land Owners and also to the wards of employees as defined in the scheme.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates can contact the Helpline No. 033 7110 4262 between 10.00 Hours to 17.00 Hours on all working days.
  • The selected candidates will be allowed for training subject to being found medically fit based on Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a period of 15 months training and would be required to give an undertaking to the effect that they would complete the entire period of training unless otherwise removed by the company.
  • They shall maintain absolute integrity and maintain the secrecy of the documents they may come across during course of training.
  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates meeting the above requirements may apply ONLINE and upload scanned copy of certificates in CIL Online application portal in career page of CIL website (coalindia.in).
  • All the fields in the form need to be filled up.
  • Candidates must provide nine choices of posting of CIL/subsidiaries in preferential order.
  • Upload recent passport size color photograph.
  • Upload scanned image of candidate’s signature in dark blue or black ink.
  • Upload proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Matriculation/HSC Mark Sheet).
  • Upload copy of AADHAR Card.
  • Upload Intermediate Examination Certificate of CA/CMA & Mark Sheets of intermediate examination of CA/CMA in chronological order.
  • Upload Community Certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates.
  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.
  • Before registering/applying online, the candidates should ensure that they have a valid email ID, which should remain valid till the selection of trainee process is completed.
  • After submitting the application through online mode, a Registration-Cum-Application Form will be generated, which candidates are required to take print out of and submit along with copies of other uploaded documents at the time of certificate verification.
  • No manual/paper applications will be entertained directly.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: Under graduation (Regular – Full time) in any discipline from a University / Institution recognized by AICTE / DOTE / UGC. The candidates should have appeared for the examination, passed and received the degree certificate in any of the years from July 2021 to 2025.
  • Essential qualifications: Candidates must have passed their Graduation not earlier than 01.07.2021. Candidate with 100% complete profile on the Apprenticeship portal only are eligible to apply.
  • Experience: The candidate possesses one year or more of work experience in any Government, Government Undertaking, or Private Organization as on 01.12.2025. (Not eligible if have experience)

Salary/Stipend

  • A monthly stipend of Rs. 9,000/- shall be paid to the apprentice during the period of apprenticeship training. The Apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances/ benefits.
  • United India Insurance Company will make a payment of 4,500/- into the apprentices account on a monthly basis.
  • Government share of Stipend of Rs. 4500 will be directly credited to the Apprentices Bank account through DBT mode as per extant guidelines.
  • The stipend shall be paid to Apprentices each month after adjusting Loss of pay, If any.

Age Limit (as on 01-12-2025)

  • Minimum Age—21 years
  • Maximum Age -28 years
  • [i.e. candidates must have been born not earlier than 01.12.1997 and not later than 01.12.2004 (both days inclusive)]
  • Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable as per Government of India guidelines for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates.

Important Dates

Activity Date
Online Application Starting Date 18.12.2025
Last date for applying “UNITED INDIA INSURANCE CO. LTD” 20.01.2026
Physical appearance for verification of documents of shortlisted candidates at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd Call letter will be sent through Registered Email ID

Selection Process

  • The shortlisting shall be carried out based on the percentage of marks (up to two decimal places) secured in the qualifying Graduate Degree Examination, subject to the candidate fulfilling all the prescribed eligibility criteria.
  • Where the result of the qualifying examination is declared in the form of CGPA / OGPA / GPA, the same shall be converted into percentage by multiplying the obtained grade by a factor of 10 (ten), and such converted percentage shall be indicated in the online application form.
  • In cases where two or more candidates secure the same percentage of marks, their position in the merit list shall be determined according to their date of birth, with the older candidate being placed higher in the order of merit.
  • Shortlisted Candidates will be intimated through their registered Email IDs only. Shortlisted candidates will have to appear in person for verification of documents at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd, the details of which will be intimated in due course.
  • The final engagement list will be prepared after verifying all the details entered by the respective candidate in the NATS portal against the original documents and shall be subject to the availability of vacancies in the respective state.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should take utmost care to furnish the details while filling in application.
  • Company reserves right to reject ineligible candidate's applications at any stage of the selection process.
  • All correspondence will be made only on the email ID mentioned by the candidate in their online application form and same has to be kept active for receiving all communications from Company related to Apprenticeship Training program.
  • Incomplete applications / applications without supporting documents will be rejected outright. Company takes no responsibility to receive/ collect any certificate/ document sent separately.
  • The name of the candidate should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the certificates/ mark sheets. Any change/ alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Candidates are advised not to change their appearance till the engagement process is complete.
  • Decision of the Company in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents to be produced for the purpose of the conduct of selection and any other matter relating to selection process will be final and binding on the candidate. Company reserves the right to modify/ amend/ cancel any of the eligibility criteria and/or any other terms and conditions spelt out in this Notification.
  • The shortlisted candidates are required to produce original documents pertaining to Age, Qualification, etc. for verification. If any candidate is found ineligible while verifying the documents, he / she shall not be allowed to join Apprenticeship Program.
  • Mere submission of application and apparently fulfilling the criteria as prescribed in the advertisement do not entitle a candidate to be called for Apprenticeship program.
  • Canvassing in any form for training seats will be treated as disqualification.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of engagement of apprentice that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he has furnished any incorrect /false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), including in unfair practices in the process, his/her candidature will be cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after engagement, his/her contract of Apprenticeship Training is liable to be terminated without any compensation or claim whatsoever.
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to submit their applications well in time before the last date for submission and Company does not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications within the last date on account of the reasons beyond the control of the Company.
  • Shortlisted candidates shall be required to produce all requisite original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, in support of their eligibility, educational qualification, and identity at the time of document verification. Failure to produce the required documents, at the time of verification shall render the candidate ineligible for further participation in the engagement process.
  • Further, non-submission of requisite documents by the candidate at the time of engagement shall result in cancellation of candidature and debarment from any subsequent stage of the Apprenticeship engagement process.
  • Candidates must ensure that the following documents are clearly uploaded in their NATS student profile: Degree Certificate, Provisional Certificate, Consolidated Mark sheet, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook (in the candidate's name), Latest Passport-size Photograph.
  • Candidates must ensure that all details entered in the student profile match the information on their educational documents, including: Candidate's Name, Parents' Names, Aadhaar Number, Educational qualification.

How to Apply

  • For students who have already enrolled in the National Web Portal and having login details: Login, search for "UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LTD" under "Apply against advertised vacancies", click apply.
  • For first time enrollment: Go to https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student Register, complete form, get Enrollment Number, then login and apply as above.
  • Upload the B.E / B.Tech/ B.A./ B.Sc., / B.Com.,/ BBA/ BCA etc., Provisional Certificate (or) Consolidated Mark Sheet. Percentage of marks in the Graduate / Non Engg, Graduate Examination is mandatory. Hence candidates are advised to compulsorily enter percentage of marks in the column "% of marks / CGPAx10" in the NATS portal.

Must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and have knowledge of local language.
  • Block Data Manager: Graduate from any recognized university and have completed at least 1 year Diploma course in Computer Application. Minimum 3 years experience in Government Sector or 5 years experience in Private Sector in data recording and data analysis. Must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and have knowledge of local language.
  • Psychiatrist (NMHP): MBBS with Post Graduate Degree (MD/DNB) or Diploma (DPM) in Psychiatry awarded by a UGC recognized University and recognized by NMC. Must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and have knowledge of local language.
  • Municipality Accounts Manager under NUHM: B.Com (From UGC recognized Universities) with 2 Years experience in Accounts & Finance and proficiency in Tally Accounting Software & MS Office. Must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and have knowledge of local language.
  • Psychiatric Nurse (NMHP): B.Sc in Psychiatric Nursing / M.Sc in Psychiatric Nursing / DPN. Must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and have knowledge of local language.
  • Psychiatric Social Worker: Master of Social Work (MSW) or M.Phil in Psychiatric Social Work of 2 years duration, with minimum 1 year experience from any recognized institution. Must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and have knowledge of local language.
  • Audiologist under NPPCD: Bachelor in Audiology & Speech language Pathology / B. Sc. (Speech & Hearing) from RCI recognized Institute. Must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and have knowledge of local language.
  • Dental Hygienist (NOHP) under NHM: Diploma in Dental Hygienist Course from a DCI recognized Institute, valid registration from WB Dental Council, and at least 2 years of experience. Must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and have knowledge of local language.
  • Dental Technician (NOHP) under NHM: Passed Higher Secondary Examination (10+2) with Physics, Chemistry and Biology AND Two Years Diploma Course in Dental Technology, with valid registration from WB Dental Council. Must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and have knowledge of local language.
  • Clinical Psychologist (NMHP) under NHM: Having a recognized qualification in Clinical Psychology from an RCI approved institution OR Post Graduate degree in Psychology/Clinical Psychology/Applied Psychology AND M.Phil in Clinical Psychology/Medical and Social Psychology. Minimum one year experience from any recognized institution.
  • Yoga Professional (Block Level) under NPCDCS Programme (NAM): Secondary / Madhyamik passed and One year Yoga Certificate / Diploma in Yoga from recognized university/ Institute. The candidate must be registered with WBCYN.
  • Pharmacist (Homoeopathy) (Block Level) under NPCDCS Programme (NAM): Madhyamik / Secondary passed and Diploma/ Certificate course in Homoeopathic pharmacy, with computer knowledge.
  • Pharmacist (Ayurveda) (Block Level) under NPCDCS Programme (NAM): Madhyamik / Secondary passed and Diploma/ Certificate course in Ayurvedic pharmacy, with computer knowledge.
  • Male Yoga Instructor at AYUSH HWC under National AYUSH Mission (NAM): Secondary / Madhyamik passed and One year Yoga and Naturopathy Certificate/Degree/Diploma course run by WBCYN, and registered with WBCYN.
  • Female Yoga Instructor at AYUSH HWC under National AYUSH Mission (NAM): Secondary / Madhyamik passed and One year Yoga and Naturopathy Certificate/Degree/Diploma course run by WBCYN, and registered with WBCYN. 

Salary/Stipend

ISI Research Associate Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total Posts
Research Associate 01

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: Ph.D. degree in a field relevant to PAMU (e.g., Condensed Matter Physics, Classical & Quantum Gravity, Fluid Mechanics, Nonlinear Dynamics, Quantum Information).
  • Essential qualifications: A good academic record throughout, at least one publication in SCI journal based on the Ph.D. work. Candidates who have submitted their thesis may also apply.
  • Desirable: Interests matching faculty members of PAMU.
  • Experience: Age relaxation may be given to candidates with relevant experience. Experience is wherever prescribed in the rules.

Salary/Stipend

  • Remuneration is as per the rules outlined in OM No.SR/S9/Z-0872018 dated 30 January 2019, and the availability of funds.
  • Salary Unit: Per month (implied).

Age Limit (as on 24-12-2025)

  • The upper age limit shall be 35 years as of December 24, 2025.
  • Usual relaxation is available for SC/ST/OBC/Women/differently abled candidates.
  • Age relaxation may also be given to outstanding candidates or candidates with relevant experience.

Important Dates

Event Date (dd/mm/yyyy)
Notification Date 08/12/2025
Last Date for Application Submission (via email) 24/12/2025
Last Date for Recommendation Letters to be sent 24/12/2025

Selection Process

  • CVs with incomplete information or without supporting documents will be summarily rejected.
  • Mere fulfilling the essential qualification/experience does not guarantee selection.
  • A written test in the subject area will be held, if required, to shortlist candidates for the interview depending upon the number of candidates.
  • Shortlisted candidates need to make an open presentation followed by an interaction with the selectors (interview).
  • Selected candidates must produce all original documents for verification at the time of joining and a medical fitness certificate.

General Information/Instructions

  • The post is purely contractual, and the candidate will have no right to claim permanent employment under ISI Kolkata.
  • The tenure of appointment will be up to March 31, 2026, which may be extended later based on availability of funds and performance, up to a maximum of two years.
  • The Institute does not have residential facilities for contractual staff.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or joining the post.
  • The Institute reserves the right not to appoint anyone.

How to Apply

  • Eligible and interested candidates should apply with a cover letter and curriculum vitae merged as a single PDF file.
  • The single PDF should be emailed to: [email protected].
  • The email subject line must be: "Application for RA position".
  • The application must include specific details: Name, Address, Email, Phone, Parent's/Spouse's Name, Date of birth, Academic Qualifications (from 10th class onwards), brief write-up on proposed research plan, List of publications, Experience (if any), ID Proof, SC/ST/OBC/Differently abled status, and self-attested soft copies of all documents/testimonials.
  • Two recommendation letters, one from the thesis supervisor, must be sent directly by the recommender to the same email address, with the subject header "Reference letter for <name of the candidate>".
  • All application material must be submitted by December 24, 2025.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and must have knowledge of local languages.
  • Block Data Manager: Graduate from any recognized university and must have completed at least 1 year Diploma course in Computer Application from Government Registered Institution.
  • Block Data Manager: Working knowledge of computer with operating knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Access and Internet.
  • Block Data Manager: Minimum 3 years’ experience in Government sector or 5 years’ experience in Private sector in data recording and data analysis.
  • Specialist Medical Officer: MBBS from any Medical College with PG Degree/PG Diploma in concerned speciality.
  • Specialist Medical Officer: Must have WBMC registration certificate.
  • All essential qualifications must be completed on or before the date of advertisement and cut off date of experience, if any, will be treated as the date of advertisement.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2025)

  • Block Data Manager: Minimum 21 years and maximum 40 years as on 1st January 2025.
  • Specialist Medical Officer: Upper age limit 67 years or less.
  • Age relaxation will be as per Government norms for reserved categories, subject to valid certificates of West Bengal.

Application Fee

  • Application fee of Rs. 100/- for Unreserved categories.
  • Application fee of Rs. 50/- for Reserved categories.
  • Fees have to be paid online.
  • The application fee amount is non-refundable.

Salary/Stipend

  • Block Data Manager under XV FC-HG: Monthly consolidated remuneration of Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • Specialist Medical Officer under XV FC-HG at Polyclinic: Rs. 3,000/- per day, thrice a week, on part time basis.

Selection Process

  • Candidates who are found eligible during the evaluation of online recruitment data duly filled by the candidates will be called for documents verification.
  • The essential qualifications mentioned are minimum and mere possession of the same does not entitle candidates to claim selection.
  • If aggregate marks after final selection are equal, preference will be given to the candidate who is senior in age as on the first date of the year of publication of the advertisement.
  • The decision of the District Level Selection Committee (DLSC) Paschim Bardhaman is final at every step of the recruitment process.
  • The panel of candidates will be valid for one year from the date of approval; vacancies arising due to non-joining, resignation, termination, retirement or other causes may be filled from the panel within the validity period.

How To Apply

  • Eligible candidates may apply online through the WB Health portal.
  • Applicants are requested to visit https://hr.wbhealth.gov.in for online application on and from 7th December 2025 onwards.
  • Only online applications will be accepted; application forms not properly filled in or incomplete are liable to be cancelled.
  • If online application details differ from original testimonials, the application shall be liable to be cancelled.
  • Candidates working in Government organisations must route their applications through proper channel if required by their department rules and must produce NOC at the time of interview.
  • Hard copy/print copy of online registration form should be downloaded from the specified link and retained for document verification; it need not be sent by post.
  • Applicants are requested to visit www.wbhealth.gov.in at the URL “Recruitment” regularly for instructions and information issued from time to time.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Recruitment Notice (Advertisement Date) 05/12/2025
Start date for online application 07/12/2025
Last date of Registration & online fees payment 21/12/2025
Last date of Online submission of Application 23/12/2025

Instructions

  • The applicant must be permanent resident of West Bengal and must have knowledge of local languages.
  • The number of vacancies may be changed or the recruitment process may be cancelled at any level as per decision of the District Level Selection Committee.
  • Passport, Voter ID Card or Aadhaar Card will only be accepted as photo cum address proof.
  • Age proof certificate such as Birth Certificate, admit card or school leaving certificate issued by West Bengal Board of Secondary Education or similar board will only be treated as valid proof of age.
  • Caste category certificate must clearly mention the caste category; otherwise the candidate will be treated as Unreserved.
  • All candidates applying under EWS/SC/ST/OBC(A)/OBC(B) must submit valid certificates issued by competent authorities of West Bengal, as per applicable Government orders.
  • Only certificates issued in the State of West Bengal will be accepted for reservation benefits.
  • If caste certificate is not submitted or found invalid at any stage, candidature will be treated as cancelled or Unreserved as decided by DLSC.
  • Online registration number should be retained by all applicants for future reference; the employer is not liable to provide this number later.
  • Any corrigendum, addendum, date/time/venue of interview, shortlisting details or other notices will be published on www.wbhealth.gov.in.

Eligibility Criteria for WBMSC Assistant Engineer (Civil) 2025

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering from recognized University or equivalent from a recognized university/board to apply for WBMSC Assistant Engineer positions.

2. Age Limit

The age limit for WBMSC Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2025 is:

  • Maximum Age: 36 years
  • Age Relaxation: As per government norms (SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen)
  • Age calculation date: As mentioned in official notification

3. Nationality

Candidates must be Indian citizens or as specified in the official notification.

Selection Process for WBMSC Assistant Engineer (Civil) 2025

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

The Examination will be held in Kolkata center only and in two successive stages, viz. (1)     Written Test (Multiple choice Objective type) (2) Personality Test, as detailed below:    

(1) Written Test: 200 marks    

The OMR based Written Examination of 200 marks consisting of 100 multiple choices,     objective type questions carrying 02 (two) marks each will be conducted. There will be negative marking of 01 (one) mark each for every incorrect / wrong answer. Question will be set in English and time     allowed will be 1 & ½ (One & half) hours.    

(2) Personality Test: 40 marks    

The Personality test will be held at the Commission's office in Kolkata. Based on merit.     candidates of 3 (three) times the number of vacancies, will be called for Personality test subject to     verification of original documents and obtaining qualifying marks @ 45% for General Candidates, a 40% for O.B.C. & EWS Candidates and @ 35% for S.C., S.T. & PWD candidates. The Commission shall have discretion to relax qualifying marks of any or all categories of candidate applied for the examination. After the said verification, eligible candidates will be allowed to appear for Interview / Personality Test. The candidature of the candidates absenting themselves on the date of Interview / Personality test will be cancelled without making any reference to them.    

Final merit list will be prepared on the basis of total marks obtained by the candidates in the written examination and Personality test.If more than one candidate obtains the same aggregate (total marks), the merit position of the Candidates shall be determined according to their date of birth, i.c., candidates with earlier date of birth shall be preferred and if the aggregate marks and also the date of birth be the same the candidates obtaining higher marks in Written Examination shall be preferred.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Dental Technician (NOHP): Passed Higher Secondary (10+2) with Physics, Chemistry, Biology from WBCHSE or equivalent. Two years Diploma in Dental Technology from recognized institution. Valid registration from West Bengal Dental Council. One year experience after acquiring Diploma in West Bengal Government Hospital or licensed Clinical Establishment
  • Clinical Psychologist (NMHP): Recognized qualification in Clinical Psychology approved by Rehabilitation Council of India OR Post Graduate degree in Psychology/Clinical Psychology/Applied Psychology and M.Phil in Clinical Psychology or Medical and Social Psychology from UGC recognized University. Minimum 1 year experience from recognized institution
  • Psychiatric Nurse: B.Sc. in Psychiatric Nursing/M.Sc. in Psychiatric Nursing/DPN
  • Co-ordinator (Finance & Logistic): Inter CA/Inter ICWA/M.Com or MBA (Finance/Material Management) with knowledge of computer. Desirable: At least 3 years experience in accounting including analysis, financial reporting, budgeting, financial software and reporting system
  • Para Medical Worker (NLEP): B.Sc./MSW with 3 years experience in Public Health OR Passed Higher Secondary and holding PMW Training certificate. Working knowledge of computer. Desirable: Experience in Leprosy activities
  • Laboratory Technician (Blood Bank/BCSU): Degree in Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) OR Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in MLT (M.Sc. in MLT/PGDMLT) from recognized University/Institution. Desirable: Six months post qualification experience in blood testing/preparation of blood components (for Degree/PG holders) OR One year experience (for Diploma holders in DMLT/DLT)
  • Technical Supervisor (Blood Bank): Passed HS (10+2) with Physics, Chemistry & Biology/Mathematics. Diploma in MLT (DMLT/DLT) OR Degree in MLT (BMLT) OR Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in MLT (M.Sc. in MLT/PGDMLT) from recognized institution. Working knowledge of computers. Desirable: Six months post qualification experience (for Degree/PG holders) OR One year experience (for Diploma holders)
  • Medical Technologist (Optometry): HS pass or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and two-year Diploma in Medical Technology in Optometry recognized by West Bengal Para Medical Council OR Bachelor Degree in Medical Technology in Optometry from recognized institution/university. Desirable: Working experience in concerned field
  • Nutritionist (NRC): B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Food and Nutrition or equivalent course with computer knowledge. Should be able to read, write and speak in Bengali
  • Social Worker (NRC) (Female only): Graduate degree (BA/BSc/BCom) from recognized university. One year diploma in computer application from recognized university. Computer knowledge required in Windows XP/7, MS Office 2010 (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), Internet experience. Good communication in local language

Last Date for Online Registration 23/12/2025
Last Date for Submission 24/12/2025

Selection Process

  • Selection will be conducted by District Level Selection Committee (DLSC), Purulia
  • Selection process varies by post and includes:
    • Written Test/MCQ based examination
    • Educational qualification marks (proportionate marking)
    • Experience marks
    • Computer knowledge test (for applicable posts)
    • Personal Interview
  • Total marks: 100 for all posts (except Social Worker NRC: 55 marks)
  • For detailed selection criteria for each post, refer to the official notification

How To Apply

  • Visit www.wbhealth.gov.in
  • Navigate to E-Governance → Online Recruitment
  • Apply online from 10.12.2025 (10:00 hrs) to 23.12.2025
  • Fill the application form carefully with all required details
  • Upload all necessary documents as per requirements
  • Candidates are not required to send any physical documents to the office

  • Any omission or suppression of information will result in rejection of application or cancellation of candidature at any stage
  • Prescribed conditions are non-relaxable

  • Duration of experience, post held, nature of work, and employer's signature with date must be clearly mentioned in experience certificate

  • District Health & Family Welfare Samiti reserves the right to cancel recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason

District Legal Services Authority (DLSA), Alipurduar, invites applications for lawyers to be engaged full-time on a contractual basis at the newly approved Legal Aid Defence Counsel Office (LADCS). This recruitment drive aims to fill a total of 6 posts across three cadres: Chief, Deputy, and Assistant Legal Aid Defence Counsel. The positions offer a monthly honorarium ranging from ₹35,000 to ₹85,000, depending on the role and experience.

Eligible candidates must possess a Law Degree, be enrolled with the Bar Council, and have relevant experience in criminal law practice (0 to 10 years). The application window is open from December 18, 2025, with a last date to apply of December 26, 2025 (5 PM). The selection process includes a written test scheduled for January 11, 2026, followed by an interview at a later date. Successful candidates must commit to full-time duties and may not engage in private practice during their engagement.

Vacancy Details

A total of 6 positions are available for contractual full-time engagement at the Legal Aid Defence Counsel Office (LADCS) under DLSA, Alipurduar.

Post Name Total Post Count
Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel 01
Deputy Legal Aid Defense Counsel 02
Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel 03

Eligibility Criteria

All engagements are on a contractual basis for 1 year (further extension on satisfactory performance as per NALSA guidelines and decision of WBSLSA).

  • Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel:
    • Practice in Criminal law for at least 10 years.
    • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
    • Excellent understanding of criminal Law.
    • Thorough understanding of ethical duties of defense counsel.
    • Ability to work effectively and efficiently with others with capability to lead, quality to lead the team with capacity to manage the office.
    • Must have handled at least 30 criminal trials in Sessions Courts (may be relaxed as per note below).
    • Knowledge of computer system, preferable.
  • Deputy Legal Aid Defense Counsel:
    • Practice in Criminal law for at least 7 years.
    • Excellent understanding of criminal law.
    • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
    • Skill in legal research.
    • Thorough understanding of ethical duties of defense counsel.
    • Ability to work effectively and efficiently with others.
    • Must have handled at least 20 criminal trials in Sessions Courts (maybe relaxed as per note below).
    • IT Knowledge with proficiency in work.
  • Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel:
    • Practice in criminal law from 0 to 3 years.
    • Good oral and written communication skills.
    • Thorough understanding of ethical duties of defense counsel.
    • Ability to work effectively and efficiently with others.
    • Excellent writing and research skills.
    • IT Knowledge with proficiency in work.

Salary/Stipend

The Legal Aid Defense Counsels will be paid Honorarium/retainership fee as per the "Legal Aid Defense Counsel Systems Modified Scheme-2022":

Post Monthly Honorarium / Retainership Fee
Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel Rs. 85,000/-
Deputy Legal Aid Defense Counsel Rs. 60,000/- each
Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel Rs. 35,000/- each

Important Dates

Event Date
Invitation for Applications commences from 18/12/2025 (10 AM onwards)
Last Date to apply 26/12/2025 (till 5 PM)
Scrutiny of Applications commences 29/12/2025
Date for commencement of admit card/ call letter 05/01/2026
Written Test 11/01/2026
Interview Date To be decided later

Selection Process

The selection procedure involves a fair, transparent, and competitive process including a written test and an interview.

  • Selection will be based purely on merit, taking into account the knowledge, skills, practice, and experience of the candidate.
  • A Selection Committee under the Chairmanship of the Ld. District & Sessions Judge will conduct the process.
  • Successful candidates will be listed in order of merit, subject to final approval by the Honb'le Executive Chairman, WB SLSA.

General Information/Instructions

  • The Legal Aid Defense Counsel Office deals exclusively with legal aid matters in criminal cases within the District.
  • Personnel must devote full time to duties and shall not engage in private practice of law during the term of engagement.
  • Applications must use the specific Bio Data form available from the official website or DLSA office/notice-board.
  • Applications received after the due date/time shall not be considered.
  • All correspondence and intimations will be made only through e-mails provided by the candidates.

How To Apply

Candidates must submit the duly filled application form along with self-attested copies of supporting documents either physically or through speed post:

  • Download the application form from the official website of the Alipurduar District Court (http://alipurduar.dcourts.gov.in) or collect from the office of DLSA.
  • Fill the form and attach self-attested copies of educational qualifications, Bar Council enrollment, photo ID, address proof, ITR for last 3 years (if available), and computer skill certificates.
  • Submit the application in a sealed envelope superscribing the name of the post applied for.
  • Address for submission: "The Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Alipurduar District Court Complex, 1st Floor of Addl. District & Sessions Judge Court, Alipurduar, Pin - 736122".
  • Ensure the application reaches before 5 PM on December 26, 2025.

  • Evidence Act & B.S.A.
  • All Special Acts (Criminal)
  • Matrimonial Laws (Criminal Cases)
  • Criminal Rules and Orders
  • Information and Technology Act

General Information/Instructions

  • Admit Card will be issued to the eligible candidates on their e-mail i.d provided in the application form
  • Only names of shortlisted candidates will be published on the court website for interview on the basis of marks obtained in the written examination
  • The venue and time of written examination and details of interview will be intimated in Jhargram District Court website (https://jhargram.dcourts.gov.in/)
  • Candidates should appear for the interview with their original certificates
  • Incomplete application will be rejected without assigning any reasons. No application will be entertained after the last date-fixed
  • All communications regarding the selection process will be published only on the Jhargram District Court website
  • A separate communication letter will not be sent to the applicants
  • For any other details candidates may refer to LADCS Modified Scheme 2022 published by National Legal Services Authority
  • Eligible Candidates List for written examination will be Published in website (https://jhargram.dcourts.gov.in/)

Code of Ethics:

Personnel engaged in the office of Legal Aid Defense Counsel shall observe the following conditions/code of ethics:

  • Personnel within the office of Legal Aid Defense Counsel shall not engage in any outside activity or act as an independent practitioner
  • No personnel shall act in any matter in which he/she has a direct or indirect personal or financial interest
  • No personnel shall willfully disclose or use, whether or not for the purpose of pecuniary gain, any information that he/she obtained, received or acquired during the fulfillment of his/her official duties and which is not available to members of the general public
  • No personnel within the office of Legal Aid Defense Counsel shall make use of his/her office or employment for the purpose of advertising any outside activity
  • No personnel within the office of Legal Aid Defense Counsel shall solicit, agree to accept or accept, whether directly or indirectly, any gift, favour, service or other thing of value under circumstances from which it might be reasonably inferred that such gift, service, or other thing of value was given or offered for the purpose of influencing him/her in the discharge of his/her official duties
  • Legal Aid Defense Counsel shall devote his/her full time to his/her duties for the office of Legal Aid Defense Counsel and shall not engage in private practice
  • Every Personnel of the office of Legal Aid Defense Counsel shall strive to preserve the public's confidence in the office's fair and impartial discharge of its duties and responsibilities
  • Legal Aid Defense Counsel shall also follow the code of ethics prescribed by Bar Council of India for lawyers

Termination of Services:

Services of any Human Resource/Staff including Legal Aid Defense Counsel engaged in the office of Legal Aid Defense Counsel may be terminated, without any time, without any prior notice in the following cases:

  • He/she substantially breaches any duty or service required in the office
  • Seeks or accepts any pecuniary gains from the legal aid seekers
  • Charged or Convicted for any offence
  • Indulges in any type of political activities
  • Found incapable of rendering professional services of the required standards
  • Failure to attend training programmes without any sufficient cause
  • Indulges in activities prejudicial to the working of Legal Aid Defense Counsel Office
  • Uses his/her position in the Legal Aid Defense Counsel office to secure unwarranted privileges or advantages for him/herself or others
  • Acts in breach of code of ethics
  • Remains absent without leave for more than two weeks

How to Apply

  • The standard form of application annexed with this notification shall be used for applying the above said post
  • Self attested education qualification certificates, experience certificate and three recently taken passport size photo/2 photographs to be attached (and another pasted on application form) must be annexed with the application
  • The duly filled in application in the prescribed format along with self-attested Copy of certificates and all other supportive documents should be submitted at a drop box at the office of DLSA, Jhargram on working days
  • Application can also be sent by speed post to the address: "In The Chairman, Selection Committee, Office of the District Legal Services Authority, Jhargram, ADR Building, District Judge's Court Compound, Jhargram, PIN-721507" which must reach before 26.12.2025, (Upto 5:00 p.m.) only
  • Incomplete application will be rejected without assigning any reasons

Eligibility Criteria for ISI Kolkata Project Linked JRF 2025

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must have first class (or CGPA 6.0 and above out of 10) M.Sc. in Geology, Applied Geology or Earth Sciences. They must have qualified CSIR-UGC NET (including LS/PhD) or GATE examination as the required eligibility criterion.

2. Age Limit

The age of the candidate should not exceed 35 years as on 25 December 2025, with usual relaxation applicable for SC, ST, OBC, Women and differently abled candidates as per rules. Additionally, essential qualification notes candidates should be below 28 years at the time of application.

3. Nationality

The position is under an Indian government funded project and is open to eligible candidates as per institutional and national norms.

Salary/Stipend

  • Consolidated pay of ₹37,000 per month for the Project Linked JRF.
  • In addition, 27% House Rent Allowance (HRA) per month is admissible.
  • The post is purely temporary with no claim for permanent employment in ISI Kolkata or continuation in any other project.

Selection Process for ISI Kolkata Project Linked JRF 2025

Candidates will be shortlisted based on eligibility and applications and may be required to appear in a written test in the subject area, followed by an interview. The shortlisted candidates will be informed by email about the mode and date of interview.

  • Screening of applications and documents submitted through Google Form and email.
  • Written test, if required, to shortlist candidates for interview.
  • Interview of shortlisted candidates; original certificates will be verified at the time of interview/joining.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or joining the post.

How to Apply for ISI Kolkata Project Linked JRF Recruitment 2025?

Eligible candidates can apply online for ISI Kolkata Project Linked JRF 2025 by following these steps.

  1. Fill the Google Form at https://forms.gle/C2HTygctpy6kkR1h8 with personal details, eligibility (NET/GATE) and academic qualifications from 10th standard onward.
  2. Upload self-attested documents in the form: covering letter mentioning project name, signed current resume, passport size photograph, ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID), caste/disability certificate (if applicable) and recommendation letter.
  3. Download the response PDF generated after submitting the Google Form.
  4. Email the response PDF to [email protected] with cc to [email protected] with subject “Application for JRF Fracture Network Characterization of Borehole Cores from the Koyna-Warna Seismic Zone, Western Maharashtra, India.”
  5. Ensure that the application reaches positively by 25 December 2025 addressed to the Professor-in-Charge, Physics & Earth Sciences Division, ISI Kolkata.
  6. Arrange for one recommendation letter from a teacher/academic mentor to be sent directly by the recommender to the same email IDs.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Staff Nurse:
    • Completed GNM training course from an Institute recognized by the Indian Nursing Council / West Bengal Nursing Council. OR
    • The candidate should have completed B.Sc. Nursing Course.
    • Must be registered under West Bengal Nursing Council
    • Candidate should have proficiency in local language.
  • Laboratory Technician:
    • Higher Secondary passed (10+2) from a recognised Board/ Institute with Physics, Chemistry and Biology / Mathematics.
    • Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT recognized by the West Bengal State Medical Faculty/AICTE
    • Basic Knowledge in computer, MS Office, Internet.
  • Pharmacist:
    • The candidate should have Two years Diploma in Pharmacy (D-Pharma) (ALLOPATHIC) recognized by the Government of WB and registered as 'A' category Pharmacist under West Bengal Pharmacy Council.
    • Weightage will be given for higher qualification. The candidate must have proficiency in Bengali and must have efficiency in computers including MS Office & Internet.
    • The applicants must be permanent resident of West Bengal.
  • Community Health Assistant - Urban:
    • Must have passed ANM / GNM course from an Institute recognised by the Indian Nursing Council and be registered with the West Bengal Nursing Council. Should be proficient in Bengali and permanent resident of the district for which application is made.

Salary/Stipend

  • Staff Nurse: ₹25,000/- per month
  • Laboratory Technician: ₹22,000/- per month
  • Pharmacist: ₹22,000/- per month
  • Community Health Assistant - Urban: ₹13,000/- per month

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2025)

  • Staff Nurse: Upper age limit 64 years
  • Laboratory Technician: Upper age limit 40 years
  • Pharmacist: Lower age limit 18 years & Upper age limit 40 years
  • Community Health Assistant - Urban: Lower age limit 21 years & Upper age limit 40 years
  • Age relaxation as per Government norms

Application Fee

  • Unreserved Categories: ₹100/-
  • Reserved Categories: ₹50/-
  • Payment Mode: Online (non-refundable)

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 05/12/2025
Online Application Start 07/12/2025
Last Date for Registration & Online Fee Payment 21/12/2025
Last Date for Online Submission of Application 23/12/2025

Selection Process

  • Staff Nurse: Total Marks-100 (Proportionate on Percentage of marks achieved in GNM or B.Sc Nursing)
  • Laboratory Technician: Total Marks-100 [DMLT-85 Marks proportionally on % of marks obtained in final examination; Computer Test-15 Marks]
  • Pharmacist: Total Marks 100 [Academic- 85 Marks (M. Pharma 85, B. Pharma 75, D. Pharma 65- Proportionate Marking- only one achievement will be considered); Computer Test-15 Marks (Qualifying Marks-minimum 50%)]
  • Community Health Assistant - Urban: Total Marks-100 (Proportionate on Percentage of marks achieved in ANM or GNM)
  • Marking after rounding off up to 2 decimal points will be considered
  • If the aggregate marks after final selection is equal then preference is to be given to the candidate inter se-senior in age as on the 1st date of the year of publication of the advertisement

General Information/Instructions

  • The Applicant must be permanent resident of West Bengal and must have knowledge of local Languages
  • The number of vacancies may be changed or recruitment process may be cancelled at any level as per decision of District Level Selection Committee
  • Only on-line applications will be accepted. Application forms not properly filled in or incomplete application forms are liable to be cancelled. If the online application details submitted by the applicant differ with the original testimonials, that application shall liable to be cancelled
  • Candidates working in Government organizations must route their application through proper channel if their department rules requires so and produce NOC at the time of interview
  • Passport or Voter ID Card or AADHAAR Card will only be accepted as Photo cum Address proof
  • The age proof certificate like Birth Certificate/admit card / School leaving certificate issued by West Bengal Board of Secondary Education or similar board will only be validated as proof of age. Relaxation of age as per Govt. norms
  • Caste Category Certificate (if any), must be mentioned specifically in the caste certificate otherwise the candidate will be treated as "Unreserved" category
  • Instruction Regarding Caste Certificate Submission. All candidates applying under EWS Category or SC/ST/OBC(A)/OBC(B) reservation category must mandatorily submit a valid Caste Certificate issued by the Competent Authority of Government of West Bengal reservation order as per order vide Gazette memo no Registered No. WB/SC-247, No. WB(Part-I)/2025/SAR-262 to 266 Dated 10.06.2025 and Memo No 959-BCW/MR-52/2019 Dated 18.05.2023 of Chief Secretary and Caste category in compliance with the Labour Department, Govt. of West Bengal Order No. Labr/110-Emp/EC/IM-01/2025 dated 13/06/2025
  • Only certificates issued in the State of West Bengal will be accepted for reservation benefits
  • If the caste certificate is not submitted or found invalid at any stage of the recruitment process, the candidature will be treated as Cancelled or as Unreserved (UR) as decided by DLSC Paschim Bardhaman
  • The essential criteria mentioned are the minimum and mere possession of the same does not entitle the candidate to claim selection. All the essential qualifications must be completed on or before the date of advertisement and cut off date of experience if any to be considered as the date of advertisement
  • Caste Certificate issued on or before the date of online application, by the competent authorities of West Bengal only will be acceptable (wherever applicable)
  • Hard copy / Print copy of online registration form may be downloaded from the link https://hr.wbhealth.gov.in/ApplicantLogin/ApplicationPrint.aspx and should be retained by all applicants for document verification purpose. Without registration form, no candidates will be entertained for original testimonials verification by the authority. No need to send hard copy / print copy of the online registration form by post
  • Online registration number should be retained by all applicants for future reference. Employer is not liable to give any information regarding the online registration number in future
  • Candidates who are found eligible during the evaluation of online recruitment data duly filled by the candidates will only be called for documents verification. Therefore, candidates are instructed to fill the form properly
  • The DLSC decision is final in every steps of the recruitment process
  • The essential qualifications mentioned are the minimum and mere possession of the same does not entitles the candidates to claim selection
  • Applicants are requested to visit www.wbhealth.gov.in at the URL "Recruitment" regularly for instruction /information issued from time to time
  • The candidates, if found ineligible at any stage of recruitment process, will not be called for the subsequent stages of the selection process
  • The decision of the DLSC Paschim Bardhaman regarding the recruitment is final in every aspect. The panel of candidates will be valid for one year from the date of approval of panel and if any consecutive vacancy generated due to non join / resignation / termination /retirement or any other cause will be filled in from the available panel within the stipulated period. Number of vacancies indicated in advertisement likely to increase as per approval of the competent authority- if so those posts are to be filled up from the existing panel till its validity
  • Any corrigendum or addendum notice, date, time venue of interview, short listing of candidate or any other notice in this regard will be published in the following website http://www.wbhealth.gov.in

How to Apply

  • Applicants are requested to visit https://hr.wbhealth.gov.in for online application on and from 7th December 2025 onwards
  • Only online applications will be accepted
  • The Last date of Registration & online fees payment is 21.12.2025 and last date of Online submission of Application is 23.12.2025
  • Fill the online form properly; incomplete or mismatched details will lead to cancellation
  • Download and retain hard copy / print copy of online registration form from https://hr.wbhealth.gov.in/ApplicantLogin/ApplicationPrint.aspx for document verification
  • No need to send hard copy by post
